## REQ-260 — Help-me-price prices the contractor's own message, never under a cost they stated (demo M24)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11: "fix every issue the demo found." Demo issue **M24** (demo-report.md / demo-rca.md M24, CONFIRMED by analyst + skeptic): "Suggested prices far too low for a full bathroom gut ($1,450 / $1,750 / $2,100)" — for a gut whose message named a $2,800 plumbing sub.
**Cause (RCA M24):** in "I know the job, help me price it" the confirm picker's Continue (`AsstChat.tsx` applyJobOption, confirm branch) called `fetchPriceSuggestions(description || summary)` — the 3–4 terse confirmed bullets (≈3–7 words, prices dropped, `slice(0, 4)`) — so `POST /agents/job-details/prices` never saw the contractor's message; the `prompts.suggestPrices` rule "If none are given, price a typical small residential job" then priced a small job, and `SuggestPrices.normalize` had no floor. Side finding: `SuggestPrices` and `TranslateBullets` sent no `responseFormat: "json"`, so the OpenAI client attached the chat tools to these one-shot JSON calls.
**Requirement:** The pricing request carries the contractor's ORIGINAL typed message as `raw` and the confirmed bullets as `scope`; the model reads both (the message is the source of truth). The prompt treats any cost the contractor states as a FLOOR and never defaults a described job to "a typical small" one. Server-side, the largest dollar amount stated in the message is a floor: tiers at or under it are re-asked once naming it, and if they (or the generic fallback tiers) still sit under it they are scaled above it (spread and order kept). `SuggestPrices` and `TranslateBullets` ask for JSON mode.

## REQ-262 — Demo M25: the assistant honours "Spanish AND English", can change the job details after the quote exists, and answers in plain text
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11: "fix every issue the demo found" — demo issue **M25** ("AI ignored 'Spanish AND English', refused to change job details, then replied in raw markdown"; `demo-report.md`, RCA in `demo-rca.md` M25, CONFIRMED by analyst + skeptic).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on develop `53f3cfc`):** (a) the job options' languages came from settings only — `targetLangs()` = app language ∪ `commsLanguages` (`job-details-controller/mod.ts`), the typed "in Spanish and English" was never read; (b) after the wizard's POST /quotes the conversation is in `terms`, whose prompt said "Do NOT introduce … job-details changes — phase 1 is locked", and no tool could change a description — the reply "I can't change the job details at this stage" is that sentence; the model also never saw the saved quote (wizard quotes leave no action_card, no businessContext was passed); (c) no plain-text rule in either chat prompt, and the bubble renders text verbatim (`white-space:pre-wrap`), so "- **English:** …" showed its asterisks.

## REQ-261 — A contractor's private costs never reach customer job details (demo M26)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11, on the 20-agent demo report: "fix every issue the demo found" — demo issue **M26** ("AI put the contractor's private plumber cost into its proposed customer job details": asked to redo the job details in Spanish and English, the assistant wrote "El plomero Ray cobra $2,800 por la instalación"). ## REQ-240 — Demo M29: the customer and start date are on the agreement as soon as they are answered; a signed quote's invoice bills a named customer and is not due the day it is signed
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11 ("fix every issue the demo found"), demo issue **M29** — "Client and start date missing on the documents ('PARA —', 'INICIO Por agendar', 'FACTURAR A —'); invoice due the same day". RCA: `demo-rca.md` M29 (analyst + skeptic, UPHELD).

A quote with NO payment terms bills one full invoice on the standard net-7, or on the agreed completion date when that is later — never due the day of signing; explicit "Due Now" terms are unchanged (due that day).

## REQ-244 — The message box comes back after a quote is sent or signed, on every reload
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11: "fix every issue the demo found." Demo issue `quote-invoice-money-m5` ("No message box after signing, after reopening a sent quote, and during the wizard"; demo-report.md, pairs 1, 5, 7), root cause in demo-rca.md (CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD).
**Cause:** the assistant auto-opens the editable quote review for every "Ready to send" CTA it has not seen reviewed, and an open review hides the composer. The reviewed set (`reviewedCtas`, `autoOpenedCtasRef` in `front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx`) lived only in memory and started empty on every page load, so after any full load of a sent or signed quote the review re-opened — Send and the Quote/Invoice toggle active again — and the message box was gone. Only the in-session send cleared it.
**Requirement:** whether a send CTA is settled is read from the persisted thread: a send CTA followed by a phase-3 (`SendQuote`, sent) or phase-4 (`AcceptQuote`, signed) `phase_divider` for the same quote, or whose quote is accepted, counts as reviewed on every load. It does not auto-open the review, it renders its "sent" state, and the composer shows. A quote merely stamped `sent` by LockQuote (before the terms wizard) does not count, so the first review still opens on its own.
**Not changed:** the composer stays hidden during wizard steps (a deliberate tap-only design, Roadmap p.2); the RCA lists a compact composer there only as "consider". Left for a product decision.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/send-cta-settled.test.ts` ("REQ-244 …": phase-3 and phase-4 dividers settle; no divider, a phase-2 divider, another quote's divider or an earlier divider do not; missing quoteIds match; accepted settles, `sent` does not; non-send CTAs ignored) · integration n/a — no server change; the dividers this reads are already written and pinned by `send-quote/int.test.ts` and `accept-quote/int.test.ts` · e2e `e2e/sent-quote-composer/sent-quote-composer.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-244 …": wizard → review → send-quote → reload shows the composer and no review; the same after accept-quote).
**Evidence (2026-11-11, branch fix/quote-m5 off develop 53f3cfc):** RED first — the unit file failed to load (`Module not found … send-cta-settled.ts`); the e2e on the unfixed island → `✗ … expectation failed: the message box is back after a reload — expected 1, got 0` and `✗ … the message box is back after signing — expected 1, got 0` (the screenshot shows the "APPROVED" review with Send as Quote/Invoice re-opened over the signed quote). GREEN — `deno test front-end/lib/send-cta-settled.test.ts` → `ok | 10 passed | 0 failed`; `shots run e2e/sent-quote-composer e2e/wizard-tbd e2e/assistant-shell -- --no-check` → `6 pass · 0 fail`. `deno check` in front-end: 8 errors, the same 8 as develop (none in touched files); `deno lint` + `deno fmt --check` clean on the new files.
## REQ-245 — The assistant chat header says where the quote really is (demo m6)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11: "fix every issue the demo found." Demo issue `quote-invoice-money-m6` ("Chat header status wrong or stale ('Gathering a little more info' with the quote ready; 'Quote sent' on lock; 'New conversation')"), RCA in `demo-rca.md` (CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on develop `53f3cfc`):** AsstChat's `pm:asst-header` effect read the header off chat artifacts in a fixed order — the last `phase_divider`'s phase, then the last quote `action_card`'s status. (a) The terms wizard ends with a `continue_cta` (toPhase "send"), never a new divider (`handle-wizard-answer/mod.ts` completion), so the phase-2 divider kept the header on "Gathering a little more info" while the finished draft was open. (b) Lock flips the quote and its card to "sent" (M3), so the header said "Quote sent" / "Out for signature" before any send; a send that reached nobody also read "Out for signature" (M8). (c) With no customer and no `action_card` (the price flow never emits one) the title was "New conversation" even with a quote on the thread.
**Requirement:** the header is derived from the quote's lifecycle and the server's own send record (SendQuote's phase-3 divider, which carries `emailedTo` / `textedTo` or the failure), in one shared rule `shared/quote-flow/chat-header.ts` that AsstChat dispatches: accepted → "Quote accepted"; viewed, or a send that reached the customer → "Out for signature"; a send that reached nobody → "Not delivered"; the terms wizard asking → "Gathering a little more info"; the wizard finished (or terms on the quote) → "Ready to send"; locked and not sent (a lock card, `lockedAt`) → "Quote locked · ready to send"; any quote or draft card → "Quote drafted · review"; nothing → the default line. Title: the customer's name, else the quote's job name, else "Conversation" once a quote exists — "New conversation" only on a thread with no quote. Works with today's lock (status "sent") and with REQ-234's (status draft + `lockedAt`, card "locked").
**Not changed:** the SSR header on /assistant before the island hydrates, and the demo stage's frame (a replica limit, RCA section 2); the backend's lock/send semantics (M3, M8 are their own fixes).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/chat-header.test.ts` ("REQ-245 …": every status and title above, the latest send winning, a quote sent outside the chat; AsstChat's header effect calls `deriveChatHeader` and re-runs on terms/lockedAt/sentAt; en+es carry every key) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/chat-header.int.test.ts` ("REQ-245 …": the real LockQuote → TransitionToTerms → HandleWizardAnswer → SendQuote, each step's `LoadConversation` snapshot through `deriveChatHeader`: drafted → locked → gathering → ready to send → not delivered; with a customer email → out for signature under the customer's name) · e2e `e2e/chat-header-status/chat-header-status.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-245 …" in a browser: the header after each step of the same walk, wizard answered in the page).
**Evidence (2026-11-11, local, REQ-245):** RED first — jest unit "Cannot find module '../../shared/quote-flow/chat-header'"; against the old AsstChat the two wiring tests fail ("Tests: 2 failed, 24 passed"); `deno test` on the int file → TS2307 (module missing); the e2e story on the old island → "expectation failed: (c) a thread with a quote is never 'New conversation' (title: New conversation)". GREEN — `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 99 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 921 passed, 922 total"; `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/{send-quote,lock-quote,handle-wizard-answer,load-conversation}` → "ok | 34 passed | 0 failed"; `shots run e2e/chat-header-status` (server on PORT=57461) → "✓ REQ-245: the chat header follows the quote … · 9.2s"; `deno lint` clean, `deno check islands/AsstChat.tsx` only the two pre-existing errors (`cs.find` on `ClientsPageResponse`, present on develop).

## REQ-248 — A quote revision gives notice and a comparison, and every version names who published it (demo issue quote-invoice-money-m9)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found". Demo issue `quote-invoice-money-m9` — "Pair 5: a revision gives no notice or comparison; version 1 has publishedBy: {}" (demo-report.md; RCA in demo-rca.md, CONFIRMED + skeptic UPHELD).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on develop `53f3cfc`):** the first issue of a quote (SendQuote, LockQuote, SendPaperworkEmail/Sms, `PUT /quotes/:id {status:"sent"}`) stamped `sentAt` only — never `publishedAt`/`publishedBy` — so `applyRevision` filed version 1 with `publishedBy: {}` and `withCurrent` showed a never-revised quote the same way; `publishPendingQuote` (a send publishing a pending edit) stamped `{ userId }` with no name; the assistant's review card set its local total as if an issued quote's edit were live (it is a pending revision) and said nothing; the send divider read "emailed to …" even when the send published Version 2; the version history listed version + date only.
**Requirement:** (1) The first issue IS version 1's publication: whenever a quote first gets `sentAt` (any path — the stamp lives in `QuoteStore.update/updateIf/create`), it also gets `publishedAt = sentAt` and `publishedBy = { userId: owner }`, once. (2) No version is ever published by nobody: a filed or current version without a publisher reads as its owner, at its `sentAt`; `GET /quotes|invoices/:id/versions` names every publisher that carries a user id (the user's name today). (3) A send that publishes a pending edit stamps the sender `{ userId, name }`, and its divider leads with "Version N published · …" (payload `publishedVersion`). (4) The assistant's review card keeps the server's answer to a total / job-details edit; on an issued, unsigned quote with a pending edit it shows "Unpublished change — the customer still sees the sent version. Sending will publish Version N." (5) The quote panel's version history shows, under each version after the first, what it changed: "Total $1,000.00 → $1,200.00 · 1 line added · 1 line changed" (en/es).
**Not done (decision left to Raphael):** the RCA also suggested a "Changed from $X" line on the customer's public page. That shows the customer a previous price, which is a product decision, so it is not built here.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/quote-revision-notice.test.ts` ("REQ-248 …": firstIssueStamp, applyRevision's owner fallback, pendingRevisionNotice, versionChanges + versionChangeLine in both languages, the review card / quote panel wiring, both dictionaries) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/int.test.ts` ("REQ-248 send-quote: …": the first send stamps publishedAt/publishedBy; a re-Send that publishes a pending edit says "Version 2" in the divider and names the sender), `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/revisions-controller/e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-248: …" over the booted app: issued by PUT → version 1 named; a pending edit published by a send → both versions named; a pre-stamp row reads back with its owner's name at its sentAt) · e2e `e2e/quote-revisions/quote-revisions.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-248: …" in a browser: the quote panel's version history names "Revision Story" on both versions and shows "Total $1,000.00 → $1,200.00" under Version 2 only).
**Evidence (2026-11-11, local, worktree fix/quote-m9 off origin/develop `53f3cfc`):** RED first — jest unit "Tests: 12 failed, 12 total" (`firstIssueStamp is not a function`, applyRevision filed `publishedBy: {}`, …); `deno test` on the two backend files → 3 failed ("publishedAt stamped at the first issue"; divider "Quote + Agreement emailed to tom@example.com" with no version; versions[0].publishedBy `{}`); `shots run e2e/quote-revisions` → "expectation failed: the first issue stamps version 1's publisher". GREEN — `deno task test:unit` → "ok | 730 passed | 0 failed" and jest "Test Suites: 99 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 907 passed"; `deno task test:int` → "ok | 416 passed | 0 failed"; `deno test` over revisions/quote/public/invoice/work-order controllers, send-quote, lock-quote, send-paperwork-*, paperwork data → "ok | 96 passed | 0 failed"; `shots run e2e/quote-revisions e2e/linked-documents` → "5 pass · 0 fail". `deno lint` clean on the touched files; `deno check` on AsstChat.tsx shows only the 2 errors develop already has (TS2339 `ClientsPageResponse.find`, line ~3564).
## REQ-249 — The quote panel's ledger calls an unsigned quote's total "Quoted", never "Agreed"
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11, on the 20-agent demo report: "fix every issue the demo found." Demo issue `quote-invoice-money-m10` (Pair 5: "'Agreed $15,700.00' in the ledger of an unsigned quote"); RCA in `demo-rca.md` (CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD).
**Cause:** `ledgerSummary` (`shared/documents/linked-view.ts`, REQ-205, b233696) always emitted its first row with key `agreed`, and `QuotesPage.tsx` renders the label `quotes.ledger.${key}` — so a draft or sent quote read "Agreed $X" before anyone had signed.
**Requirement:** the first total in the quote panel's ledger reads "Quoted" ("Cotizado") while the quote is not accepted, and "Agreed" ("Acordado") once the customer has signed (`ledger.quote.accepted`, which the backend already sets from `status === "accepted"` or `acceptedAt`). Same amount either way (quote + approved change orders).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/linked-documents.test.ts` ("REQ-249 …": unsigned → `quoted` and no `agreed` row; signed → `agreed`; en/es carry "Quoted"/"Cotizado") · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/revisions-controller/e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-249: GET /quotes/:id/ledger — quote.accepted is false while the quote is only sent, true once it is signed": the booted app's contract the label depends on — green before the fix, a guard) · e2e `e2e/linked-documents/linked-documents.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-249: …": a sent quote's panel shows "Quoted $1,000.00" and no "Agreed"; after the customer signs, "Agreed $1,000.00"; the REQ-205 story now expects "Quoted $1,000.00" on its sent quote).
**Evidence (2026-11-11, local):** RED — jest unit "Tests: 2 failed" (`Expected "quoted" Received "agreed"`; `quotes.ledger.quoted` undefined); `shots run e2e/linked-documents` → 2 failed, `the page never showed "Quoted $1,000.00"`. GREEN — jest unit "Test Suites: 98 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 898 passed"; `deno test` revisions-controller e2e "ok | 8 passed | 0 failed"; `shots run e2e/linked-documents` → "5 passed | 0 failed" on both workers, rc 0; `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on the touched files.
## REQ-250 — A payment reminder is never sent to a customer who reported paying without the contractor saying so (demo quote-invoice-money-m12)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11: "fix every issue the demo found" — demo issue `quote-invoice-money-m12` (Pair 9: "a payment reminder can be sent after the client reported paying, with no warning"); RCA in `demo-rca.md` (analyst + skeptic, CONFIRMED / UPHELD).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked at develop `53f3cfc`):** (1) the back of a `claimed` invoice card (the customer said "I paid by Zelle, ref ZL-88412") rendered "Send a nudge" wired straight to `doSendNudge`, which POSTs `/api/cron/invoice-reminder` on the first click (`front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx`, the `invoice-nudge` button); (2) `pickNextDay` in `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/mod.ts` counted `claimed` as reminder-eligible (`["sent","viewed","claimed"]`), so the automatic day-3/7/14/30 sweep kept dunning a customer whose payment claim was pending.
**Requirement:** While a payment claim is pending (`status: "claimed"`), the automatic reminder cadence is paused — no rung fires. "Didn't get it" (reject-claim → `sent`) resumes it where it left off. On a claimed card, "Send a nudge" first asks inline (no browser dialog) — "{name} says they paid via {method} · ref {ref}. Send a payment reminder anyway?" — with "Send anyway" / "Cancel"; only "Send anyway" sends. Both languages.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/cadence.test.ts` ("REQ-250 …": `pickNextDay` on a claimed invoice is `undefined` at every rung; a rejected claim back at `sent` resumes at the next rung), `jest/unit/claimed-nudge-confirm.test.ts` ("REQ-250 m12 …": the claimed nudge opens the ask instead of sending; only the ask's yes calls `doSendNudge`; the copy is fed name/method/ref; the keys exist in en + es) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/int.test.ts` ("REQ-250 m12 …": `runAll` on a 5-days-overdue claimed invoice sends no email/text and writes no history; after the reject-claim patch it sends Day 3) · e2e `e2e/claimed-nudge/claimed-nudge.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-250 m12 …" in a browser: the customer claims Zelle ZL-88412; the nudge shows the ask naming Juan / Zelle / ZL-88412 and sends nothing; Cancel sends nothing; Send anyway sends exactly one reminder).
**Evidence (2026-11-11, local):** RED first — `deno test` on send-payment-reminder → "FAILED | 11 passed | 2 failed" (the claimed invoice got Day 30 from `pickNextDay`; `runAll` dispatched Day 3 over email + sms); jest → "Tests: 3 failed, 3 total"; `shots run e2e/claimed-nudge` against develop's InvoicesPage on a PORT=57250 server → "✗ … locator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded" (no ask; the click sent). GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/ src/paperwork/entrypoints/cron-controller` → "ok | 110 passed | 0 failed"; jest unit → "Test Suites: 99 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 898 passed, 899 total"; `shots run e2e/claimed-nudge` → "✓ REQ-250 m12 … · 2.2s"; `deno check` + `deno lint` + `deno fmt --check` clean on `islands/InvoicesPage.tsx`.
## REQ-251 — A signed quote hands the customer straight to payment: "Pay now $X" to the invoice the signature billed
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11, on the 20-agent demo: "fix every issue the demo found." Demo issue `quote-invoice-money-m13` ("Pair 9: no Pay button on a signed quote whose terms say 'Pago inmediato / Al firmar'"); RCA verdict FEATURE_GAP, skeptic UPHELD (demo-rca.md).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on develop 53f3cfc):** after accept, `PublicSignQuote` only reloads the page; the signed /q document (`front-end/components/quote-doc.tsx`) rendered the "Related documents" list (one small INV-001 row) and the PDF download, but no pay call-to-action. Accept always bills (`send-signed-confirmation` creates the first installment as `sent`), yet the hand-off to that invoice existed only in the confirmation email and on /i/:id.
**Requirement:** once the quote is accepted and an invoice billed against it is open (status `sent` or `viewed`, balance owed), the public /q page shows a primary "Pay now $X" / "Pagar ahora $X" button (`data-cy="quote-pay-now"`) linking that invoice's public page `/i/:id`, X its balance. The first open invoice in number / installment order wins. No button while the quote is unsigned, or when every invoice is paid, reported paid (`claimed`), void, draft or scheduled. The rule is one pure function, `payNowTarget()` in `shared/documents/linked-view.ts`.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/quote-pay-now.test.ts` ("REQ-251 …": the target for an accepted quote; none unsigned; non-payable statuses and zero balance; first open installment wins; url / balance fallbacks; quote-doc renders it; both languages carry `quoteDoc.payNow`) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/pay-now.int.test.ts` ("REQ-251: …": the booted app — a Due Now quote's public payload yields no target unsigned; after the real accept it points at the billed invoice with its full balance) · e2e `e2e/quote-pay-now/quote-pay-now.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-251: …": in Spanish, sign in the browser → "Pagar ahora $4,800.00" → its href is `/i/<billed invoice>` and clicking it opens that page).
**Evidence (2026-11-11, branch fix/quote-m13 off develop 53f3cfc):** RED first — jest unit "Tests: 8 failed" (`TypeError: payNowTarget is not a function`, the markup and keys missing); the int test "Type checking failed" (`payNowTarget` not exported); the e2e story on a dev stack at PORT=47613 "✗ … the click never took" (signing never produced `quote-pay-now`). GREEN — jest unit "Tests: 8 passed"; `deno test … pay-now.int.test.ts` "ok | 1 passed"; `shots run e2e/quote-pay-now e2e/linked-documents` → REQ-251 ✓ and the four linked-documents stories ✓. Neighbours: jest unit lane "99 passed, 903 passed, 1 skipped"; `deno test src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/` "24 passed | 0 failed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on quote-doc.tsx and linked-view.ts; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file.
## REQ-269 — The staff side follows the app language: /admin's body, its footer, the impersonation bar (demo i18n-formatting-m2)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found." Demo issue `i18n-formatting-m2` ("Staff side is half English in Spanish mode (/admin body, 'Searching…', footer, impersonation bar)"), RCA in `demo-rca.md` (verdict CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on develop `53f3cfc`):** `front-end/islands/AdminPage.tsx` had no `t()` call — every string a hard-coded English literal, the file even said it "deliberately doesn't touch the i18n dictionaries" — while the route's greeting used `tFor`, so a Spanish staff member read "Hola, Alex" over "Search users, grant or revoke admin, and impersonate.", "Searching…", Grant/Revoke/Demo. `front-end/islands/ImpersonationBanner.tsx` likewise ("Impersonating … (as …)", "Return to your account", "Returning…"). `front-end/routes/admin/index.tsx` rendered the server component `SiteFooter` with the SSR language, so the topbar's EN/ES toggle never reached the footer until a reload.
**Requirement:** every string /admin's console and the impersonation bar show comes from the dictionaries (`adminPage.*`, `impersonation.*`, en and es in step) through `t()`, so both follow `langSignal` — the app language and the topbar toggle — like every other page. /admin's footer is a live island (`SiteFooterLive`): the SSR language for the server render and the first client render (hydration matches), then `langSignal`, so EN/ES flips it at once. "Admin" (the role's name, REQ-191), "Demo" and "no" are the same word in both languages on purpose. A feature added to `shared/features.ts` before its dictionary keys still shows its registry label, never a raw key.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/staff-i18n.test.ts` ("REQ-269 …": no hard-coded English JSX text, placeholder/title/aria-label or ternary copy in AdminPage, the banner island or its view; both render with `t()`; every key used exists in en and es, translated; the adminPage/impersonation key sets match; /admin mounts `SiteFooterLive`, which reads `langSignal`), `front-end/lib/staff-i18n.test.tsx` (`cd front-end && deno test -A lib/staff-i18n.test.tsx` — renders AdminPage and `ImpersonationBannerView` with preact-render-to-string under es and en; `liveLang` gives the SSR language until hydrated, then the signal) · integration n/a — no server or API behaviour changed; the copy is client-rendered from the bundled dictionaries · e2e `e2e/staff-i18n/staff-i18n.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-269 …": a Spanish super admin's /admin lead, tabs, search, placeholder and footer are Spanish; EN in the topbar flips the body AND the footer without a reload; impersonating a Spanish account, the bar reads "Suplantando a … · Volver a tu cuenta"). Updated to follow the copy into the dictionaries: `jest/unit/role-labels.test.ts` (REQ-191), `jest/unit/demo-mode-protocol.test.ts` (REQ-179, REQ-153), `jest/unit/impersonation-banner-room.test.ts` (REQ-181).
**Evidence (2026-11-11, local):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern staff-i18n` → "Tests: 10 failed, 1 passed, 11 total" (e.g. AdminPage JSX text `["Admin","Users","Accounts",…,"No users found."]`, ternary copy `["Searching…","Search","Revoke","Grant","Opening…","Demo",…]`, banner `["Returning…","Return to your account"]`); `deno test -A lib/staff-i18n.test.tsx` against the old AdminPage → "AssertionError: English left in the Spanish /admin: Search users, grant or revoke admin, and impersonate."; `shots run e2e/staff-i18n` against the old islands → "✗ REQ-269 … expectation failed: Spanish lead (Search users, grant or revoke admin, and impersonate.)". GREEN — jest unit "Test Suites: 99 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 909 passed, 910 total"; `deno test -A lib/staff-i18n.test.tsx` → "ok | 4 passed | 0 failed"; `SUPERADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN=… shots run e2e/staff-i18n e2e/admin-features e2e/impersonation-banner -- --no-check` → "3 pass · 0 fail"; `deno fmt --check`, `deno lint`, `deno check` clean on the seven touched front-end files.
## REQ-270 — Demo stage chrome: the Spanish hint speaks of one customer, the stage keeps the staff's language, and has a real font
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11, on the 20-agent demo: "fix every issue the demo found" — demo issue `i18n-formatting-m3` ("Demo pill/stage chrome wording: 'Alex from DocuMonster' untranslated, 'ellos' for one customer, stage pill language flips, monospace/unstyled font"); root cause in `demo-rca.md` (RC-B).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on develop `53f3cfc`):** (a) "Alex from DocuMonster" is the staff account's `user.name` that the demo harness set — data, not a UI string; no change. (b) `lang/es.json` `demoMode.pointOnlyHint` was "Ves lo que ven. Tú señalas, ellos hacen clic." — a plural for one customer. (c) `routes/demo/stage.tsx` resolved the staff's language for the `<title>` only and rendered `<DemoStage />` bare, so the island took `langSignal` from `localStorage["pm:lang"]` — which the same-origin replica frame (the customer's app under impersonation) overwrote through `setLang → persistLang` on every profile seed / EN-ES click, flipping the stage on its next load. (d) `/demo/stage` linked no stylesheet and the pill/banner use `font:inherit`, so they got the browser's default font.
**Requirement:** the Spanish hint names one customer ("Ves lo que ve el cliente. Tú señalas, el cliente hace clic."); the stage renders in the staff's own `user.language` (`<DemoStage initialLang={lang} />`, seeded into `langSignal` before the first client render); inside the replica frame (`window.name === "pm-demo-replica"` and framed) `persistLang` writes neither `pm:lang` nor the `pm_lang` cookie; `/demo/stage` links `/demo-stage.css` (keyed `css-demo-stage`), which gives the page the app's body font (Inter, system-ui fallback).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-stage-chrome.test.ts` ("REQ-270 …": the es hint is singular; `persistLang` in a replica-named framed window writes nothing, in a normal or unframed window still writes both; lang.ts names the same frame as replica.ts; the route passes `initialLang` and links the keyed sheet; the island seeds `langSignal` from it; the sheet sets the body font) — `jest/unit/demo-mode-replica.test.ts` widened to accept `<DemoStage …props />` · integration n/a — the change is a client-side storage guard, a route prop and a static sheet; no server behaviour changes · e2e n/a — the flip needs a staff session and an impersonated customer session sharing one origin with a live replica frame; the storage guard is proven in the unit test against a fake framed window.
**Evidence (2026-11-11, local):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-stage-chrome` → "Tests: 6 failed, 1 passed, 7 total" (es string "…ellos hacen clic."; `pm:lang` received "en" inside the frame; no `initialLang`; no `/demo-stage.css`). GREEN — the same → "Tests: 7 passed, 7 total"; whole jest unit project → "Test Suites: 99 passed, 99 total · Tests: 1 skipped, 902 passed, 903 total"; `deno lint` + `deno check` on `islands/DemoStage.tsx`, `lib/lang.ts`, `routes/demo/stage.tsx` clean.

A customer just added — balance 0, no quotes, no revenue, contacted today — skipped every branch (owes, active, lead, regular-with-revenue, cold) and the fallback returned `"regular"`; the page then drew the "Habitual"/"Regular" label, mood and story line. Paid work keeps a customer `regular`; owes, active, lead and cold are unchanged.

**Evidence (2026-11-11, local):** RED first — backend `deno test --no-check` → "FAILED | 27 passed | 2 failed" (int: actual `regular`, expected `new`; clients-page: no `new` filter), type check "TS2322 Type '\"new\"' is not assignable to type 'CustomerStatus'"; jest → "Tests: 4 failed" (`statusLabel("new","es")` undefined, no keys, no chip); `shots run e2e/new-customer-status` → "expectation failed: the card says Cliente nuevo (… habitual … cliente habitual. última actividad hace un momento.)". GREEN — `deno task test:unit` → "ok | 734 passed | 0 failed", jest "Test Suites: 99 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 899 passed, 900 total"; `deno task test:int` → "ok | 415 passed | 0 failed"; `shots run e2e/new-customer-status e2e/clients-pages` → "2 pass · 0 fail"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on the touched front-end and backend files.
## REQ-272 — The public invoice (/i/:id) has the same EN | ES switch as the contract
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11: "fix every issue the demo found". Demo issue `i18n-formatting-m7`: "Public invoice /i/ has no EN/ES switch; the quote page has one" (demo-rca.md; RCA verdict FEATURE_GAP, skeptic UPHELD).
**Cause (RCA at fb6d4fa, re-checked on develop 53f3cfc):** REQ-048 gave only the contract (/q) an EN | ES toggle and a `?lang=` input (`resolveContractLang`). `front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx` resolved its language with `resolvePublicLang({cookie, docLang, header})` (`shared/quote-flow/public-lang.ts`), which never read `?lang=`, and rendered no toggle. A customer who got a Spanish invoice had no way to read it in English, and `/i/:id?lang=en` still painted Spanish.
**Requirement:** /i/:id renders an EN | ES toggle above the invoice. Each choice is a link to the same page with `?lang=` set (works before hydration and without JavaScript); a tap also saves the pick (pm_lang cookie + localStorage), so a later plain visit opens in the chosen language. The language precedence for the public money pages is now: `?lang=` on the link → the visitor's pm_lang cookie → the document's language (contractor `commsLanguage`) → Accept-Language → English. `<html lang>` says the language the page paints. The invoice still opens in the document's language when the visitor has made no choice (P-12 stands); REQ-048's English-first rule stays specific to the contract.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/invoice-lang.test.ts` ("REQ-272 …": `?lang=` beats cookie, doc and header; junk/absent keeps the P-12 order; `langToggleHref` keeps the path and other params; the /i route feeds `?lang=` and renders `PublicLangToggle`, which persists the pick) · integration `jest/integration/invoice-lang.int.test.ts` ("REQ-272 …" over the dev stack: an ES-comms contractor's invoice opens Spanish with ES current and an EN link to `?lang=en`; `?lang=en` renders English with `<html lang="en">`; `?lang=en` beats `pm_lang=es`) · e2e `e2e/invoice-lang/invoice-lang.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-272: …" in a browser: opens Spanish, EN switches to English with `?lang=en`, a plain revisit stays English, ES switches back).
**Evidence (2026-11-11, branch fix/i18n-m7 off develop 53f3cfc, dev stack on PORT=57391):** RED first — jest unit 7 of 8 failed (`Expected: "en" Received: "es"`, `langToggleHref is not a function`, the route had no `searchParams.get("lang")` nor `PublicLangToggle`); integration 3/3 failed (no toggle in the SSR HTML); e2e failed `locator.getAttribute: Timeout` (no toggle on the page). GREEN — jest unit project "Test Suites: 99 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 903 passed"; integration `invoice-lang|contract-lang` "6 passed"; `shots run e2e/invoice-lang e2e/contract-lang` "4 pass · 0 fail". The new suite caught one Fresh behaviour: its active-link marking sets `aria-current` on every `<a>` whose path is the current page, so both toggle links said "current". The toggle now sets `aria-current` explicitly ("true"/"false"), which Fresh leaves alone. `deno check` + `deno lint` + `deno fmt --check` clean on the touched front-end and shared files. Pre-existing and unrelated: `footer-contact.int.test.ts` "REQ-044 /dashboard" answers 302 with and without this change.
## REQ-276 — Spanish wording and formats read as Spanish (demo issue i18n-formatting-m8)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11, on the 20-agent demo: "fix every issue the demo found". Demo issue `i18n-formatting-m8` ("Spanish wording and formats: calques, English words, English formats, usted/tú mix, 'cuatro cien cincuenta', mixed-language send result"); RCA in `demo-rca.md` (analyst + skeptic, CONFIRMED at `fb6d4fa`).

"en"`) around an SMS reason already in the contractor's UI language (REQ-030), and passed the dispatchers' English "no recipient: pass `to` …" into it; (7) job names that come back from the translate endpoint or an LLM's per-language names were stored Title Cased ("Corte De Césped").
**Requirement:** A Spanish contractor reads Spanish formats and wording everywhere this issue named: the date line is "Miércoles · 11 de noviembre" (en keeps "Wednesday · November 11"); chat times are written in the app language ("8:55 p. m." / "8:55 PM"); amounts in words follow Spanish grammar ("cuatrocientos cincuenta dólares", "veintiún dólares", "un dólar con un centavo", "mil", "un millón de dólares"); no "luces encendidas" calque, no "Bloqueamos", no "pipeline", no "PM" assistant (either language); the quote document speaks tú ("¿Preguntas sobre tu proyecto?"); the send note is one language — the contractor's UI language, the missing-recipient reason included; Spanish job names are stored sentence case whatever wrote them. One shared pure module carries the formatters: `shared/quote-flow/locale-format.ts` (`numberInWords`, `amountInWords`, `formatClockTime`, `formatGreetingDate`), plus `jobNameCase` in `shared/quote-flow/job-name.ts`. The dead `moneyInput.words/ones/tens.*` dictionary keys (39 per language) are removed with the English-grammar code.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/es-wording-formats.test.ts` ("REQ-276 …": Spanish and English numbers and amounts in words, clock times, the date line, the dictionary copy, MoneyInput/MessageBubble/AsstChat/DashTopbar wiring, `jobNameCase`) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/int.test.ts` ("REQ-276 send-quote: …": a Spanish-UI contractor sending in English to a fictional 555 number gets a Spanish note around the Spanish reason; a missing recipient reads "sin destinatario", not the English machine reason) · e2e `e2e/es-wording-formats/es-wording-formats.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-276: …" in a browser as a Spanish contractor: the /dashboard date line in Spanish order, /customers "Son los que te dan de comer.", /quotes "Todavía no hay nada en curso.", no calque, no "pipeline").
**Evidence (2026-11-11, branch fix/i18n-m8 off develop 53f3cfc):** RED first — jest `--testPathPattern es-wording-formats` → "Tests: 47 failed, 47 total" (`Cannot find module '../../shared/quote-flow/locale-format'`, `jobNameCase is not a function`, the dictionary/wiring assertions); send-quote int → `AssertionError: divider in Spanish: Quote + Agreement text failed — ese es un número 555 ficticio …` (the demo's exact mixed line), and the missing-recipient case → `Cotización + Acuerdo no entregada — correo: no recipient: pass \`to\` …`; e2e → `expectation failed: date line in Spanish order ("11 de noviembre"): "Miércoles · noviembre 11"`. GREEN — jest REQ-276 "47 passed", full jest unit "Test Suites: 99 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 942 passed"; `deno test` send-quote + lock-quote + send-paperwork-sms "13 passed | 0 failed", wizard-controller e2e "5 passed"; `shots run e2e/es-wording-formats` → "1 pass · 0 fail". `deno lint` clean on the touched front-end and backend files; `deno check` clean on them except two TS errors at `AsstChat.tsx` `cs.find` (`ClientsPageResponse`), which are on origin/develop as they are (line 3506 there) and not this change.
## REQ-273 — The topbar's live-activity pill counts up from "just now" and always shows the event's text (demo i18n-formatting-m10)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11 ("fix every issue the demo found"). Demo issue `i18n-formatting-m10` (pair 2: "'hace 1m' ticker pill does not count up (and shows no event text)"); RCA in `demo-rca.md` / scratchpad `issues/i18n-m10.json`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked at develop `53f3cfc`):** `front-end/islands/DashTopbar.tsx` `fmtAgo` clamped every age with `Math.max(1, floor(Δ/60000))`, so an event 0-119 s old read "1m" and a fresh one never said "just now"; and in `assistant-page.css` (and `dashboard.css`) the pill was `min-width: 0` and its text track `min-width: 0`, so on the crowded /assistant topbar the track collapsed to 0 px — reproduced in a browser at 1280×800: track width 0px, only "● hace 1m" left. /assistant also had no phone rule hiding the pill (the dashboard did).
**Requirement:** The pill's age is "just now" / "ahora mismo" under a minute (and for a timestamp slightly ahead, clock skew), then whole minutes, hours, days ("2m ago" / "hace 2m"), recomputed on every rotation tick so it counts up. The text track never collapses below 120 px and the pill never shrinks below its content, so the event's words are always visible beside the time. On phones (≤ 640 px) /assistant hides the pill, as the dashboard does.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/topbar-ticker.test.ts` ("REQ-273 …": `front-end/lib/ticker-age.ts` — 0/30/59 s just now, 60/119 s 1m, 120 s 2m, h, d, counting up, skew, bad date; both dictionaries carry `dashTopbar.justNow`; DashTopbar uses it, no clamp; both stylesheets give the track ≥ 100 px and the pill no `min-width: 0`; assistant-page.css hides the pill ≤ 640 px) · integration n/a — no server behaviour changes (the notification feed is untouched); the fix is a pure formatter + stylesheet · e2e `e2e/topbar-ticker/topbar-ticker.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-273: …" in a browser on /assistant at 1280×800: a 5-second-old event — the feed answered by a page route — shows its words in a ≥ 100 px track and "just now"; at 390 px the pill is hidden).
**Evidence (2026-11-11, local):** RED — jest unit on the interim module (the old clamp moved verbatim) → "Tests: 8 failed, 1 passed" (e.g. Expected `{key: "dashTopbar.justNow"}` got `timeAgo "1m"`; track min-width "Expected: >= 100, Received: 0"; no ≤640px rule); shots story → "expectation failed: the text track is wide enough to read (0px)". GREEN — `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 99 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 904 passed"; `shots run e2e/topbar-ticker` (serve on a random high port, `DENO_DEPLOY=true`) → "✓ REQ-273 … 1 pass · 0 fail"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on `islands/DashTopbar.tsx` and `lib/ticker-age.ts`.

## REQ-275 — Demo copy polish: "Once an agreement", one preposition in "paid via Zelle", "1 confirmada", "Cancellation", a labelled note dot, "customer. They'll"
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11, after the 20-agent demo: "fix every issue the demo found". Demo issue `i18n-formatting-m13` (demo-report.md: "Once a agreement", "pagó por por Zelle", "1 confirmadas", "CANCELATION", "Note ·"). RCA: demo-rca.md, `i18n-formatting-m13` (CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked at 53f3cfc):** (a) `invoicesPage.sub.empty` said "Once a agreement". (b) `invoicesPage.read.claimed` carried the preposition ("paid via {method}" / "pagó por {method}") and `methodLabel` fills `{method}` with a label that carries it again ("via Zelle" / "por Zelle"), giving "paid via via Zelle" / "pagó por por Zelle". Introduced in b6ec538. (c) `invoicesPage.kpi.paidSub` had one form ("{n} confirmadas") for every count. (d) "Cancelation" (term row, PDF, termination clause), where the rest of the copy says "Cancellation". (e) The worker's Note button appended a literal " ·" when the visit had a note. (f) The empty clients hero put `<br />` straight after "first customer.", so its text read "customer.They'll".

The paid KPI has `.one`/`.other` forms ("1 confirmada", "2 confirmadas"), picked by the new `tnFor(lang, key, n)`. "Once an agreement". English spells it "Cancellation" everywhere. This revises REQ-035's "Cancelation" spelling, and REQ-035's unit test and cypress spec now assert "Cancellation". A note on a visit shows as a small dot with `aria-label` "Has a note" / "Tiene una nota" (`worker.hasNote`), not " ·". A space before the `<br />` in the clients hero.

GREEN — unit `worker-|sidebar-` "5 passed, 15 passed"; integration "Tests: 2 passed"; `shots run e2e/worker-office-link e2e/field-tasks` → "13 pass · 0 fail". `deno lint`, `deno check`, `deno fmt --check` clean on the touched and new files. ## REQ-285 — the /worker screen opens in the worker's language (REQ-155 amended: the language is the screen's too)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11: "fix every issue the demo found" — demo issue `customers-payments-fieldops-m3` ("Worker created with language Spanish, but /worker opened in English"); RCA in `demo-rca.md` (verdict FEATURE_GAP, skeptic UPHELD): REQ-155 used the worker's language for the welcome text only; /worker picked its language from `?lang=`, else the browser's `pm_lang` cookie, else Spanish, and nothing switched it after sign-in — `publicWorker` answered `{id, name, role}`, `WorkerMe` had no language, and the welcome link was a bare `/worker`. Signing a Spanish worker in from the English owner's browser showed English; an English worker on a fresh phone got Spanish.
**Requirement:** A worker's language (REQ-155) is also the language of their /worker screen. The welcome text's link carries it (`/worker?lang=es|en`). `POST /field/worker/login` and `GET /field/worker/me` answer `language` — the worker's own, else the owner's (REQ-155's fallback for workers from before). Once signed in, the screen switches to that language, unless the person chose one: the EN/ES switch on the screen, or a `?lang=` in the address. Logging out forgets a switch made on the screen, so the next worker's language applies.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/field/domain/business/worker-welcome/test.ts` ("REQ-285 workerSignInUrl — …") · unit `front-end/lib/field.test.ts` ("REQ-285 workerScreenLang — …" ×3) · unit `jest/unit/worker-screen-lang.test.ts` ("REQ-285 the worker screen takes the worker's language": `WorkerMe.language`, the route's `langChosen`, the island's wiring) · integration `backend/src/field/entrypoints/worker-welcome.int.test.ts` ("REQ-285 a Spanish worker's welcome link carries ?lang=es …; login and /me answer the worker's language", "REQ-285 a worker from before REQ-155 … is answered in the owner's language"; REQ-151's exact body and REQ-138's login answer in `field.int.test.ts` amended for the new `?lang=en` and `language`) · e2e `e2e/worker-language/worker-language.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-285: an English owner's browser opens /worker, a Spanish worker signs in, the screen turns Spanish; EN sticks once picked").
**Evidence (2026-11-11, local):** RED — backend unit `TS2305 … no exported member 'workerSignInUrl'`; int `7 passed | 3 failed` (the Spanish welcome read `…/worker con este número` with no `?lang=es`; the old worker's login had no `language`; REQ-151's exact body); `front-end/lib/field.test.ts` `TS2305 … no exported member 'workerScreenLang'`; jest `Tests: 3 failed`; `shots run e2e/worker-language` → `locator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded` waiting for "Hola, Luis" (the screen stayed English). GREEN — `workerSignInUrl` in `worker-welcome/mod.ts` and the welcome uses it; `publicWorker` in the worker controller answers `language: workerLang(w, owner)` (the owner read only when the worker has none); `WorkerMe.language`; the route passes `langChosen` (a `?lang=`); `WorkerScreen.load()` applies `workerScreenLang(who, langChosenRef.current)`, the switch sets the ref, logout resets it. `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/field/` → `70 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A lib/field.test.ts` → `10 passed`; jest unit project → `898 passed, 1 skipped`; `shots run e2e/worker-language e2e/field-tasks` on the host (shots' own serve on a free port) → `12 pass · 0 fail`. `deno lint` (the two findings in `src/field/` are on untouched lines, present on develop), `deno check` and `deno fmt` clean on the touched files (`worker-controller/mod.ts` was not fmt-clean on develop and was left unformatted).

## REQ-288 — The assignments map starts on the business, not on Myrtle Beach (demo customers-payments-fieldops-m5)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11: "fix every issue the demo found" — demo issue `customers-payments-fieldops-m5` (pair 8: "map centred on Myrtle Beach SC for an Austin business"), RCA in `demo-rca.md` (CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on develop `53f3cfc`):** `front-end/islands/FieldAssignmentsPage.tsx` created the Leaflet map with a hard-coded `setView([33.69, -78.93], 11)` — Myrtle Beach, the dev seed's town — and re-fit only when there were subscription points, so an account with no subscriptions kept Myrtle Beach. The business's own address was never read. On the dev stack the fake geocoder also drew every address that was not hand-placed inside the Myrtle Beach box, whatever state it named.
**Requirement:** With subscriptions on the map, the map fits them (unchanged). With none, it starts on the business's own place: `GET /field/regions/center` geocodes the profile address (Settings → address; street/city/state/ZIP, a street alone is not enough) once per address — cached under the user, re-geocoded only when the address changes — and answers `{lat, lng, zoom: 11, source: "business"}`. No address, or one the geocoder cannot place (or no geocoder configured) → the whole continental US (`zoom 4`, `source: "none"`); the island also opens on that view, never on a seed town. Off the real deploy, the fake geocoder puts an address that names a state after a comma (`…, Austin, TX 78701`) around that state's capital; SC and stateless addresses keep the Myrtle Beach box the seeded data and tests use. REQ-187's replica mirror still overrides the starting view.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/field/domain/business/map-center/test.ts` ("REQ-288 …": the address line, the US view, the fake geocoder puts Austin, TX in Austin and keeps the seeded/stateless places), `front-end/lib/field-map.test.ts` ("REQ-288 …": `assignmentsMapView` fits points, else the business centre, else the US; the island has no seed-town literal and asks for the centre); `jest/unit/demo-mode-replica.test.ts` REQ-187 anchor follows the new fit call · integration `backend/src/field/entrypoints/field.int.test.ts` ("REQ-288 GET /field/regions/center …": no address → US view; an Austin, TX address → Austin, zoom ≥ 9; geocoded once per address, again when it changes; 401 signed out) · e2e n/a — the map's tiles and Leaflet come from the unpkg/OSM CDNs at runtime and the browser lane is not run in this parallel fleet; the view choice is covered by the pure `assignmentsMapView` test and the endpoint by the integration test.
**Evidence (2026-11-11, branch fix/customers-m5 off develop `53f3cfc`):** RED first — backend unit: TS2307 (`map-center/mod.ts` did not exist); integration: `Values are not equal` `404` vs `200` on `GET /field/regions/center`; front-end: type-check failed, `assignmentsMapView`/`US_MAP_VIEW` not exported. GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/field` (backend) → "ok | 73 passed | 0 failed"; `deno test -A lib/` (front-end) → "ok | 42 passed | 0 failed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 98 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 895 passed". `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on the touched front-end files; `deno lint src/field` shows only the 2 problems already on develop.
## REQ-289 — Demo fix customers-payments-fieldops-p1: every form field is named by its label, and the New customer modal is a dialog
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11: "fix every issue the demo found" — demo issue `customers-payments-fieldops-p1` (demo-report.md; root cause in demo-rca.md, analyst + skeptic CONFIRMED/UPHELD at `fb6d4fa`).

The assistant's new-customer phone and email inputs carry an `aria-label` (the same localized words as their placeholders, en and es). The /customers New customer form is `role="dialog"` `aria-modal="true"`, named by its heading through `aria-labelledby`, and Escape closes it (as the backdrop click does; not while saving).

## REQ-278 — A customer's phone and email are checked when the customer is saved (demo M16)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11, on the 20-agent demo report: "fix every issue the demo found". Demo issue **M16**: bad phones ("123", "555-12", "512-555-01") and emails ("davis@@gmail") were accepted and saved as a customer's contact; the bad phone surfaced only at Send ("invalid phone: 512-555-01"), after the quote was already addressed to it.
**Cause (RCA M16, analyst + skeptic, at fb6d4fa):** no layer checked the format. `CreateCustomerDto`/`UpdateCustomerDto` declared `email`/`phoneNumber` only `@IsOptional @IsString`; the assistant's `create_new` (handle-wizard-answer) built the customer by hand and never went through the DTO; AsstChat's "Who is this for?" inputs sit outside a `<form>` (Next is `type=button`), so the browser's `type=email` check never ran; the /customers modal's `type=tel` has no pattern and `type=email` takes "carl@x"; the only phone check (`normalizeE164`) ran at SMS send time.
**Requirement:** One shared rule, `shared/quote-flow/customer-contact.ts`, decides whether a typed contact is usable: a phone is one the SMS send path can dial (10 digits, 11 starting with 1, or `+` and 7–15 digits); an email has REQ-050's address shape. Blank is not a format error. It is applied wherever a customer is SAVED: `parseCreateCustomer`/`parseUpdateCustomer` (POST/PUT `/customers`) answer 400 with the message `customer.invalidPhone` / `customer.invalidEmail`; the assistant's `create_new` refuses in the contractor's language and creates no customer; AsstChat's create form keeps Next disabled and shows the reason; the /customers "New customer" modal refuses before POST with the message inline. Both dictionaries carry the two messages. The stored value is kept as typed (not rewritten to E.164).

## REQ-252 — A non-image file is never the business logo (demo issue M30)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11: "fix every issue the demo found" — demo issue M30 (`demo-report.md`, pair 6: a text file named `factura.pdf` picked as the logo in Settings was accepted silently, "Logo cargado · 514184e6…", and the logo on the customer's documents then drew as a broken image, `naturalWidth` 0). Root cause in `demo-rca.md` (M30, confirmed by the skeptic): the only type check anywhere was the file input's `accept="image/*"` hint; `POST /files` stores any bytes, `PUT /profile/identity` took any string as `logoFileId`, `/public-logo` served the stored bytes under the stored type, the documents drew the `<img>` whenever a logo id was on record, and Settings showed the file id instead of the logo.

A logo already on record that is not an image is never served: `/public-logo/:kind/:id` answers 404 for it and serves a real one under the type its bytes have, and the public quote/invoice say `hasLogo: false`, so no broken `<img>` is drawn. Both logo pickers (Settings, the welcome wizard) refuse a file whose type is not one of the four before uploading anything, with a message in the app's language, show the server's refusal the same way, and offer only the four types in the picker. ## REQ-280 — Demo issue M33: what is typed into the amount field is what the field holds
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11, on the 20-agent demo report: "fix every issue the demo found". This entry is demo issue M33 — "Typed text in the amount field gets reversed in the hidden input ('-50abc' shows $50.00, input value '50cba')" (demo-report.md; RCA in demo-rca.md, M33, verdict CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on develop `53f3cfc`):** `front-end/islands/MoneyInput.tsx` lays a transparent, controlled `<input value={display}>` over the odometer. `handleInput` formatted the raw text (`formatTyping` keeps only digits and one dot) and set state; Preact writes a controlled value back only when state changed, so a keystroke that left the amount unchanged (a letter, a minus) stayed in the field — and the caret, put back after the digits, sat in front of it, so the next letter landed before the last: "-50abc" → field "50cba", shown $50.00. Introduced in `aa7734c`.
**Requirement:** After every keystroke the amount field holds exactly the formatted amount the odometer shows: anything that is not a digit or the decimal point is dropped from the field itself, the caret stays where the typing was, and a form posting the field's `name` sends that amount. The typing logic lives in `front-end/lib/money-input.ts` (`typeMoney` writes the formatted text back into the field every keystroke); `/dev/money-input` mounts the island alone for the browser test (404 on the real deploy).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/money-input-typing.test.ts` ("REQ-280 …": a browser-and-Preact model of the field — "-50abc" leaves "50", 5000 cents, caret 2; field equals display after every keystroke; a letter typed mid-number is dropped and the next digit lands in place; `typeMoney` writes the field) · integration n/a — the fix is client-side input handling with no request or server state; the amount the assistant saves already came from the island's cents (RCA) · e2e `e2e/money-input/money-input.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-280: …" in a browser on /dev/money-input: type "-50abc" → `input.value` "50", "Cents: 5000", caret 2; then "x7" → "507").
**Evidence (2026-11-11, local, branch fix/m33 off develop `53f3cfc`):** RED first, with the logic extracted unchanged — jest `money-input-typing` → "Tests: 4 failed, 1 passed" (`Expected: "50" Received: "50cba"`); `shots run e2e/money-input` → "expectation failed: the field holds what the odometer shows — expected \"50\", got \"50cba\"". GREEN after the fix — jest unit project "Test Suites: 99 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 900 passed"; `shots run e2e/money-input` → "1 pass · 0 fail". `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on the touched front-end files; `deno fmt` on the new files (MoneyInput.tsx was already not fmt-clean on develop and is left as it was).
## REQ-281 — /payments shows a customer's payment claim under "Needs attention" until it is confirmed or rejected (demo M34)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11, on the 20-agent demo report: "fix every issue the demo found". Demo issue **M34**: "A customer's Zelle payment claim does not appear on /payments ('NECESITA ATENCIÓN 0 · EN TRÁNSITO $0')".
**Cause (demo-rca.md M34, analyst + skeptic UPHELD):** /payments was built only from recorded Payment rows. A customer's "I paid by X" from the public invoice is not a Payment: it sits on the invoice (`status: "claimed"` + `paymentIntent`) until `confirm-payment` records one. `PaymentsPage` used invoices only to label payments, `deriveStatus` never produced `attention` (the docstring said "reserved for future"), and Zelle settles in 0 days, so a waiting claim showed as "Needs attention 0" under the empty "nothing has arrived yet" hero. /invoices was the only place it showed.
**Requirement:** every invoice with status `claimed` is an attention item on /payments. It shows the client, the invoice number, the claimed amount (the claim's own cents, or the invoice amount if there is no intent), the method (unknown → "other"), the customer's reference and when they claimed, newest first. The "Needs attention" KPI counts these items and "held up" sums them. The fresh hero does not show while one is waiting. Each card has **Got it / Lo recibí** (`POST /api/invoices/:id/confirm-payment`, which records the Payment so it lands) and **Didn't get it / No me llegó** (`POST /api/invoices/:id/reject-claim`, which reopens the invoice). Either one reloads the page data, and a failure shows on the card. The derivation is pure (`front-end/lib/payment-claims.ts` `pendingClaims`). The copy is in en and es.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/payment-claims.test.ts` ("REQ-281 …": `pendingClaims` over claimed vs other statuses, the amount/method fallbacks, the order, a non-array payload; PaymentsPage takes attention from `pendingClaims(s.invoices…)` and its cards call both endpoints; every new key in en and es) · integration `jest/integration/payment-claims.int.test.ts` ("REQ-281 …" against the dev stack: a public Zelle claim leaves no Payment row, but `pendingClaims` over the live `GET /invoices` gives one item with the claim's amount, reference and claimant; confirm clears it and lands a Payment; reject clears it and records none) · e2e `e2e/payment-claims/payment-claims.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-281: …" in a browser: after a public claim, /payments shows one claim card (client, $420, Zelle, ref), the attention KPI reads 1 and "$420 held up" shows; "Got it" removes the card, the KPI reads 0 and the payment is recorded).
**Evidence (2026-11-11, local, worktree of origin/develop `53f3cfc`, server on PORT=6734):** RED first. jest unit: "Tests: 16 failed, 16 total" ("Cannot find module '../../front-end/lib/payment-claims'", plus the page and key pins). jest integration (`API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:6734/api`): "Tests: 3 failed, 3 total" (same missing module). shots e2e: "✗ REQ-281 … locator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded" (no claim card on /payments). GREEN: jest unit `--testPathPattern payment-claims` "Tests: 16 passed"; the whole jest unit project "Test Suites: 99 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 911 passed"; integration "Tests: 3 passed, 3 total"; `shots run e2e/payment-claims` "✓ REQ-281 … 1.4s". `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on `islands/PaymentsPage.tsx` and `lib/payment-claims.ts`.

## REQ-287 — The demo's issues get fixed: no shortcut hint (⌘N, ⌘K) that nothing handles (demo test-setup-claims-m2)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11, after the 20-agent demo (demo-report.md / demo-rca.md): "fix every issue the demo found". This entry is demo issue `test-setup-claims-m2` — "The ⌘N and ⌘K shortcut hints advertise shortcuts that have no handler".
**Cause (RCA test-m2, re-checked on develop `53f3cfc`):** `front-end/islands/AsstThreads.tsx:193-195` rendered a `.threads__new-kbd` chip (`asstThreads.newKbd` "⌘N") on "New conversation", and `front-end/islands/AsstComposer.tsx:94-95` rendered `<kbd>⌘K</kbd> commands`. The app's only key handler is GlobalSearch's bare "/" (`GlobalSearch.tsx:86`, which returns on meta/ctrl), so neither did anything — and Cmd/Ctrl+N opens a new browser window, which a page cannot intercept, so ⌘N could never work. (AsstComposer is not mounted by any route; the live composer hint is AsstChat's and carries no shortcut.)

The cypress UX-14 check now asserts the chip does not exist.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/shortcut-hints.test.ts` ("REQ-287 …": every modifier-key hint in islands/components/routes and in both dictionaries has a binding handler; no ⌘N chip; the composer keeps send/new line and drops ⌘K) · integration n/a — no backend or API is involved, the defect is rendered markup · e2e `e2e/shortcut-hints/shortcut-hints.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-287: /assistant advertises no ⌘N / ⌘K …": signed in, no `.threads__new-kbd`, no ⌘ on the button or in the composer hint, no modifier hint anywhere on the page).

## REQ-315 — A sent, unsigned quote can be repriced: an Edit → Version N+1 editor on /quotes, a `revise_quote` assistant tool that changes the line instead of appending one, and a change order that reads "for <name> on Q-00N" and links back to the quote (demo-loop cycle 1: B2, M26, m49)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, demo-loop cycle 1 on the 20-agent demo report (demo-loop/runs/r20a1d9c2/demo-report.md): "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — and, on this run, "Can you make sure we never have to do this again?". This entry is demo issues **B2** ("Price on a sent quote cannot be changed: no Edit/New version/Change order button"), **M26** ("Asking for a new price on a line adds a new line instead of changing it") and **m49** ("Change order asks which customer although named; no link to quote; no CO- number").
**Cause (RCA B2/M26/m49 at `4da03589`, analyst + skeptic UPHELD; re-proved by the RED runs below):** the server already files a content edit on an issued quote as a pending revision (`PUT /quotes/:id` → `quoteEditDecision` `pending`, `shared/documents/versions.ts:131-142`; `POST /quotes/:id/publish` applies it) but nothing on the contractor side could make one: the `QuotesPage.tsx` open panel offered only Copy link / View as client / Create invoice, its publish button appears only once a `pendingRevision` exists, and the chat's Edit is draft-only. The assistant had no "reprice a line" operation: `change_order` (lang `prompts.tools.changeOrder.description`) was fired for anything on an existing job and `apply-chat-change-order` always APPENDS `{description, price: delta}` — the demo's "Change plumbing fixtures to $1,300 on the quote I already sent (Q-001)" became the model's change_order "Adjust plumbing fixtures to $1,300" (+$150), a fifth line; and a "change order for Dana on Q-001: change plumbing fixtures to $1,300" never reaches the model at all — the change-order parser reads it as an added line "Change plumbing fixtures to" for +$1,300. `create_quote` only re-drafts a draft (`handle-chat-message/mod.ts:925`). `CUSTOMER_RE` in `change-order-intent/mod.ts` ended a name only at 's / a delimiter / a change verb / the end, so "Change order for Dana Whitfield on Q-001: …" parsed no customer and `pickChangeOrderTarget` asked "Which customer's job…"; the reply payload carried `changeOrder.quoteId` but the chat island rendered a bare bubble with no link. CO-numbering of unsigned-quote revisions is a product decision and is left as is (a revision is Version N+1 of the same Q-number).
**Requirement:** (1) On /quotes, an issued, unsigned quote's panel has an **Edit → Version N+1** button (`[data-cy=quote-edit]`; never on a draft, a signed, a declined/lost or a sample quote) that opens an inline line editor seeded from the working copy (the pending revision when one exists, else the live lines): description, qty and price per line, add/remove lines, a live new total, Save (solid primary) / Cancel (ghost). Save `PUT`s `{lineItems, estimatedTotal}` (integer cents) and the panel re-reads: the "Unpublished changes" badge and **Publish revision** show, and a note says it is saved as unpublished Version N+1. A line whose wording is unchanged keeps its `descriptionByLang` (REQ-264 — publishing does not re-translate); a reworded or new line carries none. The pure rules live in `front-end/lib/quote-line-edit.ts` (`canReviseQuote`, `editableLines`, `editorTotalCents`, `linesPatch`, `nextVersionOf`). (2) The assistant has a **`revise_quote`** tool (`customerName?`, `quoteNumber?`, `lines: [{match, description?, amountCents?}]`, `remove: [...]`); `parseToolCall` keeps only entries with a `match` and something to change. A new coordinator `ReviseQuote` finds the quote (an explicit Q-number first, else the change-order target rules), matches each named line to an existing line (case/space/punctuation-insensitive, then containment, then all-words, plural-tolerant), patches its price (the line's new total; qty becomes 1) and/or wording, drops the removed ones, keeps every other line in order, and writes the result as a pending revision on an issued quote or in place on a draft; a signed quote is refused ("…its lines can't change. Add or credit the difference with a change order instead."); an unmatched name writes nothing and the reply lists the quote's lines. The reply is `describeQuoteRevision` ("Plumbing fixtures $1,150 → $1,300. Total …") plus, for an issued quote, where to publish it; its payload carries `quoteRevision: {kind, quoteId, quoteNumber}` (and `quoteUpdated` when it is the conversation's own quote). `change_order`'s description is narrowed to adding or crediting work and points price/wording changes to `revise_quote`; both system prompts say the same. A reprice never becomes an added line, whoever reads it: `parseLineReprice` (`backend/src/agents/domain/business/quote-line-revision/mod.ts`) reads "change/adjust/set/bump/make X to $N", "the price of X to $N", "X should be / is now $N", a bare "X to $N" and the Spanish forms — never an addition ("add …", "set up a …", "a new …"), a credit, "change it / the total", or a new material ("change the tile to porcelain, $300"); `parseChangeOrderRequest` returns it as `reprice` and the chat runs it as `revise_quote` without the LLM; and a model `change_order` whose description reads as a reprice, or that is about the very line the user asked to reprice (`changeOrderAsReprice`), is run as the reprice — except on a signed quote, where it stays the change order for the difference (REQ-238). (3) `parseChangeOrderRequest` accepts a name followed by `on|for|about|re` (es `en|sobre`) and/or a `Q-00N` token, returns `quoteNumber`, drops the job reference up to its delimiter or the add/credit verb that starts the change (never the comma inside "$1,300"), and `pickChangeOrderTarget` resolves an explicit number straight to that quote (an unknown or closed number → none, and the reply names the number); the `change_order` tool carries `quoteNumber` too. Every change-order / revision reply whose payload names a quote renders an action link in the chat (`[data-cy=msg-quote-link]`, "Open Q-001 → Publish revision" for a pending revision, "Open Q-001" otherwise) to `/quotes?open=<id>`; the pure rule is `front-end/lib/chat-quote-link.ts` `chatQuoteLink`. All copy in en and es.

a reprice inside a change order is `reprice`, never an added line; a job reference ends at the change verb, never at the comma in $1,300; an explicit number wins in `pickChangeOrderTarget`, an unknown or closed one → none), `backend/src/agents/domain/business/openai-tools/test.ts` ("REQ-315 …": the `revise_quote` schema and parser, `change_order.quoteNumber`, the narrowed description), `backend/src/agents/domain/business/quote-line-revision/test.ts` ("REQ-315 …": `reviseLineItems` matches loosely, reprices without appending, rewords, removes, reports unmatched names, keeps order; ## REQ-368 — The assistant answers "how much do I charge?" with prices and "send him the deposit invoice" with that invoice — never a refusal, never a re-lock of a signed quote (demo-loop cycle 1, M30 + M32)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" (cycle 1, run r20a1d9c2). **M30** (LIKELY, medium): "Assistant refused to help with pricing despite the 'help me price it' chip" — pair 10 typed "how much do i charge for panel swap 200a" and got "I can't provide pricing advice, but I can help you draft a quote…". **M32** (CONFIRMED, high, skeptic UPHELD): "Assistant dead end when asked to bill the deposit" — pair 1 typed "John signed! Please send him the deposit invoice for $1,600" and got the signed quote back as an APPROVED card plus "Is this for a business or a person?", whose Person click ended in "All terms answered."; INV-001 ($1,600 deposit) had gone out at signing and nothing said so.
**Cause (RCA):** every chat turn went to gpt-4o-mini with all five tools attached, whatever the conversation's state. (M30) The chat had no pricing path: the "help me price it" engine (SuggestPrices) is only reachable from the chip's screens, and the prompts never said pricing questions are the job, so the model refused. (M32) The chat had no billing path either; in the terms phase the model called `lock_quote` on the ACCEPTED quote, the lock branch re-emitted it as a card with the terms CTA, and TransitionToTerms on a finished wizard answered with "All terms answered." Signing (SendSignedConfirmation) had already billed the deposit, but the chat never read the quote's invoices. The island's action card was a quote card only: SendInvoice's invoice card already rendered the quote's "Re-open" button and no way to open the invoice, and the model's context labelled an invoice card "[Quote sent: …]".
**Requirement:**
- A pricing question naming a job ("how much do I charge for …", "what should I charge for …", "what's a fair price for …", "help me price …", "¿cuánto cobro por …?") is answered by the server, before any chat model: the three SuggestPrices tiers (Competitive / Market / Premium, the contractor's area, labor and materials), and in the quote phase with no quote yet a draft at the Market price. On a conversation's own quote it prices that job's words (never its amounts) and offers to update the draft only while it is an open, unlocked draft. A pricing question naming no job goes to the model, whose quote and terms prompts both say: never refuse a pricing question; give a price or a low/typical/high range; ask what the job is when none is named.
- A billing ask ("send him the invoice", "bill the deposit", "facturarle el anticipo", …) on a conversation with a quote is answered from that quote and its own invoices (AnswerBilling): signed with an invoice out → which one, its amount, its due date and the next scheduled one, plus that invoice as a card; signed with nothing billed → the "Continue to invoice" CTA; not signed / not sent / declined → says so. It never locks, re-sends, re-drafts or bills anything, and binds the shown invoice to the conversation so the invoice step cannot bill the job twice.
- The chat model only gets the tools the state allows: the terms phase → change_order + update_job_details; the quote phase → no lock_quote / request_terms_transition unless the bound quote is an open draft (the OpenAI client sends only those, and drops any other tool call). A lock_quote / request_terms_transition that still arrives off an open draft answers with where the bill stands (quote past drafting) or re-shows the current wizard step — never the terms CTA again.
- TransitionToTerms on a finished wizard: an issued quote → where the bill stands; an unsent one → the "Ready to send" CTA. Never "All terms answered." as a dead end.
- In the chat, an invoice card (actionType "invoice") links to that invoice ("View invoice" → `/invoices?open=<id>`) and carries none of the quote card's buttons; the send preview and the payment-step preview read quote cards only; the model's context names it "[Invoice …]".
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/chat-routing/test.ts` (12, "REQ-368 M30/M32 …": the demo sentence → "panel swap 200a", EN/ES phrasings, no-job questions, negatives, invoice asks, tools per state) · `backend/src/agents/domain/business/chat-answers/test.ts` (9: tiers EN/ES, pair-1 deposit + scheduled balance EN/ES, paid, nothing billed, unsigned/unsent/declined) · `backend/src/agents/domain/data/openai/smk.test.ts` (4 "REQ-368 OpenAILLMClient smoke: …": only allowed tools sent, [] sends none, no allowlist keeps all, a disallowed call is dropped) · `jest/unit/chat-invoice-card.test.ts` (6: invoice-card link, encoding, quote cards, the island's own branch, quote-only previews) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/intent.int.test.ts` (11: M30 demo → tiers + Market draft with no chat call, Spanish, a bound draft priced not overwritten, no-job → prompts forbid refusing; M32 pair 1 → INV number/$1,600/invoice card, no re-lock, nothing billed, tools per state, unsigned, nothing billed → CTA, mid-wizard → current step, next turn reads "[Invoice sent:") · `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/transition-to-terms/finished.int.test.ts` (3: finished + signed → the bill, finished + draft → send CTA, unfinished → wizard) · e2e (HTTP) `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/intent.e2e.test.ts` (2: M30 over POST /agents/chat → tiers + one draft quote; M32 on a quote signed through the public accept → the deposit invoice named and shown, nothing billed, the stale CTA answers with the bill) · e2e (browser) `e2e/chat-deposit-invoice/chat-deposit-invoice.e2e.test.ts` (pair 1 in /assistant: the reply names INV-001 and $1,600, the card has no buttons and a "View invoice" link that opens the invoice on /invoices). M30 has no browser story: its fix is server-side and the chat renders the same text + draft card kinds as before; the HTTP e2e drives the request the browser sends.
