## REQ-398 — The public change-order page: the owner previews (no self-approval), the headline is the job total, and it has an EN | ES toggle (demo-loop cycle 2, M15 / m25 / p13-j)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4), issues `M15` "Contractor can approve their own change order on /co (no preview guard as on /q)", `m25` "Change order shows invoice totals, not job totals", `p13-j` "No EN/ES toggle on the change-order page". RCA at `deb85b35` (M15 CONFIRMED, m25 CONFIRMED, p13-j FEATURE_GAP; skeptic UPHELD all three).
**Cause (RCA):** REQ-306 guarded /q only — `getChangeOrderPublic` (public-controller/mod.ts) never read the session or returned `internal`, and `approveChangeOrder` / `declineChangeOrder` decided for any caller, so the owner's browser got the name field and "Approve this change". The page's totals came from the linked INVOICE (`originalAmountCents: invoice.amount`), so on a 50/50 job the +$850 order read "Current total $9,600 → New total $10,450" while the job went $19,200 → $20,050. `/co/[id].tsx` resolved its language without `?lang=` and mounted no toggle; the change-order alert linked a bare `/co/<id>`.
**Requirement:** (M15) `GET /change-orders/:id/public` says `internal: true` to the business's own viewer (owner, admin acting for them, staff behind an impersonation — `isInternalViewer`); `POST /change-orders/:id/approve` and `/decline` answer 409 `{reason:"owner_cannot_approve"}` to that viewer unless the full in-person override `?as=customer&confirm=1` is on (`hasSignOverride`); the anonymous customer is unaffected. `/co` forwards the viewer's session on its SSR read and, for a pending order, renders "Preview — you are viewing as the customer; approving is disabled / This is your own change order… / Customer here with you? Approve in person" (the link adds the override) instead of the form. (m25) The payload adds `jobCurrentAmount` / `jobNewAmount` — the quote's agreed total (REQ-205 ledger: quote total + other approved orders) before and after this order (`shared/quote-flow/change-order-view.ts changeOrderJobTotals`); the page's headline is "Job total $19,200.00 → $20,050.00" with "Added to INV-… ($9,600.00 → $10,450.00)" under it, and the invoice rows read "This invoice, now / before / after / proposed". With no linked quote the old labels stay. (p13-j) `/co` reads `?lang=` first (`resolvePublicLang`), sets `ctx.state.lang`, and mounts `PublicLangToggle` like /i (REQ-272); the change-order alert links `/co/<id>?lang=<commsLanguage>` (REQ-342 parity). The open page re-reads `GET /api/change-orders/:id/public` every 10 s (`front-end/lib/public-change-order-refresh.ts`, REQ-221 scheduler) and reloads when the status or version moves, and reloads after its own approve/decline, so the server-rendered headline and totals follow the decision (M13's /co part).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/change-order-page.test.ts` ("REQ-398 …": `changeOrderJobTotals` for the demo's $19,200/+$850 job pending and approved, other approved/pending/declined orders, line-sum + credit floor; `changeOrderPreview` internal/override/half-override/customer/decided; `changeOrderMoved` + `startChangeOrderRefresh` polls the public URL and reloads once; wiring — ?lang= read first, PublicLangToggle, authed SSR read, banner + owner_cannot_approve + refresh in the island, job-total markup; en/es carry the ten new keys) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/change-order-owner.int.test.ts` ("REQ-398 M15 …": `internal` for owner header/cookie and staff impersonation, none for anonymous or another account; owner/staff approve + decline → 409 owner_cannot_approve and the order stays pending, a half override is refused, the full override approves, the anonymous customer approves and declines; "REQ-398 m25 …": job $1,920,000 → $2,005,000 next to invoice $960,000 → $1,045,000, unchanged after approval) and `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-change-order-alert/int.test.ts` ("REQ-398 p13-j …": es and en sends link `/co/<id>?lang=<lang>` in the customer's email and SMS) · e2e `e2e/change-order-page/change-order-page.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-398 M15/m25/p13-j …": the owner's browser sees the preview banner and no name field / approve button, the job total $19,200.00 → $20,050.00 and "Added to INV-… ($9,600.00 → $10,450.00)"; a cookie-less customer context opens `?lang=es` ("Aprobar este cambio", ES current), toggles to EN, approves, the headline reads Approved; the owner's open tab drops the banner on its own).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-change-order-page off demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern change-order-page` → "Cannot find module '../../shared/quote-flow/change-order-view'" (1 suite failed); `deno test -A --unstable-kv` on the two int files → 5 FAILED (M15: `internal` `undefined` ≠ `true`; owner approve 200 ≠ 409; m25: "Values are not equal: the job, now"; p13-j: email body lacks `/co/<id>?lang=es` / `?lang=en`); `shots run e2e/change-order-page` with the four source files checked out from deb85b35 → "✗ REQ-398 … locator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded" (no preview banner for the owner). GREEN — the two int files "5 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/` → "ok | 283 passed | 0 failed"; chat change-order e2e + apply-chat-change-order "2 passed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 209 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2014 passed"; `shots run e2e/change-order-page` → "✓ REQ-398 … 14.4s · 1 pass · 0 fail"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on the route, island, refresh lib, shared module and the backend controller/tests; `deno fmt` clean on every touched/created ts/tsx file except `send-change-order-alert/mod.ts`, which was already unformatted at deb85b35 (left as is). ## REQ-390 — The chat's customer form names every problem in place and only turns red once touched; duplicates say which customer they mean; same-name cards are told apart; a custom duration and the onboarding steps never block or rewrite silently (demo-loop cycle 2, issues m18, m19, M18)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4, demo-report.md), issues `m18` ("Validation gaps: in-chat form one error at a time, onboarding blocks silently, -3 duration becomes 1, no language checked"), `m19` ("Red 'Add a phone number or email' error shown before anything typed") and `M18` ("Duplicate customers easy to create; two 'Bob' cards cannot be told apart"); RCA analyst CONFIRMED + skeptic UPHELD for all three at demo-fixes `deb85b35`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on deb85b35):** (1) `front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` CustomerStepPanel's form called `customerContactError`, which returns only the first bad field (phone before email); REQ-352's per-field `customerFormErrors` was wired only into ClientsPage. (2) REQ-029's missing-contact reason rendered from first paint in the red `.cust-pick__err`, with no touched state. (3) `findExistingCustomer` falls back to a name-only match, and the warning named only `dupe.name` — "Looks like Bob already exists" for a Bob with another phone; `ClientsBoard.tsx`'s card face had no phone or C-number, so two Bobs looked identical. (4) CustomDurationPickerForm clamped on input (`Math.max(1, Math.min(99, Number(raw) || 1))`) and validated the clamped number, so "-3" became "1 day" (from 5441fd71). (5) `WelcomeWizard.tsx`: a whitespace-only name / business name disabled Continue with no message; the ZIP (and payment handle) reason waited for blur; the last ticked send-in language returned early from `toggleSendIn` with no state change while the controlled box unticked in the DOM.
**Requirement:** (a) The assistant's "Who is this for?" form gives one message per field, all at once (`customerStepFeedback` in `shared/quote-flow/customer-contact.ts`, built on `customerFormErrors`): a bad phone under the phone, a bad email under the email (`data-cy` `cust-phone-err` / `cust-email-err`, `aria-describedby`), the contractor's own phone/email on that field, the empty name once the name field was left. (b) REQ-029 stays — the missing-contact reason is visible from the start — but as a neutral `.cust-pick__hint` until a contact field was typed in or left; then it is the red `.cust-pick__err`. (c) The duplicate warning shows the existing customer's contact — "Bob · (512) 555-0142 already exists — use them?" — and when only the name matched while the typed phone/email reaches someone else it reads "You already have another Bob · (512) 555-0142. Same person?" (`duplicateNotice` in `shared/quote-flow/customer-dedupe.ts`); a match with no contact keeps the old wording. (d) On /customers, every visible card whose folded name another visible card shares carries a tag on its face (`data-cy="ccard2-disambig"`): the C-number, else the phone's last four, else the email (`cardDisambiguators` in `front-end/lib/clients-display.ts`). (e) The custom duration keeps what was typed and checks it as typed: a whole number 1–99 or "Enter a whole number from 1 to 99." (`parseDurationNumber`, `shared/quote-flow/duration-input.ts`); Lock it in stays off and the preview never reads a number that was not typed. (f) Onboarding: a name or business name of only spaces says "Type a name — spaces alone don't count."; a ZIP or pay handle still being typed shows its reason as a neutral `.welcome__hint` (red after blur, as REQ-352); the last ticked send-in language is disabled with "At least one language stays on…". en and es carry every new string.

## REQ-395 — A draft quote revision only exists while it differs from the published version, can be discarded, says by name what it changes, and its editor is labelled (demo-loop cycle 2, issues M12, m24, m27, p13-i)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4), issues `M12` ("Unwanted draft revision can't be discarded; publish box says 'Wording or terms updated — total/items unchanged'"), `m24` ("Revision doesn't name the changed line or update scope; editor merged two lines"), `m27` ("Stale 'Saved as unpublished Version 2' line stays above 'Revision published'"), `p13-i` ("Revision editor fields have no labels"). RCA analyst + skeptic CONFIRMED/UPHELD (m24 FEATURE_GAP) at demo-fixes `deb85b35`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on deb85b35):** (M12) `QuoteStore.setPending` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/mod.ts`) spread every patch into `pendingRevision` and never compared it with the live record, so a V3 edited back to equal V2 stayed "Unpublished changes"; QuoteStore had no `clearPending` and no route discarded a revision; the publish preview fell back to `quotes.ledger.publishOtherChanges` whenever the line summary was empty (`QuotesPage.tsx`), even when nothing differed. (m24) `versionChanges` / `versionChangeLine` (`shared/documents/versions.ts`, `linked-view.ts`) only counted lines ("1 line added"). The "merged two lines" part is not a bug: the quote had one line item, the two bullets were the JOB DETAILS narrative; regenerating scope on revision is a separate feature, out of scope. (m27) `OpenQuotePanel`'s `savedVersion` was only reset on a new quote or Edit; the ledger's `onPublished={onRefresh}` left it. (p13-i) `QuoteLineEditor`'s inputs had no label/aria-label; the header row was plain spans.
**Requirement:** (1) Saving a pending revision keeps only what still differs from the live quote (`effectivePendingRevision`: lines compared on description / qty / unit / price by position, other fields structurally); when nothing differs the quote carries no `pendingRevision` — no badge, publish answers `nothing_to_publish`. This holds for every `setPending` caller (the editor's PUT, revise_quote, the chat change order). (2) `POST /quotes/:id/discard-revision` (owner only; 409 `locked_signed` on a signed quote; harmless when nothing is pending) drops the pending revision via `QuoteStore.clearPending`; the panel shows a quiet "Discard draft" / "Descartar borrador" by the UNPUBLISHED CHANGES badge. (3) `VersionChanges` carries the lines by name (`added` / `removed` / `changed`, each `{description, totalCents}`), and `versionChangeLine` reads "Total $18,500.00 → $19,200.00 · Added: Tile backsplash ($700.00)" (es "Agregado: …"; "Removed:" / "Changed: X ($a → $b)"), falling back to counts for a change without names — on the publish preview, the version history and the customer's page alike. (4) The preview says "Wording or terms updated" only when a non-line content field really differs (`pendingOtherContentChanged`), else "Nothing to publish" with Publish disabled. (5) Publishing or discarding clears "Saved as unpublished Version N", and that line shows only while a revision is pending. (6) Each editor input has `aria-label` "Description N" / "Qty N" / "Price ($) N" and a placeholder ("Line description", "Qty", "$").
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/quote-revision-discard.test.ts` ("REQ-395 …": `effectivePendingRevision`, `pendingOtherContentChanged`, named `versionChanges` + `versionChangeLine` en/es, the panel's Discard button / client route / preview copy / savedVersion reset / input labels, en+es keys); `jest/unit/quote-revision-notice.test.ts` REQ-248 expectations amended to the named form · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/revisions-controller/discard-revision.int.test.ts` ("REQ-395 (demo M12) …": a sent quote edited to add a line then back → no `pendingRevision`, publish 409; `POST /quotes/:id/discard-revision` drops it, live + version untouched, idempotent, foreign owner refused, signed quote 409 `locked_signed`) · e2e `e2e/quote-revision-discard/quote-revision-discard.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-395: …" in a browser: inputs found by role + name "Description 1"/"Qty 1"/"Description 2"/"Price ($) 2", the preview reads "… · Added: Tile backsplash ($700.00)", Discard draft clears the badge and the API's pendingRevision, an edit saved back to V2 leaves no badge or saved line, publish removes the saved line).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-quote-revision-discard off demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/quote-revision-discard.test.ts` → "Tests: 13 failed" (`effectivePendingRevision is not a function`, `pendingOtherContentChanged is not a function`, Received "Total $18,500.00 → $19,200.00 · 1 line added", `onPublished={onRefresh}`, no `quote-discard-draft`, no aria-label, lang keys undefined); `deno test -A --unstable-kv …/discard-revision.int.test.ts` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed" (pendingRevision `{lineItems:[Shingles]…}` instead of undefined; discard route 404); `shots run e2e/quote-revision-discard` with the implementation reverted → "✗ … locator.waitFor: Timeout 10000ms exceeded" (no input named "Description 1"). ## REQ-377 — A new total typed in the assistant ("change Q-001 to $19,750") is subtracted by the server, and a model's change-order amount is checked against the dollars typed (demo-loop cycle 2, issue B1)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4, demo-report.md), issue `B1` — "Assistant adds revision line at a tenth of the price ($125 instead of $1,250)" (pair 5: "Dana wants a tile backsplash too — change Q-001 to $19,750" on the sent $18,500 Q-001 → "Added Tile backsplash ($125.00) to Q-001 Kitchen Remodel as a revision"; editor "Tile backsplash 1 × 125 → New total $18,625.00"). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic CORRECTED (cause narrowed) at `deb85b35`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes deb85b35):** the sentence is a target-TOTAL change order, and no deterministic path read it — `parseChangeOrderRequest` needs the words "change order" and `parseLineReprice` skips `Q-\d+` — so the LLM got the turn, rightly called `change_order` (the add-a-line tool), and had to compute `deltaAmountCents` = target − current total in cents itself: it wrote 12500 for 125000. `ApplyChatChangeOrder.run` (`backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/apply-chat-change-order/mod.ts`) appended `{price: delta}` to the pending revision unchanged, with no check against the $19,750 typed or the quote's total. (Allowing `revise_quote` in the terms phase is a separate defect, M11 — revise_quote cannot add a line.)
**Requirement:** (1) "change/make/set/bring Q-00N | the total | the quote … (up) to $X", "new total $X", "total should be $X", "cambia Q-001 a $X", "nuevo total $X" with ONE dollar amount is read in code (`parseTargetTotalChange`, `change-order-intent/mod.ts`) together with the work it adds ("Dana wants a tile backsplash too" → "Tile backsplash"); on a named quote or the conversation's issued one it runs before any model as a change order carrying `targetTotalCents`. (2) The coordinator computes delta = new total − the job's current total (the pending revision's lines when one is waiting, else the quote's), so the new total lands exactly; a new total with no work named asks what the difference is for (`needs_description`, nothing written); the total already being that → `no_change`. (3) A model-supplied `deltaAmountCents` is cross-checked against the dollars the contractor typed (`reconcileChangeOrderDelta`): it stands when it is ±$A, or $A minus the current total / a line's price (REQ-315's signed-quote reprice difference); off by ×10/×100 from exactly one of those it is corrected (the demo's 12500 → 125000); anything else is asked about (`needs_amount`, nothing written); no amount typed → it stands. (4) The `change_order` tool takes the new total in DOLLARS (`newTotalDollars`), converted to cents and subtracted in code; only `description` is required.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/test.ts` ("REQ-377 B1 parseTargetTotalChange: …" the pair-5 sentence → Q-001, 1975000, "Tile backsplash"; no-item, other EN/ES phrasings; a line reprice, an added amount, two amounts → undefined · "REQ-377 B1 reconcileChangeOrderDelta: …" 12500 on $19,750 / $18,500 → 125000; typed amount, credit, line difference and right target delta stand; no amount stands; 99900 → ask), `backend/src/agents/domain/business/openai-tools/test.ts` ("REQ-377 B1 TOOL_DEFS / parseToolCall: …" newTotalDollars 19750 → targetTotalCents 1975000) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts` ("REQ-377 B1: …" the exact sentence on the bound sent $18,500 quote with the model scripted to 12500 → pending line Tile backsplash 125000, total 1975000, reply "$1,250.00"; a second new total is measured from the pending revision; no item → asks, nothing written; the model's 12500 on an unparsed phrasing is corrected; 99900 → needs_amount, nothing written; the tool's targetTotalCents is subtracted in code) · e2e `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/change-order.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-377 B1 e2e: …" booted app over HTTP: Q-001 $18,500 sent, the demo sentence in a new conversation → pendingRevision total 1975000, last line Tile backsplash 125000, reply "$1,250.00"; the browser lane is not run in the demo-loop fix step — the chat UI renders the reply text and quote verbatim).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-change-order-target off demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — unit change-order-intent: "TS2305 … has no exported member 'parseTargetTotalChange' / 'reconcileChangeOrderDelta'"; openai-tools `--filter REQ-377` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed"; int `--filter REQ-377` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 6 failed", the demo test's diff `["Tile backsplash", - 12500 + 125000]` (the demo's exact $125 line reproduced); e2e `--filter REQ-377` → "pendingRevision.estimatedTotal - undefined + 1975000". GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv` change-order-intent "ok | 23 passed", openai-tools "ok | 30 passed", handle-chat-message int "ok | 65 passed", chat-controller change-order e2e "ok | 3 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/` → "499 passed | 1 failed" — the one is `openai/smk.test.ts` "REQ-368 … no allowlist keeps every tool" (expects no `revise_quote`), which fails identically on untouched demo-fixes deb85b35 ("12 passed | 1 failed", M11's domain); `deno lint` clean on the 9 touched .ts files; `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern "i18n|lang|copy"` → 22 suites / 242 passed; en/es key sets equal (3882 each). Formatted only files that were fmt-clean at the base (openai-tools/mod.ts + test.ts and int.test.ts were not; left as they were).
## REQ-403 — After a failed text the app never says it was texted, nor promises a text confirmation (demo-loop cycle 2, issue m11)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4, demo-report.md), issue `m11` — "After a failed text the app says it was sent/delivered and promises SMS confirmation" (fleet-4 stdout:296 "Texted to +15125550177" after the send said text FAILED; fleet-1 stdout:373 "Firmado y vinculante — Te enviaremos la confirmación por mensaje de texto" to a 555 number that failed; fleet-1 stdout:374 the red "Ese número no recibe mensajes" box still shown after "Cotización aceptada"). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `deb85b35`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** (a) `send-signed-confirmation/mod.ts` sent the completion SMS with `this.sms.send` directly and logged a "text" comms-trail row on `res.ok`, skipping the `isFictionalUsNumber` guard `send-paperwork-sms` applies; the dev SMS fake answers ok for +1 512 555-0177 (fictional: exchange 555, line 01xx), so the receipts strip read "Texted to". (b) `front-end/components/quote-doc.tsx` picked `signedNoteSms` whenever the customer had no email, without checking that a phone exists or that the last text failed. (c) `AsstChat.tsx`'s recovery form (`needRecovery`, fed by `lastRecoveryDividerId`) never looked at `quoteAccepted`.
**Requirement:** every customer text goes through ONE guarded dispatch — `dispatchCustomerSms` in `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/customer-sms/mod.ts` (missing / invalid / fictional never reach the provider) — used by the quote/invoice send and the post-signing completion text alike, and a comms-trail "text" row is logged only for a real delivery. `GET /quotes/:id/public` carries `confirmChannel` (`signedConfirmChannel`): "email" when the customer has one, "text" only for a textable number whose latest text did not fail, else "none". The signed page's line follows it (`shared/quote-flow/signed-note.ts` `signedNoteKey`): the email note, the text note, or the neutral "Your contractor has your signed copy. Keep one for yourself with Download PDF below." (en + es). The chat's contact-recovery form is gone once the quote is accepted.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/customer-sms/mod.test.ts` ("REQ-403 …": target codes, a fictional number never dialled even in dev mode, `signedConfirmChannel` table) · unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/sms-guard.test.ts` ("REQ-403 (m11) …": no dial + no "text" row for +15125550177; a real number texted and logged once; a provider rejection logs nothing) · unit `jest/unit/failed-sms-truth.test.ts` ("REQ-403 (m11) …": `signedNoteKey`, the en/es neutral copy, quote-doc uses it; `lastRecoveryDividerId(…, { accepted: true })` is undefined and AsstChat passes `quoteAccepted`) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/failed-sms-truth.int.test.ts` ("REQ-403 (m11) …", app booted over HTTP, SMS in dev mode: signing a quote to +15125550177 leaves no "text" row in `GET /messages` and `confirmChannel` "none"; a real number whose latest text failed → "none"; a texted real number → "text" and one logged completion text; an email → "email") · e2e n/a — the page renders `confirmChannel` through the pure `signedNoteKey` (unit-pinned) and the int test asserts the exact JSON the /q page and the receipts strip read; the recovery form's gate is a pure scan, unit-pinned with the island's call site.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-failed-sms-truth off demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — `deno test -A --unstable-kv …/send-signed-confirmation/sms-guard.test.ts` → "FAILED | 2 passed | 1 failed" ("the fictional number was dialled", `-1 +0`); `deno test -A --unstable-kv …/public-controller/failed-sms-truth.int.test.ts` → "a 'text' receipt was logged for a number that cannot get texts" (`- ["+15125550177"] + []`, the demo's exact line); `customer-sms/mod.test.ts` → "Cannot find module …/customer-sms/mod.ts"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/failed-sms-truth` → "Could not locate module ../../shared/quote-flow/signed-note.ts". ## REQ-424 — Polling backs off while the page is idle; a mutation refetch is coalesced; one name save is one PUT (demo-loop cycle 2, issue p2)
**User's words:** "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4), issue **p2 "Heavy polling"** (related m48): `GET /api/admin/users?q=` + `/api/demo-mode/active` every 2–5 s on an idle /admin (all 8 pairs), `/api/notifications` + `/api/agents/conversations` every 1–2 s on the assistant, ~3,300 requests in 9 minutes, `PUT /api/me` twice for one save.
**RCA (cycle 2, deb85b35):** /admin refreshed every `ADMIN_REFRESH_MS` = 5 s forever, plus once on focus AND once on visibilitychange (a tab switch fires both); DashTopbar re-fetched notifications on every `pm:mutated`, which lib/api fires after every non-GET — each chat message and wizard answer; AsstThreads polled every 8 s forever; StaffNamePrompt's double-submit guard was React state (`busy`), which a fast Enter + click gets past before the re-render.
**Requirement:** (1) `startPoll(fn, ms, { idleMaxMs })` (front-end/lib/poll.ts): each tick with no user input since the last (pointerdown/keydown/wheel/touchstart on the window) doubles the period up to `idleMaxMs`; any input returns it to `ms` at once; without `idleMaxMs` a poll is unchanged (REQ-221). The poll also exposes `catchUp()`, debounced by `CATCHUP_MIN_MS` like the visibility catch-up. (2) /admin's `refreshWhileVisible` is that poll — 5 s base, `ADMIN_REFRESH_MAX_MS` = 60 s idle cap — and a focus refresh goes through `catchUp()`, so a tab switch is one refresh. AdminPage stops the refresh once the page locks (a Demo made the browser the customer, REQ-301). (3) DashTopbar's `pm:mutated` refetch goes through `coalescedRefresh` (front-end/lib/mutation-refresh.ts): at once when the last was ≥ `MUTATION_REFRESH_GAP_MS` (5 s) ago, otherwise one trailing refetch; `/agents/*` chat posts trigger none. DashTopbar's notifications poll (10 s → 60 s idle) and unread poll (30 s → 120 s idle), and AsstThreads' conversations poll (8 s → 60 s idle) pass `idleMaxMs`. (4) StaffNamePrompt guards its save with a ref (`inFlightRef`) set before the await. Out of scope: the demo overlay's `ACTIVE_POLL_MS` ask (REQ-153/222 — how a new demo reaches this app) and the topbar EN button's own PUT (m48).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/polling-load.test.ts` ("REQ-424 (cycle 2, p2) …": back-off doubling to the cap, input reset, no back-off without `idleMaxMs`; /admin ≤ 4 refreshes in an idle minute, keydown brings back 5 s, focus+visibilitychange is one refresh; AdminPage stops the refresh on lock; `isChatMutation`, the coalesced leading/trailing refetch, chat posts ignored, `stop()` drops a pending one; DashTopbar/AsstThreads pass `idleMaxMs`; StaffNamePrompt's ref guard) — and the REQ-424 AMENDMENT of `jest/unit/admin-stale-tab.test.ts` (REQ-301: a focus within 2 s of a refresh is no refresh) and `jest/unit/notifications-feed.test.ts` (REQ-299's poll pin allows the options argument) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change; the endpoints answer as before, only how often the islands ask changes · e2e `e2e/polling-load/polling-load.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-424 p2: an idle /admin backs off …" — ≤ 3 users reads in a 30 s idle window, ≥ 1; "REQ-424 p2: the staff name form submitted twice in one task … sends ONE PUT /api/me").
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-polling-load off demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED — `npx jest --selectProjects unit -t "REQ-424"` → "Tests: 14 failed, 3 passed" (no `idleMaxMs` back-off: 1 call where 4 expected; `mutation-refresh` not implemented; no ref guard); `shots run e2e/polling-load` on the pre-fix front-end → "an idle /admin re-read its users 6 times in 30000 ms" and "one save sent one PUT /api/me — expected 1, got 2". GREEN — `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Tests: 1 skipped, 2018 passed, 2019 total"; `shots run e2e/polling-load e2e/polling e2e/polling-catchup e2e/staff-name e2e/admin-stale-tab e2e/topbar-ticker` → 9 pass · 0 fail; `deno lint`, `deno check`, `deno fmt --check` clean on the touched files.
## REQ-412 — The landing page's sample quotes add up, and the documents counter never reads "0" (demo-loop cycle 2, issues m41 + p12)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." ### REQ-411 — a pay-on-completion job bills when the job ends, on the account's days to pay (demo-loop cycle 2, m34 + m35)
**Requirement (user's words):** "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4), issues **m34** ("'Próxima cuota: 26 nov' for a pay-on-completion job; settings 'INV-001 ya fue emitido' while /invoices shows 0") and **m35** ("'Pago al finalizar' says 15 días while Settings says 30 days to pay").
**RCA (demo-rca, analyst + skeptic UPHELD, at deb85b35):** m34 — `completionScheduledFor` (send-signed-confirmation/mod.ts) took the ISO completion date, else start-or-today + 14 days; the wizard's "Next week" start and "4 weeks" duration are TERMS, not ISO dates, so a job signed Nov 12 billed Nov 26, two weeks before it ends; the REQ-317 /invoices hero then called that only, after-completion bill "Próxima cuota" (next installment); `settings.numbering.lockNote` said the scheduled, never-sent INV-001 "was issued". ("/invoices shows 0" was a misread — the agent read tracks 01-03 only.) m35 — `completionTerms` hard-coded `netDays: 15` for "upon completion" and the wizard sub-lines hard-coded "15 días", while Settings' "Days to pay an invoice" (`invoiceNetDays`, REQ-174) showed 30 and fed only subscriptions.
**Behaviour:** (1) the after-completion bill is scheduled for the job's end — the quote's ISO completion date, else its start (ISO `startDate`, else the start term: Right away / Next week / Next month / a picked date, EN or ES; never before today) plus the duration term (days / weeks / months; a range counts its upper bound; hours finish the day they start); only with no duration (or TBD) the old start + 14 days. Shared in `shared/quote-flow/completion-schedule.ts`. (2) "Payment upon completion" gives the customer the account's Settings days to pay (`invoiceNetDays`), else the 30 the Settings field shows (`DEFAULT_INVOICE_NET_DAYS`, `accountNetDays`) — the due date, the wizard sub-line ("within {n} days", en + es, threaded through `localizeOptions` from HandleWizardAnswer / TransitionToTerms and the AsstChat fallback picker via a new `invoiceNetDays` prop) and Settings' own default all read it; Settings' hint now says it covers pay-on-completion jobs too. "Net N" keeps N. (3) The /invoices hero labels a single after-completion bill (installmentTotal 1) "Bills on completion:" / "Se factura al terminar:"; a split's installment keeps "Next installment:" (`scheduledHeroSubKey`). (4) The numbering lock note reads "Locked — {number} is already in use" / "Bloqueado — {number} ya está en uso". The agreement text names no number of days ("Payment upon completion"), so it needed no change.
**Deviation from the RCA's fix direction:** the direction said "invoiceNetDays (default 15 when unset)". Unset, Settings shows 30 (and field batches default to 30), so a 15 default would leave m35 reproducible on every account that never saved the field. One default — the 30 Settings shows — is used everywhere. REQ-316's tests are amended for that (due = completion + 30 when the account has no setting).
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/completion-schedule.test.ts` ("REQ-411 (m34) completionScheduledFor …" ×2, "REQ-411 (m35) completionTerms …", "REQ-411 (m35) the wizard's … sub-line …") · unit `jest/unit/completion-billing.test.ts` (shared schedule math, `accountNetDays`, lang keys en + es, `scheduledHeroSubKey`, lockNote, island/route wiring) · integration `completion-schedule.test.ts` ("REQ-411 (m34 + m35) send-signed-confirmation run: …" — the real coordinator on KV, a 21-day account, Next week + 4 weeks → scheduled today + 35, due + 21) and `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-wizard-answer/int.test.ts` ("REQ-411 … the payment step's 'Payment upon completion' sub-line names the account's Settings days to pay (21)") · e2e n/a — the browser lane is not run in the demo-fix cycle; the integration tests drive the real coordinators, and `e2e/settings-numbering/settings-numbering.e2e.test.ts`'s lock-note string is updated to the new copy (not run).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-completion-billing off demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check …/completion-schedule.test.ts` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 5 failed" (`- 2026-11-26 + 2026-12-17`; "en sub: Full amount due within 15 days of the job's completion"; run(): scheduledFor 2026-11-26 vs 2026-12-17); handle-wizard-answer `--filter REQ-411` → "sub names 21 days: Full amount due within 15 days …"; jest `completion-billing` → "Cannot find module '../../shared/quote-flow/completion-schedule'". ## REQ-384 — The "professionalize" offer sits inline under the line it rewrites, previews before → after, and is skipped for a clean line (demo-loop cycle 2, issue m16)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4), issue `m16` — "'Professionalize' popup hides the line it rewrites and does little"; RCA at `deb85b35`, analyst CONFIRMED (medium), skeptic UPHELD (fleet-2 09:12:54 "the popup HIDES the line I just added", fleet-6 report #11).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked at deb85b35):** after a bullet edit or a custom-bullet add, `front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` set `proPopup` and rendered `<Backdrop class="chat__pro-pop">` — `position: fixed; inset: 0` with a dimmed backdrop (`front-end/static/assistant-page.css`, added 66b7aacf) — which covered the very bullet it was about and asked "Want me to professionalize that?" without quoting it. The rewrite only ran AFTER Yes (`confirmProfessionalize`), so the user agreed blind, and for an already-clean line (REQ-332's prompt returns it "essentially unchanged") Yes visibly did nothing. The option-3 "disappeared" note is not reproduced (`replaceBulletWithLines` touches only the edited option; RCA: it scrolled out of the clipped list, M26).
**Requirement:** after a bullet edit or add, the line is polished FIRST (same request as REQ-332: the job's original message + sibling bullets as context) and the offer appears INLINE in the card's own list, directly under that line — a "Polish this line?" / "¿Pulir esta línea?" row (`asstChat.proPopup.msg`, EN + ES) quoting the line (struck through) → the rewrite (one or more lines), with No / Yes. Nothing covers or dims the line. Yes applies exactly the previewed lines in place (an "A + B" split becomes two bullets); a stale preview (the line changed since) applies nothing. When the rewrite has the same wording as the line (case, spacing and trailing punctuation aside) or is empty, no offer is shown. The decision is one pure function, `polishOffer` in `shared/quote-flow/polish-offer.ts`. The `.chat__pro-pop` modal and its CSS are removed; the unused `asstChat.proPopup.polishing` key is dropped from both dictionaries.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/polish-offer-inline.test.ts` ("REQ-384 …": `polishOffer` offers a real rewrite / an "A + B" split with before + after, offers nothing for the same wording or an empty result, trims lines; `sameWording`; the island renders no `chat__pro-pop`, renders `data-cy="polish-offer"` inside `.chat__jobopt-bullets` before the add row with before/after, decides through `polishOffer`; `.chat__pro-row` is not `position: fixed`; the copy in en + es) — amended: `jest/unit/professionalize-scope-basis.test.ts` (REQ-332's wiring check follows the request into `offerPolish` and the apply into `acceptPolish`) and `front-end/lib/backdrop-overlays.test.ts` (REQ-354's overlay-class list no longer expects `chat__pro-pop`) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change; POST /agents/job-details/professionalize is called with the same body and its answer is only shown earlier · e2e `e2e/polish-offer-inline/polish-offer-inline.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-384 m16: …" in a browser at 1280×900: edit the first card's first line to "4 recesed lights + City of Austin permit" → no `.chat__pro-pop`; the offer row is in that card's list right after the edited line; the edited line is still the topmost element at its centre; the row quotes the line and previews two lines; Yes replaces the line with exactly those two; then adding the already-clean "Install frameless glass shower door" shows no offer).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-professionalize-inline off demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern polish-offer-inline` → "Cannot find module '../../shared/quote-flow/polish-offer'"; `shots run e2e/polish-offer-inline -- --no-check` with HEAD's AsstChat.tsx / assistant-page.css / lang swapped back in → "✗ REQ-384 m16 … expectation failed: no full-viewport professionalize modal — expected 0, got 1". ## REQ-397 — Money owed is one rule: a sent / viewed / claimed unpaid invoice is outstanding on the dashboard, the job card and the client card, in cents (demo-loop cycle 2, issue M14)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4), issue `M14` — "Dashboard says $0 outstanding / 0 invoices while a $9,600 invoice is Sent; Current $0.02; job card 'No due date'" (fleet-4 stdout:299; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `deb85b35`).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on deb85b35):** (1) `compute-dashboard-stats/mod.ts:70,73` counted `status === "pending"`, a status accept never writes (`send-signed-confirmation` writes INV-001 `sent`, INV-002 `scheduled`; the lifecycle is scheduled|draft|sent|viewed|claimed|paid|void) → `pending` 0, and `pickKpis` clamped Outstanding to "$0 · 0 invoices". (2) `bucketPendingInvoices` (`invoice-aging-buckets/mod.ts:33`) did `current += 1` per unpaid invoice (scheduled included) while the dashboard divides by 100 → 2 invoices read "Current $0.02"; the "stray sub-dollar cents" clamp (4c45161b) only hid it. (3) `list-active-jobs/mod.ts:110-111` and `build-customer-cards/mod.ts:142,292` used the same `"pending"` filter → job card "No due date", client overdue/next-due lines missing.
**Requirement:** one predicate in paperwork business code, `isOpenReceivable` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/open-receivable/mod.ts`): status sent / viewed / claimed (or the legacy `pending` that ComputeInvoiceBalance writes for a partly paid invoice), no `paidAt`, balance (`amount − paidCents`) > 0; a `scheduled` installment is `isUpcomingReceivable`, not owed; draft and void are never owed. The dashboard's `invoices.pending` / `overdue`, the aging buckets, the job card's status + next due date, and the client card's balance / overdue / next-due line all read it. The aging buckets are the SUM of open balances in cents. The dashboard's Outstanding is what the buckets add up to — no clamp.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/open-receivable/test.ts` ("REQ-397 …": statuses owed / not owed, paidAt and covered balance close it, balance = amount − paid ≥ 0, scheduled is upcoming), `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/invoice-aging-buckets/test.ts` (cents not counts; "REQ-397 … sent deposit is its balance in cents; the scheduled half is not owed yet"; partly paid counts the rest, draft/void nothing), `front-end/lib/dashboard-kpis.test.ts` ("REQ-397 pickKpis …": $9,600 across 1 invoice; Outstanding never clamped by the count — `pickKpis` moved out of `islands/DashboardPage.tsx` into `lib/dashboard-kpis.ts` to be testable) · integration `backend/src/analytics/domain/coordinators/compute-dashboard-stats/receivables.int.test.ts` ("REQ-397 (M14) accept 50/50 → …": the REAL `SendSignedConfirmation` bills a $19,200 50/50 quote → dashboard `pending` 1, `overdue` 0, `agingBuckets.current` 960000; `ListActiveJobs` nextDueDate = INV-001's due; client card balance 960000 with a dueIn line; and an overdue `viewed` invoice is overdue on all three) · e2e `backend/src/analytics/entrypoints/dashboard-controller/e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-397 analytics e2e …": app booted over HTTP, a signed job billed as accept bills it → `GET /analytics/dashboard` pending 1 / current 960000, `GET /jobs` nextDueDate = INV-001's due); the browser lane is not run in the demo-loop fix step — the dashboard renders `pickKpis` over exactly that JSON. Baseline tests amended to the rule: `compute-dashboard-stats/int.test.ts` aging buckets now assert cents; REQ-350's "never says 'owes'" test in `build-customer-cards/int.test.ts` — its sent overdue invoice now names itself ("INV-001 · vencida"), and the owes line is still pinned in both languages.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-dashboard-receivables off demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check` on the aging-buckets test, receivables.int and dashboard e2e → "FAILED | 5 passed | 10 failed": "Values are not equal: one invoice is out with the customer — Actual 0 / Expected 1" (int), "Actual 0 / Expected 1" (HTTP `pending`), buckets "Actual 2 / Expected 35000"; open-receivable test: "TS2307 Cannot find module …/open-receivable/mod.ts"; `deno test -A lib/dashboard-kpis.test.ts` → "Actual 0 / Expected 175" (the clamp). GREEN — those four backend files "ok | 20 passed | 0 failed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/analytics/ src/paperwork/domain/business/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/compute-invoice-balance/` → "ok | 233 passed | 0 failed"; front-end `deno test -A lib/` → "ok | 172 passed | 0 failed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'dash|kpi|invoice|money|clients'` → "Test Suites: 208 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2001 passed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on every touched file; `deno fmt --check` clean on the new files, DashboardPage.tsx and build-customer-cards/mod.ts (invoice-aging-buckets mod/test, build-customer-cards int.test and the dashboard e2e test were already fmt-unclean at the base, left as they were).
## REQ-396 — The open quote panel and the customer's /q page follow the server after a sign or a publish (demo-loop cycle 2, issue M13)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4), issue `M13` "Open staff panel and customer /q, /co pages don't refresh status after sign/publish/approve" — RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `deb85b35`; fleet-4 stdout:294 "live toast Dana Price accepted… BUT the open Q-001 modal still said SENT / Version 2 · Revised / Out for response".
**Cause (RCA):** each view read the server once. The open-quote loader in `QuotesPage.tsx` depends on `[openId, openTick]`, and `openTick` was bumped only by the panel's own save/publish; REQ-321's 30 s `startListRefresh` re-read wrote the cards only, never the open quote — so the panel kept "Sent" and still offered Edit → Version 3 / Publish revision after the client signed. `/q` (`PublicQuoteView`) fetched `/quotes/:id/public` in one mount effect; REQ-321 gave a refresh to `/i` only.
**Requirement:** (a) the /quotes list re-read (30 s + focus, REQ-321) compares the open quote's fresh card with the panel's quote on the raw row fields a client-side change moves — `status`, `version`, `acceptedAt`, `lostAt`, `publishedAt` (`openQuoteMoved`, `front-end/lib/live-doc-refresh.ts`) — and re-gets the open quote (bumps `openTick`) when they differ; nothing open, still loading, or the quote gone from the list never re-gets. (b) the open /q page re-reads its projection every 10 s through REQ-221's scheduler and swaps the fresh projection in place when the shown view moved — `deriveQuoteView` mode (open / accepted / declined), the headline state (an unissued draft became sent) or the published version (`publicQuoteMoved`); a sent → viewed flip is not a move; the baseline is read at every tick, so the tab's own signature (REQ-311's in-place reload) is never a second swap; nothing shown yet or a failed read does nothing. (c) that poll is `GET /quotes/:id/public?refresh=1`, which serves the same payload but records no open and does not flip sent → viewed (a poll is not the customer opening the link); the plain GET is unchanged. /co is out of scope here (its status refresh and SSR-header sync belong to the change-order-page fix).
**Decision (deviation from the fix direction):** the /q refresh lives in `PublicQuoteView` and swaps the projection in place instead of a render-nothing island in `routes/q/[id].tsx` that reloads. /q is not SSR'd — the island owns the document — so a separate island would need its own baseline fetch, and a reload would undo REQ-311's "signing keeps the customer where they signed, no reload" for the tab's own signature.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/live-doc-refresh.test.ts` ("REQ-396 …": `openQuoteMoved` same card / signed / declined / viewed / new version / nothing open; `publicQuoteMoved` same view / viewed bookkeeping / signed / declined / new version / issued from draft; `startPublicQuoteRefresh` polls `/api/quotes/:id/public?refresh=1` at 10 s, hands a moved projection over once, reads the baseline each tick, does nothing when nothing is shown or the read fails; the wiring — QuotesPage's `startListRefresh` effect calls `openQuoteMoved` + `setOpenTick`, PublicQuoteView starts the refresh in an effect with `shown`/`onMoved`) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/refresh-read.int.test.ts` ("REQ-396 M13: GET /quotes/:id/public?refresh=1 …": records no view, leaves `sent`; the plain GET still records and flips to viewed) · e2e `e2e/live-doc-refresh/live-doc-refresh.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-396 M13: …" in a browser, no reload by the test: the /quotes?open= panel badge turns Accepted after the customer signs via API, on the window's focus; an anonymous /q/:id tab shows the signed banner naming the signer after a sign via API, within one 10 s tick).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, local, branch fix/c2-live-doc-refresh off origin/demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Cannot find module '../../front-end/lib/live-doc-refresh'"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv …/refresh-read.int.test.ts` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed" (`a poll is not the customer opening it`: actual "viewed"); `shots run e2e/live-doc-refresh` → "0 pass · 2 fail", both "locator.waitFor: Timeout 30000ms exceeded" on the post-sign wait. GREEN — jest unit "Test Suites: 209 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2011 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/ src/analytics/` → "ok | 174 passed | 0 failed"; `shots run e2e/live-doc-refresh e2e/public-page-refresh` → "5 pass · 0 fail" (/q story 13.1 s = one tick); e2e/quote-revisions + e2e/sample-quote green; `deno lint` + `deno check` + `deno fmt --check` clean on the touched islands, `lib/live-doc-refresh.ts`, the controller and the new tests. Pre-existing, not this change: e2e/signed-next-step (REQ-311) and e2e/quote-pay-now (REQ-251) fail with "waiting for locator('form.ctr__sign-form')" identically with this fix set aside at deb85b35. Not run: the whole e2e lane.
## REQ-376 — /admin while this browser guides a customer explains itself instead of becoming the customer (demo cycle 2, issues m20 + nc-second-demo)
**Requirement (Raphael):** "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4), issues m20 ("A second staff tab silently becomes the customer (redirected to customer's /dashboard)") and nc-second-demo ("A second demo could not be started from the same browser"). RCA (analyst + skeptic, UPHELD, at deb85b35): impersonation is browser-wide — placePresenter calls `adminClient.impersonate` (DemoModeOverlay.tsx:426), which swaps the session cookie — so any new /admin request resolves the CUSTOMER, and `routes/admin/_middleware.ts:17-22` answered `user.superAdmin !== true` with a bare 302 to the customer's /dashboard; no Demo button was reachable and nothing said why. Fix: when the session is an impersonation (GET /admin/whoami, in process), /admin renders an interstitial — "You are guiding {name} in this browser", why the console is not here, "To start another demo, return to your account first — or use another browser or staff account", the REQ-298 consequence line, **Back to the demo** (/demo/stage, only when this staff presents a demo per /demo-mode/active) and **Return to your account** (leave the demo, stop impersonating, land on /admin — REQ-232's order). In the presenter's language (REQ-341). A plain customer still goes to /dashboard; no session still goes to /. Per-tab impersonation (a stage-only token) is a separate feature, out of scope.

## REQ-399 — The send dialog's Send goes once, and a refused contact reads as copy, never a transport line (demo-loop cycle 2, issues M16 + M17)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4, demo-report.md), issues `M16` — "Double-click on final Send sends the quote twice" — and `M17` — "Raw 'PUT /customers/... failed: 400' shown in send dialog for invalid email"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `deb85b35` (fleet-9 stdout:165-171).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes deb85b35):** M16 — the dialog's Send is `disabled={sending}`, but `keepAndSend` (`front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx`) set nothing busy before `await clientsClient.update(...)`; with no re-render during the PUT, the double-click's second click ran the same closure — a second PUT, then a second `confirmSendQuote`, whose `if (sending || !convoId)` read the stale `sending=false`. Both POSTed `/send-quote`, and dispatch is deliberately not idempotent server-side (`send-quote/mod.ts`), so two emails and two "emailed to" cards. M17 — `keepAndSend` ran only `missingContactKey` (presence), so "bob at gmail" reached `PUT /customers`; the backend refused it as `customer.invalidEmail`, `lib/api.ts` threw `ApiError("PUT /customers/<id> failed: 400")`, and the catch rendered `err.message`. Introduced by a3dcf689 (REQ-037).
**Requirement:** (1) One Send in flight at a time: `keepAndSend` runs under a synchronous `useRef` lock (`runExclusive` in `front-end/lib/send-dialog.ts`, checked and set before the first await) that spans the contact PUT AND the send; `sending` is set before the PUT and released in `finally`; `sendQuoteNow` / `sendInvoiceSwapNow` are called only under that lock and no longer carry a stale `if (sending)` guard. (2) The server drops a repeat: each Send mints a `requestId` (`newSendRequestId`) sent with `POST /agents/conversations/:id/send-quote`; `SendQuote.run` claims `["send-quote-request", userId, requestId]` atomically in KV before dispatch, and a repeat within 10 s (`SEND_DEDUPE_MS`) delivers nothing and answers `newMessages: []`; a Send that throws gives its id back. A request without a `requestId` behaves as before (a deliberate re-send still delivers). (3) Before the PUT the dialog checks the typed contact's format with the backend's own REQ-278 rule (`sendDialogErrorKey` = REQ-308's `missingContactKey`, then `customerContactError`) and shows `tFor(lang, key)`; a refused save maps `body.message` `customer.invalidEmail` / `customer.invalidPhone` to their copy, anything else to `asstChat.send.contactSaveFailed` (en + es) — `err.message` from lib/api is never rendered (`contactSaveErrorKey`).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/send-dialog-guard.test.ts` ("REQ-399 …": `runExclusive` runs a concurrent second call zero times and releases on throw; `sendDialogErrorKey` → `customer.invalidEmail` for "bob at gmail", `customer.invalidPhone` for "555-12", REQ-308's missing keys first; `contactSaveErrorKey` maps a real `ApiError` body to the key and anything else to the generic key; en/es carry every key; AsstChat's `keepAndSend` holds `runExclusive(sendInFlight` with `setSending(true)` before `clientsClient.update(`, never `err.message`, and is the only caller of `sendQuoteNow` / `sendInvoiceSwapNow`; the send carries `requestId`) and `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/int.test.ts` ("REQ-399 M16 …": the same requestId twice concurrently → one email, one divider; a new requestId still delivers; a throw frees the id) · integration `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/conversations-controller/send-quote-dedupe.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-399 e2e …", app booted over HTTP: `PUT /customers/:id {email:"bob at gmail"}` → 400 `message: "customer.invalidEmail"`; two concurrent `POST …/send-quote` with one requestId → one divider across both answers and one in the thread) · e2e (browser) n/a — no shots story reaches the send dialog (it sits behind the whole LLM quote wizard), and the browser lane is not run in the demo-loop fix step; the lock is pinned by the unit tests and the server-side drop by the HTTP test.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-send-quote-guard off demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern send-dialog-guard` → 14 failed (`runExclusive is not a function`, `sendDialogErrorKey is not a function`, `contactSaveErrorKey is not a function`, wiring checks); `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check …/send-quote/int.test.ts …/send-quote-dedupe.e2e.test.ts` → "REQ-399 M16 … delivers once … FAILED: one Send, one email" and "REQ-399 e2e … FAILED: one 'emailed to' card, not two" (the M17 400-by-key half already held server-side). GREEN — the same jest pattern `send-dialog` → "Tests: 28 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/ src/agents/entrypoints/conversations-controller/` → "ok | 46 passed | 0 failed"; `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/` → "ok | 170 passed | 0 failed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 209 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2015 passed"; `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on `islands/AsstChat.tsx`, `lib/send-dialog.ts`, `clients/assistant.ts`; `deno lint` clean on the touched backend dirs; `deno fmt --check` clean on `lib/send-dialog.ts`, the new tests and `send-quote/` (`clients/assistant.ts` and `conversations-controller/mod.ts` were already fmt-unclean at the base, left as they were; AsstChat.tsx not formatted, known-unformattable).
### REQ-308 AMENDMENT — REQ-399 moves the send dialog's pre-flight into `sendDialogErrorKey`, which runs `missingContactKey` first and then the contact format; `keepAndSend` is now a `runExclusive` wrapper (not `async function`). Test: `jest/unit/send-dialog.test.ts` ("REQ-308 keepAndSend asks for the contact that is actually missing …" accepts `missingContactKey(` or `sendDialogErrorKey(` in the body).
## REQ-421 — /field/workers words its refusals in the page's language; a taken cell is shown under the Phone box, neutrally (demo-loop cycle 2, issue m42)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4, demo-report.md), issue `m42` — "Duplicate worker phone error shown in raw lowercase"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `deb85b35`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** `POST /field/workers` (`backend/src/field/entrypoints/field-controllers/mod.ts` create, :213-223) threw English developer strings — `FieldError("a worker with that cell already exists", 409)`, "name required", "pin must be 4 digits", … — and `errMsg` in `front-end/islands/FieldWorkersPage.tsx` (:38-49) printed `body.error`/`body.message` word for word. No code → i18n mapping existed, so the message was lowercase English in both languages and sat in the form's generic alert, not by the Phone box. `findByPhone` is global (the cell is the worker's login across every account), so the old wording also implied a worker of "yours".
**Requirement:** every refusal of `POST /field/workers` (and the row's `PUT` language / `DELETE` zone guard) carries a stable `code` on `FieldError` — `name_required`, `name_too_long`, `phone_10_digits`, `pin_4_digits`, `worker_phone_taken`, `language_invalid`, `worker_covers_zones` (with `detail.zones`). The page maps the code to a `field.wk.err.*` key in en AND es (`front-end/lib/field-worker-errors.ts` `workerError`), and shows a field's error under its own box (`wk-name-error` / `wk-phone-error` / `wk-pin-error`, the input `aria-invalid`); a taken cell reads neutrally — "That cell number is already used for a worker sign-in. Use a different number." — never naming an account; typing a new number clears it. A refusal without a known code (or a network failure) is the house `field.common.error`; the server's English never reaches the page.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/field-worker-errors.test.ts` ("REQ-421 (demo m42) …": every code → its key and box; zones named in the page's language; no code / unknown code / network failure → the fallback; every `field.wk.err.*` key worded in en and es and different, the taken-cell wording names no account; the island imports `workerError`, no longer returns `b.error`, and renders `wk-phone-error` with `aria-invalid`) · integration `backend/src/field/entrypoints/field.int.test.ts` ("REQ-421 (demo cycle 2, m42) …": each bad POST answers its status + `code`; the same cell from ANOTHER account is `worker_phone_taken`; PUT `language: "fr"` → `language_invalid`; DELETE of a zone-covering worker → `worker_covers_zones` + `detail.zones`) · e2e `e2e/field-worker-errors/field-worker-errors.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-421 (demo m42) …": in a browser a duplicate cell shows the worded English message under the Phone box, then the Spanish one after a language switch; no raw "already exists"; a new number clears it).

## REQ-423 — A nameless account is greeted namelessly in the live language; the sidebar never shows the sign-in placeholder and follows a saved name (demo-loop cycle 2, p3 + S3)
**Source:** Raphael, on the 20-agent demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4), issues `p3` ("Unnamed staff account reads 'Hola, hola' / 'Hey, hola' and 'Nuevo usuario'; sidebar stale after name saved; checklist/avatar") and `S3` ("Fresh unnamed staff account: 'Hola, hola' / 'Hey, hola' / 'Nuevo usuario' and 'from' in the pill"); RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD/CORRECTED at `deb85b35` (fleet-1:137-138, fleet-3:50, fleet-4:129-130, fleet-7:69).
**Cause (RCA):** REQ-355 (92dea1f1) routed every route's greeting through `greetingFirstName`, which returns undefined for the placeholder — so 15 routes (admin, admins, accounts-manager, assistant, clients, payments, quotes, settings, work-orders, wo/[id], field/{batches,assignments,subscriptions,tasks,workers}) fell into the older (b6ec538e) `?? tFor(lang, "common.thereFallback")`: the server baked "hola" in as the NAME, giving "Hola, hola 👋", and after the EN toggle DashTopbar re-rendered "Hey, {name}" around the frozen word — "Hey, hola 👋". Found in the same scan: `/invoices` (`common.greetingNameFallback`) and `/assistant/[threadId]` (`assistantThread.greetingFallback`) had the same pattern. `DashSidebar.projectSidebar` showed `profile.user.name` with no placeholder check ("Nuevo usuario", server initials "NU") and only updated from dash-cache refreshes — it never heard the `pm:profile-updated` StaffNamePrompt/Settings announce, so it stayed stale after the save; the dashboard checklist's "name" item likewise. ("from" in the pill is the harness's "Alex from DocuMonster" — fixed in harness-fixes, not here.)
**Requirement:** no route passes a translated word as the greeting name — a user with no real name (none, blank, or the placeholder) gets `greetingName` undefined and DashTopbar greets with `dashTopbar.greetingNoName` resolved in the LIVE language ("Hola 👋" / "Hey 👋"); the rule lives in `front-end/lib/greeting-identity.ts` `topbarGreeting` (saved name → its first word; override key; else the name or nameless). The sidebar identity (`sidebarIdentity`) treats the placeholder as no name: the business name stands in, else "Account"/"Cuenta"; initials come from what is shown (never "NU" for the placeholder). The sidebar listens for `pm:profile-updated`: it shows the saved name at once (`withSavedName` on the cached profile) and refetches the dash cache; the dashboard SetupChecklist ticks its "name" item on the same event. All without a reload.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/staff-placeholder-c2.test.ts` ("REQ-423 …": no route under front-end/routes uses `common.thereFallback` or `greetingName = … ?? tFor(`; `topbarGreeting` nameless in es then en, never "hola"; real/saved/saved-placeholder/override-key cases; `sidebarIdentity` placeholder → business + its initials, → "Account"/"Cuenta", real name → name + biz + server initials; `withSavedName`; DashTopbar/DashSidebar/SetupChecklist wiring) and `jest/unit/staff-name-placeholder.test.ts` (REQ-355's DashTopbar check amended: it re-greets through `topbarGreeting`, which uses `greetingFirstName`) · integration n/a — no backend or API change; the routes' SSR props and the islands' rendering are pinned by the unit scan and driven end to end by the e2e · e2e `e2e/staff-name/staff-name.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-423: …": a fresh unnamed Spanish super admin on /admin reads exactly "Hola 👋", the sidebar footer has no "Nuevo usuario"/"New user" and no "NU"; after the EN toggle exactly "Hey 👋"; saving "Rafa Staff" in the staff prompt puts "Rafa Staff" in the sidebar footer and "Hey, Rafa" in the topbar with no reload).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-staff-placeholder-name off demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — `SUPERADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN=… shots run e2e/staff-name -- --no-check` → "✗ REQ-423 … expectation failed: ES: the nameless greeting — expected "Hola 👋", got "Hola, hola 👋"" (REQ-355 ✓ alongside); jest `--testPathPattern staff-placeholder-c2` → "Cannot find module '../../front-end/lib/greeting-identity'", then with the helper in place "Tests: 4 failed, 6 passed" (15 routes + invoices + assistant/[threadId] in the scan; DashTopbar/DashSidebar/SetupChecklist not wired). ## REQ-401 — Batch send says only what happened, and a task on an unsent draft is not "invoiced" (demo-loop cycle 2, issues M30 / m45)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4, demo-report.md), issues `M30` — "Batch send reports '0 invoices sent — each client got theirs' alongside a failure" — and `m45` — "Unsent draft invoice labelled 'invoiced / facturado'; '1 drafts' grammar" (fleet-7 stdout:59, :173-174). RCA analyst + skeptic CONFIRMED/UPHELD at demo-fixes `deb85b35`; both introduced by fd52cfa2 (REQ-137..143).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** (M30) `front-end/islands/FieldBatchesPage.tsx` `send()` flashed `field.lt.sent` ("{n} invoice(s) sent — each client got theirs.") unconditionally, then appended each failure as `name: reason`, where the reason was the backend's hard-coded English developer text from `backend/src/field/domain/coordinators/field-batches/mod.ts` ("no recipient: the customer has no email or phone"). (m45) the pull stamps each task with its draft's `invoiceId` (the double-billing lock), and the UI equated that with "invoiced": `WorkerScreen.tsx` showed "🔒 invoiced / facturado", `field.lt.summary` read "{pullable} completed and invoiced", and `field.lt.counts` was one flat string ("{d} drafts …" → "1 drafts").
**Requirement:** (1) the batch page says "{n} invoice(s) sent — each client got theirs." only when at least one invoice went out; with none sent it shows only the failures. (2) A send failure for a customer with no email or phone carries `code: "noRecipient"` (+ `customerId`) from the backend and reads, translated, "{name} has no email or phone on file, so nothing was sent." with an "Add an email or phone to {name}" link to /customers (es: "… no tiene correo ni teléfono, así que no se envió nada." / "Agrega un correo o teléfono a {name}"). (3) The lock stays, worded by the invoice's state: the worker task view carries `lockState` — "draft" while its invoice is an unsent draft ("on a draft invoice" / "en factura borrador"), "invoiced" once sent (or unknown). (4) The pull summary reads "{pullable} completed, on draft invoices · … · {already} already on an invoice" (es: "completadas, en facturas borrador … ya en una factura"). (5) A batch row's counts are plural keys: "1 draft · 0 sent · 0 paid" / "1 borrador · 0 enviadas · 0 pagadas".
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/field/domain/business/tasks/test.ts` ("REQ-401 workerView — …": draft → "draft", sent/paid/unknown → "invoiced", none → null; the invoice stays hidden) and `jest/unit/field-batch-send-copy.test.ts` ("REQ-401 …": `describeSend` gives no flash on sent 0, the translated failure + fix in en and es, "1 invoice sent" on sent 1; `batchCounts` plurals in both languages; `lockLabelKey`; the islands use them) · integration `backend/src/field/entrypoints/field.int.test.ts` ("REQ-401 (demo M30/m45, cycle 2) …": over HTTP — pulled tasks read `lockState: "draft"`; sending Johnson (no email/phone) answers sent 0 + `code: "noRecipient"` with his customerId; once Ana's is sent her tasks read "invoiced", Johnson's stay "draft") · e2e `e2e/field-tasks/field-tasks.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-401 (demo M30/m45, cycle 2): …": in a browser — summary "1 completed, on draft invoices", row "1 draft · 0 sent · 0 paid", Send shows the Johnson failure + fix and never "each client got theirs" / "no recipient:", the worker's screen reads "on a draft invoice").
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-field-batch-copy off demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/field/domain/business/tasks/test.ts --filter REQ-401` → "TS2554 Expected 1 arguments, but got 2" (`workerView` knew nothing of the invoice's status); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/field/entrypoints/field.int.test.ts --filter REQ-401` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed": "pulled onto a DRAFT: locked, but not 'invoiced'" — actual `["ana:true:", "ana:true:", "johnson:true:"]` (no lockState); `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern field-batch-send-copy` → "Cannot find module '../../front-end/lib/field-batches'"; the e2e story with the source reverted to deb85b35 → "✗ … expectation failed: summary: 1 completed and invoiced · 0 not done · 0 deferred · 0 still open · 0 already invoiced". ## REQ-380 — A signature drawn on /q's pad reaches the demo stage and stays there (demo-loop cycle 2, issue M10)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4, demo-report.md), issue `M10` — "Drawn signature on /q signature pad never reaches the stage" (pair 4: "on my stage the signature pad is EMPTY — just the grid and the X line", while the typed name arrived). RCA analyst LIKELY / skeptic UPHELD at `deb85b35`; the open question (which in-app step clears it) is answered below.
**Cause (pinned by the e2e below, at demo-fixes deb85b35):** setting a canvas's `width`/`height` — even to the value it had — clears its bitmap. PublicSignQuote's `setupCanvas` (`front-end/islands/PublicSignQuote.tsx`, on mount and on every window `resize`) does exactly that and then redraws the same strokes, so on the customer's side the pad looks unchanged and its `toDataURL()` reads exactly as before. The recorder (`front-end/lib/demo-mode/mirror-record.ts`) sends the width/height mutations as `a` ops; the replay (`mirror-replay.ts`) sets them on its canvas, which clears the stage's copy; and the recorder's 1 s canvas sweep only sends a bitmap that differs from the last one sent — so it never sends it again. In the browser story: the drawn signature reached the stage (step 3 green), a same-width resize of the customer's window left the stage pad with 0 inked pixels for good.
**Requirement:** a canvas the customer sees is the canvas the stage shows, whatever is done to its size: (1) the replay keeps every canvas's last bitmap and paints it again after any width/height attribute op on that canvas (set or removed); a bitmap still decoding never paints over a newer one; a snapshot starts the kept bitmaps over (its own `cv` ops repaint). (2) The recorder re-sends a canvas's bitmap in the same frame, after the attribute ops, whenever its width or height changed, even when the bitmap reads the same. (3) The stage's dev pill counts the canvas bitmaps that arrived / were applied / were repainted (`cv<seen>/<applied>/<repaints>`), and the recorder counts the ones it sent (`stats().cv`), so a lost hop shows.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-mode-mirror-dom.test.ts` ("REQ-380 (demo-loop cycle 2, M10) …": the replay repaints the last bitmap after width/height ops, a removed width, a newer bitmap wins, `stats()`; the recorder re-sends `cv` after a same-value width/height set; end to end drawn → resized → the stage still painted) on a fake DOM whose canvas, like a real one, loses its paint on a width/height set (`jest/unit/support/fake-dom.ts`); `jest/unit/demo-mode-mirror-wiring.test.ts` ("REQ-380 (demo M10): the dev pill counts the canvas bitmaps …") · integration n/a — no backend or wire-format change: `cv` and `a` ops already exist; the recorder→JSON→replayer round trip is the unit test above · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-signature.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-380 (demo M10): …": a real demo, the owner on `/q/:id?as=customer&confirm=1`, draws with the mouse → the stage's mirrored canvas has ink; the customer's window resized at the same width → the stage's canvas still has ink 2.5 s later).

## REQ-372 — The stage's pill ghost is a read-only replica clipped to the frame, re-sent on every sync (demo-loop cycle 2, issues m1 + m8)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4, demo-report.md), issues `m1` — "Stage shows customer's pill only as an empty dashed box" (RCA FEATURE_GAP, skeptic UPHELD) and `m8` — "Pill placeholder on stage drawn in wrong place or outside phone frame" (RCA LIKELY, skeptic CORRECTED), both at `deb85b35`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes deb85b35):** (m1) `sendPill` in `front-end/islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx` sent only `{k:"pill", r}`; the stage (`front-end/islands/DemoStage.tsx`) drew a dashed outline with a title and no children, and the mirror skips `[data-demo-overlay]` (REQ-242) — so the pill's words, its compact/open state and any overflow never reached the presenter. The server re-parses every relay (`parseClientMessage` → `parsePeerMessage`), so any extra field was stripped on the wire too. (m8) `pillGhostBox` (`shared/demo-mode/pill.ts`) scaled the box with no clip to the frame: M6's min-width feedback (a 400/760 px box on a 390 view) drew the ghost past the phone frame's right edge. The customer's `onPeerOnline` (a stage's `sync`) did not re-send the pill — it came back only when the link status changed.
**Requirement:** (1) The `pill` peer message carries what the pill shows — `compact`, `open`, `status` (`live`/`connecting`/`ended`), `text` (the customer's line, cut to `PILL_TEXT_MAX`) and `clipped` (the pill runs off the customer's screen, `pillOverflows`) — each field optional and checked by `parsePeerMessage`, so it survives the server. (2) The stage's ghost is clipped to the frame box (`pillGhost`: the box cut to the frame and whether anything was cut; nothing drawn when wholly outside) and holds a read-only replica: the text (unless compact and closed), the status in the PRESENTER's words (`statusKeyOf` → `demoMode.connected/connecting/ended`) and an overflow marker "…" (`demoMode.pillGhostClipped`, en + es) when the pill was cut. (3) The customer re-sends the pill on every sync / new stage (`onPeerOnline` nulls `sentPillRef` and calls `sendPillRef`), and whenever its words change.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-mode-pill.test.ts` ("REQ-372 …": a 760 px pill on a 390 phone is clipped to the frame; inside → not clipped; wholly outside → null; clipped above/left; `pillOverflows`; `statusKeyOf`; the overlay's `sendPill` carries compact/open/status/text/clipped and `onPeerOnline` re-sends; the stage renders `demo-pill-ghost-status`/`-text`/`-clipped`; both dictionaries carry `demoMode.pillGhostClipped`) and `jest/unit/demo-mode-protocol.test.ts` ("REQ-372 …": the face fields parse, junk dropped, text capped, and they survive `parseClientMessage`) · integration `backend/src/demo-mode/domain/coordinators/demo-hub/test.ts` ("REQ-372 a pill message keeps its words across the socket parse and two hubs": raw relay → socket parse → hub B → KV mailbox → hub A → stage's `parseServerMessage`, every field intact) · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-clear.e2e.test.ts` (REQ-228/295's story: the desktop ghost says "Connected"; step 3a — on the phone the ghost stays inside the frame and says "Connected").
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-stage-pill-ghost off demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern "demo-mode-pill|demo-mode-protocol"` → "Tests: 8 failed, 45 passed" (`pillGhost is not a function`, `pillOverflows is not a function`, `statusKeyOf is not a function`, protocol `- Expected - 5` face fields missing, `Expected pattern: /\bcompact\b/` in sendPill, `/pillGhost\(/` in the stage); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/demo-mode/domain/coordinators/demo-hub/test.ts --filter REQ-372` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed" (the relayed pill lost `clipped`, `compact`, `open`, `status`, `text` — the server stripped them). ## REQ-378 — A demo's stage connects at once: the customer's app hears of a new demo the moment it opens, and the stage is greeted before the customer's first snapshot (demo-loop cycle 2, issue m22)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4), issue `m22` — "Stage stuck on 'Connecting to ...' 10-20 s at start while customer pill says Connected" (demo-report.md; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `deb85b35`).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes deb85b35):** (1) the customer's app is never told a demo opened: it finds it on its next `GET /demo-mode/active`, asked `ACTIVE_POLL_MS` (5 s) after the last answer (`front-end/lib/demo-mode/active-poll.ts` `arm()`, `DemoModeOverlay.tsx` effect 1), and only then opens its socket — pair 4's stage said "Waiting for Aisha Bello's app…" (no tab in the room) all that time. (2) `DemoModeSocketController.onopen` sent the stage's `welcome` and peer list only AFTER `await hub.join(...)`, and `join` broadcasts the newcomer's presence first (local delivery is synchronous); a tab answers a stage's arrival with its snapshot at once, so that relay could reach the stage before its peer list, and `transport.ts` `take()` dropped it (`followed` still null) — recovery waited for the stage's `sync` and a second snapshot.
**Requirement:** (1) `GET /demo-mode/active?wait=<ms>` with no demo for the caller is HELD (up to `ACTIVE_WAIT_MS` = 10 s, a KV watch on the caller's demo pointers, live before the check so nothing is missed) and answers the moment a demo is opened for them; with none it answers null when the wait is up; without `wait`, or with a demo already on, it answers at once. The overlay's poll asks with `wait` while the tab is shown (a hidden tab asks plainly — HTTP/1.1 allows six connections per host) and re-asks `ACTIVE_REASK_MS` (1 s) after an answer (`activePoll`'s new `rest`); a failed ask still waits `ACTIVE_POLL_MS`. A held ask plus the gap stays under `WHERE_TTL_MS`, so the reported page never lapses. (2) A joining socket's `welcome` and "who is here" go out from inside `DemoHub.join` (its `greet` callback), the moment it is in the room and BEFORE anyone hears it arrive — so no answer to its arrival can overtake them.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/demo-mode/domain/coordinators/demo-hub/test.ts` ("REQ-378 (demo-loop cycle 2, m22) a joining stage is greeted … before anyone hears it arrive": a tab that relays the instant it hears the stage; the greeting is the stage's first event and lists the tab), `jest/unit/demo-mode-start-push.test.ts` ("REQ-378 …": the constants' bounds vs WHERE_TTL_MS; `activePoll` rests `rest` after an answer, `every` after a failure; the client sends `wait`, the overlay asks with ACTIVE_WAIT_MS only while visible and rests ACTIVE_REASK_MS) · integration `backend/src/demo-mode/entrypoints/demo-mode-controller/int.test.ts` ("REQ-378 … a stage's socket gets its welcome and the tabs already here BEFORE any tab's answer": over the composed router's real socket, a tab in the server's hub relays at once on the stage's arrival → the stage's frames are welcome, peer, relay; "REQ-378 … GET /demo-mode/active?wait=": plain ask immediate, `wait=800` with no demo held ≥ 700 ms and null, a held `wait=8000` answers within 1.5 s of the demo being opened with the viewer role and its id, a demo already on answers at once) · e2e n/a — the browser lane is not run in the demo-loop fix step; the int tests drive the real HTTP route and WebSocket through the composed router, and the overlay wiring is pinned by the jest test.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-demo-start-handshake off demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — hub unit (`--no-check`, `join` had no greet): "AssertionError … - relay + greet" (the tab's snapshot reached the stage first), "FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed"; int `--filter REQ-378` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed": "the welcome comes first, not the tab's snapshot: {"t":"relay","from":"viewer","cid":"tab-m22",…}" and "held for the wait when nothing starts (2 ms)"; jest `--testPathPattern demo-mode-start-push` → "Tests: 3 failed, 3 total". GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/demo-mode/` → "ok | 39 passed | 0 failed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit` (whole unit project) → "Test Suites: 209 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2004 passed"; `deno lint` + `deno fmt --check` clean on `backend/src/demo-mode` and `shared/demo-mode/protocol.ts`; `deno check` clean on the touched backend files and tests; front-end `deno lint` + `deno check` + `deno fmt` clean on `clients/demo-mode.ts`, `lib/demo-mode/active-poll.ts`, `islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx`.
