## REQ-462 — A pending change order can be edited or withdrawn — from the chat by its number ("Change of plan on CO-001: make it $1,000…") and from its row on the quote panel — and a signed quote's panel has a "New change order" button (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M26)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `M26` — "A pending change order can't be changed, and a signed quote has no change-order button" (pair 5, fleet-4 stdout:167-168, 288-289: typed `Change of plan on CO-001: make it $1,000 and the description should just say "Upgrade to frameless glass shower door".` and got "Q-001 Bathroom Remodel is signed, so its lines can't change. Add or credit the difference with a change order instead."; the /quotes row "CO-001 · Pending · on INV-002 · +$1,200.00" was only a link, and "Signed — later changes go on a change order" offered nothing). RCA verdict FEATURE_GAP (confidence high), skeptic UPHELD at `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** nothing in the chat edits a change order. The tools were create_quote / lock_quote / request_terms_transition / change_order / revise_quote / update_job_details (`backend/src/agents/domain/business/openai-tools/mod.ts`); `change-order-intent` read only `Q-\d+` (`DOC_NUMBER_RE`), so "CO-001" was never resolved; the model called revise_quote on the signed Q-001 and ReviseQuote answered `chatCoordinator.reviseQuote.locked`. On /quotes (`front-end/islands/QuotesPage.tsx`) the lock note was a plain `<p>` and each change-order row a bare `<a href=/co/:id>`. The edit (re-pend + re-alert) and the delete already existed as `PUT` / `DELETE /invoices/:id/change-orders/:coId`, used only by the invoices page's "Adjust".
**Requirement:** (1) Chat: a message that names one change order by number (`CO-\d+`) and says what changes — a new amount ("make it $1,000", "lower CO-001 to $1,000", "$1,000 instead of $1,200", "cambia CO-001 a $1,000"), a new wording (quoted after description / say / call / rename, "que diga …"), or "withdraw / cancel / delete CO-001" (an imperative, never a question) — edits THAT order without the model: the store's edit re-pends it as its next version with the invoice's live total re-snapshotted, and the alert goes out again; a withdrawal deletes it. An approved order is never changed (the reply says to make a new change order for the difference); an unknown number, an unchanged order or a $0 amount writes nothing and says so. An edited amount keeps the order's direction (a credit stays a credit) unless the contractor says "credit" / "charge". (2) Model: a new tool `update_change_order` (changeOrderNumber, description, amountDollars — the order's NEW amount in dollars, converted in code — and withdraw) is offered in both phases; a turn whose message names a change order carries that order's state in the model's context; the model's amount is cross-checked against the dollars typed (REQ-377); a revise_quote on a message that names a change order is never run — the reply asks what to change on it. The reply names the order and links its quote. (3) Quote panel: next to "Signed — later changes go on a change order" a "New change order" button opens a form (what changed + amount, − for a credit) that posts the order on the quote's newest open invoice (not paid / void / canceled) — the customer approves it at its own link; with no open invoice it says what comes first (create the next invoice; or, when every invoice is paid, bill the extra work on a new invoice). Every change-order row shows its version and description, and a row that is not approved has Edit (description + amount, saved through the PUT — back to pending, next version) and Withdraw (asks first, then the DELETE). EN + ES copy.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/edit.test.ts` ("REQ-462 …": the demo's exact sentence → CO-001 + $1,000 + the quoted wording; amount / wording / withdraw phrasings in EN + ES; questions, a new change order, two numbers or no change are not edits; `editedChangeOrderDelta` keeps a credit a credit) and `backend/src/agents/domain/business/openai-tools/update-change-order.test.ts` ("REQ-462 …": the tool's schema, dollars → cents in code, a call with nothing to change is dropped; offered in both phases) · unit (jest) `jest/unit/quote-change-order-actions.test.ts` ("REQ-462 …": the open invoice a new order goes on, the invoice-first / new-invoice answers, which rows get Edit / Withdraw, the amount parse, the panel's wiring, the chat link, en + es copy) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/change-order-edit.int.test.ts` ("REQ-462 …": the demo's exact sentence on the signed Q-001 with CO-001 pending on INV-002 — the model scripted to make the demo's revise_quote — updates CO-001 to Version 2, pending, $1,000.00, the new wording, re-alerted, no CO-002, no quote change, the model never asked; withdraw; an approved order refused; an unknown number; no change; a credit stays a credit; the model's own update_change_order call; the revise_quote net; Spanish) · e2e `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/change-order-edit.e2e.test.ts` (booted app over HTTP: the demo's sentence edits CO-001, "withdraw CO-001" deletes it) and browser `e2e/quote-change-orders/quote-change-orders.e2e.test.ts` (a signed quote's panel: the button, the invoice-first answer with no invoice, then New change order → CO-001 on INV-001, Edit → Version 2 at $1,000.00, Withdraw → gone).
**Neighbouring tests amended (the requirement they pin is unchanged — the model gets one more tool):** REQ-368's pinned tool lists in `backend/src/agents/domain/business/chat-routing/test.ts` (the open draft's list, `noAdvance`, `termsTools`) and the OpenAI client smoke lists in `backend/src/agents/domain/data/openai/smk.test.ts` (6 → 7 tools, sorted and in TOOL_DEFS order) each gain `update_change_order`, marked `// REQ-462`.

## REQ-393 — AMENDMENT (2026-11-12, demo-loop cycle 3): superseded in part by REQ-451 — his pointer is what he pointed at, not the spot under his still mouse
Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb) found REQ-393's model wrong on the customer's screen: an arrow looked up under his still mouse after every layout pass stayed at one screen spot over whatever scrolled or loaded under it (M1), and the hand-off from /admin (the Demo button, beside a phone frame) put the full arrow, name tag and dashed ring on the phone's edge (M14). REQ-451 replaces these parts of REQ-393: "after every layout pass … the resting pointer is looked up again" (now only a provisional fraction, once the replay has settled, and his mouse beside the frame); "the newly followed tab gets the resting pointer at once" (now only when the anchor was made on that very page load); the hand-off "sends it with the first snapshot" (now only when it is on the fitted frame); and the arrow on the edge for a mouse beside the frame (now a small marker, no name tag). Kept: following his mouse document-wide, `leave` only when it leaves the window, the `tab:`-addressed relays, the "Your pointer is off {name}'s screen" hint and outline. Its tests are amended in place (`REQ-451 AMENDMENT` comments): `jest/unit/demo-stage-presenter-pointer.test.ts`, `jest/unit/demo-mode-pointer-anchor.test.ts`, `e2e/demo-mode/demo-presenter-rest.e2e.test.ts`, `e2e/demo-mode/demo-scroll-pointer.e2e.test.ts` — see REQ-451.

## REQ-451 — The presenter's pointer is what he pointed at: it stays on its element when the customer scrolls or changes page, a new page shows none until he moves, a hand-off beside the frame shows nothing, and his mouse beside the frame is a small marker on the edge with no name tag (demo M1, M14 — cycle 3)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, `demo-loop/runs/re05e1cbb/demo-report.md`): **M1** — "The presenter's pointer stays at a fixed screen spot, so it points at the wrong thing after a scroll or page change" (pairs 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 10; STILL PRESENT from cycle 2 M2: option 2's ✕ after a page change, "Workers" in a newly opened drawer, empty background on /worker; "it's a screen position, not stuck to a button", pair 1) and **M14** — "The presenter's pointer is still drawn when his mouse leaves the stage" ("Alex" pinned at the phone's right edge with a dashed ring over the ✕ column and a form field, also at demo start; pair 3, major). RCA at `cc5d4b0e`, analyst + skeptic: CONFIRMED / UPHELD.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked in this worktree):** (a) `DemoStage.replace()` pushed the rest throttle after EVERY layout pass whenever his mouse was known (REQ-393), so a scroll or a change re-anchored the arrow to whatever was under his still cursor — on the customer's screen it stayed at one spot; (b) `take()` on a new page load sent `pointToFrac(lastMove)` (+ `offFrame`), so a new page, another tab or a reload showed the arrow at that fraction over whatever the new page had there; (c) the customer's `toScreen` (and the stage's placing of a colleague) fell back to `fracToPoint` when the anchored node's page load was gone or the node detached; (d) the mouse handed over from /admin sits on the Demo button at the right of the row, beside the fitted phone frame, and was seeded as `lastMoveRef` → an off-screen anchor → the full arrow, name tag and dashed ring on the phone's right edge from the start. Found while fixing (measured, see Evidence): once an anchor is KEPT, one taken from a half-built replay stays wrong — the replay's stylesheet links already had their `sheet` (memory cache) and the logo was `complete` while the frame was still laid out without them (the wizard stacked at full width), so a stage reloaded under his still mouse put the customer's arrow on the Continue button instead of the field under it.
**Requirement:**
- His pointer is what he pointed at: the stage keeps the anchor it last sent (`sentRef`) with the customer's page load it was made on, the stage point it was made at and whether it is provisional (`Held`, `shared/demo-mode/presenter-anchor.ts`). A layout pass of the replay (their scroll, a change, a settle, the stage resized) never looks his still mouse up again — except (a) a provisional fraction (made while the replay could not name a node there) on the same page load, once that replay has SETTLED, and (b) his mouse beside the frame, whose meeting point with the frame's edge moves when the frame does (`lookAgain`).
- A replay has settled (`Replayer.settled()`) once every stylesheet it links and every image it fetches (not `loading="lazy"`, with an address) has fired its load or error event — never on `sheet` or `complete` alone — and no web font is loading; or SETTLE_CAP_MS (2.5 s) after its snapshot, when the stage is told by a layout pass. Once settled it stays so until the next snapshot. The stage names a node under his pointer only in a settled replay (REQ-305's "styled" rule, widened); `styled()` still decides REQ-370's reveal.
- Both screens draw a node anchor on its node only — while the page load it names is the one shown and the node is in the page with a box — and draw nothing otherwise, never the fraction it had (`anchorPoint`, `pointInBox`; the customer's `toScreen`, the stage's `presenterOnStage` for a colleague's pointer); a fraction-only anchor is drawn at its fraction.
- A page that joins or is mirrored afresh is sent the kept anchor only when it was made on that very page load (a tab followed again with its page unchanged, the stage's socket back) or when it is his mouse beside the frame, which names no element of any page (`resendable`); a new page, another tab, a reload get nothing until he moves.
- The mouse handed over by the page that opened the stage (or by the stage's own `pagehide`) is held as a seed and counts once the frame is fitted, only on the frame (`seedOn`); beside it the phone shows nothing and the stage shows no "off" hint until he moves. A real pointer event drops the seed.
- His mouse beside the frame is a small translucent chevron (14 px, opacity 0.7) against the edge of the customer's screen it is off, pointing out — no arrow, no name tag, no ring (`offEdge`, `offMark`; `PeerPointer`'s `off`, `DemoPointer`'s `demo-pointer-off-mark`).
- The stage shows a faint ghost of his arrow (opacity 0.5, "Your pointer on {name}'s screen" — `demoMode.pointerGhost`, en + es) where the customer's screen has it, whenever that is more than 6 px from where he put it (their page moved it with its element, or the frame moved) and never for the marker (`ghostAt`, `PointerGhost`).
- Supersedes REQ-393's every-layout-pass lookup, "the newly followed tab gets the resting pointer at once" and its edge arrow (REQ-393 AMENDMENT above), REQ-305 M2's resting pointer sent to a new page, and REQ-242 pointer-m1's pointer shown on the new page with no move.
**Tests:**
- unit `jest/unit/demo-presenter-anchor.test.ts` ("REQ-451 …"): `anchorPoint` / `pointInBox` (node only while its load is shown and it has a box; never the old fraction); `resendable` (same load; the off marker to any page; nothing for a new page); `lookAgain` (a node anchor never; a provisional fraction only once the same page settled; the off marker always); `seedOn`; `ghostAt`; `offEdge` / `offMark`; the wiring of the stage (`replace()` gates `rest.push` on `lookAgain(… settled …)`, `anchorOf` names a node only when `settled()`, `hold` / `resendPointer` / `takeSeed`, the ghost and both lang keys), the customer's overlay (`toScreen` through `anchorPoint`, `place` hides) and PeerPointer / DemoPointer's off marker.
- unit `jest/unit/demo-mode-pointer-anchor.test.ts` ("REQ-451 settled() …"): false before a snapshot and while a stylesheet, an image or a web font is coming in — a `sheet` or `complete` without its load event is not in, a failed one is; once settled, kept until the next snapshot; lazy and address-less images not waited for, a srcset-only one is; SETTLE_CAP_MS settles it and a layout pass tells the stage, a new snapshot or `dispose()` cancels the old cap. REQ-305's anchorOf and stage wiring cases amended (`REQ-451 AMENDMENT`).
- unit `jest/unit/demo-stage-presenter-pointer.test.ts`: REQ-393's wiring cases amended (`REQ-451 AMENDMENT`).
- integration n/a — front-end and shared only: no backend, wire or protocol change (the marker rides REQ-393's existing `o: 1`; the ghost and the marker are local renders).
- e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-presenter-rest.e2e.test.ts` — "REQ-393 (demo M8) + REQ-451 (demo M14) …": the hand-off beside the frame shows nothing for 2.5 s and no hint; beside the frame the marker on the phone's left edge where his mouse meets the frame as it is now, no tag; back on the frame the arrow and tag at the middle; the stage reloaded under his still mouse draws the arrow afresh where it was. "REQ-393 (demo M2 tab switch) + REQ-451 (demo M1) …": the tab the stage newly follows shows none until he moves; the tab followed again, page unchanged, gets the arrow back on the same element. `e2e/demo-mode/demo-scroll-pointer.e2e.test.ts` — "REQ-305 (demo M2) + REQ-451 (demo M1) …": no arrow on a new page or after a reload until he moves; the customer scrolls and the arrow rides with its element while the stage's ghost marks it. `e2e/demo-mode/demo-mirror.e2e.test.ts` — REQ-242 step 8 amended: the customer's new page shows no arrow for 1.5 s with his mouse still, then his move puts it there.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, local, branch fix/c3-presenter-pointer-anchor off origin/demo-fixes cc5d4b0e, dev stack on :47631/:47632):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'demo-presenter-anchor|demo-mode-pointer-anchor|demo-stage-presenter-pointer'` → "Tests: 32 failed, 33 passed, 65 total"; the settled() round, with the committed `mirror-replay.ts` put back → "Tests: 10 failed, 62 passed, 72 total" (exactly the new and amended cases); the `complete`-alone and `sheet`-alone cases each RED ("Expected: false, Received: true") before their fix. GREEN — the same suites plus `demo-mode-mirror*` and `demo-stage-styled-reveal` → "Tests: 142 passed"; the whole unit project → "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2536 passed". `deno lint` clean on the 13 changed files and on front-end/ (362 files; the repo root's 57 problems are all in files this branch does not touch); `deno check` clean on the changed islands, components and modules; `deno fmt --check` clean on every changed file. E2E RED — the four stories on cc5d4b0e's code (`shots run` with these test files): M14 "the hand-off beside the frame … the presenter's arrow showed with no move {"x":366,"y":484.469,…}"; tab switch "the tab the stage newly follows (tab 2), his mouse still: the presenter's arrow showed with no move"; M2 "the customer's new page, his mouse still: the presenter's arrow showed with no move"; REQ-242 "REQ-451: no presenter arrow on the new page while his mouse is still — expected null, got {"x":185.286,"y":556.352}". E2E GREEN — `SHOTS_JOBS=3 shots run` of the three files, three runs in a row: the M14, tab-switch and M2 stories ✓ 3/3; REQ-242 passes step 8 and stops at step 11 (line 593, End from the customer) and REQ-305 M7 at "the quote page has the sign form's name field to jump to — expected 1, got 0", both exactly as on cc5d4b0e. The reload fix measured: a story that traces the stage's `anchorOf` (temporary console instrumentation, removed) on the M8 flow put the arrow on the Continue button (248.6, 571.9) in 5 of 12 runs — at that moment both stylesheet links had `sheet`, the logo was `complete`, `styled()` said yes and the replay was laid out unstyled (the field at y 274 full width, body 672 px instead of 909) — and in 0 of 12 after `settled()` (12 of 12 at (195, 422) on the fieldset, each first sent as a provisional fraction). ## REQ-445 — A price the contractor states for the whole job is the draft's total, and a chat-drafted quote is checked before it is saved: a missed stated total, a revision that more than triples with prices nobody typed, a first draft under the job's floor (demo-loop cycle 3, issues B2 + M20)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md, pair 7, fleet-6 l.135/220/222), issue `B2` (blocker): "'Make it around $18,000' multiplies every line by 10" — on the $2,585 master-bath draft, "no no eso está muy bajo!! $2,585 for a whole master bath?? … make it around $18,000 and add the shower bench and mold remediation allowance" came back with the shower line at $18,000, every other line ×10, a $5,000 bench and a $30,000 mold allowance: "Total $2,585 → $71,050"; and issue `M20` (major): "The first price ignores the price the user gave and is far too low" — the all-Spanish master-bath job ending "Precio? tú dime, yo pienso como 18 mil" was drafted at TOTAL $2,585.00. RCA analyst CONFIRMED (high) and skeptic UPHELD on both, at `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes cc5d4b0e with the real modules):** an open draft's correction is handled entirely by gpt-4o-mini re-issuing `create_quote`, and `handle-chat-message/mod.ts` persisted its lines as they came (`price = l.amountCents`, `estimatedTotal = sum`; `quotePriceProblem` only refuses totals ≤ 0). REQ-377's new-total reader leaves open drafts out on purpose, and `parseTargetTotalChange` returns undefined for the demo text (two `$` amounts) and even for "make it around $18,000" alone (no such pattern); `statedPriceCents` → null; nothing read a spoken "18 mil". `prompts.systemQuote` had no rule for a stated total. REQ-382's `plausibilityFloorCents` (bathroom remodel $6,000 + $500 per item; $10,000 for the demo's job) ran only inside SuggestPrices, never on `create_quote`. Side defect: `parseLineReprice("make it around $18,000")` → `{ match: "it around" }`.
**Requirement:** (1) A price the contractor states for the WHOLE job — "make it around $18,000", "yo pienso como 18 mil", "18k", "18 thousand", "18 grand", "$18 mil", "more like $18.5k", "$18,000 total", a lone "$18,000" — is read in code (`stated-price/statedTotalCents`) even when other amounts sit beside it; the current total quoted back is not a new one. It is never a line's price, a cost, a deposit, a rate or a bound ("the shower should be around $4,000", "add the bench $1,500", "I need $500 for materials", "$40 per sq ft", "under $18k", "6 mil vapor barrier", "12k btu"); on a draft, "Vanity. Make it $900." / "Add a bench. Make it $1,500." point back at that thing. (2) The stated total reaches the model (business context + a STATED TOTAL rule in `prompts.systemQuote`, en and es), and the model's `create_quote` lines are held to it: more than ±15% off → re-asked once naming both totals; still off (or no answer) → the lines are scaled to it in code (whole dollars, same lines and order, the rounding on the largest). (3) With no stated total, a revision of the same draft whose total more than triples, is not within ±15% of an amount the contractor typed (as total or increase), and carries new or repriced lines nobody priced is not saved: the reply names both totals and the unpriced lines (largest first, at most three, "and N more") and asks what they cost or what the total should be. (4) A first draft (or a fresh job in the same chat) under the job's plausibility floor is re-asked once naming the job size; still under → lifted to the floor. A total or line prices the contractor typed are never re-asked or lifted. (5) When the code replaced the model's lines, its prose is dropped: a revision gets REQ-267's reply from the saved lines ("Total $2,585 → $18,000"), a first draft its card. (6) `cleanLineName` drops a leading it/that/this/these/those and an approximator ("around", "about", …): "make it around $18,000" names no line; "make that vanity $900" → "vanity".
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/test.ts` (20 × "REQ-445 …": the demo's correction → $18,000 with and without the $2,585 quoted back; the demo's Spanish job → $18,000; spoken/short forms and Spanish cues; scoped amounts, costs, deposits, bounds, thickness, BTU, line prices and draft pointers are not totals; `missesTarget` ±15%; `scaleLinesToTotal` on the demo's $71,050 lines → exactly $18,000; `revisionJump` on the demo's bench + mold allowance and ×10 lines, not on priced additions; `revisesSameJob`; `settleQuotePrice` re-ask / scale / lift / ask / keep; the floor never overrides typed prices; `priceJumpAsk` en + es) and `backend/src/agents/domain/business/quote-line-revision/test.ts` ("REQ-445 B2 parseLineReprice …") · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/price-target.int.test.ts` (11 × "REQ-445 …", the real HandleChatMessage with the stub LLM replaying the demo model's own answers: the demo's correction on the $2,585 draft saves $18,000 with all 11 lines and replies "Total $2,585 → $18,000", never $71,050; a re-ask near the total is saved as written; an honoured total needs no second call; the unpriced bench + mold jump is asked about and the draft keeps $2,585 with no card; a priced $30,000 addition passes; the Spanish "18 mil" first draft is saved at $18,000 and the model is told; the floor re-ask names the bathroom job and a model that stays low is lifted; a re-ask over the floor is kept; a small job has no floor; the Hendersons' typed $12,100 kitchen is saved as typed; the quote prompt carries the STATED TOTAL rule) · e2e n/a — the numbers come from a live LLM that the browser lane runs as the echo stub (no `create_quote` is ever produced there), so a browser story could only replay a stub; the integration tests drive the real coordinator with the demo's own texts and model output, and the card/quote wire shape is unchanged.

## REQ-493 — Open owner pages follow what the client did: the assistant chat, /quotes and /invoices re-read what they show when the client signs, declines, claims or pays, and the owner's /q page follows its linked invoices (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m7)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m7` "Open pages don't refresh after the client acts" — the assistant chat kept the "sent" card / "Save & resend" after the customer signed (pairs 1, 7), "GATHERING A LITTLE MORE INFO" until F5 (pair 4), /quotes kept "Sent" and "Edit → Version 3" (pair 5), the owner's /q kept "paga los $450.00 pendientes" after the payment and /invoices kept a claimed invoice "Enviada" while the topbar chip already said the client paid (pair 9). RCA analyst CONFIRMED (high), skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`; related M18, m57.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked at cc5d4b0e):** there is no push channel and almost no polling on the owner's pages. AsstChat re-read its quote every 8 s only while the inline review was open (`if (previewCtaId === null) return;`, `front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx:2116`); otherwise only REQ-369's hand-back from AsstThreads' conversations poll moved it, and that poll backs off to 60 s in a tab that gets no input (REQ-424) — the owner's tab gets none while the customer signs in another. /invoices re-read its list only after the owner's own actions (`refreshInvoices`, `InvoicesPage.tsx:437`). /quotes re-read every 30 s and on window focus (REQ-321); a tab that is merely switched to in a headless browser, or a window beside the signing one, fires neither focus nor visibilitychange (pair 4: "tab 1 reports visibilityState=visible and hasFocus=true"). The one thing every owner page polls is the topbar's notifications feed (REQ-299), which is why the chip moved while the list did not. /q's REQ-396 re-read compared only the quote's own view (mode, headline, version), so a linked invoice that got paid never counted as a move.
**Requirement:** (1) One change feed for the owner's pages, `front-end/lib/change-feed.ts`, built on the notifications feed the topbar already polls (no new request, REQ-424's idle back-off unchanged): each refresh's entries that the previous list did not have and that name a document (`entityType` + `entityId`) are one batch of changes; on the first list a page sees, only what was created after the page started counts (`changesBetween`). Coming back to the window asks the feed at once (debounced by REQ-299's `CATCHUP_MIN_MS`). (2) A client action taken in THIS browser — the customer signing or declining on /q (in person on the owner's device, or "View as customer"), claiming a payment on /i — is announced to the owner's other tabs at once on the `pm:changes` BroadcastChannel (`announceChange`, `front-end/lib/change-announce.ts`; public pages import only that). (3) Islands follow with `followChanges(match, reread)`: a batch with a matching change re-reads, one read at a time, and a matching change that lands during a read re-reads once more after it. (4) /invoices re-reads its list and forecast (`refreshInvoices`) on any quote or invoice change. (5) /quotes runs its REQ-321 list re-read at once on any quote or invoice change (the open panel follows its card, REQ-396), and an invoice change re-reads an open panel (its ledger). (6) The assistant chat re-reads its bound quote on a change naming it — review open or not — and takes the row when its lifecycle moved (`boundQuoteMoved`: `openQuoteMoved`'s fields, only those the chat's row holds — a re-read with nothing new never replaces it), so the header, the quote cards, the conversation list's chip and the send-recovery form say what a reload says. (The conversation itself gains no message on a public signature, so the row is what moves.) (7) /q's re-read also counts its related documents: a linked invoice paid, claimed, added or republished (status, state, amount / paid / balance, version) or a change order decided is a move, so the signed banner's "Next: pay the $X due" and the related-documents rows follow the payment. (`front-end/lib/poll.ts` reads `globalThis.document` instead of the bare global — same behaviour — so the page decisions built on it type-check in the backend's integration tests.)
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/owner-pages-live.test.ts` ("REQ-493 …": `changesBetween` — new entries naming a document are changes, seen ones / entries naming none are not, one per document, the first list counts only what came after the page started; `subscribeChanges` on the real notifications feed — one batch for the client's signature, nothing for the baseline, a repeat or after the last follower left; `announceChange` → one batch in another tab, junk on the channel ignored, the channel closed with the last follower; a window focus asks the feed once per `CATCHUP_MIN_MS`; `followChanges` — re-reads on a match only, one at a time with one trailing re-read, survives a failed read, stops; `boundQuoteMoved` — signed / declined / a new version is a move, a re-read with nothing new (fields the chat never loaded) is not; `publicQuoteMoved` — a paid / claimed / added / republished linked invoice or a decided change order is a move, the same related documents are not; `startPublicQuoteRefresh` hands over the paid projection; wiring — InvoicesPage, QuotesPage, AsstChat (not gated on `previewCtaId`) follow the feed, PublicSignQuote / PublicQuoteActions / PublicInvoiceClaim announce) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/owner-change-feed.int.test.ts` ("REQ-493 …": the real app over HTTP — the customer's signature, their payment claim and the owner's confirm each reach GET /notifications naming the document, read through `changesBetween` as the page reads it) and `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/linked-invoice-refresh.int.test.ts` ("REQ-493 …": GET /quotes/:id/public?refresh=1 before and after the deposit is paid — `publicQuoteMoved` is true while the quote's own view is unchanged) · e2e `e2e/owner-pages-live/owner-pages-live.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-493 …", in a browser, no reload, no focus or input in the owner's tab: the chat turns "Quote accepted" and the open /quotes panel "Accepted" within 4 s of the customer signing in person in another tab; /invoices moves a claim from another device to "Awaiting confirmation" on the topbar's next notifications tick; the owner's /q drops "Next: pay the $X due" once the deposit is paid).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-owner-pages-live off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Cannot find module '../../front-end/lib/change-announce' from 'unit/owner-pages-live.test.ts'" ("Test Suites: 1 failed, 250 passed"); `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check …/owner-change-feed.int.test.ts` → `Module not found "…/front-end/lib/change-feed.ts"`; `…/linked-invoice-refresh.int.test.ts` → "AssertionError: Values are not equal: the open /q page swaps in the paid projection on its next re-read" (Actual false / Expected true, every precondition — deposit paid, balance 0, the quote's view and version unchanged — held); `BASE_URL=http://localhost:<random> shots run e2e/owner-pages-live -- --no-check` (backend on the stub LLM + vite on random high ports, fresh KV) → 4 ✗: "the chat header follows the signature within 4 s (header: \"Out for signature\", 4003 ms after it)", "the open panel follows the signature within 4 s (badge: \"SENT\", 4003 ms after it)", "the list follows the claim on the topbar's next tick (25003 ms after it)", "the signed banner and the related invoice follow the payment (25005 ms after it; banner: \"Thanks, Linda Moreno — signed on November 12, 2026. Next: pay the $925.00 due →\")". GREEN — `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2521 passed" (19 REQ-493 tests); the two int tests type-checked → "ok | 2 passed | 0 failed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/ src/communication/entrypoints/notification-controller/ src/communication/domain/coordinators/notify-on-event/ src/agents/domain/coordinators/list-conversations/` → "ok | 67 passed | 0 failed"; `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/` → "ok | 212 passed | 0 failed"; `shots run e2e/owner-pages-live` → 4 ✓ (chat, /quotes, /invoices, /q); with the neighbouring stories of the touched files (thread-status, sent-quote-composer, chat-header-status, sms-recovery, live-doc-refresh, public-page-refresh, quote-card-open, quotes-new-cta, quote-revisions, quote-revise-issued, linked-documents, invoice-card-c2, payment-received-feedback, payment-claims, signed-next-step, sign-in-person, quote-pay-now, public-invoice-paid, polling, polling-catchup, polling-load, topbar-ticker, claimed-nudge, change-order-page) → "42 pass · 4 fail"; the 4 (REQ-203 linked-documents, REQ-251 quote-pay-now, REQ-311 signed-next-step: waiting for `form.ctr__sign-form` with the owner's cookie on /q, where REQ-306 shows the owner the preview; REQ-315 quote-revise-issued: waiting for `quote-published-note` right after Publish, which REQ-304 now confirms first) fail the same way on the untouched base — a detached cc5d4b0e worktree, same script → "5 pass · 4 fail", same locators. `deno lint` clean (10 front-end files, both int tests); `deno check` — the whole front-end exit 0, the int tests under the backend's config exit 0, the story under shots' check; `deno fmt --check` clean on the 13 new / base-clean files (AsstChat.tsx, fmt-unclean at base, not reformatted).
## REQ-460 — A quote can be signed only after it went out with its payment terms, and a signed agreement's terms never change (demo-loop cycle 3, issues B1 + M16 + M15)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), pair 4 (Tom Baker, roofer). `B1`: "A signed agreement's payment terms change after signature". The customer link was signed while the assistant was still asking "When do you want to get paid?"; Tom then picked "Deposit + balance", and after a reload the signed page showed "PAYMENT TERMS Deposit + balance" under "Signed and binding". `M16`: "The customer link can be signed before the quote is finished". "Customer link / Open as customer" appeared at "Lock it in", and /q could be signed while the card said "GATHERING A LITTLE MORE INFO". `M15`: "An invoice is marked sent for the full amount without the contractor doing it". The report shows "INV-001 · Invoice $14,500.00 Sent", although Tom chose Deposit + balance.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked at cc5d4b0e):** the three issues are one chain.
- (1) AsstChat rendered the REQ-310 customer-link row under every action card whose status passed `isLockedOrIssued`, including the LOCKED card that "Lock it in" appends. So "Customer link · Open as customer" appeared while the terms wizard was still asking; under REQ-234, locking is not sending.
- (2) `POST /quotes/:id/accept` (public-controller) checked only for accepted, lost and owner. It never checked that the quote had gone out or that its terms were complete; REQ-240 listed "a completeness gate on accept" as out of scope. `quote-doc.tsx` showed the pad, and the owner's "Sign in person", on every unsigned quote. So the locked draft could be signed mid-wizard.
- (3) M15: the quote had no `payment_terms` term at that moment, so `SendSignedConfirmation` billed one invoice for the whole total, status sent. That is REQ-240's no-terms rule.
- (4) B1: the wizard stayed open. `HandleWizardAnswer` (REQ-240) wrote each answer's terms onto the quote without checking for a signature, and `QuoteStore.update()` had no guard; only `PUT /quotes` went through `quoteEditDecision`'s `locked_signed`. So "Deposit + balance" landed on the signed agreement.

**Requirement:**
- (a) In the chat, a quote card carries the customer's link only once the quote went out (sent, viewed or signed), never at lock. For the thread's own card the live quote row decides. Rule: `cardShowsCustomerLink` in `front-end/lib/customer-link.ts`.
- (b) A quote can be signed only after it went out: sent or issued, or a Send was attempted (`lastDelivery`, the REQ-236/REQ-310 fallback link). If it carries the wizard's terms, those must include the payment terms. The one rule is `quoteSignRefusal()` in `shared/documents/versions.ts`. Two exceptions: the onboarding sample (REQ-256) can always be signed, and an API quote with no wizard terms still bills in full (REQ-240).
  - Otherwise `POST /quotes/:id/accept` answers `409 { ok: false, reason: "not_issued" | "terms_incomplete" }` and bills nothing. This includes the in-person override `?as=customer&confirm=1` (REQ-306).
  - `GET /quotes/:id/public` carries `signRefusal`. /q then shows "Not ready to sign yet — This quote is still being finished. It can be signed once it's sent with its payment terms." (`data-cy="quote-not-ready"`, en + es) in place of the pad, the internal preview and "Sign in person", and the pill no longer says "Awaiting signature".
  - A pad that gets the 409 shows the same notice.
- (c) A terms-wizard answer on a signed quote writes nothing. The wizard closes, its open question is removed so a reload doesn't bring it back, and the assistant replies "{number} is already signed, so its terms can't change. To change them, make a change order or send a new version." (`wizardAnswer.signedLocked`, en + es).
- (d) `QuoteStore.update()` refuses a terms, lineItems or estimatedTotal change on a signed quote (`QuoteSignedError`, reason `locked_signed`). It compares content, so bookkeeping writes (stamps, a cached translation, an identical rewrite) still land.

**Tests:**
- unit:
  - `jest/unit/sign-gate-and-lock.test.ts` ("REQ-460 …", 14 tests): `quoteSignRefusal` cases (locked mid-wizard draft, sent without payment terms, failed send, API quote, sample); `deriveQuoteView` "unready" and `internalPreview` off, override included; `acceptDecision` maps the 409 to `not_ready`; `cardShowsCustomerLink` for card statuses and the live row; quote-doc, PublicSignQuote and AsstChat source pins; the en/es keys.
  - `front-end/lib/sign-gate.test.tsx` ("REQ-460 …", 4 tests, rendered QuoteDoc): the customer sees the notice with no pad and no "Awaiting signature"; the owner gets no "Sign in person" and no pad, with or without the override; Spanish `terms_incomplete`; a ready sent quote still has the pad.
  - `backend/src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/signed-lock.test.ts` ("REQ-460 …", 3 tests): a signed quote's terms, lines and total are refused and the row is unchanged; bookkeeping still lands; an unsigned quote's terms still change.
- integration:
  - `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/sign-gate.int.test.ts` ("REQ-460 …", 3 tests, the booted app on a real KV):
    - M16: a locked mid-wizard draft gets 409 `not_issued` for the customer and for the owner's override, nothing is billed, and the public payload says `not_issued`.
    - M15: a sent quote without payment terms gets 409 `terms_incomplete`. With 50/50 added, the accept bills 725000 + 725000.
    - A failed-send draft and a sent API quote with no terms can still be signed.
  - `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-wizard-answer/int.test.ts` ("REQ-460 (demo-loop cycle 3, B1) …", 2 tests): an answer after signing writes nothing, replies with the en (and es) copy, closes the wizard with no question left open and no `terms_drafted`, and a second tap gives the same reply.
- e2e: `e2e/sign-gate/sign-gate.e2e.test.ts` (2 stories):
  - M16 + M15: the locked card has no customer link. /q, plain and with the override, shows the notice with no pad and no "Sign in person". Both accepts are 409. After Send, the card carries the `/q/<id>` link and the signature bills 725000 + 725000.
  - B1: after the signature, rewinding and clicking "Deposit + balance" shows the refusal naming Q-001, "change order" and "new version". No wizard options are left, the stored payment term is unchanged, /q shows no "Deposit + balance", and after a reload there is no wizard.

**Tests amended (a quote is now sent before it is signed; POST /quotes keeps `status: "sent"` a draft, NW-10, so each one PUTs `{status:"sent"}` first):**
- backend: `public-controller/e2e.test.ts`, `public-controller/pay-now.int.test.ts`, `public-controller/public-draft-invoice.int.test.ts`, `invoice-controller/overbill.e2e.test.ts`, `notification-controller/e2e.test.ts`, `clients-controller/paging.int.test.ts`, `chat-controller/intent.e2e.test.ts`, `chat-controller/owed-pricing.e2e.test.ts`.
- `wizard-controller/partial-terms.e2e.test.ts`: the half-finished accept is now 409 `not_issued`; the wizard is then finished, the quote sent and signed, and the due date reads net 15.
- jest: `unit/customer-link-access.test.ts` (REQ-310: the action card's row is gated by `cardShowsCustomerLink`), plus the live `integration/{public-doc-state,ux-accept-billing,invoice-parity,activity-feed-lang}.int.test.ts`.
- stories: `e2e/{chat-deposit-invoice,invoice-overbilling,form-a11y,thread-status}`.

**Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, branch fix/c3-sign-gate-and-lock off cc5d4b0e):**
- RED first:
  - `deno test -A --unstable-kv …/quote-store/signed-lock.test.ts` → "FAILED | 2 passed | 1 failed" ("Expected function to reject.").
  - `…/handle-wizard-answer/int.test.ts --filter REQ-460` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed" ("Values are not equal: the signed terms stand").

## REQ-523 — No text is reported sent, or promised, to a number that cannot get one (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m16)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m16` — "The app says texts were sent to numbers that can't get texts" (pair 2, fleet-1 stdout:187: "Le mandamos a Luis Gómez el enlace para entrar y su PIN por texto." to (305) 555-0123; pair 7, fleet-7 stdout:191: "We texted (512) 555-0199 an invite"; pair 9, fleet-9 stdout:184: "the invoice still says 'we'll text you a receipt then'" for 5125550142; pairs 6, 9, 10: the hint "like (512) 555-1234" next to "that's a made-up 555 number"). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on cc5d4b0e):** REQ-403 guarded only the customer quote/invoice texts (`dispatchCustomerSms`). Every other sender called `SmsService.send` directly, and with no `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID` `send` answered `{ ok: true }` for ANY number (`users/domain/data/sms/mod.ts:63-67`). (a) The worker welcome returned `texted: sent.ok` (`field-controllers/mod.ts:109`). (b) `AccountAdmins.invite` dropped the result, so /admins always showed `admins.sent`, in production too. (c) `ConfirmPayment` texted the raw `customer.phoneNumber` and logged a "text" comms row whatever the answer (`confirm-payment/mod.ts:201-211`). (d) `PublicInvoiceClaim.tsx:137` and `/i/[id].tsx:1168` promised a text receipt unconditionally. (e) `customer.invalidPhone` gave "(512) 555-1234" as its example, while `sms.fictionalNumber` called any "555 number" made-up.
**Requirement:** (1) `SmsService.send` asks `smsTarget` (`users/domain/business/normalize-phone/mod.ts`) BEFORE the dev-mode short circuit. A number that is missing, not dialable by the customer-save rule (`customerPhoneE164`), or fictional (NANP area code 555, or 555-01XX) is refused in dev mode and production alike with `{ ok: false, failureCode: "missing" | "invalid" | "fictional", reason: "sms.invalidNumber" | "sms.fictionalNumber" }`, and never reaches the provider. A dialable number is sent as E.164. So every direct sender (worker welcome, editor invite, field notices, alerts, demo request, OTP, reminders) gets an honest `ok`. (2) `POST /me/admins` answers the record plus `texted`. /admins shows `admins.sent` only for `texted: true`, else `admins.notTexted` ("We couldn't text {phone} an invite — they can still sign in with that number. Let them know yourself."). (3) The payment receipt text goes through `dispatchCustomerSms`. A "text" comms row is logged only when the provider accepted it, addressed to the E.164 number. (4) `GET /invoices/:id/public` carries `receiptChannel`: REQ-403's `signedConfirmChannel` over the customer record ConfirmPayment sends to — "email", "text" (a textable number) or "none". The claim thanks (`claimThanksKey`) and the claimed note (`claimedNoteKey`, `shared/documents/receipt-note.ts`) promise an email receipt, a text receipt, or no receipt ("This page will show it as paid once … confirms"), en + es. (5) `customer.invalidPhone` reads "Enter a full phone number — 10 digits, area code first." (no 555 example). `sms.fictionalNumber` names "a reserved test number (555-01XX or area code 555)", en + es.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/users/domain/data/sms/fictional-guard.test.ts` ("REQ-523 m16 …": dev mode refuses +13055550123 / (512) 555-0199 / 5125550142 / (555) 123-4567 with failureCode fictional and no dial; the same with Twilio configured; missing, "12345", "555-12" and "+1bogus" refused; (512) 555-1234 and +13055551234 dialled as E.164) · unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/confirm-payment/receipt-sms.test.ts` ("REQ-523 (m16) payment receipt: …": a 555-01XX customer is not dialled and gets no "text" row; a provider rejection logs no row; a real number is texted and logged once as +15125551234) · unit `jest/unit/sms-fictional-guard.test.ts` ("REQ-523 (m16) …": `receiptChannelOf`, `claimThanksKey`, `claimedNoteKey`; the en/es variants promise exactly their channel and the none variants promise nothing; the island and the route pick through the channel; `admins.notTexted` and AdminsPage's `texted === true`; no 555 in `customer.invalidPhone`; `sms.fictionalNumber` names 555-01XX) · integration `backend/src/users/entrypoints/admins-controller/invite-texted.int.test.ts` (pair 7's invite → 201 `texted: false`; a real number `texted: true`) · integration `backend/src/field/entrypoints/worker-welcome-fictional.int.test.ts` (pair 2's worker → 201 `texted: false`; a real number `texted: true`) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/receipt-channel.int.test.ts` (app booted, SMS in dev mode: pair 9's 5125550142 → `receiptChannel` "none" and no "text" receipt in `GET /messages` after claim → confirm; a real number → "text" and one receipt to +15125552322; an email → "email"; no contact → "none") · e2e `e2e/sms-fictional-guard/sms-fictional-guard.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-523 m16: …", in a browser: the /admins invite to 5125550199 shows "We couldn't text (512) 555-0199"; the /field/workers add of (305) 555-0123 shows data-texted "false"; the customer's Zelle claim on /i for 5125550142 shows no "text you a receipt" before or after a reload, and a real number keeps it). REQ-523 AMENDMENT of other tests' DATA (not their intent), because the guard now refuses their numbers: `sms/smk.test.ts` (REQ-030's Twilio mapping and the 4xx smoke now dial +15125551234, since +15125550100 and "+1bogus" never reach the provider), `field/entrypoints/field.int.test.ts` (REQ-171/172/255's customer +18435550199 → +18435550299), `agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/int.test.ts` (REQ-276 reads the new Spanish reason "número de prueba reservado").
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-sms-fictional-guard off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first. `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/users/domain/data/sms/fictional-guard.test.ts` → "TS2339 Property 'failureCode' does not exist on type 'SendSmsResult'"; with `--no-check` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 4 failed" (dev mode answered `[true, undefined, "dev_mode_no_dispatch"]` for +13055550123; the fictional number was dialled with Twilio configured; "(512) 555-1234" was dialled raw). `confirm-payment/receipt-sms.test.ts` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 3 failed" (the receipt "text" was logged to "5125550142", the demo's exact number; a rejected text was logged as sent). `invite-texted.int.test.ts` → `texted` undefined, "FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed". `worker-welcome-fictional.int.test.ts` → `texted` true, "FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed". `receipt-channel.int.test.ts` → `receiptChannel` undefined, "FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed". `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Could not locate module ../../shared/documents/receipt-note.ts". `SHOTS_JOBS=1 shots run e2e/sms-fictional-guard` → "2 fail": "the invite says it could not text (We texted (512) 555-0199 an invite — they sign in with that number.)" and "no text-receipt promise to 555-0142 (THANKS!
