The touched modules and their neighbours (sms, confirm-payment, admins-controller, customer-sms, send-signed-confirmation, failed-sms-truth, field.int, send-quote int, normalize-phone, demo-request, send-otp) → "ok | 139 passed | 0 failed". `deno test -A --unstable-kv --parallel src/` → "1914 passed | 6 failed": on the base `cc5d4b0e` the same command gave "1904 passed | 6 failed". The failures are parallel env races and a fixed-port AddrInUse (field REQ-171/172/177, choose-plan, me-controller REQ-112), each "ok" alone (field.int 23 passed, choose-plan 31, me-controller 3), plus REQ-123's real-Postmark smoke, which needs the real key and also fails on the base. `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2515 passed". `SHOTS_JOBS=1 shots run e2e/sms-fictional-guard` → "2 pass · 0 fail". `deno lint` and `deno check` are clean on every touched file (field.int.test.ts's pre-existing `any` aside). `deno fmt` was run on the new files and on the files that were fmt-clean at the base; confirm-payment/mod.ts, sms/smk.test.ts and admins-controller/mod.ts were not clean there and were left unformatted. en/es key sets are equal (3997 each). Not changed (out of m16's scope): the payment-reminder nudge still counts "sms" as sent without reading the answer (`send-payment-reminder/mod.ts:160`), and the paid note's "A PDF receipt is in your inbox" is not channel-aware.
## REQ-474 — A direct New invoice shows what the client already has, and the assistant tells owed now from still to bill (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M17)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `M17` — "Same job invoiced twice with no warning; the assistant says $360 owed, Clientes says $180" (fleet-re05e1cbb-1 stdout:115,175,181: INV-001 PROGRAMADA plus INV-002 Enviada; "Ana Pérez te debe $360"; Clientes "$180 pendiente"). RCA analyst CONFIRMED (high), skeptic UPHELD at `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** `NewInvoiceModal.submit` (`front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx`) built the body from the form alone — "Bill a client directly — no quote" — with no look at the picked client's scheduled / draft / open invoices or signed quotes, and no quoteId, so the REQ-233 agreement cap never ran: INV-002 $180 went out beside the scheduled INV-001 $180. Then `owedReply` (`backend/src/agents/domain/business/chat-answers/mod.ts`, REQ-388) summed open + drafts + scheduled + unbilled = $360 while the Clientes card used REQ-397 `isOpenReceivable` (sent / viewed / claimed / pending) = $180. Standalone New invoice since 8b4823c0; the wider owed sum from REQ-388 (cycle 2).
**Requirement:** (1) In the New invoice modal, picking an existing client shows what they already have — `priorBillingFor()` in `shared/documents/invoice-form.ts`: their unpaid scheduled / drafted / out-for-payment invoices (by customerId or through one of their quotes; amount = what is still owed) and their signed quotes with money left to bill or a bill still in flight — e.g. "Ana Pérez already has INV-001 ($180.00) scheduled for Q-001." / "Ana Pérez ya tiene INV-001 ($180.00) programada para Q-001.", with **Send INV-001 now** on a scheduled or drafted one (issues it — status sent — and dispatches it; no second invoice) and **Link to Q-001** on a signed quote (the form becomes quote-linked: ledger strip, prefill, and the body sends that quoteId so the REQ-233 cap applies). (2) The assistant's "what does X owe me" answer uses the Clientes card's rule: owed NOW is the open receivable (`isOpenReceivable`, at `receivableBalanceCents`); drafts, scheduled invoices and the unbilled part of signed quotes are "not billed yet" and never added to it — "Ana Pérez te debe $180 ahora; $180 más aún no se ha facturado." / "… owes you $180 now; $180 more isn't billed yet."; with only future money, "… todavía no te debe nada — $400 aún no se ha facturado." `OwedReply` carries `owedCents` (now) and `upcomingCents`.
**REQ-388 revision:** REQ-388's tests asserted the old summed headline ("Ana López te debe $400" for a scheduled-only bill; "John Miller owes you $3,200" for $1,600 out + $1,600 scheduled). They now assert the split headline above (unit `chat-answers/test.ts`, integration `owed-pricing.int.test.ts`, e2e `owed-pricing.e2e.test.ts`); every other REQ-388 assertion (the invoice sentences, dates, Spanish-only, never "se envió") is unchanged.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/chat-answers/test.ts` ("REQ-474 M17 owedReply: the demo's books … $180 owed now and $180 not billed yet, never $360", "REQ-474 M17 owedReply: owed now is what is still owed …") and `jest/unit/new-invoice-prior-billing.test.ts` ("REQ-474 …": `priorBillingFor` finds Ana's scheduled INV-001 for Q-001; draft / open counted, paid / void / other clients not; nothing for no / new client; lost and sample quotes never offered; 12 en/es keys in sync and the demo sentence; the island passes `invoices=`, reads `priorBillingFor(`, sends `quoteId: linkedQuoteId`) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/owed-pricing.int.test.ts` ("REQ-474 M17: the demo's books … the same $180 the Clientes card shows" — the reply's $180 now equals `BuildCustomerCards` `balanceCents`) · e2e `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/owed-pricing.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-474 M17 e2e: the demo's books over HTTP …") and browser `e2e/invoice-prior-billing/invoice-prior-billing.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-474 M17: picking a client with a scheduled INV-001 … 'Send INV-001 now' sends it instead of a second invoice", "REQ-474 M17: 'Link to Q-001' makes the New invoice quote-linked — a second $180 … is refused by the agreement cap").
**Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, branch fix/c3-standalone-invoice-dup off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/business/chat-answers/test.ts` → both REQ-474 tests failed ("Values are not equal: owed now = the open receivable  - 36000 + 18000"; "- 18000 + 13000"); integration `--filter "/REQ-(474|388 M19)/"` → REQ-474 failed with the demo's own words: `Expected actual: "Ana Pérez te debe $360. La factura de $180 (INV-002) ya se envió …" to contain: "Ana Pérez te debe $180 ahora; $180 más aún no se ha facturado."`; HTTP e2e → the same "$360" reply; jest `new-invoice-prior-billing` → "19 failed" (`priorBillingFor is not a function`, keys undefined); `shots run e2e/invoice-prior-billing` on the baseline island → "0 passed | 2 failed", "✗ REQ-474 … locator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded" (no warning ever shown). GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/ src/paperwork/domain/business/open-receivable/` → "ok | 622 passed | 0 failed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2521 passed"; `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/invoice-prior-billing e2e/invoice-overbilling -- --no-check` → ✓ REQ-474 ×2, ✓ REQ-233 ×2. `deno lint` + `deno check islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` clean; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file.

## REQ-461 — The send dialog names the language the quote goes out in and shows what the client gets — email subject + body and text — before Send (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m8)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m8` — "No preview of the email/SMS the client gets and no send-language choice (Settings promises it)"; RCA at `cc5d4b0e`, analyst FEATURE_GAP (high), skeptic UPHELD (pair 6 12:13:43: "NO email or SMS text preview, NO language choice"). Reported in cycle 2 as m37, not addressed then.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** the send dialog (`front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx`, `data-cy="send-dialog"`) offered only Text + Email / Text only / Email only plus the missing-contact fields. The language the quote went out in was the review card's "Preview in" pill (rendered only when `sendLangs.length > 1`), silently passed as `sendQuoteNow(m, ch, previewLang, …)` from `keepAndSend`. Nothing rendered the customer's email or text before Send, although `lang/*.json` `settings.commsLangHint` says "On each quote you can preview and send in any of them". The server already had the templates (`renderQuoteSubject` / `renderQuoteHtml` in send-paperwork-email, `renderQuoteBody` in send-paperwork-sms), but no route rendered them without sending.
**Requirement:** (1) `GET /quotes/:id/send-preview?channel=email|sms|both&lang=en|es` (owner only) answers `{ lang, email?: { to?, subject, html }, sms?: { to?, body }, needsName? }`. It uses the same renderers and the same short link (`paperworkShortUrl`, now shared with SendPaperworkSms) as the real send, in the picked language (else the Settings default, else en), with a pending revision applied in memory the way the send would publish it. It sends nothing, publishes nothing, stamps no status/sentAt/lastDelivery, logs nothing, and does not adopt the pick as the default language. An unknown channel previews both; an account with no name answers `needsName` (the send would refuse). (2) For a quote, the send dialog shows "Sends in: English | Español" (`asstChat.send.sendsIn`; one pill when only one language is configured), bound to the same `previewLang` the Send uses. Picking a language moves the review card too. Below it is a collapsed "What they'll get" (`<details>`). Opening it loads the preview for the chosen channel and language, and it reloads when either changes: the subject, the email itself in a sandboxed `<iframe srcdoc>`, and the text message, each with its recipient. Loading, failure ("you can still send") and needs-name states are covered. All copy is in en + es. Invoice-mode sends are unchanged. `settings.commsLangHint` is left as is because it is now true.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/send-dialog-lang-preview.test.ts` ("REQ-461 …": `sendPreviewPath` / `sendPreviewSections` / `parseSendPreviewQuery` in `shared/quote-flow/send-preview.ts`; the dialog renders `<SendLangPreview` for non-invoice sends with `sendLang={previewLang}`, `langs={sendLangs}`, `channel={dialogChannel}` and a pick that calls `setPreviewLang(`; Send still `sendQuoteNow(m, ch, previewLang, …)`; `quotesClient.sendPreview` uses the shared path; the 8 new keys exist and differ in en/es) · unit (SSR) `front-end/lib/send-lang-preview.test.tsx` (the real component: "Sends in" + a pill per language with the send language `aria-pressed`, one language still named in es "Se envía en", `<details>` closed by default with "What they'll get"; `SendPreviewBody` shows the subject, the email in an `iframe[sandbox=""]` srcdoc, the text, only the channel's parts, needs-name copy) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/preview-quote-send/int.test.ts` (es preview → "Cotización … Diaz Painting … Pintura del baño", text with Juan + `?lang=es`; en sections per channel; a sent quote with a pending edit previews the edit while version, pendingRevision, status and lastDelivery stay untouched and no commsLanguage is adopted; another user's quote rejects; a placeholder-named account gets `needsName`) · e2e (HTTP) `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/quote-controller/send-preview.e2e.test.ts` (bootstrapped server: `?channel=both&lang=es` → 200 with Spanish subject, html and `?lang=es` text; `?channel=sms&lang=en` → no email; the quote is still a draft with no sentAt/lastDelivery; anonymous → 401/403) · browser e2e n/a — the browser lane is not run in the demo-loop fix step; the dialog markup is asserted by the SSR render test and the wiring test, the data by the HTTP e2e.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, local, branch fix/c3-send-dialog-lang-preview off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/preview-quote-send/int.test.ts` → "TS2307 Cannot find module …/preview-quote-send/mod.ts"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/quote-controller/send-preview.e2e.test.ts` → "AssertionError: Values are not equal … - 404 + 200" (the route did not exist); `npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/send-dialog-lang-preview.test.ts` → "Cannot find module '../../shared/quote-flow/send-preview'"; `deno test -A lib/send-lang-preview.test.tsx` → type check failed, components/SendLangPreview.tsx not found. GREEN — preview-quote-send int "ok | 4 passed | 0 failed"; send-preview e2e "ok | 1 passed | 0 failed"; the neighbouring backend run (preview-quote-send, quote-controller, send-paperwork-sms, send-paperwork-email, agents send-quote) "ok | 56 passed | 0 failed"; SSR test "ok | 3 passed | 0 failed"; jest unit (the run sweeps the whole unit project) "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2509 passed"; `deno check` on AsstChat.tsx / SendLangPreview.tsx / clients/quotes.ts and backend `bootstrap/mod.ts` clean; `deno lint` clean on every touched file; `deno fmt --check` clean on every new file (AsstChat.tsx not formatted as a whole: known-unformattable).
## REQ-437 — The demo pointer's name tag never covers what it points at and is never clipped by the window (demo-loop cycle 3, issues m3 + p8-pair3-a; REVISION of REQ-374's above-left tag)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issues `m3` — "Pointer name tags cover the element they point at" ('Alex' over 'Continuar', 'Tom Baker' over 'Lock it in', 'Aisha Bello' over 'Custom') — and `p8-pair3-a` — "'Alex' pointer label clipped to 'ex' at the left edge" (fleet-2, pair 3, C 12:14:17). RCA at `cc5d4b0e`: m3 CONFIRMED (skeptic UPHELD), p8-pair3-a LIKELY (skeptic UNVERIFIABLE).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** REQ-374 (352ea567) placed the tag above-left of the tip with a 6 px gap (`DemoPointer.tsx` `bottom:${ARROW_H + TAG_GAP}px` / `right:${ARROW_W + TAG_GAP}px`), chosen by `tagPlacement` in `shared/demo-mode/motion.ts` from the point alone, never from the element pointed at — so a control hovered near its centre had its label row under the tag. The side was computed from `glide.pointer` (the glide TARGET) while the arrow is drawn at the gliding position (`use-glide.ts` paint/shownRef), and the tag's width was an estimate (`16 + name.length * 7.5`).
**Requirement:** the tag sits OUTSIDE the box of the element the pointer is anchored to — past that element's edge with the most room in the bounds (below / above / right / left, never over the arrow, within `TAG_REACH` of the tip); with no element (or none of its edges fits within reach) it sits below-right past the arrow's tail (≥ ARROW_H + 6 below the tip), above the tip only where the bounds' bottom leaves no room. It is always clamped inside the bounds (the stage's frame, the customer's window). It is placed on every painted frame from the DRAWN arrow (use-glide's paint hands each position to `attach`'s `onPaint`) with the tag's measured size (`offsetWidth/Height`, the estimate only before layout), and the side is marked on `data-tag-side`. The element's rect travels with the point: the overlay's `rectOnScreen` (recorder.nodeOf), the stage's `rectOnStage` (new replayer `rectOf`), `PointerCmd.rect`, `glide.rect`; none when the pointer is `outside`.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-pointer-tag-spot.test.ts` ("REQ-437 …": the m3 40 px button hovered at its centre — tag off the button and off the arrow; a full-width sidebar row at the left edge; the edge with most room wins (above at the bottom, below at the top); no element → below-right past the tail, above only at the bottom; p8 'Alex' at x = 0..30 and at the right edge never clipped, clamped to a stage frame; a sweep of tips × elements always inside the box; a page-sized element falls back to the tail; wiring from use-glide's paint → onPaint, DemoPointer's `data-tag-side` + `offsetWidth`, PeerPointer/overlay/stage/replayer rects) · integration `front-end/lib/demo-pointer-tag.test.tsx` (DemoPointer SSR places the tag outside the element with its side marked; `placeTag` uses the MEASURED size and stays inside either edge; an unmeasured tag uses the estimate) · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pointer-tag.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-437 (demo m3) …": the presenter "Alex" rests at the centre of a /q button — on the customer's screen his tag overlaps none of it and is inside the window; "REQ-437 (demo p8-pair3-a) …": his tag sampled on every rAF of a glide to the frame's left edge never leaves the window, and the customer's tag at their left edge is inside the stage's frame).
**Superseded REQ-374 / REQ-242 / REQ-305 assertions amended:** `jest/unit/demo-mode-pointer-look.test.ts` and `jest/unit/demo-mode-mirror.test.ts` asserted the above-left `{left, up}` result — now the tail placement and box clamping of the new `{x, y, side}`; `front-end/lib/demo-pointer-look.test.tsx` asserted `right:`/`bottom:` — now below the tail with `data-tag-side="tail"`; `jest/unit/demo-mode-pointer-anchor.test.ts` regexes accept `glideTo`'s third (rect) argument.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-pointer-tag-placement off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-pointer-tag-spot` → 8 failed (the old `tagPlacement` returned `{left, up}`: no `x/y/side`, the tag overlapped the button; no onPaint wiring); `deno test -A lib/demo-pointer-tag.test.tsx` → TS2614 "no exported member 'placeTag'", TS2322 "Property 'rect' does not exist"; `shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-pointer-tag.e2e.test.ts` → "✗ REQ-437 (demo m3) … timed out: Alex's tag … is off the button {left:56,top:684.2,width:306.8,height:31.9} (last: tag {left:159.3,top:669.6,width:44.1,height:24.6})" — the bug reproduced; the p8 story PASSED at baseline (the mid-glide clip is not reproduced in a real browser, matching the skeptic's UNVERIFIABLE; it stays as a guard, and the fix removes the mechanism: drawn position, measured size, clamping). GREEN — jest unit project "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2510 passed"; `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/` → "ok | 215 passed | 0 failed"; `shots run e2e/demo-mode/*.e2e.test.ts` → 11 pass · 9 fail, the same 9 failing identically on an untouched cc5d4b0e worktree (REQ-153…, REQ-214, REQ-228, REQ-232 ×3, REQ-242, REQ-305 M7, REQ-379 — baseline, not this change), plus ✓ both REQ-437 stories. `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on the touched front-end/shared files; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched and new file.
## REQ-439 — Job-detail options and first drafts keep every quantity and item the contractor typed (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M9)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `M9` — "Job-detail options drop quantities, the slab drain, the bench, the mold and '4 cuartos de acre'" (fleet-6 stdout: all three kitchen cards dropped 22 lf / 48 sq ft / 35 sq ft / 3x6 / 5 LEDs, the slab drain was missing from every card even after the correction, and the first master-bath draft dropped the shower bench and the mold allowance; fleet-1 stdout: no lawn option kept "4 cuartos de acre"). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** `prompts.generateJobOptions` capped every bullet at "≈3–7 words" and had no rule to keep a number, measurement or quantity. REQ-400's `coverageVerdict` (generate-job-options/mod.ts) compared the options with EACH OTHER (`partitionByCoverage`) and the typed text only by count (`detail*2 < typed.length`), so an item or quantity every option dropped was invisible; `rewriteJobOnStep` runs the same coordinator. The `create_quote` first draft in handle-chat-message was persisted with no check at all.
**Requirement:** the prompt (en + es) keeps every number, measurement and quantity the contractor typed verbatim, in the bullet that names its item, in every option, and lifts the word cap for such a bullet. The typed text is the yardstick (`shared/quote-flow/typed-coverage.ts`): its work items (no price, schedule, payment, address or chat-command talk, no bare name, no private-cost statement) and the quantities they carry (never a price, a duration, a year/ZIP, a street number). A job-options reply whose best option leaves out a typed work item, or any option a typed quantity, is asked again ONCE with them listed (`prompts.generateJobOptions.typedRetry`); the reply with fewer gaps wins; a quantity still missing goes back into the line that names its item ("Exhaust fan and 4 recessed lights", "Install shaker cabinets (22 lf)"), or becomes its own line, in every option and language. On a step correction the yardstick is the job + the correction (`typed`), never the request's framing. A `create_quote` FIRST draft (no bound quote, not a change order) that has no line for a typed work item (≥3 work items typed) is asked again once naming them (`prompts.createQuote.missingLines`); the re-asked draft is used when it is still priced, has at least as many lines and leaves out fewer items.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/typed-coverage.test.ts` ("REQ-439 …": the kitchen's quantities 22/48/35/3x6/4/5 and not the duration or price; the lawn's "4 cuartos de acre" and not $180; the bath's 60"/145 and not "18 mil"; missing vs kept quantities incl. "3 x 6" / "Five"; `withQuantity` puts "22 lf" / "4 recessed lights" back; the bath's bench and mold are work items, the start date and the price talk are not; the slab drain is missed; the bath draft misses the bench and the mold and nothing it has a line for) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/generate-job-options/int.test.ts` ("REQ-439 (M9) …": dropped quantities + slab drain → one re-ask naming them, the keeping reply used; dropped twice → every option gets them back in the naming line, no extra line; the lawn keeps "4 cuartos de acre" in es and en; a reply that keeps everything is not re-asked; a step correction's framing is never a missing item; the prompt rule in en + es) and `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts` ("REQ-439 (M9) …": the master-bath first draft without bench/mold is re-asked once naming only them and the full draft is stored; a complete first draft is not re-asked) · e2e n/a — the defect is the real model's reply; the browser lane runs the stub LLM, which neither drops items nor drafts from free text. The integration tests drive the real coordinators with the demo's shapes of reply.
**REQ-400 test amended:** "a model that splits the job twice: the parts merge …" expected the merged bullets verbatim; the typed "60in double vanity" and "4 recessed lights" were dropped by both replies, so the merged version now carries "Double vanity (60in)" and "Exhaust fan and 4 recessed lights" (es: the same quantities appended).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-job-options-keep-qty off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/typed-coverage.test.ts` → "Test Suites: 1 failed" (Cannot find module `../../shared/quote-flow/typed-coverage`); `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check …/generate-job-options/int.test.ts --filter REQ-439` → "FAILED | 2 passed | 4 failed" ("Values are not equal: re-asked exactly once"; `es "Corte de césped y limpieza" lost the lot size: ["Corte de césped semanal","Limpieza de hojas"]`; "en: no keep-the-numbers rule"); `…/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts --filter REQ-439` → "FAILED | 1 passed | 1 failed" ("re-asked exactly once"). GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/ src/agents/domain/coordinators/generate-job-options/` → "ok | 135 passed | 0 failed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/` → "ok | 621 passed | 0 failed"; jest unit project → "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2510 passed". `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on the touched files; `deno fmt` applied to the two mod.ts files, option-bullets.ts, typed-coverage.ts and the new jest test (both int.test.ts files were already unformatted at baseline and are left so).
## REQ-438 — The assistant reads a delete-invoice ask and a new-quote ask for what they are, answers in the language typed, and never loops on "which job is this change order for?" (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M7)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `M7` — "Delete-invoice and new-quote requests become change orders, answered in English, and loop". Pair 6 (fleet-5 stdout:62-67, 212-217; app in EN) typed "Cotización para María José Peña: cambiar la llave del fregadero de la cocina, $180 todo incluido." → "I couldn't find a quote for María José Peña, so I didn't make a new one. Which job is this change order for?", then "No es change order, es una cotización NUEVA…" → "Which customer's job is this change order for?". Pair 1 (fleet-1 stdout:43, 117; app in ES) typed "No, el trabajo es solo de $180. Borra la factura repetida INV-001 por favor." → "¿Cuánto debe sumar Eliminar factura INV-001 a Q-001 …? Dime el monto ("agrega … $1,250") o el nuevo total ("cambia Q-001 a $19,750")".
**Cause (RCA analyst CONFIRMED + skeptic UPHELD, at cc5d4b0e):** (a) the chat model has only quote tools (`chat-routing` ALL_TOOLS), so a delete-invoice ask was squeezed into `change_order` and hit ApplyChatChangeOrder's askAmount, whose template (lang es/en `chatCoordinator.changeOrder.askAmount`) carried fixed $1,250 / $19,750 examples; (b) `CHANGE_ORDER_RE` (change-order-intent/mod.ts) matched the denial "No es change order…", so the REQ-238 coercion in handle-chat-message turned the model's `create_quote` into a customer-less change order → askCustomer, every turn; (c) `replyLang` was the app language only (`contractor.language`); (d) the first Spanish message was sent to `change_order` by the model itself.
**Requirement:** (1) "change order" that is denied ("no es / not a / isn't a / no change order", "no es una orden de cambio") is not a change-order request, and an outright NEW quote ("cotización nueva", "nueva cotización", "presupuesto nuevo", "new / separate / another quote", not itself denied) wins over change-order wording in the same message (`isChangeOrderRequest`, `isNewQuoteRequest`). (2) The model's `create_quote` is not coerced into a change order when the customer the request names has no quote. (3) In a conversation with no quote yet, a message that asks for a new quote ("Cotización para … / Quote for …" or an outright new quote) that the model sends to `change_order` with no quote to land on becomes the `create_quote` draft (the typed amount when exactly one, else the model's), never the "didn't make a new one" dead end. (4) Every coordinator reply follows the language the message was typed in (`messageLang`: es/en from function words and lower-case accented words — a Spanish NAME doesn't flip an English sentence), falling back to the app language when it can't tell. (5) "Borra / elimina / anula la factura INV-001", "delete / void / cancel invoice INV-001" is answered in code, before the model and the billing answer, from the contractor's own invoices: how to delete it ("open Invoices, tap INV-001, then “Delete invoice” and confirm"), that a paid one stays on the record, or that the number wasn't found — nothing is written. A line taken off an invoice, a billing ask and a change order are not deletes (`parseInvoiceRemoval`). (6) The change-order "how much?" question builds its examples from the job's own amounts — the typed amount (else a tenth of the job, else $100) and the job's total plus it (`askAmountExamples`) — never $1,250 / $19,750.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/test.ts` ("REQ-438 M7 isChangeOrderRequest: a denied 'change order' is not one", "REQ-438 M7 isNewQuoteRequest: …wins over change-order wording", "REQ-438 M7 askAmountExamples: …never $1,250 / $19,750"), `backend/src/agents/domain/business/invoice-removal-intent/test.ts` ("REQ-438 M7 parseInvoiceRemoval: …" ×3 — the demo's exact sentence → INV-001; en/es verbs; a line FROM an invoice / a change order / billing is not a delete), `backend/src/agents/domain/business/message-language/test.ts` ("REQ-438 M7 messageLang: …" ×3 — the demo's Spanish messages read es; English with Spanish names reads en; too short → undefined) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/misroute.int.test.ts` ("REQ-438 M7: …" ×9 — pair 6's first message with the model's change_order drafts the $180 quote; the denial with the model's create_quote drafts it; create_quote for a customer with no quote is not coerced; replies follow the typed language both ways and fall back to the app language; pair 1's "Borra la factura repetida INV-001" with the model's change_order answers how to delete INV-001 without calling the model, writing nothing; English ask in English; a paid invoice stays; an unknown number; the askAmount examples read $180 / $360 on the $180 job) · e2e n/a — the misroutes need the real OpenAI model to pick change_order (the browser lane runs the stub LLM); the new answers are server-authored text bubbles that the chat already renders verbatim, and the integration tests drive the real coordinator end to end with the model's exact demo payloads. Not changed: the system prompt (a large shared string other branches edit; the deterministic guards above cover what the prompt misled).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-chat-co-misroute off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check …/handle-chat-message/misroute.int.test.ts` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 9 failed" (new-quote cases "Values are not equal: a draft quote is made"; the delete ask got "La factura de $180 (INV-001) está en borrador y aún no se ha enviado." / "Factura INV-001 · vence el 12 dic"; askAmount reproduced the demo verbatim: "…("agrega Poda de setos $1,250") o el nuevo total ("cambia Q-001 a $19,750")…"); `change-order-intent/test.ts` → "FAILED | 23 passed | 3 failed" ("Values are not equal: No es change order, es una cotización NUEVA para María José Peña, $180.", new helpers not implemented); `invoice-removal-intent/test.ts` + `message-language/test.ts` → 6 failed (not implemented). GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/ src/paperwork/` → "ok | 940 passed | 0 failed"; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 250 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2502 passed"; `deno test src/core` → "ok | 66 passed"; `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on the touched files; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched/new file.
## REQ-497 — Documents speak the app's language: dashboard job/quote rows use the per-language title, and a standalone invoice gets its other-language title and concepts (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m23)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m23` — "Documents mix languages (INV-002 title Spanish on /i?lang=en; English job names on the Spanish dashboard)" (fleet-re05e1cbb-8 stdout:191-192, fleet-re05e1cbb-0 stdout:116,179). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic CORRECTED at `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** `front-end/islands/DashboardPage.tsx` `quoteToRow` rendered `desc: q.summary` although the QuoteCard it gets (build-quote-cards spreads `...q`) already carries `jobNameByLang`/`summaryByLang`; `jobToRow` rendered `task: j.quote.summary`, and `backend/src/analytics/domain/coordinators/list-active-jobs/mod.ts` projected only `{ id, summary, estimatedTotalCents }` into the job's quote. Both rows predate REQ-394, whose `quoteJobTitle` rule was scoped to /quotes. Standalone invoices never had per-language text: `public-controller` copied only `jobName`/`description`, so `/i/[id].tsx`'s `jobNameByLang?.[lang] ?? jobName` always fell back to what was typed.
**Requirement:** the dashboard's Active jobs row and Quotes awaiting row title a document with `quoteJobTitle(…, lang)` — `jobNameByLang[lang]` → `jobName` → `summaryByLang[lang]` → `summary` — via `front-end/lib/dashboard-titles.ts` (`jobRowTitle`, `quoteRowTitle`); `GET /jobs` carries the quote's `jobName`, `jobNameByLang` and `summaryByLang`. A standalone invoice (no quote) gets its typed title and concepts in both languages on the server when it is created through `POST /invoices` (and again when a live edit changes them): `TranslateInvoice` (agents) stores the base language — the contractor's app language — verbatim and translates the other through TranslateBullets in one call; a failed translation is never cached (REQ-264). The base slot is the cache key: `shared/documents/invoice-lang.ts` `invoiceTextByLang` projects a map only while its base entry equals the current text, so an edited invoice shows what was typed, never an old translation. `GET /invoices/:id/public` puts the maps in `jobDetails`. Paperwork reaches the translator through `InvoiceTranslatorPort` (agents imports paperwork, not the reverse; TranslateInvoice registers itself at boot); without it POST /invoices is unchanged.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/dashboard-titles.test.ts` ("REQ-497 jobRowTitle …" / "REQ-497 quoteRowTitle …": an English job/quote on the Spanish dashboard reads its Spanish name; fallbacks) and `jest/unit/document-titles-lang.test.ts` ("REQ-497 …": the island renders `jobRowTitle(j, lang)` / `quoteRowTitle(q, lang)`, not the summaries; `invoiceTextByLang` projects a current cache, drops a stale name or description map, ignores blank lines) · integration `backend/src/analytics/domain/coordinators/list-active-jobs/int.test.ts` ("REQ-497 list-active-jobs: the job's quote carries jobName, jobNameByLang and summaryByLang"), `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/translate-invoice/int.test.ts` ("REQ-497 …": Spanish standalone → English title + concepts, Spanish verbatim, one model call, idempotent; a failed translation is not cached; a renamed invoice is translated again; a quote-linked invoice is left alone; the port reaches the coordinator) and `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/translate-invoice/http.int.test.ts` ("REQ-497 (demo m23) …": booted app, a Spanish contractor's POST /invoices → GET /invoices/:id/public carries `jobNameByLang` {es, en} and `descriptionByLang`) · e2e `e2e/dashboard-job-titles/dashboard-job-titles.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-497 (demo m23): the Spanish dashboard names an English job and an English quote in Spanish"). The invoice half has no browser story: the lane runs the stub LLM, which returns no translation; the booted HTTP test scripts the model and checks the page's data, and `/i/[id].tsx` already renders `jobNameByLang[lang]` (REQ-272 lane).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-dashboard-job-titles off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check …/list-active-jobs/int.test.ts --filter REQ-497` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed" (`job.quote.jobName` undefined); `deno test -A lib/dashboard-titles.test.ts` → TS2307 "Cannot find module …/lib/dashboard-titles.ts" + TS2353 (`jobName` not on the Job quote type); jest `document-titles-lang` → first "Cannot find module '../../shared/documents/invoice-lang'", then "Tests: 2 failed" (`Expected pattern: /task:\s*jobRowTitle\(j,\s*lang\)/`, `/desc:\s*quoteRowTitle\(q,\s*lang\)/`); `…/translate-invoice/int.test.ts` → "Module not found …/translate-invoice/mod.ts"; `…/translate-invoice/http.int.test.ts` → "AssertionError: Values are not equal" (`jobDetails.jobNameByLang` undefined); `shots run e2e/dashboard-job-titles` with the old DashboardPage + list-active-jobs restored → "✗ REQ-497 … expectation failed: the job row names the job in Spanish" (the row read "Bathroom remodel — Maria Lopez"). GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/ src/agents/ src/analytics/` → "ok | 1073 passed | 0 failed"; `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/` → "ok | 215 passed | 0 failed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2509 passed"; `shots run e2e/dashboard-job-titles e2e/dash-lang-race -- --no-check` → "✓ REQ-422 …", "✓ REQ-497 …". `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on every touched file (invoice-controller keeps its baseline `no-unused-vars` on `@Param("id") id` at the change-order list route); `deno fmt --check` clean on the new files and the touched files that were clean at baseline.
## REQ-481 — The quote ledger and the /quotes, /invoices headlines agree with the documents: a scheduled invoice is "Scheduled", not invoiced or a draft; /quotes money includes approved change orders; the hero names signed history, failed sends and waiting change orders (demo-loop cycle 3, issues M28 + m10)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issues `M28` ("Quote ledger counts a scheduled invoice as invoiced; totals ignore an approved CO") and `m10` ("Headlines and counts contradict state"); RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** `shared/documents/ledger.ts` `quoteLedger` summed every non-void row (`live`) into invoiced and invoiced-but-unpaid, scheduled and draft installments included, so Karen's 50/50 job read "Invoiced $7,050 · Invoiced but unpaid $7,050" with INV-002 still scheduled for Nov 26; `shared/documents/versions.ts` `invoiceState` mapped `scheduled` → `draft` (INV-002 read "Draft", beside "DRAFTING 0 · no drafts open" on /invoices); `front-end/islands/QuotesPage.tsx` mapped the card value (and so the Decided row) from `estimatedTotal`, never adding approved change orders; `front-end/components/QuotesSections.tsx` `QuotesHero` showed "Nothing sent yet — 1 draft ready to send" whenever nothing was out, signed history or not, counted a failed send as a draft, and said "Nothing is waiting on a client" with CO-001 pending (it had no change-order input). Introduced by REQ-205/REQ-201 (474f09dc) and REQ-404 (26ff9e29).
**Requirement:** the ledger keeps `invoicedCents` (every non-void invoice — what the agreement cap and remaining-to-invoice count) and adds `billedCents` (issued), `scheduledCents` (scheduled + drafts) and `nextScheduled`; "Invoiced but unpaid" counts issued invoices only. The quote panel shows Invoiced (billed) · Paid · Invoiced but unpaid · Scheduled (sends {date}) · Remaining, a scheduled invoice row says "Sends Nov 26", and the disabled "Create next invoice" says "The rest is on INV-002, scheduled to send Nov 26." (or "…a draft not sent yet."). `invoiceState` has a `scheduled` DocState labelled "Scheduled" / "Programada" everywhere (public doc state, invoice headline, related rows, clients board); the /invoices Drafting KPI reads "no drafts · 1 scheduled to send" instead of "no drafts open". The /quotes card value and Decided rows are the agreement (quote + approved change orders; `GET /quotes` cards carry `approvedChangeOrdersCents` and `pendingChangeOrders`). The hero reads "Nothing sent yet" only with no signed/lost history (else the settled headline plus the drafting note), names a waiting change order ("CO-001 is waiting on Karen."), and calls a failed send "Not delivered", never a draft.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/scheduled-invoice-ledger.test.ts` ("REQ-481 …": billed/scheduled split and unpaid on issued only; cap still counts the scheduled invoice; panel rows + `fullyInvoicedKey`; `invoiceState`/`stateLabel`/headline/related rows say Scheduled; `draftingKpiSub`; `quoteCardValue`; `quotesHeroNumbers` decided/undelivered + mode; `heroCoWaiting`; island/component wiring; en+es keys) · integration `backend/src/analytics/domain/coordinators/build-quote-cards/int.test.ts` ("REQ-481 card: approvedChangeOrdersCents + pendingChangeOrders …") and the HTTP `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/revisions-controller/e2e.test.ts` (REQ-205 ledger: 50/50 terms → INV-002 `scheduled`, `billedCents` 50000, `scheduledCents` 50000, invoiced-but-unpaid 50000, then 0 once INV-001 is paid — its old 100000/50000 expectations encoded the bug) · e2e (browser) n/a — every string the panel and the heroes show comes from the pure helpers pinned above against the real dictionaries and island sources, and the wire contract is covered by the HTTP ledger test; no navigation or interaction changed.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-scheduled-invoice-state off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern scheduled-invoice-ledger` → 33 of 35 failed (`billedCents` undefined; `invoiceState({status:"scheduled"})` → "draft"; `draftingKpiSub`/`quoteCardValue`/`heroCoWaiting` not functions; mode "draftsOnly" for won + draft; keys missing); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/analytics/domain/coordinators/build-quote-cards/int.test.ts` → "FAILED | 20 passed | 1 failed". GREEN — jest unit project "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2537 passed"; build-quote-cards int "ok | 21 passed"; revisions-controller e2e "ok | 9 passed"; `deno test` over paperwork revisions/invoice/public/work-order controllers + analytics → 201 passed, the only other failures being owner-cannot-sign.int.test.ts under the parallel run (passes alone, "ok | 2 passed"; untouched); conversations failed-send + chat change-order e2e + src/crm "ok | 82 passed"; `front-end deno test -A lib/` "ok | 212 passed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on the touched front-end, shared and backend files.
## REQ-456 — A chat change order says what reached the customer and shows its CO number and /co link (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M25)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `M25` — "'Send it to her' ignored for a change order; nothing appears sent" (fleet-4 stdout:161-173: "Make a change order for Q-001 and send it to her" → "It's waiting for Karen Mills's approval — I've sent you the link to share"; only "Open Q-001" shown, no CO number). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** the send did happen; the reply misreported it. `ApplyChatChangeOrder.run` (apply-chat-change-order/mod.ts:265) fired `SendChangeOrderAlert.run(co.id)` without awaiting it, and that alert emails AND texts the CUSTOMER the /co approval link (send-change-order-alert/mod.ts:100-150) before the contractor's backup. The reply `chatCoordinator.changeOrder.created` (written for a contractor-only alert in f4a3f731, REQ-238) said "I've sent you the link to share", and `chatQuoteLink` mapped a change_order outcome only to "Open Q-00N" — no CO number, no /co link.
**Requirement:** the chat waits for the change-order alert. The alert returns what reached the customer, channel by channel (`customer: { number, approvalPath, emailedTo | emailFailureReason, textedTo | smsFailureReason }`). The reply reads "Change order CO-001 added to … Sent CO-001 to Karen by email (…) — text failed (…). It's waiting for Karen's approval." in the quote send divider's wording (`changeOrderSentLine` in `backend/src/agents/domain/business/change-order-delivery/mod.ts`, keys `chatCoordinator.changeOrder.sent.*`, en + es). A channel with nothing on file is not mentioned; nothing delivered (or the alert threw) says "was not sent" and points at the approval link. The outcome carries `changeOrderNumber`, `approvalPath` and `delivery`; the chat renders "Open CO-001 as customer" (→ /co) and "Copy CO-001 link" under the reply (`chatChangeOrderLink` in `front-end/lib/chat-quote-link.ts`). Out of scope here: the garbled change-order description (separate demo issue).
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/change-order-delivery/test.ts` ("REQ-456 M25 changeOrderSentLine …": emailed + text failed, both, one channel on file, nothing delivered / no contact, Spanish, "no recipient" reason) and `jest/unit/chat-change-order-link.test.ts` ("REQ-456 M25 chatChangeOrderLink …": CO number + /co path, fallback path, foreign path refused, other outcomes none, AsstChat wiring, en/es keys in sync and the old "sent you the link" copy gone) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-change-order-alert/int.test.ts` ("REQ-456 M25: the change-order alert returns the CO number, the /co link and the customer's per-channel delivery", "… both addresses are reported") and `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts` ("REQ-456 M25: a chat change order waits for the alert and says what reached the customer …", "REQ-456 M25: when the alert throws …"; REQ-238 M27's outcome now includes `changeOrderNumber` + `approvalPath`) · e2e `e2e/chat-change-order-sent/chat-change-order-sent.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-456 M25: a chat change order on an invoiced job says it was sent to the customer by email, and the reply shows CO-00N with 'Open as customer' (→ /co) and 'Copy link'").

## REQ-446 — The job-description picker: a refinement keeps the contractor's pick, the pencil edits the current card in place, and the three versions are concise / standard / detailed, labelled (demo-loop cycle 3, m13)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m13` — "The job-description picker confuses: three near-identical options (1); the pencil re-opens the whole picker and rewords the options (3); a refinement resets her chosen card to card 1 (7)" (fleet-6 12:08 "My selection got RESET to card 1"; fleet-2 12:10 "option 2 bullets got reworded"). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** (1) `front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` `applyStepAnswer` (REQ-392, f1d502fd) did `setJobOptions(drafts); setSelectedOptionId(drafts[0]?.id ?? null)` — every rewrite selected card 1. (2) The review card's pencil (REQ-330) called `openJobPicker(seed)`, which still POSTed for three new model options and seated them beside the current card. (3) `prompts.generateJobOptions` (REQ-400) said the options "differ only in wording and grouping", so three near-twins were the intended output; `dedupeOptionsByBullets` only collapses identical bullet sets.

(2) The pencil opens the picker on the current card alone, editable in place — no regenerated alternatives ("Tell the assistant…" still rewrites on request). (3) The prompt asks for three distinct roles in order — CONCISE (fewest lines, related items grouped), STANDARD (one line per item), DETAILED (one line per item with every stated specific) — each still the whole job (REQ-400 holds); the coordinator labels every model option by how much it says (`labelVersionStyles`: `style` concise / standard / detailed, in place, none for a single option) and the picker card shows the label (`versionStyleLabel`, EN "Concise / Standard / Detailed", ES "Breve / Estándar / Detallada").

## REQ-473 — The dashboard's money panel never reads "$-0 — No invoices yet" over a scheduled bill, and a job's paid label follows its payment terms (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M8)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `M8` — "Dashboard 'MONEY OWED TO YOU $-0 — No invoices yet', 'Deposit · No due date' on a job with only a scheduled invoice" (fleet-0 stdout:39,176 with INV-001 paid and INV-002 $925 scheduled; fleet-1 stdout:44,119 "Depósito · Sin fecha de vencimiento" on "Pago al finalizar"). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** (a) `front-end/islands/Ticker.tsx` clamped `t` only above, so a rAF timestamp earlier than the effect's `performance.now()` gave `t<0`; easing to 0 then produced `Math.round(0 × negative) = -0`, rendered "-0", and Preact's `!==` state check kept it there because `-0 !== 0` is false. (b) `DashboardPage.tsx` listed `dashboardClient.invoices("pending")`, an exact match on a legacy status that accept never writes, so the list was always empty. `Outstanding` then said "No invoices yet" whenever owed was 0, even on an account with invoices. (c) `jobToRow` printed "Deposit" whenever nothing was paid, whatever the terms, and `ListActiveJobs` took `nextDueDate` only from open receivables. A job whose one bill was scheduled therefore had none.
**Requirement:** (a) the Ticker's frame (`tickerFrame` in `front-end/lib/ticker-frame.ts`) clamps `t` to [0,1] and never returns -0. (b) `GET /invoices?status=open` lists the open receivables using the REQ-397 `isOpenReceivable` rule, and the dashboard lists those. The next unpaid scheduled installment shows as "Upcoming: $925 bills Nov 26" ("Próximo: $925 se cobra el …"). "No invoices yet" shows only when the account has zero invoices (`stats.invoices.total`); otherwise it says "All paid up", or nothing when the upcoming line stands in for it (`nextUpcomingBill` / `outstandingEmptyKey` in `front-end/lib/dashboard-receivables.ts`). (c) `Job` carries the quote's `paymentTerms`. With nothing paid, the row reads "Deposit" only when the first milestone of the shared `computePaymentSplit` is a deposit. Pay-after-the-job terms ("Payment upon completion", "Net N") read "Due on completion" / "Pago al finalizar", and anything else reads "Not paid yet" / "Sin pagar aún" (`jobPaidLabel`). With nothing open, `nextDueDate` falls back to the earliest scheduled installment's due date.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/dashboard-receivables.test.ts` ("REQ-473 …": tickerFrame with an early frame and target 0 gives +0, clamped at both ends, and the Ticker is wired through it; nextUpcomingBill picks the earliest unpaid scheduled installment and its scheduledFor; outstandingEmptyKey; DashboardPage queries `open` + `scheduled` and never `pending`; jobPaidLabel per terms; en/es keys) · integration `backend/src/analytics/domain/coordinators/list-active-jobs/int.test.ts` ("REQ-473 list-active-jobs: …": only a scheduled installment left → its due date + the quote's payment terms; an open receivable still wins; no terms → null) and `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-473 invoice e2e: GET ?status=open …": sent/viewed/claimed/pending listed, never scheduled/draft/paid/void) · e2e `e2e/dashboard-money-owed/dashboard-money-owed.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-473 (demo M8, fleet-0)": paid + scheduled → "Upcoming: $925 bills …", no "No invoices yet", no "-0", job row has a due date; "REQ-473 (demo M8, fleet-1)": a "Payment upon completion" job with nothing paid → "Due on completion" with a due date, never "Deposit"). The -0 race itself is pinned by the unit test, because a browser cannot be made to deliver an early rAF timestamp on demand.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, branch fix/c3-dashboard-money-owed off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first. `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/dashboard-receivables.test.ts` (helpers stubbed to the old behaviour) → 10 of 11 failed, including "AssertionError: expected +0, got -0", "Ticker.tsx must call tickerFrame()" and "the Outstanding list must not query the legacy 'pending' status". `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check …/list-active-jobs/int.test.ts …/invoice-controller/e2e.test.ts --filter REQ-473` → 3 failed (nextDueDate `null` vs `"2026-05-26"`, paymentTerms `undefined`, `?status=open` → `[]`). `shots run e2e/dashboard-money-owed` with the implementation reverted → ✗ fleet-0 "MONEY OWED TO YOU $0 No invoices yet — once you bill a job, it'll show up here." and ✗ fleet-1 "Rosa Martinez Bathroom door repair — Rosa Martinez No due date $925 Deposit". GREEN: the unit file "ok | 13 passed" (with dashboard-kpis); `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/` → "ok | 223 passed | 0 failed"; `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/analytics/ src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/` → "ok | 155 passed | 0 failed"; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 250 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2502 passed"; `SHOTS_JOBS=1 shots run e2e/dashboard-money-owed -- --no-check` → ✓ fleet-0 (4.7s), ✓ fleet-1 (1s). `deno lint` + `deno check` + `deno fmt --check` are clean on the 7 touched or new front-end files and the e2e story. `deno check` is clean on the touched backend files. `deno lint` on invoice-controller/mod.ts reports one baseline `no-unused-vars` at line 227 (`@Param("id") id`), which this change does not touch.
## REQ-488 — "Didn't get it" asks first, closes the claim in the feed, and tells the customer on /i (demo-loop cycle 3, issues m56 + m57)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issues `m56` — "'No lo recibí' has no confirm and tells the client nothing" (fleet-re05e1cbb-8 stdout:84,189) — and `m57` — "'Maria Lopez dice que pagó por Z…' chip stays after the claim was rejected" (fleet-8 stdout:83,202). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** `doRejectClaim` in `front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` POSTed `/api/invoices/:id/reject-claim` on the first click. `rejectClaim` in `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/mod.ts` only set `status: "sent"` and cleared `paymentIntent`. It emitted no bus event, stored no marker and sent nothing, so the customer's /i silently went back to "How do you want to pay?". The topbar ticker shows the newest notification (`lib/ticker-pick.ts`), and the claim's `invoice_claimed` row (notify-on-event) stayed the newest, so the chip kept saying "… dice que pagó por Zelle". Introduced by 61f9fec7 (reject-claim UI).
**Requirement:** the claimed card's "Didn't get it" / "No lo recibí" asks first, inline ("Mark Maria Lopez's payment via Zelle as not received? The invoice goes back to unpaid and their link will tell them the payment hasn't arrived." with "Mark not received" / "Cancel"). Only "Mark not received" rejects. `reject-claim` stores `claimRejectedAt` + `claimRejectedMethod` on the invoice and emits an invoice `claim_rejected` event. NotifyOnEvent writes a newer feed row ("You marked {name}'s payment via Zelle as not received" / "Marcaste el pago de {name} por Zelle como no recibido") and marks that invoice's open `invoice_claimed` rows read, so the chip moves on. `/invoices/:id/public` exposes both fields, and /i shows "{who} hasn't received your payment yet — Your Zelle payment hasn't arrived. Check that it went to {handle}, then pick how you paid below." above the pay options (helper `claimRejectedNote` in `shared/documents/claim-rejected-note.ts`). The next claim clears both fields. The fields can't be set through PUT /invoices/:id. en + es keys are in sync. No email or text goes to the customer; the /i note is how they find out.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/communication/domain/coordinators/notify-on-event/test.ts` ("REQ-488: invoice claim_rejected maps to a 'marked as not received' row in both languages") and `jest/unit/reject-claim-confirm.test.ts` ("REQ-488 m56 …": the reject button only opens the ask; only the ask's yes calls `doRejectClaim`; en/es copy; `claimRejectedNote` with and without a handle, and null when there is no marker or the invoice is paid or claimed again; /i wires it) · integration `backend/src/communication/domain/coordinators/notify-on-event/int.test.ts` ("REQ-488 integration: claim → claim_rejected → a newer 'not received' row and the open claim row is marked read", where another invoice's claim stays open) and `backend/src/communication/entrypoints/notification-controller/e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-488 cross-module e2e: …" over real HTTP: claim → reject-claim → the newest feed row is the Spanish "not received" title, the claim row is read, /public carries `claimRejectedAt` + method "zelle", and a new claim clears both) · e2e `e2e/reject-claim-notify/reject-claim-notify.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-488 m56/m57: …": in a browser, the first click opens the ask and POSTs nothing, Cancel POSTs nothing, "Mark not received" rejects, the topbar chip then reads "not received" and not "says they paid", and /i shows the note with the contractor's Zelle handle).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, branch fix/c3-reject-claim-notify off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):**
- RED first:
  - `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/communication/domain/coordinators/notify-on-event/ --filter REQ-488` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed" (titleKey `undefined`; no "not received" row).
  - The cross-module e2e → "Values are not equal: Maria Lopez dice que pagó por Zelle — confirma que lo recibiste", which is the demo's stale chip as the newest row.
  - jest `reject-claim-confirm` → 6 failed (the button still had `onClick={doRejectClaim}`, no `invoice-reject-ask`, no keys, no helper).
  - `shots run e2e/reject-claim-notify` with the implementation reverted → "✗ REQ-488 … :118" (the first click POSTed `/reject-claim` and reloaded the page).
- GREEN:
  - The same backend filter → 3 passed.
  - jest unit project → "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2508 passed".
  - `shots run e2e/reject-claim-notify` → "✓ REQ-488 … 25.6s".
  - `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/communication/ src/paperwork/` → 413 passed, 1 failed. The failure is `REQ-123 smoke (real Postmark)`, which asserts the real POSTMARK_API_KEY from ../.env; that is environmental, not this change.
  - `deno lint` + `deno check` are clean on the touched front-end files. The one backend lint hit is a pre-existing unused `id` at invoice-controller/mod.ts:228, which is not in this diff. `deno fmt` was run on the new files and on the two previously clean front-end files.
## REQ-480 — After "Issue invoice" with nothing delivered, the notice is the invoice's own and the invoice is not listed as Sent (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M18)

"sent" : …` BEFORE trying delivery ("the send coordinators don't stamp invoice status"), so the list always read Enviada; "Finish + send" (`doFinishDraft`) flipped status to "sent" up front the same way. When both channels then failed, `dispatchFailureCopy` (InvoicesPage.tsx:2034-2039) mapped through `sendResultLangKey` (shared/quote-flow/send-result.ts:43-47) to the QUOTE divider key `sendQuote.divider.noEmail` ("Cotización + Acuerdo redactada — no hay correo…") and dropped the text channel's reason on that branch. Introduced in `ad0e8c3b` (P-09/P-31), which reused the quote's divider keys.

An invoice nobody received is never listed as Sent: "Issue" with a dispatch to follow creates it as a draft (`newInvoiceStatus` in shared/documents/invoice-form.ts), "Finish + send" no longer flips the status up front, and the invoice email / text send coordinators stamp a draft or scheduled invoice "sent" + sentAt only when that channel delivered (the email it goes out in already reads "Sent"; issued invoices are never touched). "Issue" for a client with no email or phone at all (nothing to dispatch) still issues it as sent. en + es keys: `invoicesPage.send.{notDelivered,invoiceFallback,noEmailOnFile,emailFailedReason,noPhoneOnFile,textFailedReason,keptDraft}`.

"sent"`, no `sendQuote.divider.noEmail`, no up-front `status: "sent"` in `doFinishDraft`) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/int.test.ts` and `send-paperwork-sms/int.test.ts` ("REQ-480 M18 …": a draft invoice emailed / texted becomes sent with sentAt and its email never reads Draft; a scheduled one sent now becomes sent; no email on file / a fictional 555 text → stays draft, no sentAt; a viewed invoice re-emailed keeps "viewed") · e2e `e2e/invoice-send-fail/invoice-send-fail.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-480 M18: 'Issue invoice' for a client with no email and a fictional 555 phone → the invoice's own 'not delivered' notice … and the invoice is not listed as sent").
