## REQ-447 — One job, one name: the quote's jobName titles the thread, the header and the list share one title rule, and a translated job name is a title (demo-loop cycle 3, issues m14 + p8-pair10-d)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issues `m14` — "One job, several names; awkward 'X's Replacement of Faucet Agreement'" (fleet-5 l.93 EN title "María José Peña's Replacement of Faucet Agreement"; fleet-6 dashboard "Kitchen renovation and debris removal" vs quote "Kitchen Renovation & Cleanup") — and `p8-pair10-d` — "Assistant thread header stays 'New conversation'" (fleet-9 l.76). RCA analyst + skeptic CONFIRMED/UPHELD at `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** the job was named by independent writers that nothing reconciled: the conversation title (first user message, `conversation-title/mod.ts` `deriveTitleFromFirstUserMessage`), `quote.jobName`, `quote.summary` (shown by the dashboard's active-job row, `DashboardPage.tsx` `task: j.quote.summary`), and the translated name (`translate-quote/mod.ts` sent the jobName through TranslateBullets' clause-by-clause scope-line prompt, so "Cambio de llave" came back "Replacement of Faucet"). REQ-385 claimed one title rule for the header and the list, but `threadTitle` (list) fell back to the stored title while `deriveChatHeader` had no title input, so a thread with messages but no quote read "New conversation" in the header only.
**Requirement:** (1) `shared/quote-flow/thread-title.ts` `threadLabel` — job name, then "· customer", else the stored conversation title — is the one rule; `threadTitle` (list) and `deriveChatHeader` (header, new `title` input) both use it. AsstChat seeds the title from the route (`initialTitle={detail?.conversation?.title}`, also passed to the SSR header) and re-reads it from every turn's `res.conversation.title` (and the `?c=` load). (2) Once a quote names the job, its jobName is the stored conversation title: `handle-chat-message` sets `convPatch.title` from the created/updated quote's jobName (the first-message title only when no quote named it); `StartConversation.run` (POST /agents/conversations { quoteId }) and the new `StartConversation.bindQuote` (POST /agents/conversations/:id/draft { quoteId }) title the thread by the bound quote's jobName (`titleFromJobName`). (3) The dashboard's active-job row shows `quote.jobName` (ListActiveJobs now returns it), the summary only as a fallback — the summary is not a separate heading. (4) `TranslateQuote` marks the jobName's line in the batch (`titleLines`), and `TranslateBullets` tells the model that line is the job's TITLE: the short noun phrase a contractor would use (e.g. "Faucet Replacement"), never a word-for-word rendering ("Replacement of Faucet"); scope lines are still translated clause by clause, in the same single call.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/chat-header.test.ts` ("REQ-447 (cycle 3, p8-pair10-d/m14) …": a first message with no quote titles the header; the job name wins over the title; for every job/customer/title combination the header reads exactly `threadTitle` in en and es; AsstChat passes `title: convTitle` and re-reads `res.conversation` title; the route passes the title to the SSR header and the island; DashboardPage shows `j.quote.jobName || j.quote.summary`) and `backend/src/agents/domain/business/conversation-title/test.ts` ("REQ-447 m14 titleFromJobName …") · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts` ("REQ-447 m14 …": the drafted quote's jobName titles the conversation even on the first message; a plain first message still titles a quote-less thread), `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/translate-quote/int.test.ts` ("REQ-447 (m14) …": "Cambio de llave de fregadero" → en "Faucet Replacement" with the scope line still literal and one call; a batch with no job name marks no title line), `backend/src/analytics/domain/coordinators/list-active-jobs/int.test.ts` ("REQ-447 m14 … the job carries the quote's jobName") · e2e `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/conversations-controller/thread-title.e2e.test.ts` (booted app over HTTP: after the first message the header derived from GET /agents/conversations/:id equals the list row's `threadTitle`; POST /agents/conversations { quoteId } and POST :id/draft { quoteId } title the thread "Faucet Replacement") and browser `e2e/chat-header-status/chat-header-status.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-447: after the first message the chat header names the thread as the list does, never 'New conversation'" — live after the turn and after a reload).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-thread-title-one-rule off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/chat-header.test.ts -t REQ-447` → "Tests: 4 failed … 1 passed" (header clientName undefined for a titled thread; AsstChat/route pass no title); `deno test … conversation-title/test.ts handle-chat-message/int.test.ts --filter REQ-447` → "titleFromJobName is not a function", and "Values are not equal: - Repaint 3 bedrooms and the hallway for John Miller, $2,400 / + Bedroom & Hallway Repaint"; `thread-title.e2e.test.ts` → POST /agents/conversations { quoteId } title `undefined`, :id/draft kept "cambiar la llave del fregadero de la cocina, $180", and with the old `chat-header.ts` the header was `undefined` vs "Need a price on a cedar fence for the Ruiz family"; translate-quote → "- Replacement of Sink Faucet / + Faucet Replacement"; list-active-jobs → jobName `undefined`; jest dashboard assertion failed; `shots run e2e/chat-header-status -- --filter REQ-447` with the four front-end/shared files at HEAD → "✗ … expected "Need a price on a cedar fence for the Ruiz family", got "New conversation"" (the demo's bug). GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/ src/analytics/` → "ok | 766 passed | 0 failed"; jest unit project → "Test Suites: 250 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2508 passed"; `shots run e2e/chat-header-status` → ✓ REQ-245, ✓ REQ-447; `deno lint` clean on the touched backend + front-end files, `deno check` clean on AsstChat.tsx, DashboardPage.tsx, clients/dashboard.ts, routes/assistant/[threadId].tsx; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file that was clean at baseline (AsstChat.tsx not formatted, by rule; start-conversation/mod.ts, conversation-title/mod.ts and conversations-controller/mod.ts were already unformatted at baseline and are left so).
## REQ-442 — A correction typed on a guided step shows on the step, while it is rewritten and after; the confirm strip never says "Setting up…" over the old message (demo-loop cycle 3, issues M22 + m49)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issues `M22` — "User's own chat messages don't appear until reload" (fleet-6 stdout l.112, l.117, l.196: the bubbles showed only after a sidebar reload) — and `m49` — "'Setting up…' card shows the original message, not the correction" (fleet-6 l.188). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD for both at `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** `front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` renders the step panel INSTEAD of the thread while any guided panel is open (`(empty || panelOpen) ? <chat__empty…> : thread`, from 4a1457ab). Since REQ-392 (f1d502fd) the contractor can type on those panels: `sendStepText` → `submitTurn` appended the stub and the server's messages to `messages`, which were not mounted, and `applyStepAnswer` only set the assistant's `stepNote`. `submitTurn` also set the shared `sending`, so the confirm strip's label and Continue read "Setting up…" while still echoing `pendingJobDetailsRaw` (the first message).
**Requirement:** on Pick a price and the Job details picker the step shows its own transcript (`addStepExchange` / `StepLog` in `shared/quote-flow/step-composer.ts`, the last 3): the contractor's line ("You: …", `data-cy=step-composer-said`) over the assistant's answer (`step-composer-note`), also when the box is closed again. A step send runs on its own `stepSending` flag (submitTurn takes the busy setter), so while it runs the step shows "Rewriting with your change…" (es "Reescribiendo con tu cambio…") with the correction (`step-composer-pending`), and the confirm strip and Continue keep their labels (disabled until the answer lands). Once the job-details rewrite lands, the confirm strip's echo is the message plus the correction on its own line (`echoWithCorrection`), which is what "Use what I wrote" then confirms. The thread's first turn tells the conversation list to refresh (`publishThreadTurn` / `THREAD_TURN_EVENT` in `front-end/lib/thread-status-sync.ts`, handled in `AsstThreads.tsx`) so its title shows without a reload.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/step-composer-echo.test.ts` ("REQ-442 …": the transcript appends per step, restarts on another step, keeps the last `STEP_LOG_MAX`, ignores a blank message; the echo appends the correction once; `isFirstUserTurn` and `publishThreadTurn`; en/es keys; the island holds `stepSending`, `sendStepText` passes its words into `applyStepAnswer`, the composer renders `step-composer-said` / `step-composer-pending`, the list listens to `THREAD_TURN_EVENT`) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change; the step turn's API is REQ-392's, covered by `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/step.int.test.ts` · e2e `e2e/step-composer/step-composer.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-442 M22/m49: a correction typed on the Job details picker shows on the step while it is rewritten and after …": the chat turn is held mid-flight to read "Rewriting with your change" + the correction, the unchanged confirm label and a Continue without "Setting up"; then the contractor's line, the assistant's note and the confirm echo carrying the correction).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, branch fix/c3-step-composer-echo off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern step-composer-echo` → 14 failed (`addStepExchange is not a function`, `echoWithCorrection is not a function`, `isFirstUserTurn is not a function`, `publishThreadTurn is not a function`, island had no `stepSending`); `SHOTS_JOBS=1 shots run e2e/step-composer/step-composer.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check --filter REQ-442` → "✗ REQ-442 … locator.waitFor: Timeout 10000ms exceeded — waiting for locator('[data-cy=step-composer-pending]')". GREEN — jest unit project "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2516 passed"; `shots run e2e/step-composer/step-composer.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → "✓ REQ-392 M7 … Pick a price", "✓ REQ-392 M7 … Ready to send", "✓ REQ-442 M22/m49 …"; `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/` → "ok | 212 passed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on AsstChat.tsx, AsstThreads.tsx, StepComposer.tsx, thread-status-sync.ts, step-composer.ts; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file but AsstChat.tsx (known-unformattable, left so).
## REQ-436 — The stage follows the customer's browser tab, not a socket: a navigating tab keeps the stage through its next page, and a background or unfocused page never takes it (demo-loop cycle 3, issues M2, M2b, M2c, M5)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md). The issues: `M2` "Stage stays on another tab (still 'Live') after the customer returns to an older tab; a background tab that refreshes takes the stage", `M2b` "Followed tab navigates while another tab is open: the stage flips to the background tab and labels it 'Live'", `M2c` "A background tab that reloads claims the stage at mount", and `M5` "Presenter pointer vanishes on an older tab". RCA: M2/M2b CONFIRMED, M2c/M5 LIKELY, skeptic UPHELD on all four, at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** `front-end/lib/demo-mode/transport.ts` `tabLeft` read REQ-391's `why` only when no tab was left (`if (tabs.size === 0)`) and then always called `follow()`. With /q or /i open behind it, a followed tab that navigated (an EN/ES switch, `location.reload()` after "Okay, I got it") was replaced at once by the background tab. The stage synced that tab, offered it WebRTC, showed it as Live, and sent the navigating tab a `leave`. This lasted until the new page's mount claim landed. `front-end/islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx` claimed at mount on `visibilityState === "visible"` alone, so a visible but unfocused page took the stage when it reloaded: every headless tab, a side-by-side window, or the /i tab's REQ-321 auto-reload. Only pointerdown, focus and visibilitychange claimed. Introduced by REQ-232 (1701c3a1); REQ-391 (8dca1d2f) scoped the navigating grace to the last tab.
**Requirement:** the stage follows BROWSER TABS. Each tab has a stable key in sessionStorage (`demoTabKey`, `front-end/lib/demo-mode/tab-key.ts`). Every claim carries it (`tab`), plus `f: 1` when the page has focus. A page sends a claim on every welcome, with `at` 0 if it never claimed, so the stage can match a new page to its browser tab. The hub forwards `tab` and `f`, and the parsers drop a junk key but keep the claim. When the followed tab's page leaves with `why: "navigating"`, the stage keeps following that key for PRESENCE_GRACE_MS with status "between". During that time it does not sync another tab, does not send it a `leave`, and does not relay the presenter's pointer to it. The tab's next page takes the stage back as soon as it names the key. The stage switches to another tab only when the grace ends, on `closing` or a silent departure, or when another tab sends a newer claim. A tie on claim time goes to the page that reports focus. The overlay claims at mount and on `pageshow` only when the page is `visible && document.hasFocus()`. It also claims on keydown, wheel and touchstart (at most once a second), as well as pointerdown, focus and visibilitychange. Harness: `demo-loop/VM-FLOW.md` tells the customer agent to click (or type or scroll) in a page after a Playwright tab select. Not done: the optional stage pill showing the followed path, and a non-hidden DemoPointer attribute.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-stage-tab-follow.test.ts` ("REQ-436 …") covers these cases:
- The followed tab navigates while /q is open, and the stage does not follow /q within the grace: it shows "between", sends no sync or leave to /q, and relays the presenter's move only to the gone tab. The new page's key claim resumes the stage, and the timer running out later changes nothing.
- The new page announces itself before the old page's departure.
- No next page arrives: the stage falls back to /q only after the grace.
- `closing` falls back at once.
- A newer /q claim during the grace wins.
- A background tab's navigation changes nothing.
- On a claim-time tie, the focused tab wins.
- The viewer sends its key on welcome (`at` 0) and `f: 1` on a focused claim.
- `demoTabKey` is stable per storage, wire-safe, and survives junk or refused storage.
- The overlay wiring: the key and hasFocus are passed to the link, the mount and pageshow claim needs visible && focused, and the keydown, wheel and touchstart listeners are added and removed.

integration `backend/src/demo-mode/domain/coordinators/demo-hub/test.ts` ("REQ-436 …"): a claim parsed off the wire with `tab` and `f` reaches every stage in one hub and across two (KV mailbox) stamped with cid, tab and f. A claim from before REQ-436 and junk keys still parse as claims, without the key. e2e: n/a. The browser lane runs headless Chromium, where every page is visible and focused and a tab select fires nothing, which is the exact condition that hides this bug (RCA s3). The full scenario runs in the unit test against the real transport, and the wire runs in integration through the real hub.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-stage-tab-follow off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first. `npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/demo-stage-tab-follow.test.ts` gave "Tests: 11 failed" (the stage followed "q1" after the navigating departure; "Expected: a1, Received: q1" on the focus tie; no `tab` on the viewer's claims; `demoTabKey` not implemented; the overlay had no hasFocus mount guard and no keydown/wheel/touchstart listeners). `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check …/demo-hub/test.ts --filter REQ-436` gave "FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed" (the parsed claim lacked `tab`/`f`; type-check also rejected `tab` on the claim). GREEN. `npx jest --selectProjects unit` gave "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2516 passed". `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/demo-mode/` gave "ok | 45 passed | 0 failed". `deno lint` + `deno check` are clean on the touched front-end, shared and backend files. `deno fmt` was applied to the touched files, all of which were fmt-clean at baseline.
## REQ-479 — The owner cannot file "the customer paid" on her own invoice; her /i/:id offers "Record a payment you received" (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M30)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `M30` — "Owner can file a 'customer paid by Zelle' claim on her own invoice" (fleet-re05e1cbb-8 stdout:43,68,153,172: the owner's tab tapped Zelle → "Ya lo envié", the invoice went to claimed and her bell rang "El cliente pagó por Zelle"). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** REQ-306 (5d86e18f) guarded `POST /public/quotes/:id/accept` with `isInternalViewer` + `hasSignOverride` (public-controller/mod.ts acceptQuote), and REQ-398 the change-order approve/decline; `POST /invoices/:id/claim-payment` (claimInvoicePayment) read no session at all — "knowledge of the invoice id is the capability" — so the owner's own browser set `status: "claimed"`, recorded a payment intent and emitted the claimed event. `GET /invoices/:id/public` carried no `internal` flag, and `/i/:id` read it without the viewer's session, so the claim island could not tell the owner from the customer.
**Requirement:** the business's own session (owner, admin acting for her, staff behind an impersonation) gets 409 `owner_cannot_claim` from the claim, and nothing changes on the invoice, unless the full in-person override `?as=customer&confirm=1` is passed. The anonymous customer, and any other account, claims as before. `GET /invoices/:id/public` says `internal: true` to that viewer; `/i/:id` reads it with the viewer's session; for an open invoice the claim island shows "Preview — you are viewing as the customer; payment claims are disabled" and, in place of the method chips, "Record a payment you received" → `/invoices?open=<id>&pay=1` plus a "Customer here with you?" in-person link; the claim POST carries the override only when the page has it. Helpers: `invoiceClaimPreview`, `recordPaymentHref`, `claimPaymentPath` in `shared/documents/invoice-claim-view.ts`; en + es keys `publicInvoiceClaim.internalPreview*`, `.recordPayment`, `.ownerCannotClaim`.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/owner-cannot-claim.test.ts` ("REQ-479 …": preview for an internal viewer of an open invoice, not for the customer; full override shows the form, half does not; paid/void never a preview; record-payment href; the POST path carries the override only when present; route reads with `getSessionId` and passes `internal`; the island's banner precedes the chips; en/es keys) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/owner-cannot-claim.int.test.ts` ("REQ-479 M30 …": `internal: true` for owner (header + cookie) and impersonating staff, absent for anonymous and another account; owner/staff claim 409 `owner_cannot_claim`, invoice stays `sent` with no `paymentIntent`; half override 409; full override 200; anonymous and another account 200) · e2e `e2e/owner-cannot-claim/owner-cannot-claim.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-479 M30: the owner's /i/:id is a preview with 'Record a payment you received' (no claim chips), her claim POST is 409 owner_cannot_claim; the customer still claims").
**Existing tests amended (they claimed from the owner's own session — the bug):** `e2e/public-page-refresh` REQ-321 "the customer's open /i/:id tab…" opens `/i/:id?as=customer&confirm=1` (that browser carries the owner's cookie); `cypress/support/commands.ts` `apiClaimPayment` posts with the override (cy.request sends the signed-in owner's cookie).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-owner-claim-guard off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `deno test -A --unstable-kv …/owner-cannot-claim.int.test.ts` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed" (`internal` undefined, expected true; owner claim "Values are not equal: {"ok":true,…} 200 → 409"); `npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/owner-cannot-claim.test.ts` → "Tests: 8 failed" (`Cannot find module '../../shared/documents/invoice-claim-view'`); `shots run e2e/owner-cannot-claim` → "✗ REQ-479 … locator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded" (no preview banner on the owner's page). GREEN — the int file "ok | 2 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/ src/paperwork/entrypoints/revisions-controller/ src/communication/entrypoints/notification-controller/` → "ok | 60 passed | 0 failed"; jest unit project "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2510 passed"; `shots run e2e/owner-cannot-claim e2e/public-page-refresh` → ✓ REQ-479, ✓ REQ-321 ×3. `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on the island, `routes/i/[id].tsx`, the shared helper and the backend controller; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file.
## REQ-508 — The scheduled-invoice nudges are swept by the server, not by a page view; the worker screen skips the refresh tick after an action's reload (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m20)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m20` — "Heavy polling; the browser calls POST /api/cron/run-nudges on every /invoices load"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** REQ-022 (`b7c29de9`) made `front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx`'s mount effect `fetch("/api/cron/run-nudges", { method: "POST" })` on every load as a stand-in for a scheduler ("a real scheduler is a deploy decision"); the backend already ran REQ-074 minute timers for the CRM outbox and REQ-172's field notices but not for nudges. `WorkerScreen.tsx` also reloaded after every `act()` and then again on the 5 s tick that followed.
**Requirement:** `ScheduleInvoiceNudges.registerSweep()` is started in `backend/bootstrap/mod.ts` (REQ-074's pattern: a minute `setInterval` in the isolate, unref'd, never Deno.cron, never throws). Each tick calls `sweep()`, which takes a KV lease (`["invoice_nudge_sweep"]`, compare-and-set) so one isolate sweeps per `NUDGE_SWEEP_EVERY_MS` (15 min), walks every account under the invoice index (one KV read per account), and claims `["invoice_nudge_sent", invoiceId, day]` before emitting `invoice:nudge_due`, so each due scheduled invoice is nudged once a day (the claim is released if the emit fails). A failing account or KV is logged, never thrown. The /invoices island no longer calls `/api/cron/run-nudges`; the endpoint stays as a manual trigger. The worker screen stamps each load's start and its 5 s tick skips a load started less than 80% of the interval ago (`refreshTickDue` in `front-end/lib/refresh-tick.ts`). The optional /admin back-off change from the RCA was left alone — REQ-424 already backs it off to 60 s while idle.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/schedule-invoice-nudges/sweep.test.ts` ("REQ-508 m20 …": all accounts' due invoices nudged with no request; once a day, again the next day; the lease holds off a concurrent or too-early sweep, another instance too; registerSweep is a 60 s unref'd timer whose tick sweeps, never Deno.cron, never throws; an unreadable store is logged, not thrown; bootstrap registers the sweep) · unit `jest/unit/nudges-off-the-page.test.ts` ("REQ-508 …": no front-end source calls `/cron/run-`; `refreshTickDue` skips a fresh reload and passes the regular tick; WorkerScreen stamps loads and gates the tick on it) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/schedule-invoice-nudges/int.test.ts` ("REQ-508 m20 int …": real InvoiceStore + EventBus + NotifyOnEvent on KV — the sweep alone lands one `invoice_nudge_due` notification, a second sweep that day adds none); REQ-022's `jest/integration/invoice-schedule.int.test.ts` keeps pinning the manual endpoint · e2e `e2e/invoices-no-cron/invoices-no-cron.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-508 m20: loading /invoices sends no POST /api/cron/run-nudges").
**Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, branch fix/c3-nudges-server-timer off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/schedule-invoice-nudges/` → "FAILED | 6 passed | 2 failed" (`SyntaxError: The requested module './mod.ts' does not provide an export named 'NUDGE_SWEEP_EVERY_MS'`; type-checked: "Property 'sweep' / 'registerSweep' does not exist on type 'ScheduleInvoiceNudges'"); `npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/nudges-off-the-page.test.ts` (helper stubbed) → "Tests: 4 failed"; `shots run e2e/invoices-no-cron -- --no-check` → "✗ REQ-508 … expected "", got "POST /api/cron/run-nudges, POST /api/cron/run-nudges"". GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/schedule-invoice-nudges/ src/paperwork/entrypoints/cron-controller/ src/communication/domain/coordinators/notify-on-event/ src/users/domain/coordinators/crm-lead-capture/test.ts` → "ok | 35 passed | 0 failed"; jest unit project → "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2506 passed"; `shots run e2e/invoices-no-cron -- --no-check` → "✓ REQ-508 m20: loading /invoices sends no POST /api/cron/run-nudges"; a real boot (`KV_PATH=:memory: deno run -A --unstable-kv bootstrap/mod.ts`) logs "[schedule-invoice-nudges] minute sweep on a timer". `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on every touched file; `deno fmt --check` clean on InvoicesPage.tsx, WorkerScreen.tsx and the new files (the backend's mod.ts/bootstrap were not fmt-clean before and were left unformatted).
## REQ-483 — The New invoice starts from what the account already said: onboarding's payment methods fill "Payment instructions", and the terms follow Settings and the quote (demo-loop cycle 3, issues M40 + m18)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issues `M40` — "Onboarding's Zelle payment method not prefilled into New invoice 'Payment instructions'" (fleet-2:76,164,242) — and `m18` — "Payment-term defaults don't follow the quote (New invoice Net 30; '30 days of completion' wording)" (fleet-2:81,166; fleet-8:204,207). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** `NewInvoiceModal` in `front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` seeded "Payment instructions" only from localStorage `pm:invoice-payment-instructions` and `profile.contractDefaults.paymentInstructions`; onboarding saves the methods to the business identity's `acceptedPaymentMethods`, which the form never read (the public /i page lists them separately, so only the form looked empty). The terms were `useState<number>(30)` — Settings' "Days to pay an invoice" (`identity.invoiceNetDays`, REQ-174) and the linked quote's `payment_terms` were never read. The "Payment upon completion" sub-line "Full amount due within {n} days of the job's completion" (REQ-411) read as a contradiction to owners expecting payment the day the job ends.
**Requirement:** "Payment instructions" starts with Settings' own text, else what was last typed on this device, else the enabled accepted methods as one line ("Zelle: 5125550102 · Cash"; es "Efectivo"; ACH only by its own instructions, never routing/account numbers) — `paymentInstructionsFromMethods` / `defaultPaymentInstructions` in `shared/documents/invoice-form.ts`. The terms start from `defaultInvoiceNetDays(identity.invoiceNetDays, quote.terms)`: from a quote, "Due now" → 0, "Net N" → N, "upon completion" → the account's days; otherwise (no quote, a split, custom text) the account's days, else 30. A count with no preset (21, 45) opens as custom terms with its due date filled in. The default never overrides terms the contractor already picked. The "upon completion" sub-line (en + es, wizard + assistant) now reads "Billed when the job is done · the customer then has {n} days to pay" / "Se cobra al terminar el trabajo · el cliente tiene {n} días para pagar".
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/new-invoice-defaults.test.ts` ("REQ-483 …": the onboarding methods → "Zelle: 5125550102 · Cash" (en/es), every enabled method with its handle, disabled/blank left out; precedence Settings › remembered › methods; days from Settings else 30; quote Due now → 0, Net 15 → 15, net-7 → 7, upon completion → account days, splits/free text → account days; presets vs custom; the en/es completion sub-lines; the island wires `defaultInvoiceNetDays(` with `invoiceNetDays` + the quote's `.terms`, `defaultPaymentInstructions(` with `acceptedPaymentMethods`, and no `useState<number>(30)`) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change: `GET /profile` already returns `identity.invoiceNetDays` + `identity.acceptedPaymentMethods` and `GET /quotes/:id` the full quote with `terms`; the e2e story below drives both over the real API · e2e `e2e/new-invoice-defaults/new-invoice-defaults.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-483 M40 + m18: onboarding's Zelle + Cash and Settings' 15 days to pay → … 'Zelle: 5125550102 · Cash' and Net 15 …", "REQ-483 m18: a New invoice drawn from a 'Due Now' quote opens with Due now terms (0 days) …").
**Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, branch fix/c3-new-invoice-defaults off demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern new-invoice-defaults` → "Tests: 9 failed" (`paymentInstructionsFromMethods / defaultPaymentInstructions / defaultInvoiceNetDays / isPresetNetDays is not a function`; en sub-line "Full amount due within {n} days of the job's completion"; the modal still `useState<number>(30)` and no `defaultPaymentInstructions(`); `shots run e2e/new-invoice-defaults` (dev serve on PORT=5747) → "✗ … Payment instructions start from the onboarding methods — expected "Zelle: 5125550102 · Cash", got """, "✗ … the terms follow the quote's Due now — expected "0", got "30"". GREEN — jest unit project "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2511 passed"; `shots run e2e/new-invoice-defaults e2e/invoice-overbilling` → 4 ✓ (both REQ-483, both REQ-233); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/ src/agents/domain/business/terms-wizard-spec/` → "ok | 50 passed | 0 failed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on InvoicesPage.tsx / clients/dashboard.ts / invoice-form.ts; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file (all were clean at base). `e2e/linked-documents` REQ-203 (public /q sign form never visible) and `e2e/invoice-numbering` REQ-206 quote prefill (expects "Agreed", REQ-409 made it "Quoted" for an unsigned quote) fail identically on untouched `cc5d4b0e` — not this change.
## REQ-440 — The customer's demo pill covers no page content: its band is real on pages whose document scrolls (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m2)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m2`: "The customer's demo pill covers page content". It covered /q "01 QUICK SUMMARY" (pairs 1, 2, 3, 5, 9), "Servicio desde" in the New invoice sheet (2, 3), "Export customers (CSV)" (3), the INV-001 related row (5, 10) and the worker card on a phone (8). RCA analyst CONFIRMED and skeptic UPHELD at `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** REQ-379 gives the pill one fixed home at the bottom-left and reserves its band only as `body { padding-bottom: var(--demo-pill-h) }` (`shared/demo-mode/pill.ts` `setPillRoom`). Body padding frees the END of the document, not the bottom band of the window. On a page whose document scrolls (/q, /i, /co, /terms, the phone dashboard, the worker view), content scrolls under the fixed pill. Only the shells that subtract `--demo-pill-h` from their own scroller keep the band clear. The New invoice sheet is a full-view scrolling backdrop (`inset:0`) and runs under the pill too.
**Requirement:** while the pill (or the ended notice) holds its band:
- (a) `setPillRoom` also sets `scroll-padding-bottom: var(--demo-pill-h)` on `<html>` and keeps the body padding, so scrolling to something (an anchor, focus, `scrollIntoView`, Page Down) stops above the band. `clearPillRoom` removes it.
- (b) DemoModeOverlay paints the band (`data-cy="demo-band"`): window-wide, `--demo-pill-h` high, `pointer-events:none`, `z-index:1` (over the page's flow, under the page's own fixed layers such as dialog backdrops and toasts). It is painted in the page's own opaque background (`bandBackground` picks the first opaque colour under the band's left foot, then up to `<html>`, else white). A scrolling document therefore goes under the band's edge, as if it ended there, and never under the pill.
- (c) The New invoice sheet's scrolling backdrop ends above the band (`inset:0 0 var(--demo-pill-h, 0px) 0`).
- (d) The phone pill's open details are saved when they are tapped, not in a later effect: a reload right after the tap no longer loses the choice. REQ-379's story raced this once the band added a render.
**Tests:**

## REQ-449 — A price-tier tap selects; Continue goes into the wizard in place, with no page reload (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m48)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m48`, "Tapping a price tier jumps ahead and reloads the page" (fleet-6 l.149). RCA: analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** in `front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` each Pick-a-price tier card had `onClick={() => onPriceContinue(t.priceCents)}` (since 49a5d6ca). With job details already entered, that called `startQuoteFromRaw`, which created the quote and ended with `globalThis.location.href = /assistant/<id>`. That is a full page load: it re-fetched whoami and demo-mode and replaced every element. All of this happened under the copy "Tap a suggestion, or enter your own below.", next to a Continue button that was still disabled.
**Requirement:** a tier tap only SELECTS. The tier's price fills the price box, the card gets `is-selected` / `aria-pressed="true"`, and no quote is created. Continue is what moves on. The selected card is the tier whose price is in the box (`selectedTierIndex` in `front-end/lib/money-input.ts`). Continue now hands off into the wizard in place, with no page load. It reads the thread back with `assistantClient.conversation` and sets its messages, customer and quote. It closes the pre-quote panels (the same result `restorableDraft` gives with a quote bound), marks the end-of-wizard Job Details polish as owed, and starts that generation. Then it sets the thread id and calls `history.replaceState` to `/assistant/<id>`. A full page load happens only as a fallback, when the thread can't be read back. The copy (en and es) now reads "Tap a suggestion or enter your own below, then Continue." / "… y luego Continuar."
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/tier-tap-selects.test.ts` ("REQ-449 …"). It checks that `selectedTierIndex` picks the tier whose price is in the box and returns -1 when nothing matches. It checks that the tier button calls `selectPriceTier` and never `onPriceContinue`, that `selectPriceTier` sets the price and remounts the box, and that `startQuoteFromRaw` keeps the page load only in the read-back fallback and otherwise uses `replaceState`. It checks the copy in en and es. Integration: n/a, because no backend or API change (the hand-off makes the same calls as before, plus a GET of the conversation the page load already made). e2e `e2e/tier-tap-selects/tier-tap-selects.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-449 m48: …"): help me price it → Pick a price → tap the middle tier. It asserts that no `POST /quotes` is sent, no page load happens, the card is selected, the box holds the tier's price and the copy says "then Continue". It then asserts that Continue creates the quote once, the wizard step shows in the same document (no `load` event, a window marker survives), the URL is `/assistant/<id>`, and a reload lands on the same step. Amended for the new flow: `e2e/step-composer` (Continue no longer waits for a `load` event) and `cypress/e2e/quotes-help-me-price.cy.ts` (tap a tier, then Continue; the Cypress file was edited but not run).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, branch fix/c3-tier-tap-select off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first. `npx jest --selectProjects unit` gave "Tests: 5 failed" (`selectedTierIndex is not a function`, the tier button still called `onPriceContinue(`, `startQuoteFromRaw` still did a page load, the copy had no "continue"). `shots run e2e/tier-tap-selects` gave "✗ REQ-449 … expectation failed: a tier tap creates no quote — expected 0, got 1". GREEN. `npx jest --selectProjects unit` gave "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2507 passed". `shots run e2e/tier-tap-selects e2e/step-composer e2e/known-price-lines e2e/help-me-price-scope e2e/bullet-tap-selects e2e/confirm-strip-layout e2e/confirm-strip-own-words e2e/edit-job-details-lang` passed ✓ REQ-449, REQ-392 ×2, REQ-259, REQ-260, REQ-335, REQ-338, REQ-381 ×2 and REQ-400. One story failed: ✗ REQ-383 M26 ("Cannot read properties of null (reading 'getBoundingClientRect')"), and it fails the same way on an untouched origin/demo-fixes worktree, so it is a baseline failure and not caused by this change. `deno lint` and `deno check` are clean on `islands/AsstChat.tsx` and `lib/money-input.ts`. `deno fmt --check` is clean on `lib/money-input.ts`, the new tests and `e2e/step-composer`.
## REQ-496 — The topbar's live-activity notice follows the EN/ES switch at once (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m36)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m36`: "Top notice stays Spanish ~1.5 s after switching to EN" (fleet-re05e1cbb-3/stdout:143,216-220). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** `front-end/islands/DashTopbar.tsx` set the ticker to `html: tickerItem.title`. That string was rendered on the server in the viewer's `user.language` at fetch time (P-59, `notify-on-event` `localizeNotification`). The EN click flipped `langSignal` and PUT the profile language, but the title only changed after the PUT returned and `pm:mutated` refetched the feed. That refetch goes through REQ-424's `coalescedRefresh`, which allows at most one per 5 s, so an ES→EN switch in quick succession waited seconds. The age chip next to it was already English because it is rendered client-side.
**Requirement:** the ticker renders an event-sourced row's title client-side in the LIVE language from the feed's `titleKey` + `titleParams`. The feed already carried them; the front-end `Notification` type now declares them. A legacy row without a key keeps the server's title. Client-rendered words are HTML-escaped before `innerHTML`. Rendering goes through one shared renderer, `shared/quote-flow/notification-title.ts` (`renderNotifString` / `notificationTitle`: the "your client" fallback, REQ-224 `amountCents` and `method` formatting, sentence case). The backend's `localizeNotification` uses the same renderer, so the client's words always match the server's.

## REQ-441 — A line the contractor adds to (or edits on) the confirmed help-me-price card reaches every language of the quote (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M23)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `M23` — "Spanish customer copy drops the user-added job line (es 10 lines vs en 11)" (fleet-6 stdout l.191: a line added via "Add your own…"; l.205-207: the translate-quote response had es 10 lines, en 11). RCA analyst CONFIRMED (high), skeptic UPHELD at `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** confirm mode in `applyJobOption` (front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx) stores `confirmedOptionRef.current = { ...opt, bullets: live }` with `opt.byLang` unchanged; `startQuoteFromRaw` then wrote `descriptionByLang` as the live text for the app language and `v.bullets.join("\n")` from that stale `byLang` for every other language. The polish path re-translates edited bullets; the confirm path never did. Server-side, `missingQuoteTranslations` (shared/quote-flow/quote-translations.ts) treated any non-empty cached language as done, so TranslateQuote never refilled the short Spanish copy. Introduced in 78471312 (byLang fields in startQuoteFromRaw).
**Requirement:** `startQuoteFromRaw` seeds `descriptionByLang` through `confirmedDescriptionByLang(byLang, appLang, raw)`: another language reuses the pre-generated bullets only when the live lines are exactly the app language's pre-generated ones; otherwise it is stale and the live lines are translated for it (`assistantClient.translate`), and if that fails it is left out for TranslateQuote to fill — never the pre-edit copy. Server guard: a cached description whose line count differs from the base description counts as missing, so TranslateQuote re-translates it (and the preview's "translation missing" notice shows).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/confirm-retranslate.test.ts` ("REQ-441 …": unedited bullets reuse the pre-generated translation; an added, reworded or deleted line marks the other language stale; whitespace is not an edit; a Spanish contractor's edit marks English stale; no app-language bullets → stale; `missingQuoteTranslations` flags a short es copy and keeps a same-count one, base slot too; AsstChat's `startQuoteFromRaw` uses the helper and `assistantClient.translate`, no `v.bullets.join`) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/translate-quote/int.test.ts` ("REQ-441 (M23, cycle 3) a cached copy missing the contractor's added line is stale — re-translated with every line") · e2e `e2e/confirm-retranslate/confirm-retranslate.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-441 M23: a line added with 'Add your own…' on the confirmed card reaches the quote's Spanish copy" — help me price it, add a line on the confirmed card, pick a tier; the POST /quotes body's `descriptionByLang.es` carries the translated added line).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, branch fix/c3-confirm-retranslate off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/confirm-retranslate.test.ts` → "Tests: 10 failed" (`confirmedDescriptionByLang is not a function`; the short es copy not reported missing; startQuoteFromRaw still `v.bullets.join("\n")`); `deno test -A --unstable-kv …/translate-quote/int.test.ts --filter REQ-441` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed" (en stayed "Prepare walls\nPaint the bathroom"); `shots run e2e/confirm-retranslate` against the pre-fix AsstChat → "✗ … expected "Retirar el mueble viejo\nInstalar el mueble nuevo\nRetirar los escombros", got "Retirar el mueble viejo\nInstalar el mueble nuevo"" (the demo's bug). GREEN — jest unit project "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2513 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/` → "ok | 308 passed | 0 failed"; `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/confirm-retranslate/confirm-retranslate.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → "✓ REQ-441 M23 … 5s". `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on AsstChat.tsx and quote-translations.ts; `deno fmt --check` clean on quote-translations.ts, translate-quote/int.test.ts and the two new tests (AsstChat.tsx left unformatted as a whole; the new hunk is fmt-stable).

## REQ-501 — Settings refuses a malformed email and a blank business name instead of saving them (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M35)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `M35`: "Settings saves invalid email 'carl@@jensen' and an empty business name". RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** `EditCard` in `front-end/islands/SettingsPage.tsx` saved the email and business name on blur with no check (`saveUser({ email: email.trim() })`, `saveIdentity({ businessName: biz.trim() })`). The server accepted both: `UpdateUserDto.email` and `UpdateBusinessIdentityDto.businessName` were only `@IsOptional() @IsString()`. Both PUTs returned 200. The initials went CJ → CA, and the hero `businessName ?? displayName ?? user.name` rendered "" because `??` does not skip an empty string.
**Requirement:** one rule, `shared/quote-flow/settings-fields.ts`, is used by Settings and by the server. `accountEmailError` refuses a malformed email using the customer email rule (REQ-278's `isValidCustomerEmail`) and returns `customer.invalidEmail`. A blank email is allowed because it clears the field. `businessNameError` refuses a blank business name once one is set, including a name of spaces only, and returns `welcome.nameBlank` (the wizard's copy). On blur, Settings shows the error inline under the field (`settings-email-error` / `settings-biz-error`) and saves nothing, so the stored value stays. PUT /me answers 400 `customer.invalidEmail` (`UserInputError`). PUT /profile/identity answers 400 `welcome.nameBlank`. The hero and the Business identity card use `||`, so an empty name falls through to the next one.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/settings-field-validate.test.ts` ("REQ-501 M35 …": the helpers' accept and refuse cases; the en/es copy; the island calls both helpers on blur and renders the inline errors; the hero uses `||`; the backend uses the same rule) · integration `backend/src/users/entrypoints/me-controller/e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-501 M35 me e2e: PUT /me refuses a malformed email …": carl@@jensen / carl@ / carl@jensen → 400 with the key, the stored email is kept, "" clears it) and `backend/src/users/entrypoints/business-identity-controller/e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-501 M35 business-identity e2e: a blank businessName is refused once one is set") · e2e `e2e/settings-field-validate/settings-field-validate.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-501 M35: Settings refuses 'carl@@jensen' and a blank business name on blur …": inline errors appear, GET /api/me and /api/profile/identity are unchanged, the hero keeps "Jensen Roofing", and a valid email still saves).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-settings-field-validate off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first. `deno test -A --unstable-kv …/me-controller/e2e.test.ts …/business-identity-controller/e2e.test.ts --filter REQ-501` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed" (`carl@@jensen`: 200, expected 400; blank businessName: 200). jest → "Cannot find module '../../shared/quote-flow/settings-fields'". `shots run e2e/settings-field-validate -- --no-check` → "✗ REQ-501 … [data-cy='settings-email']: the blur never took" (no inline error appeared). GREEN: backend `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/users/entrypoints/me-controller/ src/users/entrypoints/business-identity-controller/ src/users/domain/data/user-store/ src/crm/dto/` → "ok | 60 passed | 0 failed". jest unit project → "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2508 passed". `shots run e2e/settings-field-validate e2e/settings-lang-toggle -- --no-check` → ✓ REQ-501, ✓ REQ-254. `deno lint`, `deno check` and `deno fmt --check` are clean on SettingsPage.tsx, settings-fields.ts and the new tests. Backend `deno check` and `deno lint` are clean on dto/user.ts and business-identity-controller/mod.ts.

## REQ-452 — The "Couldn't send" / "Sent" card is drawn at the send, below anything typed before it (demo-loop cycle 3, issue p8-pair7-b)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `p8-pair7-b` — "'Couldn't send' card renders above a later message" (fleet-6 stdout l.209-210: pair 7 typed a fix on the review step at 12:12:36, sent at 12:12:57, and the failure card showed ABOVE the 12:12:36 message). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** the send outcome is not a message of its own. `front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx`'s continue_cta branch re-renders the `toPhase: "send"` CTA in place — title `asstChat.cta.sendFailed` when reviewed && dispatchFailed, else "Sent" — reading the outcome from the phase-3 divider after it. ## REQ-487 — A standalone invoice's public page shows Bill to / From and its own line-item table (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m58)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m58` — "Manual (standalone) invoice page lacks FACTURAR A / DE blocks and line-item table" (fleet-8 stdout:192); RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** `front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx` drew the Bill to / From `PartyCard`s and the itemized table only when `rich = items.length > 0 || agreementTotal != null`, and `items` came only from `jobDetails.lineItems`, which `getInvoicePublic` (`backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/mod.ts`) filled only from a linked quote. A standalone invoice got `jobName`/`description` only, so it never showed the parties or its own line items. Introduced in 9d773fe2; REQ-206 (474f09dc) added the standalone fields but not the party blocks or items.
**Requirement:** every public invoice page shows "Bill to / Facturar a" (the bill-to snapshot, else the CRM customer — `customer` in the projection, with business name and address when known) and "From / De" (the contractor), whether or not it came from a quote and whether or not it has line items. `GET /invoices/:id/public` projects a standalone invoice's own line items (description, quantity, unit, price) into `jobDetails.lineItems`, so /i draws its itemized table; a batch (visit) invoice keeps its address-grouped visits and gets no second flat table. A standalone bill shows no "Agreement value" card (it has no agreement), even when tax/discount makes the amount differ from the line sum.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/standalone-invoice-doc.test.tsx` ("REQ-487 (demo m58): …": renders the real /i/[id] route over a stubbed in-process backend — Bill to "Maria Lopez" + From the contractor; Facturar a / De with no line items in Spanish; the line-item rows render with no "Agreement value"; with tax the card still stays off) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/standalone-invoice-doc.int.test.ts` ("REQ-487 (demo m58, cycle 3): …": app booted, a standalone invoice with billTo + two line items → `jobDetails.lineItems` carries both, `customer.name` is the bill-to, no `agreementTotal`; a batch visit invoice → `visits` and no `jobDetails.lineItems`) · e2e n/a — the page is server-rendered with no client interaction involved; the unit test renders the real route against the projection shape the integration test pins.

## REQ-494 — An EN/ES pick on /worker survives re-opening the worker view, and the demo pill keeps the viewer's language there (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M43)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `M43` — "Worker view forgets English; worker sign-in turns the owner's UI and demo pill Spanish" (fleet-7 stdout:38: clicked EN at 12:09:21, went Back to office, re-opened Worker view from the sidebar and it was Spanish again at 12:13:45; the customer's demo pill read "Modo demo · Alex te está guiando"). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** `front-end/routes/worker/index.tsx` set `langChosen` only from `?lang=`. The sidebar links plain `/worker` (DashSidebar.tsx:480), so the pm_lang=en the switch had persisted looked like a default. `WorkerScreen.load()` then ran `workerScreenLang(who, false)` → "es" and `setLang("es", { persist: false })` over the person's pick; REQ-416 kept the pick in island memory only. Separately, `DemoModeOverlay` rendered its pill with `t()` → the live `langSignal`, which REQ-285 sets to the worker's language on /worker. Introduced by 722aa813 (REQ-285), not covered by REQ-416.
**Requirement:** the /worker EN/ES switch remembers the pick in its own browser-session cookie `pm_worker_lang` (`rememberWorkerLangPick`, `front-end/lib/field.ts`). The route resolves `?lang=` > that pick > pm_lang > Spanish (`workerRouteLang`, `workerLangPickFromCookie`) and passes `langPicked`; the island counts a remembered pick as chosen, so the signed-in worker's language (REQ-285) does not override it on re-entry. Salir forgets the pick, so the next worker's own language applies (REQ-285 unchanged). On /worker, the demo chrome (DemoModeOverlay's strings) speaks the viewer's stored language (`storedLang()`: pm:lang, else pm_lang) and not the worker's session language (`demoChromeLang` in `front-end/lib/lang.ts`). Other pages follow the live language as before.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/worker-lang-pick.test.ts` ("REQ-494 …": the cookie name and parser incl. HTTP/2 ", " joins; re-entry with pick "en" and no ?lang= → lang en, picked, and `workerScreenLang` leaves it; precedence ?lang= > pick > pm_lang > es; demoChromeLang keeps the stored language on /worker only) · unit `jest/unit/worker-lang-pick.test.ts` ("REQ-494 …": the route uses `workerLangPickFromCookie` + `workerRouteLang` and passes `langPicked`; the island seeds `langChosenRef` with `langChosen || !!langPicked`, the switch calls `rememberWorkerLangPick(c)`, logout calls `rememberWorkerLangPick(null)`; DemoModeOverlay goes through `demoChromeLang`) · integration n/a — no backend or API change; it is a cookie, an SSR route and two islands · e2e `e2e/worker-language/worker-language.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-494: EN picked on /worker survives re-opening /worker without ?lang= while the Spanish worker is signed in"). The demo-pill half has no e2e story: it needs a live two-browser demo session. The unit tests cover the pure language pick and the overlay's wiring.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-worker-lang-memory off demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`):** RED first — `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/worker-lang-pick.test.ts` → "Type checking failed" (TS2305: no exported member `WORKER_LANG_COOKIE` / `workerLangPickFromCookie` / `workerRouteLang` / `demoChromeLang`); `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/worker-lang-pick.test.ts` → "Tests: 3 failed"; `shots run e2e/worker-language/worker-language.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check --filter REQ-494` → "✗ REQ-494 … locator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded — waiting for getByText('Hey, Luis')" at line 255 (after re-opening /worker the screen was Spanish). GREEN — `deno test -A lib/` → "ok | 216 passed | 0 failed"; jest unit project → "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2505 passed"; `shots run e2e/worker-language/worker-language.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → ✓ REQ-285, ✓ REQ-416, ✓ REQ-494. `deno lint` and `deno check` are clean on the 6 touched front-end files. `deno fmt --check` is clean on all of them except `lib/lang.ts`, which was already unformatted on demo-fixes (STRINGS lines it does not touch) and is left as it was.
## REQ-476 — The live-activity pill shows "Quote sent to <customer>" whole at a laptop width (demo-loop cycle 3, issues p8-pair9-a, p8-pair10-c)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issues `p8-pair9-a` — "Truncated chip 'Cotización enviada a t…'" — and `p8-pair10-c` — "Truncated 'Quote sent to your…'"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked and measured):** (1) REQ-406 (cycle 2) set `.topbar__ticker { flex: 0 100 auto; min-width: 220px }`, so at 1280px the pill gives way first and lands near its floor, where the one-line track (`white-space: nowrap; height: 18px`) held ~120px of text. Measured at 1280×720 on demo-fixes: /assistant en "Quote sent to your client" needs 145px and had 123px; es "Cotización enviada a tu cliente" needs 181px and had 143px (1px short even on /dashboard). The search input there has only ~8px to spare over its placeholder (292px for 284px), so the pill cannot take more width without breaking REQ-406. (2) `SendQuote` (backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/mod.ts) emitted `quote:sent` with no `data`, so `notificationL10n` always used the "your client" / "tu cliente" fallback instead of the customer's name.

The ticker's sentence wraps to a second line inside the 36px pill when it is narrow (two 14px lines, ellipsis only past the second; `-webkit-line-clamp: 2`), in dashboard.css and assistant-page.css alike, without taking width from the search box; the whole pill's hover title is "Live activity: <full sentence>".
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/topbar-ticker-two-lines.test.ts` ("REQ-476 …": both sheets' `.topbar__ticker-item` wraps and clamps at 2 lines, the track has no fixed one-line height and room for two lines inside the 36px pill, DashTopbar's pill title carries `tickerPlainText(…)`) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/int.test.ts` ("REQ-476 …": the `quote:sent` event's data is `{ customerName: "Tom & Linda K.", jobName: "Roof repair" }` and `notificationL10n` fills `{name}` from it) · e2e `e2e/ticker-sent-name/ticker-sent-name.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-476 …" ×4: at 1280×720 on /assistant and /dashboard, en + es, "Quote sent to your client", "Quote sent to María García", "Cotización enviada a tu cliente", "Cotización enviada a María García" are not cut off, stay inside the pill, are in the pill's title, and the search input still fits its placeholder).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, branch fix/c3-ticker-sent-name off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e, dev server on PORT=5917):** RED first — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/int.test.ts --filter REQ-476` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed" (customerName `undefined`, expected "Tom & Linda K."); `npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/topbar-ticker-two-lines.test.ts` → 5 failed (`white-space: nowrap`, track `height: 18px`, pill title without the sentence); `shots run e2e/ticker-sent-name` → "✗ … /assistant (en): \"Quote sent to your client\" is not cut off (overflow x=22px y=0px)", "✗ … /assistant (es): \"Cotización enviada a tu cliente\" is not cut off (overflow x=38px y=0px)". GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/ src/agents/domain/coordinators/list-conversations/ src/communication/domain/coordinators/notify-on-event/` → "ok | 45 passed | 0 failed"; jest unit project → "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2507 passed"; `shots run e2e/ticker-sent-name e2e/topbar-layout` → "ok | 7 passed | 0 failed" (REQ-476 ×4, REQ-406 ×3), `e2e/topbar-ticker` → ✓ REQ-273, ✓ REQ-319. `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on send-quote/mod.ts and islands/DashTopbar.tsx; `deno fmt --check` clean on the touched .ts/.tsx and the new tests (dashboard.css / assistant-page.css were already not fmt-clean on demo-fixes and are left so).
## REQ-492 — A signed quote's hand-off links keep the reader's language: Pay now opens /i in the language /q was read in (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M29)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Toggling the quote's EN | ES re-renders the links in the new language.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/quote-to-invoice-lang.test.ts` ("REQ-492 …": withLang on bare / queried / hashed / absolute urls; quote-doc.tsx links payNow.url twice and r.url through `withLang(…, lang)`, never raw) · integration `front-end/lib/quote-to-invoice-lang.test.tsx` ("REQ-492 (M29) …": the real QuoteDoc rendered signed, contractor commsLanguage "es", in en and in es — Pay now, banner, invoice row and change-order row hrefs all end `?lang=<lang>`) · e2e `e2e/quote-to-invoice-lang/quote-to-invoice-lang.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-492 (M29): a fresh browser opens /q in English, signs, clicks Pay now — /i opens in English (html lang=en)…"). **Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `p8-pair2-d` — "/quotes blank for 1–2 s on load". RCA analyst LIKELY (medium), skeptic UPHELD at `cc5d4b0e`.

A list that can't be read (no session, non-2xx, a throw) gives `null` and the island keeps its skeleton + client fetch; a failed win-rate/insight read is a `null` field. ## REQ-464 — Edit's "Change the quote: " seed doesn't outlive the draft card: Lock it in / Re-open / send drop a bare seed, and Edit shows what to type (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m33)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m33` — "'Edit' on the quote card only types 'Change the quote:', which stays after 'Lock it in'"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e` (pair 4 saw the leftover text after Lock it in).
**Cause (RCA):** REQ-246's `openDraftEdit` (`front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx`) seeds the composer with `asstChat.actionCard.editPrompt` ("Change the quote: ") but nothing remembered the seed; `lockActionCard` never touched the draft, so after Lock it in the composer still asked for a change to a now-locked quote, and sending it would post that as a correction. ## REQ-500 — Settings never lets both "Languages you send in" be unticked: the last one is locked on with the keep-one hint, and the API refuses an empty list (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M34)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." ## REQ-486 — Demo fix m32 (cycle 3): a New invoice with "What's it for" + an amount and no line rows doesn't warn "No line items", and it's issued with that label as one itemized line
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m32` — "New invoice warns 'No line items' with an item description and $320 entered" (fleet-2 stdout:76,166,242); related m58 / M39. RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** the form supports amount-only billing (`amountCents` is "the typed total when there are no lines", `shared/documents/invoice-form.ts` `InvoiceFormValues`; `computeTotals` uses it as the subtotal), but `missingInfo` pushed `noLineItems` whenever `form.lineItems.length === 0`, even when there was an amount. The demo user filled "What's it for" (`jobName`) and Amount and never added a line row, so the warning fired on a supported bill. The POST body then had no `lineItems`, so the invoice and the /i page showed no itemized row. Introduced in 474f09dc (REQ-206 missingInfo).
**Requirement:** `missingInfo` warns `noLineItems` only when there are no lines AND no amount. On submit, `buildInvoiceBody` turns a bill with no line rows into one line: "What's it for" (or else the description) × 1 @ the typed amount, in cents, before any discount or tax. No line is made up when there's no label, no amount, or when the invoice is drawn from a quote, because the backend derives the quote's own lines for that case. Typed line rows still take priority.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/amount-only-invoice.test.ts` ("REQ-486 m32 …": no `noLineItems` with an amount; an empty bill still warns both; jobName + $320 → one line, subtotal 32000, discount + tax on top; description fallback; no line without a label / amount / on a quote; typed rows still take priority) · integration n/a — no backend or API change; `POST /invoices` already accepts `lineItems` (`backend/src/paperwork/dto/invoice.ts`) · e2e `e2e/amount-only-invoice/amount-only-invoice.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-486 m32: What's it for + $320, no line rows → no 'No line items' warning, and the invoice is issued with one line 'Gutter cleaning' × 1 @ $320").
**Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, branch fix/c3-amount-only-invoice off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first: `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/amount-only-invoice.test.ts` → "Tests: 3 failed" (`Received array: ["noLineItems"]`; `lineItems` received undefined ×2). `shots run e2e/amount-only-invoice/… -- --no-check` → "✗ REQ-486 … expectation failed: an amount-only bill does not warn "No line items" (got: "Before you send — this bill is missing:\nNo line items")". GREEN: jest unit project → "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2508 passed". `shots run e2e/amount-only-invoice e2e/invoice-numbering -- --no-check` → "✓ REQ-486 m32 …" and "✓ REQ-206 the standalone invoice form …". The REQ-206 ledger-prefill story in that file ("expected Agreed, got Quoted", from REQ-409's copy) was already failing before this change, and fails the same way on the untouched branch. `deno lint`, `deno check` and `deno fmt --check` are clean on `shared/documents/invoice-form.ts`, `islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` (unchanged) and the new tests.
## REQ-520 — The new-worker form says why it can't add: Add stays enabled, a bad box is named under itself, and the Spanish default is explained (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m19)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m19` — "New worker form defaults to Spanish on an English account; 'Add' stays grey with no reason (3-digit PIN)" (pair 8: "A 3-digit PIN just kept Add greyed out with no explanation"; pair 2: "Agregar disabled with no hint"). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** `front-end/islands/FieldWorkersPage.tsx` computed `canAdd = name && phone.length === 10 && /^\d{4}$/.test(pin)` (:98-100) and rendered Add `disabled={!canAdd}` (:321). A disabled submit never runs the browser's `required`/`pattern` checks, and the page drew a box's error only for a server refusal (`addErr`), so a 3-digit PIN left a grey button and no reason. The Spanish default is REQ-155 (a product decision, kept); the only explanation of it was a `title` tooltip on the select.
**Requirement:** Add is enabled whenever nothing is being added. `addFormProblems` (`front-end/lib/field-worker-errors.ts`) names each invalid box with the same `field.wk.err.*` keys the server's refusals use (name → `nameRequired`, phone ≠ 10 digits → `phone10`, PIN ≠ 4 digits → `pin4`). A box's problem shows under it (`wk-name-error` / `wk-phone-error` / `wk-pin-error`, input `aria-invalid`) once the box was left (blur) or Add was pressed; a server refusal for the box takes precedence; fixing the value clears it. Add on an invalid form posts nothing. Spanish stays the default (REQ-155), with a visible one-line note under the row (`wk-lang-note`, `field.wk.langNote`, en + es): "Workers get their texts in Spanish unless you switch the language here." / "Los trabajadores reciben sus mensajes en español, salvo que cambies el idioma aquí."
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/field-worker-form-hints.test.ts` ("REQ-520 (demo cycle 3, m19) …": valid → no problems; 3-digit PIN → `pin4` only; blank name + short phone + empty PIN → all three keys; `field.wk.langNote` in en and es; the island has no `disabled={!canAdd}`, uses `disabled={adding}`, `addFormProblems`, `onBlur`, and renders `wk-lang-note`) and `jest/unit/field-worker-errors.test.ts` (REQ-421's island scan amended: the phone box's error/aria-invalid now goes through `boxErr`, server refusal first) · integration n/a — no backend or API change; the server's own 4-digit/10-digit refusals are pinned by REQ-421's `backend/src/field/entrypoints/field.int.test.ts` · e2e `e2e/field-worker-form-hints/field-worker-form-hints.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-520 (demo m19): …": in a browser, a 3-digit PIN leaves Add enabled, Add shows "The PIN must be 4 digits." under the PIN box with `aria-invalid`, and no POST is sent; a short phone shows "Enter a 10-digit cell number." once left, cleared by a full number; the language note reads as above with Spanish still selected; a 4-digit PIN clears the error and Add creates the worker).

## REQ-430 — The stage's copy of the customer's pill says what their pill says: the status in the customer's words, never a frozen "Connected", the guide's short name on a compact phone (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m4) — also REQ-187 AMENDMENT
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m4` — "Stage copy of the customer pill: English-only status, frozen 'Connected', REQ-187 conflict" (RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on cc5d4b0e):** `front-end/islands/DemoStage.tsx` drew the ghost's status as `t(statusKeyOf(pillFace.status))` — the PRESENTER's dictionary (REQ-372), so a Spanish customer line sat next to an English "Connected". `pillFace` was only ever replaced by a `pill` message or cleared by `onPeerOnline`; `onStatus` with the link down (waiting / between) cleared the pointer only, so the frozen frame's ghost kept the last `live` → "Connected". A compact, closed phone pill hid its line on the ghost, leaving a bare status, while the phone itself shows "● Alex · Connected".
**Requirement:** (1) The `pill` peer message carries `label` (the status as the customer's pill words it, its language) and `guide` (the guide's short name while the compact pill's details are hidden), each a checked string cut to `PILL_LABEL_MAX` (60) by `parsePeerMessage`, so they survive the server. The overlay sends `label: statusLabel` and `guide: showGuide ? copy.shortName : undefined` (the ended notice sends its "Ended" label). (2) The stage words the ghost with `ghostWords(face, t)` (`shared/demo-mode/pill.ts`): the status is the customer's label, or the stage's `statusKeyOf` words for an older page; the line unless compact and closed, and then the guide's short name (`demo-pill-ghost-guide`). (3) When the stage's link goes down, `onStatus` resets the face with `pillFaceOffline(face, s)`: status `connecting` (`ended` when the demo ended), the customer's label dropped, so the frozen ghost never says "Connected"; a face never heard stays empty.
**REQ-187 AMENDMENT:** REQ-187's e2e line "inside [the frame] there is no banner and no demo pill" means the replayed page carries no pill (the mirror skips `[data-demo-overlay]`, REQ-242). The ghost drawn OVER the frame by the stage (REQ-295, REQ-372, REQ-430) is intended: it marks where the customer's real pill covers their screen and what it says. It is not a REQ-187 violation.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-stage-ghost-face.test.ts` ("REQ-430 (demo-loop cycle 3, m4) …": the customer's label wins; no label → stage words; compact closed → guide, no line; open → line; `pillFaceOffline` live → connecting, label dropped, ended → ended, `{}` stays `{}`; `parsePeerMessage` keeps/caps `label`/`guide` and drops junk; the overlay sends `label`/`guide`; the stage uses `ghostWords(pillFace, t)`, renders `demo-pill-ghost-guide`, and `onStatus` calls `setPillFace((f) => pillFaceOffline(f, s))`); `jest/unit/demo-mode-pill.test.ts` REQ-372 source check updated in place (`ghostWords(` instead of `statusKeyOf(`) · integration `backend/src/demo-mode/domain/coordinators/demo-hub/test.ts` ("REQ-430 a pill message keeps its translated status label and guide name across the socket parse and two hubs") · e2e n/a — the browser lane is not run in the demo-loop fix step; `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-clear.e2e.test.ts` still holds unchanged (English customer and presenter: the ghost says "Connected").
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-stage-ghost-pill off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-stage-ghost-face` → "Tests: 7 failed, 7 total" (`ghostWords is not a function`, `pillFaceOffline is not a function`, protocol `- Expected - 2` label/guide stripped, `Expected pattern: /\blabel: f\.label\b/`, `/ghostWords\(pillFace, t\)/`); `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/demo-mode/domain/coordinators/demo-hub/test.ts --filter REQ-430` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed" (the relayed pill lost `label` and `guide`). GREEN — the same jest file "Tests: 7 passed"; the whole unit project `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2509 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/demo-mode/` → "ok | 45 passed | 0 failed"; front-end `deno lint` (4 files) + `deno check` on both islands clean; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file.

## REQ-435 — The assistant keeps the customer details the contractor typed: house number, "casa de" name, "on <Street>" address, and the address on the draft card (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M4)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `M4` — "Assistant drops customer details: house number, name, job address, address on draft card"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** the "Who is this for?" prefill comes from the regexes in `shared/quote-flow/quick-quote-prefill.ts`. (1) The US street form needs the street type AFTER the name, so "4410 Avenue F" failed and REQ-386's city/state fallback kept "Avenue F Austin TX 78751" without the 4410. (2) `leadInName` stopped at the lowercase "casa" in "para la casa de Ana Pérez" → no name. (3) The number-less "on Barton Hills Dr" form was accepted only when a ZIP followed → no address. (4) The draft `action_card` payload had no `serviceAddress`, so the card could not show it.
**Requirement:** a street-type-first US address ("4410 Avenue F", "12 Ave B", "900 County Road 175", "5100 Highway 71") is read whole, house number and following city/state/ZIP included, ahead of the city/state fallback; the fallback itself keeps a house number typed right before the city words. "la casa de / the house of / la familia (de)" is skipped to reach the name ("Ana Pérez", "Familia Nguyen"). "on <Street> <type>" is an address when a ZIP, a city, a comma/period clause or the end of the text follows (still never "on Monday" / "on the roof"). The quote `action_card` payloads (create_quote draft, chat lock, LockQuote, ReopenQuote) carry the quote's `serviceAddress`, and the chat's quote card shows it as a "Job address / Dirección del trabajo" row (`data-cy="action-card-address"`, key `asstChat.actionCard.jobAddress` in en + es).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/c3-prefill-address-name.test.ts` ("REQ-435 M4 …": the demo's three sentences — "…4410 Avenue F Austin TX 78751" → "4410 Avenue F Austin TX 78751", "para la casa de Ana Pérez" → "Ana Pérez", "for the Hendersons on Barton Hills Dr, Austin" → "Barton Hills Dr, Austin"; Ave B / County Road / Highway forms; house number kept by the fallback; old forms and the "on Monday" / "on the roof" refusals unchanged; `ActionCardPayload.serviceAddress` + the rendered row; en/es keys) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts` ("REQ-435 M4 handle-chat-message integration: the draft action_card carries the stored serviceAddress, house number kept") and `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/lock-quote/int.test.ts` ("REQ-435 M4 lock-quote integration: the locked action_card carries the quote's serviceAddress") · e2e n/a — the extractor is pure and deterministic and the card row is a direct render of the payload field; both are pinned above, and the browser lane was out of scope for this fix run.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-prefill-address-name off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/c3-prefill-address-name.test.ts` → "Tests: 9 failed, 1 skipped, 2505 passed" (`Received: "Avenue F Austin TX 78751"`, `"Lakeview Austin TX 78751"`, `null` for Ave B / Barton Hills Dr / Ana Pérez / John Reed, no `serviceAddress` in `ActionCardPayload`, key undefined); `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --filter REQ-435 …handle-chat-message/int.test.ts …lock-quote/int.test.ts` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed" (stored "Avenue F Austin TX 78751"; card serviceAddress undefined). ## REQ-491 — "Deposit + balance" names its split: "20% upfront, rest when done · $90 / $360" (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m60)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m60` — "'Deposit + balance' never asks the amount; silently 20%" (fleet-9 stdout:63,178,259); RCA analyst FEATURE_GAP, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** `computePaymentSplit` (`front-end/lib/payment-split.ts`) hard-codes "Deposit + balance" as 20% upfront / 80% on completion, but the wizard option's sub-line (`termsWizard.paymentTerms.depositBalance.sub`, `asstChat.terms.payment.depositBalanceSub`) read "Small upfront, rest when done" and never said 20% — the contractor picked a split whose size no screen showed. Introduced in `894d8819` (one source of truth for the split).
**Requirement:** the "Deposit + balance" option's sub-line names the percentage computePaymentSplit bills — "20% upfront, rest when done" / "20% por adelantado, el resto al terminar" — and, once the quote's total is known, the dollars: "… · $90 / $360" (whole dollars, from the same split the invoices use). The percentage comes from one constant, `DEPOSIT_BALANCE_PCT` in `front-end/lib/payment-split.ts`; `depositBalanceSubVars(totalCents)` builds the `{pct}` / `{deposit}` / `{balance}` vars. A deposit-percentage picker is a later feature, not part of this.

## REQ-454 — Lock → terms reads forward: "Quote locked · adding terms", never a step back to "Gathering a little more info"; nothing says "ready to send" before the terms are done (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m34)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." REQ-236's `headerStatusKey` overlay agrees.

## REQ-485 — No Delete on a signed quote or a paid invoice; the API refuses deleting a signed or billed quote (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m22)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m22` — "Delete offered on a paid invoice and on a signed quote" (fleet-re05e1cbb-4 stdout:72,208); RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** `front-end/components/QuotesSections.tsx` `DecidedRow` rendered `<DeleteQuoteButton … variant="icon" />` on every decided row, won included; `DELETE /quotes/:id` (`quote-controller/mod.ts`) called `QuoteStore.delete`, which soft-deletes with no accepted check — so a signed, binding agreement went after one confirm(). On a paid invoice the detail's "Delete invoice" (and the card's Delete) were rendered disabled — still offered, only greyed (the API already refused with 409 `locked_paid`, REQ-202).
**Requirement:** a won (signed) quote shows no Delete on its decided row or card; `DELETE /quotes/:id` answers 409 `locked_accepted` for an accepted quote (status accepted or an acceptedAt stamp) and 409 `locked_invoiced` for a quote any non-void invoice points at, and leaves it untouched; a draft/sent/lost quote with no live invoice still deletes. A paid invoice shows no Delete at all (detail and card) instead of a disabled one. One pure rule, `quoteDeleteBlock(quote, invoices)` in `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/quote-delete-guard/mod.ts`.
