## REQ-499 — Spanish wording/number slips: "today" not "0d", one gender for "Cotización + Acuerdo", "atenderte", a paid /i footer, US-grouped landing counts (demo-loop cycle 3, issue p6)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `p6` — "Spanish wording/number slips ('hace 0 d', enviada/enviado, 'atenderla', 'pregunta antes de pagar' on paid, '+1.200' beside '$4,200.00')" (fleet-1 stdout:50,114; fleet-5 :170,172; fleet-8 :194,206,266,276). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** (1) `invoicesPage.subline.out` "Enviada hace {n}d" and `quotesDecided.daysAgo` "hace {n} d" were rendered with n=0 on the send/decide day (InvoicesPage.tsx `inv.daysIn`, QuotesSections.tsx `decidedDays`), no "today" case. (2) `asstChat.cta.sent` "Cotización + Acuerdo enviada" vs the `sendQuote.divider.emailed*/texted*` "… enviado por …" and `asstChat.cta.emailedTo` "Enviado por correo a" (while `cta.textedTo` was "Enviada"). (3) `publicInvoice.footer.thanks` "es un gusto atenderla". (4) `routes/i/[id].tsx` rendered `publicInvoice.footer.questions` ("…una pregunta antes de pagar,") whatever the status; only PublicInvoiceClaim swapped it client-side right after an in-session claim, so a reload of a paid invoice put it back. (5) `formatSocialProof` / landing-scripts `groupCount` es-grouped counts ("+1.200", "48.217") while REQ-413 US-groups landing money in both languages; `landing.hero.trustStrong` es was the literal "+1.200 contratistas".
**Requirement:** (1) the send day reads "Enviada hoy · vence {date}" / "Sent today · due {date}" (`invoicesPage.subline.outToday`, picked when `daysIn < 1`), and a quote decided today reads "hoy" / "today" (`quotesDecided.today`, `decidedDays < 1`). (2) "Cotización + Acuerdo" is feminine everywhere in es (enviada/redactada/entregada/aceptada), and the send card's sub lines read "Enviada por correo a" / "Enviada por mensaje de texto a". (3) "es un gusto atenderte". (4) /i renders the footer lead-in by status on the server: paid → `publicInvoice.footer.questionsPaid` ("Si tienes alguna pregunta sobre este pago," / "If you have a question about this payment,"), claimed → `questionsClaimed`, else `questions`. (5) Landing counts are US-grouped in both languages ("+1,200 contratistas", "48,217"), the same rule as REQ-413's money and format-helpers' `formatNumber` (P-64).

## REQ-489 — "Payment received" on /invoices opens the pay form in place, never a full page load (demo-loop cycle 3, issue p8-pair1-d)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `p8-pair1-d` — "'Payment received' does a full page load" (fleet-0 stdout:170); RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** `InvoiceCard.doPaymentReceived` in `front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` (2326-2329) ran `globalThis.location.assign('/invoices?open=<id>&pay=1')` from the /invoices page itself, reloading the whole page to open the detail in pay mode, though the island already holds `openId` state and mounts `InvoiceDetail` in place. Introduced in `3b445e28` (REQ-018).
**Requirement:** on /invoices, a card's "Payment received" (the out card's stage CTA and the overdue card's back button) opens that invoice's detail in "Payment received" mode without reloading the document: the island sets `openId`, rewrites the URL to `?open=<id>&pay=1` with `history.replaceState` (other params kept), and remounts the detail so REQ-018's pay-mode initializer applies even when another (or the same) invoice was already open. Only a call from another page navigates to the `/invoices?open=<id>&pay=1` deep link. The decision lives in one pure helper, `paymentReceivedTarget(href, id)` in `front-end/lib/invoice-card.ts`.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/invoice-card.test.ts` ("REQ-489 p8-pair1-d: on /invoices, 'Payment received' opens in place and keeps the other params", "REQ-489 p8-pair1-d: from another page, 'Payment received' navigates to the /invoices deep link") · integration n/a — no backend or API change; the fix is client-side navigation in one island · e2e `e2e/payment-received-inplace/payment-received-inplace.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-489 (demo p8-pair1-d, cycle 3): 'Payment received' on /invoices opens the pay form in place — no page load": with invoice A's detail open, the out-card CTA of invoice B shows the pay form, a window marker survives, no main-frame navigation request, the URL reads `?open=<B>&pay=1` and the detail shows B).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, branch fix/c3-payment-received-inplace off demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`):** RED first — `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/invoice-card.test.ts` → "SyntaxError: The requested module './invoice-card.ts' does not provide an export named 'paymentReceivedTarget'"; `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:47391 shots run e2e/payment-received-inplace -- --no-check` against the unchanged island → "✗ REQ-489 … expectation failed: the document was not reloaded (window marker kept) — expected 1, got null". GREEN — `deno test -A lib/` → "ok | 214 passed | 0 failed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 250 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2502 passed"; `shots run e2e/payment-received-inplace e2e/payment-received-feedback e2e/invoice-card-c2 e2e/headline-counts` → ✓ REQ-489, ✓ REQ-322 (a)(b), ✓ REQ-407, ✓ REQ-243 (d)(e), ✓ REQ-317; REQ-243 (a) (a /quotes hero count, a page this change does not touch) fails the same way on the untouched island (see the commit). `deno lint`, `deno check`, `deno fmt --check` clean on `islands/InvoicesPage.tsx`, `lib/invoice-card.ts`, `lib/invoice-card.test.ts` and the new story.
## REQ-434 — A job name on a customer document is never cut into a fragment: no trailing connector after the budget cut, bed/bath counts kept as "3-Bed 2-Bath" (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M10)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `M10` — "Job title truncated on customer documents ('Deep Clean Bed', 'Renovación de cocina y')" (fleet-6 l.207 `jobNameByLang.es: "Renovación de cocina y"`; fleet-2 l.70-74 / l.205 "Deep Clean Bed" on the quick-quote path). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** (1) `generate-job-options` `clampJobName` (es) ran `summarizeJobName` (which trims a trailing connector) and THEN `fitJobNameToBudget`, which cuts at 30 characters on whole words with no connector trim — the model's 31-character "Renovación de cocina y limpieza" became "Renovación de cocina y", stored straight into `jobNameByLang.es` by the confirm-mode picker. (2) `summarizeJobName` (en; the fallback in quote-store and AsstChat) skipped every digit-led token and kept 3 words, so "deep clean 3 bed 2 bath" became "Deep Clean Bed". The polish-job-details English clamp had the sibling defect (3-word slice → "Kitchen Renovation And"). Both introduced with REQ-337 (a51e7c5e).
**Requirement:** `fitJobNameToBudget` never leaves an English or Spanish connector/article last (`trimTrailingConnectors` in `shared/quote-flow/job-name.ts`: a/an/the/and/&/or/of/for/with/to/in/on/at/by + de/del/la/el/los/las/un/una/y/o/para/por/con/en/al), always keeping the first word; the polish-job-details English clamp uses the same trim. The English `summarizeJobName` keeps a bed/bed­room/bath/bath­room/room/story/car count as a size qualifier up front ("3 bed 2 bath" / "3-bed" → "3-Bed 2-Bath Deep Clean"), at most two, dropped last-first before the core name when the whole would break the 5-word / 30-character budget; any other number is still skipped (no bare-number title).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/job-name.test.ts` ("REQ-434 M10: a job name is never cut into a fragment …": "Renovación de cocina y limpieza" → "Renovación de cocina" directly and through the es summarizer; English trailing "and"/"&"/"of" dropped; names inside the budget untouched; "deep clean 3 bed 2 bath" → "3-Bed 2-Bath Deep Clean"; non-size numbers still skipped; qualifiers give way under the budget; the REQ-337 m6 case now reads "3-Bed Deep Clean House") · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/generate-job-options/int.test.ts` ("REQ-434 M10 a model jobName over the budget is never cut after a connector, in either language"), `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/polish-job-details/int.test.ts` ("REQ-434 M10 polish: … never ends on a connector"), `backend/src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/translations.test.ts` ("REQ-434 (M10) a derived job name keeps the bed/bath counts …") · e2e n/a — a deterministic string derivation; every writer of the stored name (the options coordinator, the polish coordinator, the quote-store fallback) is pinned at integration level and the documents render the stored string verbatim; the stub LLM cannot make a browser lane produce the over-budget model name.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-job-name-clamp off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/job-name.test.ts` → "Tests: 5 failed" (Received "Renovación de cocina y", "Deep Clean Bed", "Deep Clean House"); `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv` on the three integration files → "FAILED | 33 passed | 3 failed" (Actual "Bathroom Renovation And", "Kitchen Renovation And", "Deep Clean Bed"). GREEN — jest unit project → "Test Suites: 250 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2507 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/{generate-job-options,polish-job-details,translate-quote,handle-chat-message}/ src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/` → "ok | 156 passed | 0 failed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on job-name.ts, AsstChat.tsx, polish-job-details and generate-job-options; `deno fmt --check` clean on job-name.ts and polish-job-details/mod.ts.
## REQ-504 — "Skip setup for now" defers every open question and lands on the dashboard, which no longer loops back to the wizard (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M37)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `M37` — "Dashboard unreachable after 'Skip setup for now'" (fleet-9: /dashboard REDIRECTED to /welcome Step 8; the sidebar Dashboard link BOUNCED back again). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** `skipSetup()` in `front-end/islands/WelcomeWizard.tsx` posted `/api/me/onboarded {skipped:true}` and sent the person to /assistant. That `onboardedAt` stamp is "a record, not a gate"; the dashboard middleware (`routes/dashboard/_middleware.ts`) 302s to /welcome while `dashboardBlockers` (open questions minus REQ-227's per-question "deferred" stamps) is non-empty, and only a step's own Skip wrote a deferred stamp. So the escape left logo/insurance/… open and undeferred, and every /dashboard visit looped — while the logo step's copy promises "your dashboard keeps it on your setup list". Introduced by REQ-091 (3dadf6a78), which made the dashboard a gate and kept the escape a bare skip.
**Requirement:** `POST /me/onboarded { skipped: true, deferAll: true }` stamps every OPEN deferrable question deferred on the server (`skipSetupDeferrals` in `shared/quote-flow/onboarding-questions.ts`: open ∩ deferrable — never the name, never an answered question) in one `UserStore.deferOnboarding` write, then records the leave as before. The wizard's escape sends that body and lands on /dashboard, whose setup checklist asks for the rest; the escape is offered only once the name is answered (`canSkipSetup`), since the name cannot be deferred. A bare `{ skipped: true }` / a finish stamps nothing. REQ-091 stands: the next code still lands in the wizard at the first open question.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/skip-setup-defer-all.test.ts` ("REQ-504 …": `skipSetupDeferrals` picks the six open deferrable questions and never the name; deferring them leaves no dashboard blocker; `canSkipSetup` only with a real name; the island's escape posts `deferAll: true`, lands on /dashboard and renders behind `canSkipSetup(snap) &&`) · integration `backend/src/users/entrypoints/me-controller/e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-504 me e2e: POST /me/onboarded { skipped, deferAll } …": over HTTP the six open questions are stamped, the answered business name/email are not, `dashboardBlockers(GET /profile)` is `[]`; a nameless account keeps `["name"]`; a bare skip stamps nothing) · e2e `e2e/onboarding-until-answered/onboarding-until-answered.e2e.test.ts` (REQ-091's first story, expectation updated: no escape before the name; after the name and a step Skip, "Skip setup for now" lands on /dashboard and a second /dashboard visit stays there; the next code still lands in the wizard at the business name).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-skip-setup-defer-all off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/users/entrypoints/me-controller/e2e.test.ts --filter REQ-504` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed" (`onboardingDeferred` keys expected `[address, insurance, logo, payment, plan, state]`, got `[]`); `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern skip-setup-defer-all` → "Tests: 4 failed" (`skipSetupDeferrals is not a function`, `canSkipSetup is not a function`, the escape still posts `{ skipped: true }` → "/assistant"); `shots run e2e/onboarding-until-answered/… --filter "REQ-091: onboarding happens"` with the fix reverted → "✗ … expected 0, got 1" (escape shown before the name). GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/users/entrypoints/me-controller/ src/users/domain/coordinators/sign-in-landing/ src/users/domain/data/user-store/` → "ok | 40 passed | 0 failed"; jest unit project → "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2506 passed"; the same shots story → "✓ REQ-091: … 'Skip setup for now' (REQ-504) defers what is open and opens the dashboard … · 46.8s"; `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/` → "ok | 212 passed | 0 failed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on the touched backend and front-end files. `deno fmt` not run on WelcomeWizard.tsx / the backend files — they already carried unrelated fmt diffs on demo-fixes.

## REQ-510 — A signed-in visitor on a policy page gets "Back to app", not "Log in" (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m35)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m35` — "/terms says 'Log in' while signed in"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.

## REQ-519 — Client search ignores accents and skipped words, in the customer list AND the header search (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M33)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `M33`: "Client search does not ignore accents or skipped words: 'maria pena' finds nothing, the top search 'maria' finds nothing" (pair 6: 'maria pena' → "Ningún cliente coincide con este filtro."; top bar 'maria' → 'Nada coincide con "maria"'). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** two search paths, and REQ-279 fixed only one. (1) `shared/quote-flow/customer-search.ts` `customerMatchesQuery` (GET /customers ?q=, the /customers page, the assistant's picker) folded accents but tested the whole query as ONE substring, so "maria pena" missed "maria jose pena" because of the middle name. (2) The header search (`GlobalSearch` → `global-search` → `shared/documents/search.ts` `searchRecords`) never folded accents: `hasText` was `hay.toLowerCase().includes(q)`, and `fold()` (the number match) stripped "é" instead of folding it. Introduced in 474f09dc (REQ-198..210); REQ-279 never reached it.
**Requirement:** both searches are accent- and case-blind and match word by word: every word of the query must appear somewhere in the record's texts, in any order, and words may be skipped ("maria pena" and "pena maria" find "María José Peña"; "maria smith" does not). One shared rule, `textsMatchAllWords` in `shared/quote-flow/customer-search.ts`, used by `customerMatchesQuery` and by `searchRecords`' `anyText`; `fold()` in `shared/documents/search.ts` folds accents via `foldSearch` before stripping non-alphanumerics.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/customer-search-tokens.test.ts` ("REQ-519 …": 'maria pena' / 'pena maria' / 'María Peña' match, a word found nowhere filters out; `searchRecords` 'maria', 'pena', 'PEÑA', 'maria pena' find her, 'maria smith' finds nothing; an accented quote summary is found unaccented) · unit `backend/src/analytics/domain/business/clients-page/test.ts` ("REQ-519 … matchesQuery matches word by word") · integration `backend/src/analytics/domain/coordinators/global-search/int.test.ts` ("REQ-519 … global-search integration: accent-blind and word-by-word") · e2e `e2e/clients-pages/clients-pages.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-519 … 'maria pena' finds María José Peña") and `e2e/global-search/global-search.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-519 … the header search … 'maria' and 'maria pena' bring up María José Peña").
**Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, branch fix/c3-customer-search-tokens off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — jest unit `customer-search-tokens` → "Tests: 4 failed" (received false / []); `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/analytics/domain/business/clients-page/test.ts src/analytics/domain/coordinators/global-search/int.test.ts` → "FAILED | 17 passed | 2 failed" (both REQ-519); `shots run e2e/clients-pages e2e/global-search -- --no-check --filter REQ-519` with the old implementation → "✗ … expectation failed: one card for "maria pena" (0)", "✗ … locator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded". GREEN — `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2507 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/analytics/domain/business/clients-page/ src/analytics/domain/coordinators/global-search/ src/crm` → "ok | 97 passed | 0 failed"; `shots run e2e/clients-pages e2e/global-search -- --no-check` → 8 ✓ (REQ-135, 207, 274, 277, 279, 419, 519 ×2); `deno lint` + `deno check` clean (backend modules, AsstChat.tsx, GlobalSearch.tsx); `deno fmt --check` clean on the touched shared files and the new jest test (clients-page/test.ts and clients-pages.e2e.test.ts were not fmt-clean before and were left unformatted).
## REQ-525 — A failed send explains its reason once: the send card owns it, the divider says "Text not delivered", the recovery box names the fix (demo-loop cycle 3, issue p8-pair2-a)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `p8-pair2-a` — "The same 555 send error is shown three times" (pair 2 customer 12:09:52: card "No se pudo enviar — No entregada — ese es un número 555 ficticio…", divider "Error al enviar … — …", box "Ese número no recibe mensajes — revísalo"). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** one failed text writes one `phase_divider`, and AsstChat drew its reason three times: (1) the divider label built server-side as `sendQuote.divider.textFailed` "… text failed — {reason}" (`backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/mod.ts:356`); (2) the send CTA card's `asstChat.cta.notDelivered` + `dispatchFailReason` read from the divider payload (`front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` 6608-6640, 8259-8266); (3) the recovery box headline `asstChat.recovery.checkPhone` "That number can't get texts — check it" (REQ-226).
**Requirement:** the reason has one home — the send card's "Couldn't send — Not delivered — <reason>" (unchanged; it reads `smsFailureReason` from the divider payload, which still carries it). A text-only failure's divider label is the short `sendQuote.divider.textNotDelivered` "Text not delivered" / "Mensaje de texto no entregado", with no `{reason}`. The recovery box headline for a number that can't take texts is the action "Fix the number and resend" / "Corrige el número y vuelve a enviar". `sendQuote.divider.textFailed` stays for the invoices page, where its reason has no other home.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/send-fail-one-reason.test.ts` ("REQ-525 …": en/es `textNotDelivered` short with no `{reason}`; the recovery headline is the action and doesn't restate the failure; the coordinator uses the short key; the send card still renders `cta.notDelivered` + `dispatchFailReason`), `jest/unit/sms-failure.test.ts` (REQ-226 headline assertion follows the new action copy) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/int.test.ts` ("REQ-525 send-quote: a failed text's divider label is short …"; REQ-276's Spanish-note test now reads the label as "Mensaje de texto no entregado" and the Spanish reason off the payload) · e2e `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/conversations-controller/failed-send.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-525 e2e: …" over HTTP on the booted app) and browser `e2e/sms-recovery/sms-recovery.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-525 (en|es): a failed text's divider is short and the recovery box doesn't repeat the reason"; REQ-226's headline regex follows the new copy).

## REQ-478 — A reported payment awaiting confirmation counts in the /invoices KPI tiles; tile totals are the balance owed (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M32)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `M32` — "Invoice KPI tiles all $0 while a reported payment awaits confirmation" (fleet-8: INV-001 $450 "Pago reportado"; hero "1 pago esperando tu confirmación." over tiles "VENCIDA $0 · ENVIADAS PARA COBRO $0 · 0 en camino · PAGADAS ESTE MES $0"). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** `front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` put a claimed invoice in its own `claimed` bucket; `outstandingTotal` and `outTotal` summed only `[...overdue, ...out]`, and `<InvoicesKpis>` received no claimed value — a $450 claim sat in no tile. Totals also summed the face `amount`, not what is still owed. Since the KPI row's first version (8b4823c0); the claimed stage was never added to the tiles.
**Requirement:** a claimed (reported, unconfirmed) invoice is still money out: its balance counts in the "Out for payment / Enviadas para cobro" tile and in the hero's outstanding total (and the hero's "across N invoices" count). The tile's sub-line says how many await confirmation — "{n} on the way · {c} awaiting your confirmation" / "{n} en camino · {c} esperando tu confirmación" (`invoicesPage.kpi.outSubClaimed.one/.other`). Overdue, out and claimed totals are the balance still owed, amount − paidCents, never below zero. One pure helper, `invoiceKpiTotals` (with `invoiceBalanceCents`) in `front-end/lib/headline-counts.ts`, used by the island.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/invoice-kpi-claimed.test.ts` ("REQ-478 (M32) …": a lone $450 claim → out tile and outstanding $450; out + claimed sum into the out tile, overdue apart, drafts/scheduled/paid excluded; totals are amount − paidCents; overpaid/missing amounts never go negative/NaN; the island derives totals from `invoiceKpiTotals(` and no longer from `[...overdue, ...out].reduce`; `<InvoicesKpis>` receives `claimedCount`; en/es `outSubClaimed` keys exist with `{n}` and `{c}` and the island renders them) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change; `status: "claimed"`, `amount` and `paidCents` already arrive on `GET /invoices` · e2e n/a — a sum over the already-loaded list rendered verbatim into the tile; pinned by the unit test against the real dictionaries and the island source.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-kpi-claimed off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/invoice-kpi-claimed` → "Tests: 7 failed" (`invoiceKpiTotals is not a function` ×4; island source lacks `invoiceKpiTotals(`; `<InvoicesKpis … />` has no `claimedCount=`; `invoicesPage.kpi.outSubClaimed.one` undefined). GREEN — the same run (it sweeps the whole unit project) → "Test Suites: 251 passed, 251 total · Tests: 1 skipped, 2509 passed"; `deno lint`, `deno check` clean on `islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` and `lib/headline-counts.ts`; `deno fmt --check` clean on both and on the new test.
## REQ-528 — The /worker day navigator keeps one label, writes the viewed day out, and has a date picker (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m51)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m51` — "Worker day navigation renames itself, shows a raw '2026-11-13', and has no date picker" (pair 8: "← Día anterior · Viendo 2026-11-13 · Hoy · Día siguiente →"); RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** `workerDayNav` (`front-end/lib/field.ts`, REQ-362, 63e78ef3) switched the link keys on whether the viewed day was today — `worker.yesterday`/`worker.tomorrow` on today, `worker.prevDay`/`worker.nextDay` otherwise — so "Mañana →" became "Día siguiente →" after one tap. `islands/WorkerScreen.tsx` rendered `{t("worker.viewing")} {date}` with the ISO state string, although `fmtDay(date, lang)` already formats the greeting line; there was no date input, so a far day needed `?date=` typed into the address.
**Requirement:** the /worker day links read "← Previous day" / "Next day →" (es "← Día anterior" / "Día siguiente →") on every day, today included, with "Today" as the jump back off today. The viewed day is written with `fmtDay` ("Viewing Fri, Nov 13" / "Viendo vie, 13 nov"), never as YYYY-MM-DD, and that label is a native `<input type="date">` that opens /worker?date=<picked> (keeping REQ-417's `?from=`) through one helper, `workerDayHref(iso, from?)`, which the prev/next links use too; a blank or malformed pick goes nowhere. The now-unused `worker.yesterday` / `worker.tomorrow` keys are removed from en and es; `worker.pickDay` (the picker's aria-label) is added to both.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/worker-day-nav-stable.test.ts` ("REQ-528 …": the same prev/next keys on today, tomorrow and a past day; Today only off today; `workerDayHref` with and without `from`, null for blank/malformed; the nav hrefs equal `workerDayHref`; `fmtDay` es/en is readable and not ISO; the island has no `{t("worker.viewing")} {date}`, has `data-cy="w-day-label"`, a `type="date"` `data-cy="w-day-pick"` and calls `workerDayHref(`); `jest/unit/worker-day-nav.test.ts` (REQ-362's today expectation amended to prevDay/nextDay) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change; `GET /field/worker/tasks?date=` already serves any day · e2e `e2e/worker-tomorrow/worker-tomorrow.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-362 (demo M35) + REQ-528 (demo m51) …": on today the links read "← Previous day" / "Next day →"; on tomorrow the label reads "Viewing <fmtDay>" with no ISO date; filling the date picker with a day 20 days ahead lands on /worker?date=<that day>).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, branch fix/c3-worker-day-nav off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern worker-day-nav-stable` → "Tests: 7 failed, 2 passed, 9 total" (`workerDayHref is not a function`; keys `worker.yesterday`/`worker.tomorrow` on today; island still `{t("worker.viewing")} {date}`, no `type="date"`); `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/worker-tomorrow/worker-tomorrow.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → "expectation failed: the back link — expected "← Previous day", got "← Yesterday"". GREEN — jest unit project "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2511 passed"; the same shots run "✓ REQ-362 (demo M35) + REQ-528 (demo m51) … 2.6s"; neighbours `shots run e2e/worker-office-link e2e/worker-language` → ✓ REQ-282 ×2, REQ-285, REQ-361, REQ-416, REQ-417; `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/` → "ok | 212 passed | 0 failed"; `deno lint`, `deno check`, `deno fmt --check` clean on `islands/WorkerScreen.tsx`, `lib/field.ts` and the tests.

**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `p8-pair4-b` — "Dashboard empty-state text flush to the card edge"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.

The Active jobs empty block padded `18px 4px` inline (`front-end/components/DashSections.tsx:284`, from 49a5d6cae) and the Quotes awaiting empty line `8px 0 14px` (:382), so their text sat 0–4 px from the rounded border (measured 5 px in a browser). **Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, branch fix/c3-dash-empty-padding off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/dash-empty-padding.test.ts` against the untouched DashSections.tsx/dashboard.css → "Tests: 4 failed" (`.panel__empty` padding undefined; no `panel__empty` class on either empty block; `padding:18px 4px` present); `shots run e2e/dash-empty-padding -- --no-check` → "✗ … at 1280 px … expectation failed: "No jobs in flight yet." left inset 5.0 px ≥ 18" and the same at 390 px. ## REQ-498 — Onboarding's "Languages you send in" default remembers the language the account was created in, not the live EN/ES switch (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m42)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m42`: "Onboarding from ?lang=es defaults 'Languages you send in' to English only". RCA: analyst LIKELY (medium confidence), skeptic UPHELD at `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** `BusinessNameStep` in `front-end/islands/WelcomeWizard.tsx` defaulted to `sendLanguagesOf(ctx.snap.identity, ctx.snap.user.language)` and recomputed it on every render from the live account language. The wizard's own EN/ES switch (`switchLang`) writes `snap.user.language`. So a contractor created in Spanish (verify-otp: `otp language ?? 'es'`) who tapped EN on the name step got English alone on the business step, and the Spanish origin was lost. Introduced in `cbb6b983` (REQ-348, cycle 1).
**Requirement:** until the person ticks a box, the business step's send-in default is seeded from every language the account was in during this onboarding visit: the account's language and `initialLang` when the wizard opened, plus each language the EN/ES switch moved to (`onboardingLanguagesSeen`). Spanish anywhere in that list gives English + Spanish; otherwise English (`onboardingSendLanguages` in `shared/quote-flow/comms-language.ts`, the union of `defaultCommsLanguages` over the languages seen). A stored `commsLanguages` set or a legacy `commsLanguage` still wins.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/onboarding-sendin-seen.test.ts` ("REQ-498 …": created 'es' then switched to EN at step 1 → [en, es]; English-only account → [en], one that tried ES → [en, es]; the seen list drops repeats and non-en/es values; a stored choice wins; the wizard uses `onboardingSendLanguages` with `ctx.languagesSeen`, no longer `sendLanguagesOf(ctx.snap.identity, ctx.snap.user.language)`, and `switchLang` records the language) · `jest/unit/onboarding-comms-lang.test.ts`'s REQ-348 wiring assertion now looks for `onboardingSendLanguages(` · integration n/a — no backend or wire change; the wizard already sends `commsLanguages` explicitly on the identity write · e2e `e2e/onboarding-comms-lang/onboarding-comms-lang.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-498: a Spanish-landing signup who switches to EN on step 1 still sends in English and Spanish by default …": /login?lang=es → name → EN → business step has both boxes ticked → saved `commsLanguages` [en, es]).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, branch fix/c3-onboard-sendin-default off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first: `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/onboarding-sendin-seen.test.ts` → "Tests: 5 failed" (`onboardingLanguagesSeen is not a function`; the wizard has no `onboardingSendLanguages(`); `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/onboarding-comms-lang/… -- --no-check --filter REQ-498` → "expectation failed: Spanish is still checked after switching the wizard to EN — expected true, got false". GREEN: jest unit project → "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2507 passed"; the e2e file → "✓ REQ-348 …", "✓ REQ-498 …"; `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/welcome-*.test.tsx lib/plan-pick-note.test.tsx` → "ok | 14 passed | 0 failed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on WelcomeWizard.tsx and comms-language.ts; `deno fmt --check` clean on comms-language.ts, the e2e file and the new jest test (WelcomeWizard.tsx was already not fmt-clean on demo-fixes and was left unformatted).
## REQ-453 — The conversation list's chip is pink only when something needs attention: in-progress steps get a neutral tone (demo-loop cycle 3, issues p8-pair5-d, p8-pair2-b)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issues `p8-pair5-d` "Red 'Gathering a little more info' chip" and `p8-pair2-b` "Red chips for positive states (e.g. 'Lista para enviar', 'Gathering a little more info')". RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD (both) at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** `threadChip` in `shared/quote-flow/chat-header.ts` mapped every status other than accepted / sent / drafted to the kind `needs`, which `front-end/static/assistant-page.css` paints `var(--pink-50)` / `var(--pink-700)`, the alert colour. So a normal locked, terms-wizard ("Gathering a little more info"), picking-details or ready-to-send quote looked like a problem. Introduced by 7d20c250 (REQ-369).
**Requirement:** the chip has a neutral `progress` kind (teal: `.thread__chip--progress` uses `--teal-50` / `--teal-600`) for locked, gathering, pickingDetails and readyToSend. `needs` (pink) is used only for undelivered and declined. drafted stays `draft` (coffee), sent stays `sent` and accepted stays `paid`. The mapping is one exhaustive `Record<ThreadStatus, ThreadChipKind>` (`CHIP_KIND`).

## REQ-443 — "Polish this line?" never splits inside parentheses (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m46)

**Requirement (Raphael):** "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb), issue m46: "'Polish this line?' turns '(trench + patch)' into '(trench Patch)'".
**Cause (RCA at cc5d4b0e, analyst CONFIRMED + skeptic UPHELD):** REQ-332's `splitJoinedItems` (`backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/professionalize-bullet/mod.ts`) split on every "+"/"plus", including one inside parentheses, so "New drain line thru slab to island (trench + patch)" became the items "…(trench" and "patch)". The model then had to return two lines or the faithfulness gate sent it to `professionalizeFallback`, which capitalised each item ("Patch)"); `polishOffer` (`shared/quote-flow/polish-offer.ts`) previewed the two broken halves.
**Rule now:** a bullet splits only on a TOP-LEVEL "+"/"plus" (depth 0 outside (), [] and {}) and only when every piece has an item of its own (a letter). `polishOffer` offers nothing when a single-line result differs from the line only in case or punctuation, nor when a multi-line split leaves any line with an unbalanced bracket; a well-formed "A + B" split is still offered (REQ-384).
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/professionalize-bullet/test.ts` ("REQ-443 m46 splitJoinedItems …": "+" and "plus" inside brackets never split; a top-level joiner still splits around a nested one; a joiner without an item on both sides does not split) and `jest/unit/polish-offer-inline.test.ts` ("REQ-443 …": the "(trench" / "Patch)" split is not offered; a case/punctuation-only single line is not offered; a real rewrite and a well-formed split still are) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/professionalize-bullet/int.test.ts` ("REQ-443 m46 professionalize …": a one-line model answer is accepted and the stub fallback keeps the parenthetical whole) · e2e `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/job-details-controller/e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-443 m46 e2e …", the booted app on the stub LLM: POST /agents/job-details/professionalize returns the bullet as one line) · browser e2e n/a — the island renders whatever lines the endpoint and `polishOffer` return, both pinned above; REQ-384's browser story still covers the offer row.

## REQ-482 — The New invoice sheet fits a 390 px phone: paired fields stack, line items wrap (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M39)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." A bare `1fr` is `minmax(auto,1fr)`, so each column is at least its `<label>`'s min-content width — the input's intrinsic width (~170-217 px) — and two of them plus gaps and the sheet's padding are wider than a phone. **Requirement:** on a 390 px phone every input, select and textarea of the New invoice sheet (line items included) lies inside the screen. The paired grids are `repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,240px),1fr))` — two columns only when both get 240 px, else one; the labels carry `min-width:0` and the small inputs `width:100%`. The line-item row (`.ninv-line` in `static/quotes.css`) keeps one row on desktop and under 560 px puts the description on its own row with qty · unit · price · × beneath it; the header row uses the same grid.
**Tests:** unit n/a — a CSS layout outcome, only observable in a rendered browser · integration n/a — no backend or API change · e2e `e2e/new-invoice-mobile/new-invoice-mobile.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-482 M39: on a 390px phone (en|es) every field of the New invoice sheet, line items included, stays inside the screen").

**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m28` — "Click wave lasts only 1.1 s and is missed by eye" (related: M6); RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.

**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." ## REQ-455 — A change order's description is never the contractor's raw, half-stripped sentence (demo-loop cycle 3, issue M24)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `M24` — "Change order /co shows contractor's garbled raw request to the client"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** `parseChangeOrderRequest` (`backend/src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/mod.ts`) strips only the "change order" phrase, the first `$` amount, a `Q-001`, a leading add-verb and article, and keeps everything else as the description; `handle-chat-message/mod.ts` (REQ-238 block) then skips the LLM whenever a description and a delta are present. Pair 5's "Karen signed but now she wants to upgrade to a frameless glass shower door, add $1,200. Make a change order for Q-001 and send it to her." became the stored description "Karen signed but now she wants to upgrade to a frameless glass shower door, add. Make a for and send it to her", shown on /co under "What's changing" and in the customer email. Introduced in f4a3f731 (REQ-238), extended by REQ-315 / REQ-377.
**Requirement:** code reads a change order's description only when the change clause is a short, well-formed item: at most 8 words, no sentence break, and no narrative (who signed, she/he/they wants, "make a", "send it", please, and the Spanish forms) — `isCleanChangeClause`. The clause after the money ends at the first sentence boundary. Otherwise the parser keeps the customer / quote number / amount but no description, so the coordinator sends the message to the model's `change_order` tool, whose delta is still checked against the typed dollars by `reconcileChangeOrderDelta` (REQ-377).
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/test.ts` ("REQ-455 M24 …": the exact pair-5 sentence → `{ quoteNumber: "Q-001", deltaAmountCents: 120000 }` with no description; "…$40. Send it to her today." → "Fridge cleaning"; `isCleanChangeClause` accepts the existing short items and rejects long / multi-sentence / narrative clauses) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts` ("REQ-455 M24: the demo's narrative change-order sentence stores the model's clean description …": Karen's signed, invoiced Q-001 + the pair-5 sentence → the LLM is called once and the stored change order reads "Upgrade to a frameless glass shower door", +$1,200) · e2e n/a — the browser lane runs the stub LLM, which cannot reproduce the model writing the description; the coordinator contract (model consulted, its description stored verbatim on the ChangeOrder that /co renders) is pinned by the integration test.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-co-description-clean off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/test.ts src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts --filter REQ-455` → int "the model reads a narrative change order" Actual 0 / Expected 1; unit (with a placeholder export) "FAILED | 0 passed | 3 failed": description `"Karen signed but now she wants to upgrade to a frameless glass shower door, add. ## REQ-524 — The chat's customer form does not call a phone or email wrong while it is still being typed (demo-loop cycle 3, issue p8-pair7-a)

**Requirement (user's words):** "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none". Demo-loop cycle 3, pair 7 (issue p8-pair7-a, "Phone validation error shows while still typing"): in the assistant's "Who is this for?" form, "Enter a full phone number, like (512) 555-1234." appeared after the first digit, while she was still typing.
**Root cause (RCA, CONFIRMED + skeptic UPHELD, at cc5d4b0e):** `customerStepFeedback` (`shared/quote-flow/customer-contact.ts`, REQ-390, 0f1541a9) gated the name error on `nameTouched` and the contact tone on `contactTouched`, but set the phone / email FORMAT errors unconditionally; `AsstChat.tsx` recomputes it on every keystroke.

The contractor's own phone / email is still named at once (it only matches a whole value).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/customer-step-feedback.test.ts` ("REQ-524 …", 6: half-typed phone → no message and Next off; left phone → named; half-typed email waits for its own blur; touching the phone does not surface the email's; half-typed phone beside a good email still blocks Next; AsstChat sets the flags on blur, never in onInput; REQ-390's both-fields test now passes the touched flags) · integration n/a — no backend or API change; the rule is pure and the island is covered end to end · e2e `e2e/customer-step-feedback/customer-step-feedback.e2e.test.ts` (the REQ-390 chat-form story, extended: "512" in the phone → no `cust-phone-err` while focused, Tab → it shows; "bob@" in the email likewise).

## REQ-526 — A task added for another day moves /field/tasks to that day and the flash names it (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m50)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." ## REQ-475 — Milestone invoices after the first are scheduled across the job's own start + duration TERMS, not signing + 14 days (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m63)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m63` — "Balance invoice for a 1-day job starting Nov 20 'Scheduled to send Nov 26', 'DUE Dec 3'" (fleet-9 stdout:66,186,271; fleet-4 stdout:67-68). RCA analyst CONFIRMED (high), skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** for multi-milestone terms (Deposit + balance, 50/50, 30/30/40) `SendSignedConfirmation` scheduled installments 2..N with `computeScheduledDates(count, quote.startDate, quote.estimatedCompletionDate, today)` (send-signed-confirmation/mod.ts:171-176, 433-458). No writer ever sets `quote.startDate`, and `estimatedCompletionDate` comes only from the invoice wizard, so the window fell back to today → today + 14: signed Nov 12 → balance "Nov 26", due + 7 = "Dec 3", whatever the terms' start ("11/20/2026") and duration ("1 day"). REQ-411 had added `startDayFromTerms` / `completionFromTerms` (`shared/quote-flow/completion-schedule.ts`) but used them only for the single pay-after-completion milestone.
**Requirement:** `computeScheduledDates` takes the quote's terms and spans the same job window as `completionScheduledFor`: start = the ISO `startDate`, else the start term, else today (never before today); end = the ISO `estimatedCompletionDate`, else start + the duration term, else start + 14 days. The last milestone lands on the job's end, so Deposit + balance on a 1-day job starting Nov 20 bills its balance Nov 21 (due Nov 28), not Nov 26 / Dec 3.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/completion-schedule.test.ts` ("REQ-475 (m63) computeScheduledDates: Deposit + balance, start 11/20/2026, 1 day → … Nov 21", "REQ-475 (m63) computeScheduledDates: 30/30/40 over 'Next week' + '2 weeks' … ; a start term with no duration keeps the 14-day window from that start" incl. ISO estimatedCompletionDate still winning) · integration same file ("REQ-475 (m63) send-signed-confirmation run: Deposit + balance on a 1-day job starting in 8 days → the balance invoice is scheduled for the job's end (today + 9), due 7 days later" — the real coordinator over in-memory KV stores) · e2e n/a — a server-side date computation; the browser only renders the stored `scheduledFor`/`dueDate`, which the integration test pins through the real accept flow.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-scheduled-dates-terms off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/completion-schedule.test.ts` → "FAILED | 5 passed | 3 failed" (`- "2026-11-26" + "2026-11-21"`; `- "2026-11-19" + "2026-12-03"`; run: `- 2026-11-26 + 2026-11-21`). GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/` → "ok | 38 passed | 0 failed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/` → "ok | 312 passed | 0 failed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on the touched module; `deno fmt` on mod.ts and the test file.
## REQ-521 — Add task with no workers says so and links to /field/workers; an empty Save names Customer first, not Service (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m54)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m54` — "Add task with no workers: no hint or link; the browser's 'Please fill out this field.' lands on Service, not Customer"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e`.
**Cause (RCA):** the Customer field on the /field/tasks Add-task form is a `SearchSelect` whose only form element is a hidden input (`front-end/islands/SearchSelect.tsx`), which the browser never validates, while Service and Price carried native `required`. On an empty Save the browser's constraint validation ran before `onSubmit`, so its bubble went to Service and `addTaskProblem` (`front-end/lib/field.ts`: customer → service → price) never ran. The Worker `<select>` held only "Pick a worker" plus `workers.map(...)`: with no workers there was no text and no link. Introduced in `7d93e0ec` (REQ-164).
**Requirement:** the Add-task form is `noValidate`, so on Save `addTaskProblem` decides and the first message ("Pick a customer from the list, or add a new one.") lands on Customer, which is marked invalid. When the account's worker list has loaded and is empty, a hint under the Worker picker reads "No workers yet. Add a worker" (es "Aún no hay trabajadores. Agrega un trabajador"), and the link goes to /field/workers (`field.tk.noWorkers`, `field.tk.addWorkerLink`).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/field-add-task-validation.test.ts` ("REQ-521 (demo m54, cycle 3) …": `addTaskProblem` on an empty form → customer; the `tk-add-form` tag carries `noValidate`; `tk-add-no-workers` renders only on `workers.length === 0` with `href="/field/workers"`; en/es keys) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change; `GET /field/workers` already returns the empty list · e2e `e2e/field-tasks/field-tasks.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-521 (demo m54, cycle 3): an account with no workers opens Add task …": the hint and its link show, an empty Save shows the customer message with the customer box aria-invalid and Service not flagged, no task POST, the link opens /field/workers).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, branch fix/c3-add-task-validation off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/field-add-task-validation.test.ts` → "Tests: 3 failed" (no `noValidate` on the form tag; no `tk-add-no-workers`; `field.tk.noWorkers` undefined); `shots run e2e/field-tasks/field-tasks.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check --filter REQ-521` → "✗ … locator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded" at the hint; with only the hint in place → "✗ … the page never showed "Pick a customer from the list, or add a new one."" (the browser's bubble blocked submit). GREEN — jest unit project "Test Suites: 251 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2506 passed"; the whole `e2e/field-tasks` file 17 ✓ (REQ-143…REQ-415, REQ-521); `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/field.test.ts` → "ok | 10 passed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` + `deno fmt --check` clean on `islands/FieldTasksPage.tsx` and the new jest test (the e2e file was not fmt-clean on demo-fixes and was left unformatted).

## REQ-484 — The /invoices forecast's "this week" is the calendar week, today through Sunday (demo-loop cycle 3, issue m12)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 3 (run re05e1cbb, demo-report.md), issue `m12` — "'Expected this week' for a date next week (Nov 19 on Thu Nov 12)"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `cc5d4b0e` (fleet-0 stdout:106, fleet-3 stdout:133).
**Cause (RCA):** `ComputeInvoiceForecast.run` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/compute-invoice-forecast/mod.ts`) bucketed "this week" as the rolling, inclusive `day >= today && day <= isoDay(addDays(now, 7))` — 8 calendar days. An invoice signed Thu Nov 12 with net-7 terms is due Thu Nov 19 = today+7, so the hero printed "$… expected this week" (`invoicesPage.hero.expectedThisWeek`) for a date in the next calendar week.
**Requirement:** "this week" in the forecast is the calendar week — today through the coming Sunday (just today on a Sunday) — and "next week" is the Monday–Sunday after it, so the hero's existing copy ("expected this week", "Quiet week — … coming next week.", en + es) is true as written. Days are UTC ISO days, as before (REQ-243).
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/compute-invoice-forecast/forecast.test.ts` ("REQ-484 m12: on Thu Nov 12 an invoice due Thu Nov 19 (today+7) is next week, not this week", "… this week runs through Sunday; next week is the following Monday–Sunday", "… on a Sunday, this week is just today and Monday starts next week") · integration n/a — the window is a pure function of the server clock, which an int test against the live API can't pin; `GET /invoices/forecast/this-week` passes the coordinator's result through unchanged (its shape stays covered by `jest/integration/pipeline-stats.int.test.ts`) · e2e n/a for a new story — same clock reason; the existing `e2e/headline-counts/headline-counts.e2e.test.ts` REQ-243 (e) seed now dues its invoice today instead of today+2, which would be next week on a Friday–Sunday run.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c3-forecast-week-window off demo-fixes cc5d4b0e):** RED first — `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/compute-invoice-forecast/` → "FAILED | 12 passed | 3 failed" (thisWeek held "due-19"; on Sunday it held "mon", "next-sun"). ## REQ-533 — demo agents click in a tab after switching to it (demo-loop cycle 3, harness)

The cycle 3 root-cause pass (M2) found that switching tabs with Playwright in a headless browser fires no focus or visibilitychange event. Every page stays "visible" and focus-emulated, so a switch followed only by a scroll or a look never claims the stage. That turned the harness's behaviour into a reported "regression" in 4 pairs. A real person's tab switch does focus the page. Requirement: both agents' prompts say the browser is headless and tell them to click once on a neutral spot after switching tabs, before judging what the other side sees.

- unit: n/a — a prompt string; covered by the harness test.
- int: `demo-loop/demo20b_test.ts` "REQ-533 …" runs the real harness with a fake fleet-claude and checks both prompts.
- e2e: n/a — the next demo cycle is the run that uses it.

## REQ-583 — The assistant sends the invoice and records the payment it is told about (demo-loop cycle 4, issue M2)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `M2` — "Assistant can't send/create/record an invoice or payment when asked". Pair 1: "Linda paid the deposit $1,425 by Zelle today. Send her the invoice" got an invoice summary and the Zelle payment was ignored. Pair 3: "Invoice Maria for the deep clean" got "…INV-001 hasn't gone out yet — it's scheduled for Nov 19" with nothing to press, then "send it to her now please" got "I can't send the invoice directly…". Pair 6 (new chat): "Job done for Carmen Ruiz, faucet and the 2 doors. Make the invoice for $450 please." got 'I couldn't find a line called "invoice for"…'. Pair 7: "she paid the deposit by check" got "You can check the payment status in the Invoices section." Pair 9: "Mándala ahora por favor, ya terminé hoy" got "No puedo enviar la factura ahora…". RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** the chat model had no tool to send an invoice or record a payment. `chatToolsFor` (`backend/src/agents/domain/business/chat-routing/mod.ts`) offered only create_quote, lock_quote, request_terms_transition, change_order, update_job_details, revise_quote and update_change_order. The only billing code path was the read-only AnswerBilling reply, and `prompts.pricingAndBilling` told the model to "say where to see it (Invoices)". Each demo phrasing ended in one of four dead ends. (a) Bound quote + the word "invoice": AnswerBilling, and the "paid … by Zelle" clause was never read. `RecordPaymentFromUtterance` was wired only to the voice/photo endpoints. (b) No "invoice" word: the model had no tool that fits. (c) New chat: the billing route needs a bound quote, and `parseLineReprice`'s `make <line> $N` pattern read "the invoice for" as a line name. (d) Pay-on-completion: `billingReply` returned the scheduled invoice as text only, with no card and no Send-now action. Introduced by REQ-368 (1892d291) and REQ-315 (ce9a7adf).
**Requirement:**
- A payment the contractor reports in the chat is recorded, in code, before any model call. The amount, the method (Zelle, check, cash, …), deposit / balance and an INV number are read from their words ("Linda paid the deposit $1,425 by Zelle today", "she paid the deposit by check", "Juan me pagó $450 por Zelle"). It goes on the invoice that fits: the number named; else the named customer's (when that is not the thread's customer); else the thread's job's; else, with nothing bound, only an exact amount match. If two invoices fit, the chat asks which and records nothing. It is recorded through ConfirmPayment, which writes the payment row, sends the receipt and marks the invoice paid or still owed. The reply says the amount, the method, who paid and the invoice, what is still owed, and when the job's next unsent invoice goes out, shown with "Send now" and never sent by itself. If it fits no invoice at all, the chat model reads the message instead. Questions, plans, negations, payment terms ("paid in full upon completion"), "paid" describing something ("paid parking") and the contractor's own spending are not payments.
- An invoice that has not gone out yet (scheduled or drafted) is shown as its chat card with "Send now". This applies to the billing answer (pay on completion; the deposit paid with the balance scheduled; a draft) and to the reply after a payment. The card's chip reads the invoice state (Scheduled / Draft / Paid), never the quote card's "Draft". The button posts its own words ("Send INV-001 now" / "Envía INV-001 ahora"). Those words, any explicit INV number, or a bare "send it (now)" / "mándala" right after a Send-now offer send that invoice. Without such an offer, the model decides.
- A send goes out by email and text through SendPaperworkEmail / SendPaperworkSms. These stamp the invoice "sent" only when delivery succeeds (REQ-480). The reply names the number, amount, customer and channel(s), plus any real failure on the other channel. If nothing went out, the reply is the invoice's own not-delivered copy plus "It's still scheduled — …", and the card keeps Send now. A sent card retires the older Send-now button. Nothing new is billed.
- The chat model gets `send_invoice` (invoice number optional) and `record_payment` (amountDollars → cents in code, method enum, invoice number, deposit/balance, reference) only on a SIGNED bound quote, as its invoices allow: send_invoice while one is unsent or nothing is billed yet, record_payment while one is unpaid. It also reads the job's invoices in its context. Its calls run through the same ChatBilling coordinator, and the reply is what was done, never the model's prose. `prompts.pricingAndBilling` no longer sends people to the Invoices page. It tells the model to send or record with those tools and never to say it can't.
- An invoice ask in a new chat that names a customer with a job binds that job and answers where its bill stands. Pair 6's unsigned quote gets "Carmen Ruiz hasn't signed yet…": no line edit, no change order. An invoice / bill / factura is never a quote line for `parseLineReprice`, and "for" before a price no longer sticks to a line name.

## REQ-585 — The assistant's edit replies say what really happened: no "Updated the quote." over an unchanged card, no failure line under a correct draft, the question answered beside the changes, a job-details line never reported missing, no raw message echoed or stored as the job details, the start date / duration / payment changeable from chat, and old step requests never replayed (demo-loop cycle 4, issues M4 + M30)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, `demo-loop/runs/r857a9d67/demo-report.md`), issue `M4` — "The assistant ignores requests, says it changed things it did not, or contradicts itself" (STILL PRESENT from cycle 3 M21): pair 5 asked for "a second option with a 48in double vanity for $2,900" and got "Updated the quote." over an identical card (fleet-4 stdout:55/121); pair 6's correct Q-001 card sat under "Todavía no pude actualizar los detalles del trabajo: pídemelo otra vez." (fleet-5 stdout:60/231); pair 7's start-date + deposit message ("we start monday nov 23 … is 50% normal in texas?") got "The job details already say that — nothing changed. I couldn't find a line called "Floor stays (LVP is new)" …", an answer to an older request, and a cabinet rewording got "added …; removed … I couldn't find a line called "…" … so I changed nothing"; start-date and duration corrections were ignored twice (fleet-6 stdout:44-50/139/144/226/234/251/254). Issue `M30` — "A Spanish edit dumps the whole raw message into the job scope" (pair 7): the quick-quote Q-002's only job line was her raw message, and "oops no, empezamos la próxima semana, no el próximo mes. y agrega 1,500 por la calefacción del piso" got "agregué <her whole message> ; quité <her whole message>.." while "Start: Next month" stayed. RCA analyst CONFIRMED (high) for both, skeptic UPHELD, at ad104a19.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked at ad104a19):** (1) `quote-revision-reply/mod.ts:86-92` answered `chatCoordinator.revision.updatedNoChange` ("Updated the quote.") when no line changed; a quote has no options, and nothing said so. (2) `tool-calls/mod.ts:82-101` `planToolCalls` ran only the first call of a create_quote + update_job_details mix and `notDoneLine` named the other, so the card-bearing create showed only the failure line. (3) `handle-chat-message/mod.ts:817-956` `applyEditCalls` built the reply from tool outcomes only — the model's prose (its answer to the question) was dropped; job-details bullets and priced lines are separate lists, so `ReviseQuote` (`revise-quote/mod.ts:167-181`) reported a bullet that update_job_details had just rewritten as "I couldn't find a line called …, so I changed nothing"; `llmTurns` (`mod.ts:1732-1787`) replayed every earlier step turn, so the model re-issued the price-step request "take out the Floor stays line". (4) No chat tool could change an answered terms step (start_date / wraps / payment_terms) and nothing said a mentioned date wasn't applied. (5) `front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx:3209` `startQuoteFromRaw` stored `description: raw.trim()`, so the quick quote's job details were the whole message as one line, and `jobDetailsChangeLine` (`tool-calls/mod.ts:138-176`) echoed whole changed lines into the reply.
**Requirement:**
- A create_quote that leaves every line and price as it was (and the summary and job details too) says "Nothing on the quote changed …" — never "Updated the quote." — even when the model's prose claims a change (its answer, minus the claim, follows); a message that asks for an option / alternative ("second option", "otra opción", "so he can pick one") is told plainly that a quote can't hold options yet and how to offer a choice (a second quote).
- An update_job_details that rides along with a create_quote is folded into that create (the new / updated draft carries its `descriptionByLang`, and `description` in the reply language) and is never reported as not done.
- `jobDetailsChangeLine` never echoes a job-details line longer than 80 characters, nor a one-line body that was replaced: it says the job details were reworded (with their languages); listed items carry no trailing period.
- When the model makes edit calls, the reply keeps its prose answer after the outcome lines, minus the sentences that claim a change (the outcome lines say what changed).
- A revise_quote that names a job-details bullet (before or after this turn's update) is never answered "I couldn't find a line called …": when update_job_details changed the job details this turn the bullet is covered and says nothing more; otherwise the reply says that wording is in the job details, not a priced line.
- A new chat tool `update_terms` (start date, time to complete, payment terms — offered in the terms phase in every quote state, as the terms prompt names it; never in the quote phase) re-answers the wizard through `HandleWizardAnswer.change`: the active step is answered as a tap would (the next question follows), an answered step is changed in place (its transcript pick keeps its id and place, the wizard state and the quote's terms follow, so back / rewind still pops the right pick), a later step's preset is pre-selected, a signed quote is refused and a sent quote's answered terms stay as sent. Dates are resolved on the server from the contractor's words ("monday nov 23" → Nov 23, "next week" → Next week); durations like "2 and a half weeks" / "dos semanas y media" keep the half. The reply says what changed. A terms-phase message that names a start date or a duration that this turn did not apply gets a line saying so.
- Earlier step-tagged turns whose request was already applied (a reply carried the step, a quote / change-order / revision / terms outcome) are left out of the chat model's history, so it never replays them.
- The quick-quote (price-first) path stores the typed message's scope lines (`scopeDescriptionFromRaw` → `scopeBulletsFromRaw`: intent opener / price clause stripped, one per sentence, the customer's phone / email left out) as the new quote's job details — never `raw.trim()`; the end-of-wizard polish still runs on the message as typed.
- The chat island merges a turn's messages by id: a pick the turn changed in place replaces that message where it sits, never a second copy under the reply.

`proseAnswer` drops EN/ES claims of a change and keeps the answer; update_terms runs beside the other edits and is named when not done) · `backend/src/agents/domain/business/quote-revision-reply/test.ts` ("REQ-585 M4 …": nothing changed → "Nothing on the quote changed" (EN/ES); ## REQ-575 — The assistant reads what the contractor typed — "18 mil" / "18k" amounts (a rate is no amount), a date typed after a weekday, "next week", "y media" durations, "cliente <Name>" / "la señora <Name>", a household's full name, the user's own turns first, and a phone that is not a number is named; a fence, deck or roof drafted with no price has a per-unit floor (demo-loop cycle 4, issues M3 + M13)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issues `M3` — "The assistant drops or misreads details from the message" (client name, dates, duration, amount, phone; pairs 1, 7, 9, 10) and `M13` — "The assistant's prices are far too low" (120 ft of 6 ft cedar fence at $10/ft; help-me-price tiers below the costs she stated; pairs 7, 8). RCA: M3 analyst CONFIRMED, M13 LIKELY, skeptic UPHELD both, at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** the deterministic fact readers in `shared/quote-flow` missed common phrasings and the wizard, the price picker and the suggest-prices cost floor prefill only from them. (1) `parseDateAt` read a weekday word before a month-day: "we start monday nov 23" → the next Monday, Nov 16; "la próxima semana" was no date at all. (2) `DURATION_RE` dropped "y media": "Dos semanas y media" → 2 weeks. (3) `extractPriceCents` knew only "$N" / "N dólares": "como 18 mil?" → null (AMOUNT $0.00), and "~$23k labor … $9.5k cabinets" → $97.50, so the REQ-260 cost floor was $97 and $24.5k tiers passed under her ~$32.5k of costs; the k/mil reader existed only in backend `stated-price` (REQ-445). (4) `extractCustomerName` needed "for/para <Name>": "cliente Juan Pérez 5125550199" and "de la señora Tran" → null. (5) `quoteFactsSource` read the quote description before the user's turns, and `fullNameFor` was not plural-tolerant, so "for the Hendersons" beat "Carol Henderson". (6) "phone 555" was dropped with no word. (7) `plausibilityFloorCents` returned 0 for anything but a gut / remodel, so a $10/ft fence was saved as drafted.
**Requirement:** one money reader for client and server — `shared/quote-flow/money-amounts.ts` (moved from `stated-price`, which now re-exports it) reads "$18k", "18k", "18 thousand", "18 grand", "18 mil (dólares)", "$9.5k" and flags a rate ("$65/hr", "$40 a foot", "$5 per sq ft", "65 dólares la hora"); `extractPriceCents` / `extractPriceLines` use it and never count a rate, so the quick-quote picker opens at the typed amount and the suggest-prices floor is the stated costs' sum. A start date typed after a weekday wins ("monday nov 23" → Nov 23; "el lunes 23" when the 23rd is a Monday) and a weekday the date does not fall on is named on the prefill row ("that's a Tuesday" / "cae en martes", `asstChat.wiz.weekdayMismatch`); "next week / la próxima semana / la semana que viene", "next month / el mes que viene", "right away / de inmediato" pre-select the wizard's own option; "in 2 weeks / en 3 días" is a date from today; "to" / "para" may sit between "start" and the date. A duration keeps its half — "Dos semanas y media", "two and a half weeks", "2.5 weeks", "2½ weeks", "a week and a half", "un mes y medio" — offered as "2.5 semanas" / "2.5 weeks"; the whole-number custom picker (REQ-390) opens on the same length in a whole unit (`wholeDuration`: 2.5 weeks → 18 days). A role or honorific names the customer with no "para" — "cliente / clienta / client: / customer is <Name>", "la señora / Sra. / Mrs. / Mr. <Name>" (possessive dropped; lowercase "don" only; "Dr" stays a street); a household lead-in gives way to its member ("Hendersons" → "Carol Henderson"). The facts read the user's own turns before the quote description (`factsSourceText`). A number typed after a phone word that is no 10-digit phone ("phone 555", "tel: 555-0123", "su teléfono es 512 555") is `unusablePhone`, named under the empty phone box of the "Who is this for?" form (`asstChat.customerStep.phoneUnusable`, `data-cy="cust-phone-unusable"`), never put in it. `plausibilityFloorCents` adds per-trade unit floors — fence per linear ft (wire / chain link $8, wood $15, privacy / cedar / vinyl / metal $20) + $250 a gate, a new deck per sq ft ($15, composite $25), a roof replacement per square ($300, metal / tile / slate $600) — none for a repair / stain / size-less mention, the higher of remodel and unit floor when both apply, halved for labor only; `describeJobSize` names the size ("120 linear ft of fence with 1 gate") in the re-ask. A price the contractor typed is still never re-asked or lifted. en + es keys in sync.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/c4-fact-readers.test.ts` (84 × "REQ-575 …": pair 7's "…como 18 mil?" → $18,000 and the other k/mil/thousand/grand forms; sizes / BTU never money; pair 7's "$65/hr = ~$23k labor alone, cabinets are $9.5k" → $32,500; eight rate phrasings alone → null; a rate beside job amounts; `moneyAmounts` rate flags and both callers importing the shared module; pair 7's "we start monday nov 23…" → Nov 23 and five more weekday + date forms; bare numbers that are not that weekday stay the weekday; the mismatch flag; eight relative-start phrasings → their wizard option; "in 2 weeks" / "en 3 días"; pair 7's "Dos semanas y media" → 2.5 weeks and ten more duration phrasings; the wraps prefill in es + en; `wholeDuration` and the picker's call site; a 2.5-week completion date; pair 9's "cliente Juan Pérez", pair 7's "la señora Tran" and six more role / honorific forms; five no-name refusals; the Hendersons / Joneses plural fold; `factsSourceText` order and AsstChat's use of it; five unusable phones and four non-cases; the customer form note, the weekday note and their en/es keys) and `backend/src/agents/domain/business/price-floor/test.ts` (7 × "REQ-575 M13 …": pair 8's fence floor between $1,600 and $5,450 reading 120 ft not 6 ft, also from the model's own line; chain < wood < cedar and more feet; repair / no length / "cerca de" → 0; deck sq ft and composite, stain / repair → 0; roof squares and sq ft, leak repair / size-less → 0; labor-only halving; `describeJobSize`) and `backend/src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/test.ts` ("REQ-575 the stated-price money reader IS the shared one …") · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/price-target.int.test.ts` (3 × "REQ-575 M13 …", the real HandleChatMessage with the stub LLM replaying pair 8's $1,200 + $400 draft: re-asked once naming "$1,600", "120" and "fence", then lifted to the floor; a re-ask at $38/ft saved as written; the contractor's typed "$4,800 ($40 a foot), gate $650" kept with no second call) and `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/suggest-prices/int.test.ts` (2 × "REQ-575 M13 suggest-prices …": pair 7's $24.5k/$27.5k/$31k tiers re-asked once naming the $32,500 floor; a model that stays low never ships a tier under it) · e2e `e2e/c4-fact-readers/c4-fact-readers.e2e.test.ts` (3 stories: "Just give me a quick quote." + pair 7's Spanish job → the price picker opens at 18,000;
