## REQ-556 — The app never says a receipt, an invoice or a nudge went out when nothing could be delivered (demo-loop cycle 4, issue M7)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `M7` — "The app says something was sent or nudged when nothing could be delivered": pair 9's /invoices read "Confirmada 12 nov. El recibo se envió automáticamente." and /i "Un recibo en PDF está en tu correo" for a client with no email and a test number; pair 7's INV-001 showed SENT and the assistant said it "went out automatically" a minute after "Couldn't send… reserved test number"; pair 10's "Send a nudge" on an invoice with no recipient said "Already nudged today — the next reminder is scheduled." RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** three paths claimed a delivery without reading a result. (1) `MarkInvoicePaid` emailed the PAID invoice, logged any failure and stored nothing; `invoicesPage.read.paid` and `publicInvoice.received.body` were fixed strings. (2) `SendSignedConfirmation` billed the first milestone and recorded nothing about whether its email/text got through; `billingReply` said "went out automatically" for every first milestone signing billed. (3) `SendPaymentReminder.runForInvoice` answered `channels: []` alike for no recipient, muted and already-fired (and counted a channel whatever the provider answered); the card mapped every empty answer to "Already nudged today".
**Requirement:** delivery results are recorded and the copy follows them. `MarkInvoicePaid` stores `receiptSentVia` ("email" when its email was delivered, else "none"); `ConfirmPayment` upgrades it to "email"/"text" when its receipt email/text is delivered. The /invoices paid card says emailed (existing copy) / "Receipt texted." / "Receipt ready — couldn't be sent: no email or phone on file can take it." (no claim at all for invoices paid before this was recorded); /i's paid note says the PDF is in the inbox only for email, "texted" for text, "This page shows the invoice as paid." for none. Signing records `deliveredVia` (["email"], ["text"], both, or [] for nobody) on the milestone it billed; with [] the assistant says "INV-001 is ready — due … — but it couldn't be delivered … Add one and send it from Invoices", and the /invoices card says "Issued today" / "not emailed or texted" instead of "Sent today". `runForInvoice` returns `reason` ("muted" | "already_fired" | "no_recipient" | "not_delivered"), lists only channels the provider took, and does not burn the rung when nothing was delivered; the card shows "No email or phone on file — add one to send a reminder." for no_recipient. en + es in sync.
**Deviation from the RCA's fix direction:** the RCA proposed creating the signing milestone as draft and stamping it "sent" via `stampInvoiceDelivered` only after delivery. That hides it from the signer: REQ-312 keeps draft invoices off the public /q payload, so REQ-251's "Pay now" hand-off disappears for exactly the customers with no reachable contact (`public-controller/pay-now.int.test.ts` signs a quote with no customer and asserts the Pay now target). The milestone therefore stays issued (the signer is handed it on /q) and the delivery truth is recorded in `deliveredVia`, which the assistant and /invoices read.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/delivery-truth.test.ts` ("REQ-556 …": `paidReadKey` / `receivedNoteBody(channel)` / `nudgeNote` / `outReadKey` with the real en/es dictionaries, and the InvoicesPage + /i bindings) · unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/chat-answers/undelivered.test.ts` (billingReply en/es) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/mark-invoice-paid/receipt-sent-via.test.ts`, `confirm-payment/receipt-sent-via.test.ts`, `send-signed-confirmation/delivery-truth.test.ts`, `send-payment-reminder/delivery-truth.test.ts` (real stores on in-memory KV, SMS in dev mode) · e2e (HTTP, app booted) `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/delivery-truth.int.test.ts` ("REQ-556 (M7) e2e: signing, paying and nudging a client nothing can reach …": accept → `deliveredVia: []` with Pay now kept; claim → confirm → `receiptSentVia: "none"` on /invoices and /i's payload; POST /cron/invoice-reminder → `reason: "no_recipient"`) · browser e2e n/a — the islands render the recorded fields through the pure helpers the unit test pins; the HTTP e2e pins the fields they read.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-delivery-truth off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Cannot find module '../../shared/documents/delivery-truth'"; `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check <the 5 new unit/int files>` → "FAILED | 1 passed | 17 failed" (receiptSentVia/deliveredVia undefined, reason undefined, "went out automatically"); `deno test … public-controller/delivery-truth.int.test.ts` → "Values are not equal: the invoice signing billed reached nobody — the record must say so". GREEN — `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 326 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 3217 passed"; every backend test file touching these coordinators/endpoints (37 files: grep SendPaymentReminder|SendSignedConfirmation|MarkInvoicePaid|ConfirmPayment|billingReply|reminderHistory|/accept|confirm-payment|invoice-reminder) → "ok | 188 passed | 0 failed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on the touched backend modules, InvoicesPage.tsx and routes/i/[id].tsx; `deno fmt` clean on every touched file that was clean before (confirm-payment/mod.ts and send-payment-reminder/mod.ts were already not fmt-clean on demo-fixes and were left unformatted).
## REQ-545 — The customer's demo pill yields to the page: a small edge tab whenever content is under it (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m2)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `m2` — "Customer demo pill covers page content (tiles, fields, confirm buttons, pointer)" (fleet-2 stdout:46,128 · fleet-8:47 · fleet-7:61); RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** REQ-379 gave the pill one fixed home bottom-left in a reserved band (`pillHome`), and REQ-440 painted that band opaque (`DemoModeOverlay.tsx` band, z-index 1). Body padding (`setPillRoom`) only frees the END of a document that scrolls, so mid-scroll whatever passed the window's foot (tiles, "Export customers (CSV)", a service address, "Registrar un pago…") sat under the band and the pill. A dialog over the home moved the pill to the top-left only while that was clear, else `dockPill` left it home OVER the dialog (the Publish confirm, the Add task sheet, the send modal). The overlay mounts on public /q, /i, /co in the owner's browser too (`_app.tsx`), with the full pill and band. The stage's mirror skips `[data-demo-overlay]`, so the presenter saw content where the customer saw the band.
**Requirement:** the customer's live pill never stays over the page. With anything of the page under its home it folds to a small tab on the window's left edge (16×40, its status dot; `data-tucked`) and the band is not painted, so the page shows; a hover or tap on the tab brings the whole pill out of it (End included) until the pointer leaves it (or 6 s after a tap); with nothing under the home (a shell that subtracts the band, the document's end) it sits home on the painted band. A dialog docks it home, then top-left, then top-right — all covered, it folds (never home over the dialog). On public /q, /i, /co it is always the tab. The ended notice, the restart notice and opened phone details are messages being read and do not fold. The link state is on the pill even folded (`data-status`). The stage draws the customer's band (`demo-band-ghost`) and a folded pill as a tab, so both screens agree.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-pill-yield.test.ts` ("REQ-545 …": `placePill` folds over content / sits home when clear / always folds on public paths; `dockPill` asks home, top-left, top-right, then null; non-yielding pills never fold; `bandGhostBox`; the pill message carries `tucked`/`band`/`bandBg` and drops junk; overlay + stage wiring); amended `jest/unit/demo-pill-home.test.ts` (REQ-379 "both covered" → null after the top-right) and `jest/unit/demo-pill-band.test.ts` (band height only while `bandOn`) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change beyond the peer message's optional fields, covered by the unit parse test · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-yield.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-545 …": 24 customers on a 390×844 phone, mid-scroll nothing of the page under the demo's chrome right of the tab, the band unpainted, the stage's ghost tucked and no band ghost, hover unfolds with End and leaving folds it, public /q a tab at top and mid-scroll); amended REQ-440 `demo-pill-band` (on /q the pill is the tab, no band, the heading clear of it), REQ-379 `demo-pill-home` and REQ-228 `demo-pill-clear` (the pill checked at the document's end; the clear story's user onboarded), and the demo-lifecycle stories that read or click the customer's whole pill now bring it out with `e2e/_shared/demo-pill.ts` `pillUp` (scroll to the end, else a real pointer onto the tab).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-pill-yield-content off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-pill-yield` → "Tests: 13 failed, 13 total" (`placePill is not a function`, …); `shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-yield.e2e.test.ts` against the old code → "✗ REQ-545 … timed out: mid-scroll, nothing of the page is under the demo's chrome — {"pillShown":true,"tabShown":false,"bandH":64,"covered":["div \"Customers · 24 on the books…\"",…]}". GREEN — the unit demo suites → "Test Suites: 31 passed · Tests: 421 passed"; shots one by one on a PORT=7493 dev server → ✓ REQ-545 yield, ✓ REQ-379 pill-home, ✓ REQ-440 pill-band, ✓ REQ-228 pill-clear, ✓ demo-ended, ✓ demo-restart, ✓ demo-presenter-rest (2/2), ✓ demo-stage-live, ✓ chat-demo-repin. demo-mode, demo-mirror, demo-viewers, demo-presenters and one demo-scroll-pointer story fail with the same errors on unmodified demo-fixes code (run side by side under host load 50–80), so they are not caused by this change. `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on the overlay, the stage and the shared modules.
## REQ-551 — A payment above the balance asks first, above 10x the invoice is refused; every "paid" total counts what was owed; the leaderboard names paid invoices with no customer (demo-loop cycle 4, issue B2)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `B2` — "Payment 10x the invoice accepted with no overpayment check; totals disagree across pages" (fleet-9: $999,999,999 recorded on a $99,999,999 invoice; /payments said $999,999,999, /invoices "paid this month" $99,999,999, and the Customers leaderboard "Aún no hay facturas pagadas"). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** `PaymentController.create` (`backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/mod.ts`) parsed, checked ownership, stored and re-ran `ComputeInvoiceBalance` with no comparison to the balance (REQ-202 only flags `overpaidCents` afterwards). `validatePaymentReceived` (`front-end/lib/payment-received.ts`) rejected only amount ≤ 0, and `PaymentReceivedForm` got the invoice total only to prefill. Each page summed something different: `InvoicesPage` paid-this-month summed `invoice.amount`, `PaymentsPage` `monthTotal` summed `payment.amount`, and the leaderboard (`clients-controller` `top()`) ranks customer cards, so an invoice with no customer was never counted.
**Requirement:** one rule (`shared/documents/overpayment.ts` `overpaymentCheck`) for the form and the API: up to the balance still owed records as before; above it the form shows an inline "This is $X more than the $Y owed. Record it anyway?" with a "Record anyway" button and sends nothing until it is pressed, and `POST /payments` answers 409 `{ error: "overpayment", balanceCents, overCents }` unless the request carries `override: true` (a request flag, never stored; REQ-202 then flags the overpayment); above 10x the invoice total the form refuses ("That's more than 10 times the $X invoice. Check the amount.") and the API answers 422 `overpayment_limit`, override or not. `PUT /payments/:id` applies the same rule to a changed amount. The form is prefilled with the balance, not the face amount. Every "paid" KPI counts what was collected against the bill, min(paid, amount): /invoices paid-this-month uses `paidKpiInvoiceCents`; /payments credits each payment only what its invoice still owed when it arrived (`creditedPayments`) and shows the overpaid rest on its own line ("$X received beyond what the invoices owed isn't counted in this total."). `GET /analytics/clients/top` returns `unassigned: { invoiceCount, revenue12moCents }` for paid invoices with no (or a deleted) customer, and the leaderboard says "N paid invoice(s) with no customer ($X) isn't/aren't ranked." instead of "No paid invoices". en and es in sync.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/overpayment.test.tsx` ("REQ-551 B2: …" ×10: the shared decision; the form's confirm text en/es and override; the 10x refusal en/es; the server 409/422 worded; the balance prefill; `paidKpiInvoiceCents`; `creditedPayments` making both pages agree on the demo numbers; the leaderboard's no-customer line) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/overpayment.int.test.ts` ("REQ-551 B2: …" ×5, app booted over HTTP: 409 overpayment with nothing stored; override records and flags $35; the demo's $999,999,999 is 422 even with override; partial + exact still record; `/analytics/clients/top` reports the customer-less paid invoice as `unassigned`) — and `revisions-controller/e2e.test.ts` (REQ-202's deliberate extra payment on a paid invoice now sends `override: true`) · e2e `e2e/overpayment-guard/overpayment-guard.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-551 (a)": $100 on a $65 invoice asks, sends nothing, "Record anyway" records it, the invoice flags $35, /payments hero reads $65 with the $35 overpaid line; "REQ-551 (b)": $1,000 is refused with no POST and no "Record anyway").
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-overpayment-and-kpis off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/overpayment.test.tsx` → `Module not found ".../shared/documents/overpayment.ts"`; `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/overpayment.int.test.ts` → "1 passed | 4 failed" (the 10x and 1.5x payments came back 201 with the body stored — even `"override":false` was persisted; `/analytics/clients/top` had no `unassigned`); `shots run e2e/overpayment-guard/overpayment-guard.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` on demo-fixes → "✗ REQ-551 (a) … locator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded", "✗ REQ-551 (b) … locator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded". GREEN — the unit file + `lib/payment-received.test.tsx` → "17 passed | 0 failed"; backend `deno test -A --unstable-kv --parallel src/paperwork src/analytics` → "524 passed | 0 failed"; the shots story → "✓ REQ-551 (a) … 4.3s", "✓ REQ-551 (b) … 3.6s"; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 325 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 3201 passed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on every touched front-end file, `deno check` clean on the two controllers; `deno fmt --check` clean on the new files and on every touched front-end file that was clean before.
## REQ-589 — Server-written chat lines follow the EN/ES switch: wizard bubbles, the send divider, the thread preview and the feed's job name (demo-loop cycle 4, issues M15 + m15)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issues `M15` — "Assistant wizard bubbles frozen in language they were created in after EN/ES switch" — and `m15` — "English left in Spanish screens and Spanish content in English screens"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD for both at demo-fixes `ad104a19` (fleet-5 stdout:55, fleet-9 stdout:230, fleet-6 stdout:262).
**Cause (RCA):** the server rendered these lines in the contractor's language at write time and stored only the text: `transition-to-terms` (divider, question, option labels via `localizeOptions`), `handle-wizard-answer` (pick line "Inicio: La próxima semana", the next question, `conversation.preview`), `send-quote` (divider label "Text not delivered" and the SMS reason). `AsstChat.tsx` printed `m.content` / `dp.label` verbatim and `AsstThreads.tsx` printed `c.preview`. The accepted-quote feed row passed `job: event.data.jobName`, one language.
**Requirement:** each such line stores its dictionary key with its vars next to the text (`payload.i18n`; each wizard option `i18n: {label, sub}`; a send divider's `smsFailureI18n` / `emailFailureI18n` when the reason has a key; the conversation's `previewI18n`). The island and the thread list re-render them in the live language through `shared/quote-flow/chat-i18n.ts` (`localizeChatMessage`, `localizedPreview`). Rows without a key render as stored. A later preview written without a key drops the stale one (conversation store). The accepted-quote event carries `jobNameByLang`, and the feed and ticker name the job in the reader's language (`job_en` / `job_es` params). Left as intended per the RCA: COI / W-9 / TIN-EIN, Q-/INV- prefixes, map attribution, per-language job projections, and the public tab's own language. A revision send's "Version N published" prefix now reads in the contractor's UI language, like the rest of the note (new key `sendQuote.divider.withRevision`, en + es).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/chat-msgs-i18n-keys.test.ts` ("REQ-589 …": pick line / date / wizard / divider / SMS reason / legacy row / preview re-render, the feed's job by language, and AsstChat / AsstThreads / DashTopbar / ticker-pick wiring) + `backend/src/communication/domain/coordinators/notify-on-event/test.ts` ("REQ-589 m15: quote accepted names the job in the reader's language") · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-wizard-answer/i18n-keys.int.test.ts` (4 × "REQ-589 M15 …": transition keys, pick + next question + preview, date + customer name, stale preview key dropped) + `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/int.test.ts` (2 × "REQ-589 m15 send-quote …") · e2e (HTTP) `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/wizard-controller/e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-589 M15 agents wizard e2e: a reloaded Spanish wizard thread re-renders in English from its keys") · browser e2e n/a: the island's only change is mapping each message through the shared localizer before rendering. The unit test pins that wiring, and the HTTP e2e pins the wire data the localizer reads.

## REQ-565 — A change order reaches the customer from its row, is on her card, and "Revision published" goes stale (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m33)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." ## REQ-547 — The stage's replay never animates a snapshot from its unstyled look, and a later snapshot keeps the previous page on show until its sheets are in (demo-loop cycle 4, issues M21 + m32)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issues `m32` "Ghost back-of-card text on stage only after rejoin" (pair 4: '/customers after rejoin — ghost back-of-card text on stage only ("No subscriptions", "$2,250.00", duplicate names)'; RCA LIKELY, skeptic UPHELD) and `M21` "After customer reopened tab, stage shows NEW CUSTOMER card empty" (pair 9; RCA LIKELY/low, skeptic UNVERIFIABLE — the transition mechanism explains a momentary ghost, not a 13 s empty card; this fix is the hardening both analyses ask for, M21's persistent case still needs the stage's card DOM captured) at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA, re-measured):** a snapshot rebuilds the whole `<html>` (`front-end/lib/demo-mode/mirror-replay.ts` apply "snap" → build → replaceChild) and its `<link rel=stylesheet>` load after the elements are laid out; when they land, every element whose look they change runs its CSS transition from the unstyled look. `.ccard2__panel` (`front-end/static/clients.css` 313-337: `opacity 240ms, visibility 0s linear 240ms`) faded 1 → 0.77 → 0.61 … → 0 on the stage after a rejoin (real Chromium, real clients.css + dashboard.css). REQ-370 only hid the frame for the first snapshot, and revealed it the moment the sheets loaded — the moment the transitions start. A fresh `<link>` is never styled synchronously, even with its file loaded a moment before (measured without cache headers).
**Requirement:** (1) from a snapshot until it has settled (REQ-451), and while a stylesheet an op added is loading, every transition and animation in the stage frame is held still (`*,*::before,*::after{transition:none!important;animation-duration:0s!important;animation-delay:0s!important}`, an adopted constructed sheet of the stage's own, so no op can remove it; a `<style>` put back after every frame where there are no adopted sheets). It is let go only after the frame's styles were computed with it on (a forced layout first — releasing it in the same style pass runs the transitions anyway, measured). (2) A later snapshot whose stylesheets the frame has neither loaded nor is loading keeps the previous page on show while they preload into it (`media="not all"`), and replaces it once they are in, or HOLD_CAP_MS (1.2 s, under STYLE_WAIT_MS) after it came; its ops apply to it meanwhile; `styled()`/`settled()` say false until it is in. (3) A page put in the frame is styled at once by constructed copies (baseURL = href) of the same-origin sheets the frame has already loaded, dropped once its own links are in. The first snapshot is never held (REQ-370 hides the frame until styled).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-replay-still.test.ts` ("REQ-547 …": still from snapshot to settled, survives a head rewrite, `<style>` fallback, re-armed by an op-added sheet; a rejoin's snapshot held while its sheet preloads, styled by copies at the swap, ops kept, same-page resync not held, HOLD_CAP_MS cap, first snapshot never held; the fake DOM gains `adoptedStyleSheets`/`CSSStyleSheet`) · integration n/a — no backend, wire or protocol change; the replayer runs only in the stage's browser · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-replay-still.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-547: …": real Chromium, the app's real dashboard.css + clients.css, the real replayer bundled into a sandboxed MIRROR_SRCDOC frame; every animation frame the closed `.ccard2__panel` reads only `0/hidden` once styled, on the first snapshot and on a rejoin onto a not-yet-loaded sheet, the rejoin keeps the previous page and never shows its page unstyled, and once settled the still rule is gone).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-replay-no-transitions off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest -i --selectProjects=unit --testPathPattern demo-replay-still` → "Tests: 5 failed, 3 passed" ("the replayer has no still()", `Expected: true Received: false`, the old page replaced at once); `BASE_URL=<static server of front-end/static on a random port> shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-replay-still.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → "✗ REQ-547 … the rejoin's panel never fades either: … "1/visible","0.772362/visible","0.613167/visible","0.486959/visible" …". GREEN — the same unit run → "Tests: 10 passed"; `npx jest --selectProjects=unit` → "Test Suites: 326 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 3211 passed"; the same shots run 4× → "✓ REQ-547 … 2.4s"; `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on `lib/demo-mode/*.ts` and `islands/DemoStage.tsx`; `deno fmt` clean on every touched file.
## REQ-566 — Dashboard and page headlines agree with what happened: owner work fills "What we handled today", "Quiet week" never hides more money out, an undelivered quote reads "Not delivered" (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m11)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `m11` — "Dashboard/page headlines contradict real state (QUOTES PENDING 0, Nothing yet, Semana tranquila)"; seen by pairs 3, 6, 8, 10 (fleet-2 l.55 "QUOTES PENDING 0 — No quotes out yet — 1 draft is ready to send" after Send to a 555 number; fleet-5 l.250-253 "Aún no hay cotizaciones enviadas" on first paint, then "1 enviadas"; fleet-7 l.149/226 "Nothing yet" after Carlos finished a $450 job; fleet-9 l.239/320/334 "Nothing yet" after an invoice was issued, and "Semana tranquila — $450 llegan la próxima semana" beside ENVIADAS PARA COBRO $100,000,449). RCA analyst CONFIRMED (medium), skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on ad104a19):** (a) the dashboard's Activity panel reads only the notifications feed (REQ-299, `front-end/islands/DashboardPage.tsx` `notifToActivity`), and `notificationL10n` (`backend/src/communication/domain/coordinators/notify-on-event/mod.ts`) mapped customer-side events only — SendInvoice's `invoice:sent` was unmapped, and nothing emitted an event for an invoice issued by POST/PUT /invoices or by the REQ-480 delivery stamp, a payment recorded by POST /payments, or a field task completed (worker or office). (b) `invoicesHeroMode` (`front-end/lib/headline-counts.ts`) chose `nextWeek` whenever next week's forecast had money, before `outstanding`, whatever else was owed. (c) a send that reached nobody leaves the quote a draft (REQ-320/NW-10 — correct), and the dashboard named it "1 draft is ready to send" with a bare "—" under QUOTES PENDING 0. (d) a warm start paints the cached stats before the lists load, so "Quotes awaiting signature" said "none sent" under a tile that already counted one; the es count read "{n} enviadas" ("1 enviadas").
**Requirement:** (a) the owner's own work is feed activity: an invoice moving from unissued (draft / scheduled / new) to sent or viewed emits `invoice:issued` (POST /invoices issued at birth — not on a REQ-200 retry; PUT /invoices/:id issuing a draft; SendPaperworkEmail / SendPaperworkSms when their delivery issues a draft — `stampInvoiceDelivered` now returns the invoice it issued) and SendInvoice's `invoice:sent` carries the amount; POST /payments emits `invoice:payment_recorded`; a field task completed by its worker (POST /field/worker/tasks/:id/complete) or by the office (PUT /field/tasks/:id status complete) emits `task:completed` via the new `FieldActivity` coordinator. NotifyOnEvent maps them to "Invoice for $450 sent to Bob Smith" / "Factura de $450 enviada a Bob Smith" (type `invoice_sent`), "Payment recorded: $1,425 from Linda Perez" / "Pago registrado: $1,425 de Linda Perez" (`invoice_paid`), "Carlos finished a job for Ana Torres: Lawn mowing" / "Carlos terminó un trabajo para Ana Torres: Lawn mowing" and the office's "Job done for … : …" / "Trabajo terminado para … : …" (`task_completed`); the dashboard gives the new types an icon. A draft created, a re-save of an issued invoice, a re-send and a failed delivery emit nothing. (b) the /invoices quiet line ("Quiet week — $X coming next week") shows only when next week's money is all that is outstanding; when more is owed the hero is the `outstanding` headline ("$100,000,449 on the way across 2 invoices"). (c) `GET /analytics/dashboard` counts `quotes.undelivered` (drafts whose last send reached nobody, `isUndelivered`); the QUOTES PENDING tile's sub-line reads "Not delivered (1)" / "Sin entregar (1)" when nothing is in flight, and the "Quotes awaiting signature" empty line says the quote was not delivered and to check the contact and send again — never "1 draft is ready to send". (d) that panel shows no empty-state sentence until its list has loaded (`listsLoaded`), and the es count reads "Enviadas: {n} · ${total}".
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/communication/domain/coordinators/notify-on-event/test.ts` ("REQ-566 (cycle 4, m11) …": issued/sent → `invoice_sent` en + es with and without amount and name; `payment_recorded` → "Payment recorded: $1,425 from Linda Perez" en + es; `task:completed` with and without worker en + es) and `jest/unit/dashboard-headlines-c4.test.ts` ("REQ-566 …": (b) $450 next week beside $100,000,449 → `outstanding`, equal → `nextWeek`, InvoicesPage passes `outstandingCents`; (c) `dashQuotesEmpty` undelivered keys, drafts keep REQ-404's line, `quotesPendingSub`, DashboardPage/DashSections/client wiring, en + es keys; (d) the `pending` flag and `listsLoaded`, es count grammatical; (a) icons + client union, every new notify key in en and es with the same placeholders) · integration `backend/src/communication/entrypoints/notification-controller/owner-activity.int.test.ts` (app booted over HTTP: a draft → no row; POST /invoices issued → "Invoice for $450 sent to Bob Smith"; PUT draft → sent → a row, a second save no row; POST /payments → "Payment recorded: $450 from Bob Smith"; the worker's check-off → "Carlos finished a job for Ana Torres: Lawn mowing"; the office's → "Job done for Ana Torres: Hedge trim"), `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/int.test.ts` ("REQ-566 … the delivery that issues a draft invoice announces it once; a failed one does not"), `backend/src/analytics/domain/coordinators/compute-dashboard-stats/int.test.ts` ("REQ-566 … stats count an undelivered draft apart from the drafts ready to send") · e2e n/a — the browser lane is not run in the demo-loop fix step; the owner-activity int test drives the real HTTP routes the dashboard polls (GET /notifications) end to end, and the headline rules are pure functions bound to the islands by the jest test.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-dashboard-headlines off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — notify-on-event unit → "FAILED | 7 passed | 3 failed" (the three REQ-566 tests); owner-activity int → "FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed" (GET /notifications `[]`, expected `["Invoice for $450 sent to Bob Smith"]` / `["Carlos finished a job for Ana Torres: Lawn mowing"]`); compute-dashboard-stats int → `stats.quotes.undelivered` undefined, expected 1; send-paperwork-email REQ-566 with the emit removed → "FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed"; jest unit project → "Tests: 10 failed, 1 skipped, 3203 passed" (all 10 in dashboard-headlines-c4). ## REQ-554 — /invoices re-reads in place after a card action, the sidebar badge follows, a change-order decision reaches the open pages, and "Send now" issues the invoice today (demo-loop cycle 4, issues M9, m23, m43, m52)

**Requirement (Raphael):** "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67), RCA CONFIRMED / UPHELD at ad104a19: **M9** — after "Enviar ahora" with the email delivered and the text failed, the card stayed "PROGRAMADA" in 04 Próximas (doSendNow re-read nothing on a partial send, while the server had already stamped the invoice "sent"), and a change order approved on /co reached the owner's open pages only on the topbar's next notifications tick (PublicChangeOrderActions never called announceChange — REQ-493 covered sign, decline and claim only); **m23** — the sidebar's Invoices badge kept its count after the invoice was paid (nothing on /invoices or /payments called refreshDash); **m43** — "Listo, lo recibí" (and "Didn't get it") reloaded the whole page; **m52** — the half-delivered note rendered in the failure red, and "Send now" kept the due date its schedule computed (sent Nov 12, "Due Dec 19").
**Behaviour:** every InvoiceCard gets the page's `refreshInvoices` (which now also calls `refreshDash()`); Send now / Finish + send re-read after every outcome (full, partial, failed — in `finally`), confirm / reject / delete re-read instead of `location.reload()`; the note an action leaves ("Invoice sent", "Payment confirmed — the invoice is paid", "Marked as not received…", the half-delivered note) is held by the page so it outlives the card moving track; a half-delivered note is amber with what went in green (check icon) and only what failed in red (also on the Create & send flash); Send now PUTs `sendNowDates` before dispatching — issued today, due today + `netDays`, else + the schedule's span (scheduledFor → dueDate), never before issued — and puts the old dates back if nothing was delivered; /payments' claim confirm / reject refreshes the dash cache; /co announces `invoice` (and the order's `quote`) on approve or decline, before its own reload (extends REQ-493).

## REQ-623 — Payment reminders have a business setting: on/off and cadence days, in Settings; the invoice detail shows the state and its own mute (demo-loop cycle 4, issue M26)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `M26` — "No payment-reminder settings (cadence/on-off)": "Settings has no reminder cadence or on/off switch; the only reminder is 'Enviar recordatorio' on an invoice card." RCA verdict FEATURE_GAP, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** the cadence was hard-coded to day 3/7/14/30 in `SendPaymentReminder` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/mod.ts`, `CADENCE_DAYS` / `pickNextDay`); the only switch was the per-invoice `remindersMuted` flag, toggled only from an overdue/out card's back. `front-end/islands/SettingsPage.tsx` had no reminder controls and no reminder setting existed in backend, shared or front-end.
**Requirement:** `BusinessIdentity.reminders = { enabled, days }` (days ⊂ 3/7/14/30, at least one; unset → on at 3/7/14/30; a bad value is a 400 and changes nothing). The overdue sweep (`runAll`) sends nothing when it is off and runs only the picked steps (`pickNextDay(invoice, now, days)`); manual nudges are unchanged. Settings has a "Payment reminders" card with an on/off switch and Day 3/7/14/30 chips (the last chip stays on — off is the switch), saving at once. The invoice detail (`/invoices?open=<id>`) of a sent/viewed invoice says whether automatic reminders are on (with the days), off for all invoices (linking to Settings), or muted for this invoice, with a Mute / Turn back on button. ## REQ-572 — "Copy link" offers "mark as sent"; a quote shared by link reads "Shared by link" (demo-loop cycle 4, issue p4-p7c; amends REQ-480 / REQ-236)
**Source:** Raphael, on the 20-agent demo report: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — this entry is demo-loop cycle 4 issue **p4-p7c** ("'Copy link' leaves quote 'Ready to send'"; related m41). RCA (analyst + skeptic UPHELD, at ad104a19): FEATURE_GAP — the send menu's Copy link item (`front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` → `copyLinkFor`) only copied the URL; by design (REQ-236/REQ-480) a quote becomes "sent" only when a channel delivers, and a copy proves nothing was delivered, so there was no "shared by link" state and no way for the owner to say they shared it.
**Requirement:** After "Copy link" copies the link of a quote that has not gone out yet (a draft / locked / ready-to-send / not-delivered quote — never one already sent, signed or declined), the toast reads "Link copied — mark as sent?" with a "Mark as sent" button. Pressing it sends `PUT /quotes/:id {status:"sent", sentVia:"link"}`; the backend accepts `sentVia: "link"` (and refuses any other value), stamps `sentAt` on the first issue and stores `sentVia`. Amendment to REQ-480/REQ-236: an explicit owner mark is the one non-delivery way a quote becomes sent. A quote marked this way reads "Shared by link" in the chat header and the conversation list chip (a new thread status `sharedByLink`, "sent" tone), is never "Not delivered" on any surface (`isUndelivered` is false for it — chat, /quotes stage, pipeline), and a later delivery or the customer opening it moves it on to "Out for signature".

- integration: `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/quote-controller/shared-by-link.int.test.ts` ("REQ-572 …": PUT status sent + sentVia link stores both and stamps sentAt; an undelivered quote marked by link is stage "sent" on GET /quotes, not "undelivered"; any other sentVia is refused and stores nothing).
- e2e: `e2e/copy-link-mark-sent/copy-link-mark-sent.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-572 p4-p7c …": finish the wizard to "Ready to send", ▾ → Copy link → toast "Link copied — mark as sent?" → Mark as sent → PUT body `{status:"sent",sentVia:"link"}` and the header reads "Shared by link").

(got Link copied". ## REQ-563 — The chat says the client signed, and the header, the list, the card and the ticker agree (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m3)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `m3`: "Nothing in the chat says the client signed; statuses out of step". Only the header changed to "Quote accepted". "Reabrir" was still offered (pair 9). The ticker kept "Cotización enviada a Bob Smith · hace 1m" (pair 10). The header said "Quote accepted" while the list said "Invoiced" (pairs 1, 7). RCA: analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** (1) the public accept (`PaperworkPublicController` POST `/quotes/:id/accept`) emits the bus event and runs the accepted alert and the signed confirmation, but writes nothing to the quote's conversation. Only the dev "simulate" path (`AcceptQuote` via POST `/agents/conversations/:id/accept-quote`) appended a divider. (2) `threadChip` (`shared/quote-flow/chat-header.ts`) put "Invoiced" on the list while the header said "Quote accepted". (3) the card's Re-open was gated on `isLockedOrIssued(payload.status)`, the card's append-time snapshot (`front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` ~9329), never on the live quote. (4) the ticker reads the notifications feed, which is polled every 60 s when idle. A signature announced from another tab reached the page's change feed but never refreshed that feed.
**Requirement:** when the customer signs on /q, every owner thread bound to that quote gets ONE system divider (phase 4, `signed: true`) in the owner's language. It names the signer, the quote number and the invoice the signature billed: "Linda Perez signed Q-001 · deposit INV-001 $1,425.00 sent" ("invoice" when there is one installment; es "firmó … · anticipo … enviado" / "factura … enviada"; with no invoice due yet, just "… signed Q-001"). The conversation row carries the invoice id/status, the unread badge and the preview. The paperwork module reaches the agents' `AcceptQuote.recordSigned` through `QuoteSignedPort`, using the REQ-497 port pattern. A signed quote whose bill went out reads "Signed · Invoiced" / "Firmada · Facturada" on BOTH the header and the list chip, and "Paid" on both once paid. "Invoiced" alone stays for an unsigned thread. A quote card's Re-open (and its Lock/Edit on a draft card) follows the live quote row (`cardReopenAction`, `quoteAnswered`, `liveCardQuote` in `shared/quote-flow/quote-lock.ts`): no Re-open once signed or declined, and revision (never unlock) once sent. A change announced by another tab refreshes the notifications feed at once. The topbar follows the change feed, so the ticker catches up on every page. The open chat re-reads its transcript when its quote turns signed, so the divider shows without a reload.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/chat-signed-status.test.ts` ("REQ-563 …": cardReopenAction over the live row, the island's gate and handler, header == list chip "Signed · Invoiced" en/es and Paid, unsigned "Invoiced" kept, an announced change calls refreshFeed, DashTopbar subscribes to changes, AsstChat re-reads the conversation on becameSigned) · REQ-563 AMENDMENTS to `jest/unit/reopen-quote-button.test.ts` (REQ-334), `jest/unit/quote-lock.test.ts` (REQ-234) and `jest/unit/thread-status.test.ts` (REQ-369), whose source/chip assertions named the old gate and the old "Invoiced" key · integration (HTTP, the real composed AgentsModule app) `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/accept-quote/signed-chat.int.test.ts` ("REQ-563 m3: a public signature appends ONE divider …" with 50/50 terms → "deposit"; "… in Spanish, and with one invoice (Due Now) it is 'factura'") · browser e2e n/a: the server half is pinned over HTTP by the integration test. The island half is a gate and a re-read over shared functions the unit test pins, and this task excludes the browser lane.

## REQ-543 — The demo pointer's name tag sits next to its arrow (≤ 40 px), off the other controls, and clear of the frame's edge (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m6; REVISION of REQ-437's most-room side)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `m6` — "Pointer name tags cover targets, drift 60-130 px from arrow, run off edge" (pair 7: "Her name tag ~130 px from her arrow", "Priya Nair tag appeared 60–130 px from her arrow, in different directions"; pair 3: "Deb's tag sits under Cancel", "my Alex tag runs off the right edge (x 350–390)" on a 390 px frame; 'Carl' over Cancel, 'Rosa Delgado' over the option buttons). RCA analyst CONFIRMED (confidence high), skeptic UPHELD at `ad104a19`; related m14.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** REQ-437 (0808369b) `tagPlacement` (`shared/demo-mode/motion.ts`) built four sides past the anchored element's edges, kept those within `TAG_REACH = 140` px of the tip and took the one with the MOST room in the box (`ok.reduce((a, b) => b.room > a.room ? b : a)`) — nearness to the arrow played no part, so on an option card, chip, modal button or chat bubble the tag landed 86–139 px away past the element's far edge, over the neighbouring control, and its direction changed with screen position. `fit()` clamped it flush to the box (no margin), which read as running off the edge.
**Requirement:** a candidate tag position — just above, below, right or left of the anchored element, or under the arrow's tail — counts only when, fitted into the box, it covers neither the element nor the arrow and its nearest point is within `TAG_REACH = 40` px of the tip; among those, one that covers no OTHER control of the page under it wins (DemoPointer's `coversControl` hit-tests the candidate's centre and inset corners with `elementFromPoint`, through the stage's same-origin mirror iframe, counting `button, a[href], input, select, textarea, summary, label` and the button/link/option/tab/radio/checkbox/menuitem roles, never the control the tip is on), then the nearest. No such position (an element bigger than the reach around the tip — a card, a page — or no element): the arrow's tail, above the tip only at the box's bottom. The tag always sits `TAG_EDGE = 4` px inside the box (the stage's frame, the customer's window). Not changed: the arrow stays fully opaque (REQ-374 p8 made it opaque because it read as faint); the RCA marked a translucent arrow optional.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-pointer-tag-near.test.ts` ("REQ-543 (demo m6, cycle 4) …": TAG_REACH ≤ 40 and TAG_EDGE 4–6; the RCA's option card / chip / low modal button / chat bubble hovered at their centre — tag within 40 px of the tip, never over the arrow; a chip keeps its tag off itself; a card puts it at the tail; 'Carl over Cancel' with a hit-test of Cancel; 'Rosa Delgado over the option buttons' in a column of chips; every side covering a control still keeps the nearest within reach; 'Alex' at x 340–389 of a 390 px frame and at the left/top/bottom edges is ≥ 4 px clear; a sweep of 40–160 px buttons across 1280×720 is always within reach, off the button and off the arrow) · integration `front-end/lib/demo-pointer-tag-near.test.tsx` ("REQ-543 (demo m6) …": `coversControl` over Cancel's label is true, over plain text or the target OK false; `placeTag` with the page hit-test puts 'Carl' on OK over neither OK nor Cancel, within reach; DemoPointer's first render on a chip at a 390 px frame's right edge is within reach, off the chip and TAG_EDGE clear) · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pointer-tag.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-543 (demo m6, cycle 4) …": the presenter rests at the centre of a /q button — on the customer's screen his tag is ≤ 40 px from the tip, off the button, over no other control (in-page hit-test) and 4 px inside the window; then at the frame's right edge his tag is 4 px clear of the window's right edge).
**REQ-437 test amended:** `jest/unit/demo-pointer-tag-spot.test.ts` "the edge with the most room wins: …" retitled "… (REQ-543: the nearest free side within reach, no longer the roomiest)"; its assertions (above at the bottom, below at the top) still hold unchanged, as do all other REQ-437 cases.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-pointer-tag-placement off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` with the new test → "Tests: 8 failed" in demo-pointer-tag-near (`Expected: <= 40, Received: 140` / `86` / `56`; card side `Expected: "tail", Received: "below"`; `Expected: <= 386, Received: 390`; Cancel overlapped); `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/demo-pointer-tag-near.test.tsx` → TS2305 no exported `coversControl` / `TAG_EDGE`, TS2554 "Expected 5 arguments, but got 6" (`placeTag` took no hit-test); `shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-pointer-tag.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check --filter REQ-543` on the baseline motion.ts + DemoPointer.tsx → "✗ … timed out: Alex's tag at the window's right edge is 4 px clear of it (last error: flush: {x:417.997, side:"tail", tag:{left:376.01, width:44.09}})" — the pair-3 flush edge reproduced (the button-centre half passed at baseline on /q, whose first qualifying button is wide enough that "above" was both roomiest and nearest; it stays as a guard). ## REQ-550 — An invoice is never issued to nobody or listed as Sent when nothing was sent, and a huge amount is confirmed before it is issued (demo-loop cycle 4, issue B1)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." **Cause (RCA, re-checked):** `NewInvoiceModal.submit` (front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx:3586-3600) checked only total > 0, a due date and a new client's name, so "no client" passed. `canSend` was then false, and `newInvoiceStatus({ issue: true, dispatch: false })` returned "sent" (shared/documents/invoice-form.ts:358, REQ-480's "issued by hand" rule). `POST /invoices` took it: `customerId` is optional, `amount` was a bare `@IsNumber` with no bound (backend/src/paperwork/dto/invoice.ts:115-119), and the controller stamps sentAt on any non-draft status (invoice-controller/mod.ts:338-344). The yellow missing-info box is a prompt by design (REQ-206) and stays one.
**Requirement:** (1) "Issue" needs someone to bill: an existing client, a new client's name, or a typed bill-to name. With none, the form says "Choose a client or type who it's billed to before you issue it." (es "Elige un cliente o escribe a quién va facturada antes de emitirla.") and creates nothing. A draft needs no recipient. (2) No total past the $1bn cap (`MAX_CENTS`, now exported from shared/quote-flow/assistant-draft.ts and reused as `INVOICE_MAX_CENTS`) is accepted, on Issue or draft. (3) "Issue" with a total over $250,000 (`INVOICE_CONFIRM_CENTS`) shows "This invoice is for $X. Is that right? Press Issue invoice again to confirm." It stays a draft; share its link yourself (<origin>/i/<id>), or add their email or phone and send it." (`data-cy=invoice-not-sent`, en + es). (5) `POST /invoices` answers 422 `invoice_needs_recipient` for an issued status (anything but draft / scheduled) with no customerId (given or from the quote) and no non-blank `billTo.name`, and 422 `invalid_invoice` for a body that fails validation, which now includes `@Max(MAX_CENTS)` on `amount` (create and update). Helpers in shared/documents/invoice-form.ts: `invoiceIssueBlock`, `needsAmountConfirm`, `invoiceNotSentCopy`. en + es keys: `invoicesPage.new.{errRecipient,errAmountMax,confirmLarge}`, `invoicesPage.send.notSentShareLink`.

## REQ-562 — One rule for a signed job in flight: /clients and the dashboard agree, a first job is "active", and the money KPIs count jobs and same-day payments right (demo-loop cycle 4, issues M38 + m21)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issues `M38` — "Customers page '0 signed jobs / $0 owed' contradicts dashboard ACTIVE JOBS 1" — and `m21` — "Customer stats wrong (new client 'Regular', no avg days with paid invoice, deposit-only avg)"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19` (fleet-0 stdout:244-266, fleet-8:280).
**Cause (RCA):** `BuildCustomerCards` counted active jobs as `max(0, accepted quotes − paid invoices)`, so Linda's 50/50 job with its deposit paid and its balance scheduled was 1 − 1 = 0 jobs (the /clients hero's `hasJobInFlight`), while the dashboard's `ListActiveJobs` builds one job per won quote, complete only when its invoices are paid → 1. With 0 active jobs and the scheduled balance not owed, `deriveStatus` fell to "regular". On /payments a same-day payment averages 0 days and `PaymentsKpis` tested `avgDays > 0`, printing "— / no paid history yet". The dashboard's "Avg. paid job" was `ytd / paid invoices`, so each installment counted as a job ($1,425 for a $2,850 job).
**Requirement:** (1) A signed job (a won, non-sample quote) is in flight until it has invoices and every non-void one linked to it — scheduled installments included — is paid; that one rule (`backend/src/analytics/domain/business/signed-jobs/mod.ts`) drives the dashboard's job status and the customer card's `activeJobs`, so the Customers hero and the dashboard count the same jobs. (2) A customer with a signed job in flight is "active"; "regular" takes at least two completed jobs (a standalone paid invoice is a job of its own); one finished job alone reads "new" (or "cold" when quiet > 60 days). (3) The /payments avg-days KPI shows history whenever a payment has landed: 0 days reads "0d · paid the same day" / "pagado el mismo día"; only no landed payment reads "— · no paid history yet". (4) "Avg. paid job" divides this year's paid revenue by distinct jobs paid on this year (`revenue.paidJobsYtd`: one per quote, a standalone invoice its own). The "$0 owed" half of M38 is correct as is: a scheduled invoice is not owed yet (REQ-397).

## REQ-579 — One job, one name: no cut titles, the typed language names the job, the agreement says the customer once (demo-loop cycle 4, issues M14 + m7)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issues `M14` — "Job titles truncated ('(sod St', 'Baño Principal De') and cut text enters quote" — and `m7` — "One job, several names across title/list/agreement". RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD for both at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** (1) `clipClause` (`backend/src/agents/domain/business/chat-routing/mod.ts`, CLAUSE_END_RES, REQ-388) ended a clause at any ". Capital", so "(sod St. Augustine)" titled pair 2's draft quote and its line "Poner césped nuevo (sod St". (2) AsstChat `startQuoteFromRaw` named the price-first quick quote with `summarizeJobName(<first 8 raw words>, <UI language>)` — Spanish typed in the English app came out "Baño Principal De" — and made the 8-word slice ("Baño principal de la señora Tran en Round") the quote's only line. (3) `agreementTitle` (`shared/quote-flow/agreement-title.ts`) always prefixed the customer, so a surname the option generator had put in the jobName read twice ("Carol Henderson's Henderson Kitchen Gut Agreement", "Acuerdo de henderson kitchen gut de Carol Henderson"); the option prompt let jobName name the customer or cover part of the scope. (4) The end-of-wizard option pick saved the new jobName but left it out of the chat's local quote (the header kept the old name while the list showed the new one) and never re-titled the thread.
**Requirement:** a pricing question's job never ends at the '.' of an abbreviation (St, Dr, Ave, Mt, Mr, Mrs, Ms, Jr, Sr, No, approx, …) nor inside open parentheses. A quick quote's job is named in the language its details were typed in (the shared `messageLang`, now `shared/quote-flow/message-language.ts`; the app language only when the text can't tell), on the client (`quickQuoteNames`) and in the server's fallback derivation (`QuoteStore.create`); its single line is the job name (or the confirmed option's summary), never the raw 8-word slice. The option pick puts the picked jobName in the chat's quote at once and asks the server to re-title the thread from it (REQ-447 `bindQuote`), so header, list and thread title carry one name. The agreement title names a person customer once: words of their name already in the job (incl. a possessive or a "for/para <surname>" tail) are dropped, a job that was only the name reads as no job; a business or household customer never strips the job's words. In Spanish the job is still lowered (REQ-394) but an abbreviation and the name after it ("St. Augustine") and the customer's name keep their capitals. The option prompt (en + es) says the jobName never names the customer and covers every scope item.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/chat-routing/test.ts` ("REQ-579 M14 …": pair 2's sentence, the abbreviation list, parentheses) · unit `jest/unit/c4-job-name-consistency.test.ts` ("REQ-579 …": quickQuoteNames for pair 7 in the English app, English in the Spanish app, the line item, a confirmed option, the fallback; the shared detector; AsstChat wiring; agreementTitle en/es de-duplication, possessive, "para López", name-only job, St. Augustine, business/household customers, unchanged REQ-036/394 shapes; the prompt rule in en/es; the option pick's local jobName + thread re-title) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/job-name-lang.test.ts` ("REQ-579 M14 …": QuoteStore.create derives the jobName in the typed language, falls back to the account language) · e2e n/a — the browser lane is out of this fix's budget (the workflow forbids running it); the island change is two wiring lines asserted by the unit source test, and every rule behind them is unit/integration-covered.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-job-name-consistency off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/business/chat-routing/test.ts --filter REQ-579` → "0 passed | 3 failed" (`- poner césped nuevo (sod St` / `+ … (sod St. Augustine) en un patio …`; `- a fence on Oak Dr`; `- a sod install (St`); `deno test … quote-store/job-name-lang.test.ts` → "1 passed | 2 failed" (`- Baño Principal De` / `+ Baño principal`); `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --runTestsByPath unit/c4-job-name-consistency.test.ts` → "Tests: 15 failed, 1 passed" (`Cannot find module '../../shared/quote-flow/message-language'`, `Received: "Carol Henderson's Henderson Kitchen Gut Agreement"`, `Received: "Acuerdo de henderson kitchen gut de Carol Henderson"`, `Received: "Acuerdo de césped st. augustine nuevo de Ana"`, the prompt rule missing, the option pick's setQuote without jobName). ## REQ-542 — The top-bar activity pill always shows its sentence and time whole, and the send dialog's email preview fits its frame (demo-loop cycle 4, issues m31 + m8)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issues `m31` — "Top-bar activity pill has text on stage but empty/missing for customer" (fleet-4: the customer saw "● just now" with no sentence) — and `m8` — "Text cut off" (the pill read "Carol Henderson aceptó tu cotizaci… ahora mism", fleet-1/fleet-6; the send dialog's email preview clipped on the right, "Reparación de Grif", fleet-2/fleet-5). RCA at demo-fixes `ad104a19`: m31 analyst LIKELY / skeptic UNVERIFIABLE; m8 analyst LIKELY / skeptic CORRECTED (assistant.css is unlinked dead CSS; the cause is the pill's floor plus an unshrinkable time, and the fixed 600px email table).
**Cause (RCA + reproduction):** (1) `.topbar__ticker-item` slid in with `tickerSlideIn … both` from `opacity: 0` (front-end/static/dashboard.css, assistant-page.css ×2), so any tab where the animation did not run to its end — paused, throttled, restarted by a re-keyed event — held the sentence invisible; reproduced in a browser with animations paused: computed opacity "0". (2) At the pill's 220px floor the track keeps 120px and `.topbar__ticker-time` was `flex-shrink: 0` on one line, so "ahora mismo" (70px) overflowed the ~44px left and was clipped by the pill's `overflow: hidden` (reproduced: time 1095..1164 vs pill right 1154). (3) `overflow-wrap: anywhere` split the sentence mid-word. (4) The email card was a fixed `width="600"`/`"640"` table (send-paperwork-email/mod.ts) inside the ~353px preview iframe: the document was 672px wide in a 340px frame.
**Requirement:** the pill's sentence is never transparent — its entrance animates only the movement, so a paused or restarted animation still shows it; the sentence breaks between words (`overflow-wrap: break-word`); the time stays on one line while the track gives way (track shrink 100 vs the time's 1) and, once the track is at its floor, wraps onto the pill's second line instead of being clipped. The stale ticker block in the unlinked static/assistant.css is removed (its `tickerPulse` keyframes stay for `.chat__head-dot`). Every email card table (quote, invoice, basic invoice) is fluid (`width="100%"`, max-width 600/640px) and, on a screen ≤480px, a `<style>` media query tightens the gutters, puts the four "what happens next" steps two by two and drops the total under its label, so the email fits a 340px (and 320px) frame without scrolling sideways. Not covered: the m8 composer placeholder at 390px and the assistant starter below the fold (not traced by the RCA).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/topbar-ticker-never-hidden.test.ts` ("REQ-542 …": per linked sheet the entrance keyframes never set opacity below 1, no `overflow-wrap: anywhere`, the time is not `flex-shrink: 0`/nowrap; assistant.css has no ticker rules) and `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/fluid-width.test.ts` ("REQ-542 m8 …": no table in the three email renderers has a fixed pixel width; the card is `width="100%"` with a max-width) · integration n/a — no store, wire or coordinator behaviour changes; the send-preview endpoint returns the renderer's HTML unchanged, exercised end to end by the e2e story · e2e `e2e/ticker-pill-clip/ticker-pill-clip.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-542 m31/m8 …" on /dashboard and /assistant: with every animation paused the Spanish sentence is opaque, and "ahora mismo" sits wholly inside the pill at 1280px and at its 220px floor; "REQ-542 m8 …": the real GET /api/quotes/:id/send-preview email HTML in a 340px frame has no horizontal overflow).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-ticker-pill-and-clip off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Tests: 7 failed" (keyframes `Expected: 1 Received: 0`, `Expected: not "anywhere"`, `Expected: not "0"`, assistant.css still matching `.topbar__ticker`); `cd backend && deno test -A src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/fluid-width.test.ts` → 6 FAILED (`fixed-width table: <table … width="640" …>` / `width="600"`); `shots run e2e/ticker-pill-clip/ -- --no-check` (fake-mode serve on PORT=47311) → "✗ … the sentence is opaque even though its entrance never ran — expected "1", got "0"" on /dashboard and /assistant, "✗ … the email is no wider than its frame (672px in 340px)"; with the opacity fix only → "✗ … at the pill's 220px floor: the time sits wholly inside the pill (time 1094.8..1164.4, pill 933.8..1153.8)". GREEN — `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 326 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 3208 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv` over send-paperwork-email/, preview-quote-send/, quote-controller/ → "ok | 44 passed | 0 failed"; `SHOTS_DIR=<private> shots run e2e/ticker-pill-clip/ e2e/topbar-ticker/ e2e/topbar-layout/ e2e/ticker-sent-name/ -- --no-check` → "ok | 13 passed | 0 failed" (REQ-273, 319, 406 ×2, 476 ×2, 496, 542 ×3 …); the email story also passes at a 320px frame; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on the touched backend module and the story; `deno fmt --check` clean on the three new test files (send-paperwork-email/mod.ts was not fmt-clean on demo-fixes and was left unformatted).
## REQ-557 — The owner's preview of a claimed invoice is addressed to her, with Confirm received / Didn't get it (demo-loop cycle 4, issue M25)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `M25` — "Owner's invoice preview addresses owner as client, with no Confirm". RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.

The customer (and the override) keeps ClaimedNote; PublicInvoiceRefresh still mounts. ## REQ-600 — The customer card adds and edits phone, email and address in place, and opens from /customers?open=<id>; a batch send's fix links to that card (demo-loop cycle 4, issue M5)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." ## REQ-561 — The revision editor (Edit → Version N) edits the job-detail bullets the customer reads (demo-loop cycle 4, issue M28)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `M28` — "Revision editor (Version 2) hides job-detail bullet lines the client reads" ("my 3 bullet lines … are not here"). RCA analyst CONFIRMED (high), skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** the bullets on the agreement are `quote.description`, rendered by `JobDetailsSection` → `detailLines(description)` (`front-end/components/quote-doc.tsx`, `doc-parts.tsx`). `QuoteLineEditor` in `front-end/islands/QuotesPage.tsx` (REQ-315) edited only `lineItems` and saved only `{lineItems, estimatedTotal}`; `quote.description` was not in the form.
**Requirement:** the editor shows a "Job details (what the customer reads)" / "Detalles del trabajo (lo que lee el cliente)" textarea, one bullet per line, prefilled from the working copy (`pendingRevision.description`, else `description`). Saving sends `description` only when the text really changed (lines trimmed, blanks dropped); on an issued quote it waits in the pending revision like the lines (the customer keeps the published bullets). A pending revision that changes `description` carries `descriptionByLang: {}` so Version N+1 never shows the old bullets' translations (readers fall back to the new text; the next translate run refills them); text edited back to the live version leaves nothing pending. `versionChanges` reports `descriptionChanged`, so the publish preview and the version history say "Job details changed" / "Detalles del trabajo cambiados", and a job-details-only revision is not "Wording or terms updated".
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/quote-revision-job-details.test.ts` ("REQ-561 …": `editableJobDetails`, `jobDetailsPatch`, `versionChanges.descriptionChanged`, `versionChangeLine` en/es, `pendingOtherContentChanged`, the editor's textarea + save body, en/es keys) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/revisions-controller/job-details-revision.int.test.ts` ("REQ-561 (demo M28) …": PUT on a sent quote → `pendingRevision.description` + `descriptionByLang: {}`, live untouched, publish → Version 2 with the new bullets and no stale `es`; edit back → nothing pending) · e2e `e2e/quote-revision-job-details/quote-revision-job-details.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-561 (M28) …": Edit → Version 2 shows the three bullets, a fourth is saved as unpublished, the preview says "Job details changed", publish puts it on /q/:id).

## REQ-538 — REQ-451 AMENDMENT: when what the presenter pointed at goes (a card swapped or flipped, a new page, another tab), his still mouse is looked up again once the replay has settled, and the stage says when his arrow is not on the customer's screen (demo M1 — cycle 4)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, `demo-loop/runs/r857a9d67/demo-report.md`): **M1** — "Presenter pointer disappears on customer screen after every page/card change and when idle" (pairs 1, 2, 6, 8, 10: "seems the pointer disappears on each new card until you move it", "I do NOT see your pointer right now" after a card flip, "Pointer disappeared after my click", no pointer after the Workers → /worker page change). RCA at `ad104a19`, analyst + skeptic: CONFIRMED / UPHELD.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked in this worktree):** designed in by REQ-451 (eb3b493b). The presenter's anchor is a node id plus the customer's page load. The customer's overlay draws nothing once that node is gone (`anchorPoint` → `pointInBox` null, or `toScreen` not `isConnected`) or another load is shown, and `place()` sends `leave`. Nothing re-anchored it: `lookAgain` (`shared/demo-mode/presenter-anchor.ts`) was false for every node anchor, and `resendPointer` → `resendable` gave nothing for another load. The arrow came back only on his next move. The "idle" vanishes were the same thing (a click flipped or replaced the card under his still mouse); idle time alone hides nothing (`motion.ts` keeps the arrow at opacity 1). The stage never told him either: `ghostAt` gets nothing when the node is gone.
**Requirement:**
- A presenter's node anchor is DEAD when the replay shows another page load than the one it names, or its node no longer resolves there (the stage's `presenterOnStage` is null: a card swapped or flipped, a button replaced). When it is dead, he has not moved since, and the replay shown has `settled()`, the stage sends exactly one `anchorOf(lastMove)` — the node now under his still cursor (`lookAgain(h, { load, settled, alive })`; `DemoStage.replace()` passes `alive`, `resendPointer` falls back to `lookAgain` for a new load). The look-up makes a live anchor, so it happens once. It waits until the replay's layout has been still for `REANCHOR_QUIET_MS` (250 ms; every layout pass restarts the wait) and, after a snapshot, until its last settle pass (`reanchorDelay`, `SETTLE_MS`'s 1.5 s): found while fixing — on a reload the replay was `settled()` at once (its stylesheets cached) but its scroll was not the customer's yet, so the arrow landed on a node 19 px off (`presenter → …/DIV:2/STRONG:2 · arrow … → …/DIV:2`).
- REQ-451 kept: a node anchor whose node is still on the page shown is never looked up again (their scroll, a change, a settle, the stage resized) — the arrow rides with its element. Before the replay has settled nothing is looked up (never the node an unsettled replay puts under his mouse).
- While his node anchor is not drawn on their screen, the stage says "Your pointer isn't on {name}'s screen — move to show it" (`demoMode.pointerAbsent`, en + es; `data-cy="demo-pointer-absent"`, `pointerAbsent`), and not while the "off their screen" hint shows. Making a new anchor or leaving the window clears it.
- Supersedes REQ-451's "a new page shows none until he moves", "a new page, another tab, a reload get nothing until he moves" and "draw nothing otherwise" as a lasting state: the arrow is gone only until that replay has settled.
**Tests:**
- unit `jest/unit/demo-presenter-anchor.test.ts` ("REQ-538 …"): `lookAgain` re-anchors a dead anchor (node gone; new page load) only once settled, never while the node exists; a stage model where a card swap and a page change each re-anchor exactly once after settle and never during a scroll; `pointerAbsent`; the stage wiring (`replace()` passes `alive` from `presenterOnStage`, `setAbsent(pointerAbsent(…))`, `hold` clears it, `resendPointer` falls back to `lookAgain` + `rest.push`) and both lang keys. REQ-451's `replace()` wiring case amended (`REQ-538 AMENDMENT`).
- integration: n/a — the change is in the stage island and a pure shared module; no backend or API path is involved (the relay carries the same `move` message).
- unit also: `reanchorDelay` (the quiet wait; not before a snapshot's last settle pass) and the stage's `reanchorSoon` / `reanchor` wiring.
- e2e (amended REQ-451 stories, `REQ-538 AMENDMENT` comments): `e2e/demo-mode/demo-scroll-pointer.e2e.test.ts` (after the customer's page change and after a reload the arrow comes back on the element under his still cursor with no move, and the absent hint is gone); `e2e/demo-mode/demo-mirror.e2e.test.ts` step 8 (the new page gets the arrow with his mouse still); `e2e/demo-mode/demo-presenter-rest.e2e.test.ts` tab-switch story (a newly followed tab gets the arrow with his mouse still).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, local, branch fix/c4-pointer-reanchor off origin/demo-fixes ad104a19, dev stack on random high ports, `SHOTS_DIR` private):** unit RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/demo-presenter-anchor.test.ts` → "Tests: 8 failed, 1 skipped, 3203 passed" (the 8 new REQ-538 cases). Unit GREEN — the whole unit project → "Test Suites: 325 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 3213 passed". `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on `DemoStage.tsx` and `presenter-anchor.ts`; `deno fmt --check` clean on all 8 changed files. E2E RED — the amended stories with ad104a19's `DemoStage.tsx` + `presenter-anchor.ts` put back: scroll-pointer "timed out: REQ-538: after the customer's page change, his mouse still"; tab switch "timed out: REQ-538: the tab the stage newly follows (tab 2) gets the arrow with his mouse still"; REQ-242 "timed out: REQ-538: the presenter's pointer is back on the customer's new page with his mouse still". E2E GREEN (two runs): scroll-pointer ✓, tab switch ✓, M8/M14 ✓; REQ-242 passes step 8 and stops at step 11 (End from the customer, line 584) and REQ-305 M7 at "the quote page has the sign form's name field to jump to — expected 1, got 0", both failing on ad104a19 as well (REQ-451's evidence).
### REQ-538 — SUPERSEDED by REQ-645 (demo-loop cycle 5, M1 + M2 + m36)

The look-up of his still mouse for a dead anchor (`lookAgain` true for a dead node anchor, `reanchorDelay`, `REANCHOR_QUIET_MS`, `reanchorSoon` / `reanchor`) put the arrow on whatever the new content had at that spot — cycle 5 M1: "or a person?" where "Lock it in" was, "Back" for "Dashboard"; m36: the arrow on her other tab — and kept every page change dark for at least 1.5 s (M2). It is removed: a dead anchor is found again by the print of its element (REQ-645 rule 1), or not at all. Kept from REQ-538: the stage says "Your pointer isn't on {name}'s screen — move to show it" while his anchor is not drawn on her screen (REQ-645 adds: and while he holds nothing). Its tests now assert what supersedes them (`REQ-645 AMENDMENT` in `jest/unit/demo-presenter-anchor.test.ts` and in the three e2e stories it amended).

## REQ-535 — The customer's demo pill survives a page load: drawn at once, Connected through a short grace (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m13)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `m13` — "Customer pill flickers Connecting… or disappears after each page load (aborted long-poll)"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19` (fleet-2 stdout:129).
**Cause (RCA):** the app has no client-side navigation (no `f-client-nav` in front-end routes/components), so every link is a full load and `DemoModeOverlay` mounts fresh with `demo = null`: with no `opening` and no `notice` it renders nothing until the first `/demo-mode/active` answers, then effect 2 opens a new socket whose status is `connecting` (transport.ts:214) or `waiting` (:215) until the stage's presence arrives — both "Connecting…" in `statusLabel`. Nothing carried "this tab was connected a moment ago" across the load. The cancelled `/active?wait=10000` is the in-flight long-poll the browser aborts on navigation — a side effect, not the cause.
**Requirement:** the customer's tab keeps its demo (`{id, role, presenters, presenterName, …}`) and whether its page was connected, with the time, in sessionStorage (`front-end/lib/demo-mode/pill-carry.ts`, key `pm:demo-pill`; refreshed on `pagehide`, forgotten when the demo is gone). On mount the overlay seeds `demo` from it (fresh: under 30 s old; viewer only), so the pill is drawn at once and the link starts without waiting for `/active`. After a load from a connected page the pill keeps the Connected face for a grace of `PILL_CARRY_GRACE_MS` (5 s) while its own link comes up; "Connecting…" shows only if the grace runs out first. An ended / closed / replaced link is never masked; once the link is up on its own the grace stops, so a later drop is said.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-pill-carry.test.ts` ("REQ-535 …": carry/forget/freshness/garbage/refusing store, `showsConnected` faces, the ~5 s grace, and the overlay's wiring: seeds from `carriedDemo(sessionStore(), …)`, labels via `showsConnected(status, carrying)`, keeps on `pagehide`, forgets) · integration n/a — front-end only, no backend or wire change · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-reload.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-535 (cycle 4, m13) …": a connected customer reloads, then follows a link to /quotes; sampled every 40 ms from the page's first byte, the pill once drawn never says "Connecting…" and never goes, and ends on Connected).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-pill-survives-reload off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern unit/demo-pill-carry` → "Cannot find module '../../front-end/lib/demo-mode/pill-carry'"; with the module but the overlay unwired → "Tests: 3 failed, 6 passed" (the wiring cases); `shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-reload.e2e.test.ts` (own stack, random high ports) → "✗ REQ-535 … after a reload — … at 280 ms the pill said \"Connecting…\" (first drawn at 280 ms …)". ## REQ-546 — The customer's click ripple on the stage stays where the click happened, goes with its node, and stays inside the frame (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m14)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `m14` — "Customer click ripple misleads: stays on next card's button, ~130 px off, drawn outside frame"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19` (pair 7: the "Next month" ripple sat on the swapped-in card's "1 week", and a large ripple was drawn over the impersonation banner; pair 9: a ripple near "Por definir").
**Cause (RCA):** (1) every layout pass re-placed each stage wave with the pointer's rule, `placeWavesAgain(w, (a) => placeOnStage(a).at)` (`front-end/islands/DemoStage.tsx`, REQ-371 f2434208); `toStage` falls back to the click's viewport fraction once the node is gone or its load is no longer shown, so a card swapped in place moved the ~4 s wave onto the new card's button, and a re-laid-out node carried it ~130 px away. (2) each wave was a `position:fixed` 180 px ring (`front-end/components/demo-mode/DemoPointer.tsx`, REQ-153/REQ-431); the stage root's overflow:hidden does not clip a fixed descendant, so a click near the frame's top drew over the banner.
**Requirement:** a stage click wave is placed once, where the click happened (on its node when the replay has it, else at the click's fraction while the frame lags), and then stays there — it follows only a refit of the frame. It goes as soon as what was clicked is no longer there: its node gone, its node moved more than `WAVE_DRIFT_PX` (12 px), or the replay on another page load. It never falls back to the fraction once it was on its node. A wave placed at the fraction for want of its node moves onto the node once (also when the replay catches up to the click's page load). The waves and the last-click dot are drawn inside a clip with the fitted frame's box (overflow:hidden) and the ring is 120 px (was 180), so it neither escapes the frame nor encloses the neighbouring chips.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-click-wave-freeze.test.ts` ("REQ-546 (demo m14, cycle 4) …": a card swap removes the wave and never moves it to the fraction; a new load removes it; a ~130 px re-layout removes it; a still node keeps the same array; a refit moves it with the frame; mirror-lag and load-lag waves land on the node once; a node-less click stays frozen until the load changes) · unit/render `front-end/lib/demo-click-wave-clip.test.tsx` ("REQ-546 …": a wave 10 px under the frame's top is inside a `demo-wave-clip` with the frame's box and overflow:hidden, placed relative to it; the dot is clipped with it; the ring ≤ 120 px; no bounds → clipped to the window) · integration `jest/unit/demo-click-wave-freeze.test.ts` ("REQ-546 … the stage wires the frozen waves": DemoStage makes waves with `newStageWave`, re-places them with `placeWavesAgain(w, waveFrame())`, no `placeOnStage(a).at`, and hands `bounds={fit}` to DemoPointer) · REQ-371's tests in `jest/unit/demo-mode-customer-pointer.test.ts` updated to the new signature · e2e n/a — the two mechanisms are deterministic in the pure placement and the rendered geometry pinned above; the live two-session demo lane (`e2e/demo-mode/`) was not run for this fix (out of this task's scope).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-click-wave-freeze-clip off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/demo-click-wave-clip.test.tsx` → "FAILED | 1 passed | 4 failed" ("the ring is at most 120 px, got 180px", "a clip is drawn", the ring's parent was not `demo-wave-clip`); `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 1 failed, 325 passed · Tests: 10 failed, 1 skipped, 3202 passed" (only demo-click-wave-freeze.test.ts: `newStageWave` missing, DemoStage did not call it).
