## REQ-586 — In-app customer links (/q and /i) open in the language the document went out in (demo-loop cycle 4, issue M11)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `M11` — "Customer /q and /i links open in English though document sent in Spanish (no ?lang)"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19` (fleet-8 stdout:257 "Juan's view (logged out): came up in ENGLISH … although I sent 'en Español'"; fleet-5 stdout:267 "INV-001 Open -> NEW TAB /i/e5a81de1… opened in ENGLISH (… no ?lang)").
**Cause (RCA):** REQ-342 put `?lang=<send language>` only on the links inside outbound SMS/email. The in-app links were bare: `front-end/lib/customer-link.ts` `customerLinkPath` returned `/q/${quoteId}` (CustomerLinkRow "Open as customer" + AsstChat "Copy"), QuotesPage/QuoteCard copy + "View as client" built bare `/q/` links, InvoicesPage "Open" opened a bare `/i/`. Nothing recorded which language a quote was sent in. `/q` without `?lang` falls to the cookie then `en`; `/i` used the contractor's commsLanguage as docLang, never the invoice's own language.
**Requirement:** SendQuote records the language each send went out in (the per-send pick, else the Settings default — the dispatchers' own resolution) on `quote.lastDelivery.lang` and on the send divider's `payload.lang`, failed sends included. Every in-app customer link carries it as `?lang=` through `shared/quote-flow/share-link.ts` (`withSendLang`, `quoteSendLang`): the chat's CustomerLinkRow Open + Copy (divider `lang`, else the quote's last send language), the /quotes open panel and card Copy + View as client, and the onboarding sample link (the UI language). The public invoice projection carries `docLang` (`invoiceDocLang`: the invoice's own `lang`, else the language its quote was sent in, else the quote's base language), which `/i` uses ahead of `contractor.commsLanguage`; /invoices "Open" adds `?lang=<invoice.lang>`. No language recorded → the link is unchanged.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/customer-link-lang.test.tsx` ("REQ-586 …": customerLinkPath/Url/invoiceLinkPath add ?lang; quoteSendLang; invoiceDocLang order; CustomerLinkRow Open href + Copy hand the send language; deliveryFromDivider keeps the divider's lang; AsstChat/QuotesPage/QuoteCard/InvoicesPage/routes/i wiring) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/int.test.ts` ("REQ-586 (cycle 4, M11) send-quote: …" ×3 — per-send pick, Settings default, failed text) and `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/invoice-doc-lang.int.test.ts` ("REQ-586 … the public invoice names its document language") · browser e2e n/a — the links are built by the pure helpers pinned above and the /q, /i pages already honour `?lang=` (REQ-048/REQ-272 stories); a browser story would only re-read the same href.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-customer-link-lang off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/int.test.ts src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/invoice-doc-lang.int.test.ts --filter REQ-586` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 4 failed" (type-checked run: "Property 'lang' does not exist on type 'QuoteDelivery'"); `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/customer-link-lang.test.tsx` → "does not provide an export named 'invoiceDocLang'" / "'invoiceLinkPath'". GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv --parallel src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/ src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/ src/agents/domain/coordinators/list-conversations/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/` → "ok | 112 passed | 0 failed"; front-end neighbouring deno tests (15 files incl. customer-link-lang/label) → "ok | 75 passed | 0 failed"; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 325 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 3201 passed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on every touched front-end file and backend module; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file that was clean before (AsstChat.tsx, send-quote/int.test.ts, send-paperwork-email/mod.ts were already not fmt-clean on demo-fixes and were left unformatted).
## REQ-541 — A stage window whose demo moved or ended never leaves the presenter as the customer (demo-loop cycle 4, issue M22)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `M22` — "Second staff browser: first stage freezes, ~15 s lag; ending from one leaves the other impersonating the customer; /admin shows no live demo"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED (high), skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19` (fleet-9 stdout:43, 84-90, 295).
**Cause (RCA):** a newer stage window of the same staff account makes the hub close the older socket as `replace` (`backend/src/demo-mode/domain/coordinators/demo-hub/mod.ts:152-156, 369-383`); the older link stays `replaced` for good (`front-end/lib/demo-mode/transport.ts:212, 594-617`) and never hears the later `ended`. Its /active poll (`front-end/islands/DemoStage.tsx` "1. which demo") then found no demo and showed "No demo is open" with a plain `<a href="/admin">`. Nothing called `backToOwnAccount()` (only `onEnded` and `end()` did), so the browser stayed impersonating the customer and /admin put up AdminGuideGate ("You are guiding … in this browser"). Separately, `stageFrameLook` (`shared/demo-mode/stage-frame.ts`) had no case for `replaced`: the stale mirror stayed at full colour with only a small "Open in another window" chip, which the employee read as the stage lagging (~15 s).
**Requirement:** (a) a stage that has shown a demo and then finds none hands the presenter their own account back (stop-impersonating → `/admin?demo=ended`). That covers both the /active poll, which keeps running while the link is `replaced`, and the re-check on a `closed` link. It happens once, and never races the `ended` path, which says who ended it (`afterActiveCheck` → `"handBack"`). (b) The "No demo is open" screen's Back to admin is a button that stops impersonating before it navigates. (c) A `replaced` window greys the frame (`WAITING_FILTER`) and lays a banner across it, "This demo moved to another window." / "Esta demo pasó a otra ventana.", with Use this window (a reload takes it back). No connecting spinner appears under it, and its click layer is gone. The optional "In a demo" badge on the /admin row is not part of this.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-stage-replaced-handback.test.ts` ("REQ-541 …": `stageFrameLook` for `replaced` greyed + `elsewhere`, before and after a frame; `afterActiveCheck` show/handBack/empty; the island routes both the poll and the closed re-check through it to `backToOwnAccount({ by: "unknown" })`; the empty screen has no plain `/admin` link, only a `demo-stage-back` button; the banner + Use this window are rendered; en/es `demoMode.movedElsewhere`) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change. The hub's `replace` and `/active` answering no session after an end are existing behaviour; the fault and the fix are the island's reaction, pinned by the unit test and driven for real by the e2e story · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-replaced-handback.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-541 (cycle 4, M22) …": window 2 of the same account takes over → window 1 shows the moved banner over a greyed frame. Window 2 ends the demo → window 1 lands on /admin by itself, with no `admin-gate`, and `/api/admin/whoami` is not impersonating).
**Amends:** REQ-297 (`jest/unit/demo-stage-waiting.test.ts`: "ended / closed never dim". `replaced` now dims under its own banner) and REQ-309/REQ-370 (`jest/unit/demo-mode-mirror-wiring.test.ts`, `jest/unit/demo-stage-styled-reveal.test.ts`: the connecting overlay is `look.visibility === "hidden" && !look.elsewhere`).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-stage-replaced-handback off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first. `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/demo-stage-replaced-handback.test.ts` gave "Tests: 7 failed, 1 skipped, 3202 passed" (filter `none` for replaced, `stageFrame.afterActiveCheck is not a function`, `Expected pattern: not /href="\/admin"/`, no `demoMode.movedElsewhere`). `shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-replaced-handback.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` on the demo-fixes source gave "✗ REQ-541 … locator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded" (waiting for `demo-elsewhere`). On the fix with `handBack()` disabled (mutation) it gave "✗ … timed out: the first window lands on /admin". GREEN: the same story gave "✓ REQ-541 … 28.2s". `npx jest --selectProjects unit` gave "Test Suites: 326 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 3209 passed". `deno lint` + `deno check` were clean on `islands/DemoStage.tsx` and `shared/demo-mode/stage-frame.ts`, and `deno fmt --check` was clean on every touched file. Neighbouring `e2e/demo-mode/demo-viewers.e2e.test.ts` gave 2 passed, 3 failed, with the same 3 stories failing at the same lines (201, 273, 406) on the unchanged demo-fixes source: B3, p1 and m3 click End without its REQ-235 confirm, so these failures predate this change.
## REQ-599 — The New customer modal takes an optional address, with the street autocomplete (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m30)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `m30` — "New customer form: no address field; backdrop covers EN/ES toggle"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19` (fleet-1 stdout:131, 270-271, 340).
**Cause (RCA):** the /customers New customer modal (`front-end/islands/ClientsPage.tsx`) collected only name, business name, phone and email; `submitAddClient` never sent `address`, though `clientsClient.create` / `POST /customers` take one (FieldTasksPage passes it, REQ-283). So a customer added there showed "No address on file" / "Sin dirección registrada" on its card. The backdrop half (the full-screen modal backdrop covers the topbar's EN/ES toggle) is standard modal behaviour — NOT_A_BUG, left alone.
**Requirement:** the New customer modal has an optional "Address (optional)" / "Dirección (opcional)" field with the same Mapbox street autocomplete as the onboarding wizard (typed text always the first option, "Use as typed"; picking a suggestion fills its full one-line label). A draft with only an address typed counts as dirty (REQ-300: a backdrop click keeps it). Add sends the trimmed address with the customer (`newCustomerPayload` in `shared/quote-flow/customer-contact.ts`; a blank one is left out), and the card's panel shows it. en and es stay in sync.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/new-customer-address.test.ts` ("REQ-599 m30 …": an address-only draft is dirty; the payload carries the trimmed address and omits a blank one; en/es label; the island renders `AddressAutocomplete` with `data-cy="add-client-address"`, creates through `newCustomerPayload` and passes `address: addAddress` to `customerDraftDirty`) · integration (HTTP) `backend/src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-599 m30 customer e2e: POST /customers keeps the New customer modal's address" — pins the contract the modal relies on; green from the start, as the RCA said the API already took an address) · e2e `e2e/new-customer-address/new-customer-address.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-599 m30: …": open the modal, type the address, pick "Use as typed", Add → `/api/customers` holds the address and the opened card shows it, not "No address on file").
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-new-customer-address off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/new-customer-address.test.ts` → 4 failed (`customerDraftDirty` address-only → false; `newCustomerPayload is not a function`; `clientsPage.address` undefined; no `<AddressAutocomplete`); `shots run e2e/new-customer-address/new-customer-address.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → "✗ REQ-599 … the page never showed \"Address (optional)\"". ## REQ-549 — A tab the customer is not using never takes the demo stage on its own (demo-loop cycle 4, issue S4)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `S4` — "Headless tab switching: the two remaining tab findings (pair 9 background tab, pair 8 restart) are said not to be harness"; RCA analyst LIKELY (medium), skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** REQ-436's load-time claim (`front-end/islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx`, the `[demo?.id]` effect) took "in front" = `visibilityState === "visible" && document.hasFocus()`. Headless Playwright sends `Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled` to every page, so every tab passes. (pair 9) the background owner /i/ tab's poll saw the invoice paid, `startInvoiceRefresh` called `location.reload()`, and the reloaded page claimed the stage. (pair 8) on a demo restart the effect ran in every open tab, both claimed, and `follow()` gave the stage to the later claim — tab 1, not the tab 2 the customer had just clicked.
**Requirement:** (1) a reload the app starts on its own (`public-invoice-refresh.ts`, `public-change-order-refresh.ts`) leaves a `pm:demo-self-reload` mark in the tab's sessionStorage; the next page takes it (once, fresh within 30 s) and skips its load-time claim until the customer presses a key or the pointer in it. (2) every pointerdown/keydown in any tab writes `{ k: tabKey, at }` to localStorage `pm:demo-input`; at load and at a demo's start a page claims only when it is in front AND no other tab has had input since this page loaded. A back-forward-cache restore (`pageshow` with `persisted`) still claims when in front; a click, key, focus or visibilitychange still claims as before. The logic is `front-end/lib/demo-mode/tab-claim.ts` (`loadClaim`). The optional stage label naming the shown tab is not part of this entry.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-tab-claim.test.ts` ("REQ-549 …": the self-reload mark is taken once, expires, survives refused storage; a self-reloaded page skips the claim; the invoice and change-order refresh really mark their reload; input is kept per tab key, newest wins; pair 8's restart — tab 1 loaded before tab 2's click does not claim, tab 2 does; a page loaded after the other tab's input still claims; the overlay wires loadClaim/takeSelfReload/noteInput and `persisted`) · `jest/unit/demo-stage-tab-follow.test.ts` REQ-436 wiring assertion amended to the loadClaim shape · integration n/a — browser-only claim decision, no backend or wire change (the claim message is unchanged) · e2e n/a — the bug exists only because headless Playwright reports every page in front; the e2e lane runs the same headless browser and the next demo cycle is the run that exercises it.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-demo-tab-claim off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/demo-tab-claim.test.ts` → "Cannot find module '../../front-end/lib/demo-mode/tab-claim'" (Test Suites: 1 failed, 325 passed). GREEN — `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 326 passed, 326 total · Tests: 1 skipped, 3211 passed"; `deno check` + `deno lint` + `deno fmt --check` clean on `islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx`, `lib/demo-mode/tab-claim.ts`, `lib/public-invoice-refresh.ts`, `lib/public-change-order-refresh.ts` and both test files.
## REQ-393 / REQ-451 — AMENDMENT (2026-11-12, demo-loop cycle 4): superseded in part by REQ-539 — the hand-off from /admin is never sent
REQ-451 counted any hand-off on the fitted frame as where he points ("the mouse handed over by the page that opened the stage (or by the stage's own `pagehide`) … counts once the frame is fitted, only on the frame"), and said a hand-off beside the frame shows "no 'off' hint". REQ-539 replaces both: only the stage's own hand-off (a reload) is sent; /admin's is a hint for the stage's off outline only. Amended in place (`REQ-539 AMENDMENT` comments): `jest/unit/demo-stage-presenter-pointer.test.ts`, `jest/unit/demo-presenter-anchor.test.ts`, `e2e/demo-mode/demo-presenter-rest.e2e.test.ts` (step 1 of the M8/M14 story).

## REQ-539 — The cursor handed over from /admin never puts the presenter's arrow on the customer's screen: only the stage's own hand-off (a reload) is sent; /admin's is a hint for the stage's off outline, and the customer sees his arrow only after a real pointer move (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m24)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, `demo-loop/runs/r857a9d67/demo-report.md`), issue **m24** — "Presenter pointer appears at a left-over spot when demo starts": pair 8 (desktop 1280×720 customer) "Your pointer sits near my mic button bottom-right of the chat box", employee "a spot I had not pointed at"; pair 7 "at an old spot (~1150,595) before I moved"; pair 10 after a restart "sat on my Send button for a minute". RCA at `ad104a19`, analyst LIKELY / skeptic UPHELD.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked in this worktree):** `DemoModeOverlay.placePresenter` hands the mouse's last spot over (`cursor-handoff.ts`, `pm:demo-cursor`) before sending the staff to the stage; `DemoStage` takes it (`seedRef.current = takeCursor(sessionStore())`) and, once the frame is fitted, `takeSeed` pushed it as a real move whenever `seedOn` put it on the frame → `anchorOf` → a node under that point on her page. REQ-451 assumed the Demo button sits beside a phone frame; for a desktop customer the fitted frame covers most of the stage, so the Demo button's spot is on it and her arrow sat on whatever her page had there.
**Requirement:** a hand-off carries the page that made it (`from`: `"admin"` from placePresenter, `"stage"` from the stage's own `pagehide`; an untagged or unknown one is `"admin"`). Once the frame is fitted (`seedUse`, `shared/demo-mode/presenter-anchor.ts`): the stage's own hand-off on the frame is where he points and is sent (a reload: the same page, the same spot); beside the frame, nothing (REQ-451). /admin's — on the frame or beside it — is only where his mouse is: it feeds the stage's on/off-frame outline and "Your pointer is off {name}'s screen" hint (`hintRef`), is never `lastMoveRef`, never sent, never handed on at `pagehide`; nothing reaches the customer until a real pointer event, which (like leaving the window) drops the hint.
**Tests:**
- unit `jest/unit/demo-pointer-seed-origin.test.ts` ("REQ-539 …", 10 cases): the hand-off's `from` round trip (stage, admin, untagged and junk tags → admin); `seedUse` — the demo's case (/admin's Demo spot on a desktop frame → hint, not sent), /admin's beside a phone frame → hint, the stage's own on the frame → sent, beside it or nothing → null; the wiring (the stage hands over `"stage"`, placePresenter `"admin"`, `takeSeed` through `seedUse` with the hint branch before any `lastMoveRef`/push, `markOff` reads `lastMoveRef ?? hintRef`, a pointer event and `gone` drop the hint). Amended: `jest/unit/demo-stage-presenter-pointer.test.ts` (round trip carries `from`; the two `handCursor` call shapes) and `jest/unit/demo-presenter-anchor.test.ts` (`takeSeed` goes through `seedUse`).
- integration n/a — front-end and shared only: no backend, wire or protocol change (the tag lives in this tab's sessionStorage).
- e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-presenter-rest.e2e.test.ts` — new "REQ-539 (demo m24): a desktop customer …": a 1280×720 customer, the Demo click lands on the fitted frame, her screen shows no presenter arrow for 3 s and the stage no off hint; his move puts the arrow (with its tag) at the middle of her screen. Amended "REQ-393 (demo M8) + REQ-451 (demo M14) …" step 1: /admin's hand-off shows no arrow on the phone, on the frame or beside it; beside it the stage says he is off her screen. Its step 4 (the stage reloaded under his still mouse starts where it was) is the stage-origin seed, kept.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-pointer-seed-handoff off origin/demo-fixes ad104a19, host):** RED — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-pointer-seed-origin` → "Tests: 10 failed, 10 total" (`takeCursor` without `from`, `seedUse` not a function, the old `handCursor`/`takeSeed`/`markOff` shapes). E2E RED on ad104a19's source (the new story file only): `shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-presenter-rest.e2e.test.ts -- --filter "/REQ-539 \(demo m24\)/"` → "✗ … m24: /admin's hand-off on the desktop frame (his mouse at {"x":1024.26,"y":478.68}): the presenter's arrow showed with no move {"x":1035.13,"y":415.303,"outside":false,"off":false,"tag":true}". GREEN — the four pointer suites `demo-pointer-seed-origin|demo-presenter-anchor|demo-stage-presenter-pointer|demo-mode-pointer-anchor` → "Tests: 82 passed"; every `demo` unit suite → "Test Suites: 31 passed · Tests: 416 passed"; `SHOTS_JOBS=2 shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-presenter-rest.e2e.test.ts` → ✓ REQ-393 tab switch (11.7 s), ✓ REQ-393 M8 + REQ-451 M14 incl. the reload step (31.7 s), ✓ REQ-539 m24 (27.8 s), rc 0. `deno lint` and `deno check` clean on the changed islands and modules; `deno fmt --check` clean on every changed file.
## REQ-622 — Settings has one payment-term setting: "Days to pay an invoice" (demo-loop cycle 4, issue p4-p6c)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `p4-p6c` — "Two payment-term settings" (fleet-5 stdout:191: 'Settings has "Days to pay an invoice: 30" and also Contract defaults "Payment terms (days)", left empty'); RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** "Days to pay an invoice" (REQ-174) saves `identity.invoiceNetDays`, which the invoice form (`shared/documents/invoice-form.ts` accountNetDays) and the signed-confirmation send read. The Settings "Contract defaults" card (`ContractDefaultsEditCard`, P-42, ~69b4ed4f) autosaved `paymentTermsDays`, `depositPct` and `warrantyDays` to `PUT /profile/contract-defaults`; no quote, invoice or agreement code reads any of the three. REQ-174 added invoiceNetDays next to it without retiring the old field.
**Requirement:** Settings shows one payment-term setting, "Days to pay an invoice" (`invoiceNetDays`). The Contract defaults card — its "Payment terms (days)", deposit % and warranty days, all read by nothing — is removed, so nothing in Settings saves into a store nothing reads (the quote-terms wizard keeps its per-quote payment/warranty picks). On load, a `paymentTermsDays` the old card stored (a whole number 0–365) moves into `invoiceNetDays` when that was never set, and is persisted; a set `invoiceNetDays` is never overridden. The front-end `ContractDefaults` type mirrors the backend DTO and no longer lists the dead fields.

## REQ-603 — The chat's recovery box checks the number before it saves; a letter stays visible and is flagged, a refusal reads as copy (demo-loop cycle 4, issue M23)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `M23` — "Raw 'PUT /customers/<id> failed: 400' in chat; letter silently dropped from number"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED (high), skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19` (fleet-9 stdout:100-101, 223: "512-867-53O9" shown as "(512) 867-539", then the raw PUT line).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on ad104a19):** the recovery box under a failed-send divider ("Fix the number and resend") saves through `saveContactAndRetry` (`front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx`), which sent the typed phone straight to `clientsClient.update` and, on the backend's `customer.invalidPhone` 400, ran `setError(err.message)` — lib/api's `${method} ${path} failed: ${status}`. The phone input's value was `formatPhoneInput(draft.phone)`, whose `tenDigits` strips every non-digit, so a typed letter vanished and 9 digits were shown; Save was disabled only on an empty draft. REQ-399 (cycle 2, M17) fixed the same class in the sibling `keepAndSend` only. `saveContactAndRetry` introduced in c2b7c2cf.
**Requirement:** before saving, the recovery box checks each asked field with `recoveryContactErrors` (`front-end/lib/send-dialog.ts`): a phone with a letter → `asstChat.recovery.phoneLetters` ("Phone numbers use digits only — remove the letter." / es), a phone that is not a full number → `customer.invalidPhone` ("Enter a full phone number — 10 digits, area code first."), a malformed email → `customer.invalidEmail` (REQ-278 rule); the error shows under the fields (`data-cy="recovery-phone-error"` / `recovery-email-error`, the input `aria-invalid`), Save and resend is disabled while any is shown, and `saveContactAndRetry` returns before the PUT on one. The phone box shows the raw text when it carries a letter (`recoveryPhoneValue`), the as-you-type mask otherwise. A refused save shows `tFor(lang, contactSaveErrorKey(err))` (REQ-399) — never `err.message`. Guard: the count of `setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message …)` in AsstChat may only fall (ratchet ≤ 17; the other 17 are outside this issue's scope).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/contact-retry-validate.test.ts` ("REQ-603 …": "512-867-53O9" and "512-867-5309x" → phoneLetters; "512-867-539" → invalidPhone; full numbers masked or not pass; "bob at gmail" → invalidEmail; blanks pass; `recoveryPhoneValue` keeps the letter and masks digits; en/es carry every key, differ, and none is a transport line; `saveContactAndRetry` calls `recoveryContactErrors(` before `clientsClient.update(`, uses `tFor(lang, contactSaveErrorKey(err))`, no `err.message`; the card uses `recoveryPhoneValue`, renders `recovery-phone-error` with `aria-invalid`, and Save's `disabled` reads `recoveryErrs.phone`; the err.message ratchet) · integration n/a — no backend change; the server's `customer.invalidPhone` 400 is already pinned over HTTP by REQ-278/REQ-399, and the client's mapping of a real `ApiError` by REQ-399's `contactSaveErrorKey` unit test · e2e `e2e/contact-retry-validate/contact-retry-validate.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-603 (en|es) …": a quote texted to a 555-01XX number opens the recovery box; typing "512-867-53O9" keeps the "O" visible, shows the worded letter error, disables Save, sets aria-invalid; "512-867-539" shows the 10-digits copy and Save stays disabled; "5128675309" clears the error and enables Save; no "failed: NNN" / "PUT /customers" on screen).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-contact-retry-validate off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit -- unit/contact-retry-validate.test.ts` → "Tests: 10 failed, 10 total" (`recoveryContactErrors is not a function`, `recoveryPhoneValue is not a function`, missing `asstChat.recovery.phoneLetters`, wiring checks; ratchet 18 > 17); `shots run e2e/contact-retry-validate -- --no-check` → "✗ REQ-603 (en) … locator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded" and the same for (es) (no `recovery-phone-error`). GREEN — `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 326 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 3211 passed"; `shots run e2e/contact-retry-validate e2e/sms-recovery -- --no-check` → "✓ REQ-603 (en)", "✓ REQ-603 (es)", "✓ REQ-226 (en/es)", "✓ REQ-525 (en/es)"; `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/` → "ok | 309 passed | 0 failed"; `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on `islands/AsstChat.tsx` and `lib/send-dialog.ts`; `deno fmt --check` clean on `lib/send-dialog.ts` and the two new tests (`static/assistant-page.css` was already fmt-unclean at the base, left as it was; AsstChat.tsx not formatted, known-unformattable).
## REQ-584 — Job Details versions never differ only by a word (demo-loop cycle 4, issue p4-p1d)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `p4-p1d` — "Job Details options differ only by a word" (pair 1, one-scope interior paint job, 3 bedrooms: "3 almost identical options (Standard/Concise/Detailed)", stdout 186/233). RCA verdict LIKELY, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`; related `p4-p5a`; still present from cycle 3 m13.
**Cause (RCA):** the only dedupe, `dedupeOptionsByBullets` → `sameBullets` (`shared/quote-flow/option-bullets.ts`), collapsed EXACT twins only (same lines, same order), so model versions differing by one word all survived. `padToThree` (`backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/generate-job-options/mod.ts`) padded short answers with a "· Short version" that is the same words regrouped into fewer lines and a "· Wider scope" that only appends "Jobsite cleanup" — near-twins by construction, then labelled Concise / Standard / Detailed.
**Requirement:** two versions are twins when their bullets are equal (REQ-330) or when the word sets across all their bullets overlap by a token-set Jaccard of `NEAR_TWIN_OVERLAP` = 0.85 or more (case, accents, punctuation, line breaks and a plural "s" are not differences); twins collapse to the first, order kept. This applies to the model's options, to `padToThree` (a pad variant that is a near-twin of an option on the list is skipped) and to the edit-reopen seed. A one-item job (one bullet) is not padded at all. The degraded heuristic fallback (LLM down: server `fallbackOptions`, island `localFallbackOptions`) keeps the REQ-330 exact-only rule (`dedupeOptionsByBullets(…, { exact: true })`) — its three versions are titled "· Short version" / "· Wider scope" and several browser stories depend on them. Amends REQ-028 (a three-line one-option reply is now padded with the wider version only) and the REQ-330 seed / REQ-392 step fixtures, which used near-twin versions.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/option-near-twins.test.ts` ("REQ-584 …": threshold ~0.85; one-word twins; case/accents/plurals; regrouped lines are twins; real concise/detailed versions are not; pair 1's three cards collapse to the first; a distinct version between twins survives; the seed drops a near-twin; exact mode) and `jest/unit/job-options-seed.test.ts` (REQ-330 seed fixture amended) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/generate-job-options/int.test.ts` ("REQ-584 …": three one-word model twins → one card; a one-bullet job is not padded; padding never adds a near-twin; the degraded fallback keeps three titled versions; REQ-028 padding test amended) and `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/step.int.test.ts` (REQ-392 fixture now three really different versions) · e2e n/a — the picker renders whatever options the endpoint returns; the change is in the option set the server computes, pinned at integration level, and the existing picker stories run on the stub's degraded fallback, which is unchanged.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-option-near-dupes off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern option-near-twins` → "Tests: 8 failed, 8 total" (`nearTwinBullets is not a function`); backend with `nearTwinBullets` shimmed to the old `sameBullets` → `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/generate-job-options/int.test.ts` → "34 passed | 3 failed" (`[["Paint walls in 3 bedrooms, two coats"],["Paint the walls in 3 bedrooms, two coats"],["Paint walls in 3 bedrooms, two full coats"]]`; one-bullet job padded with `[…,"Jobsite cleanup"]`). GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv --parallel src/agents` → "804 passed | 0 failed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 326 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 3210 passed"; `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on `islands/AsstChat.tsx`, `shared/quote-flow/option-bullets.ts` and the touched backend files; `deno fmt` on the new test and option-bullets.ts.

## REQ-590 — The language picked on /verify is the new account's language, and the dev code survives that toggle (demo-loop cycle 4, issues M33, p4-p6d)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issues `M33` — "Onboarding ignores language picked on code page" (fleet-5: "on Check your phone click ES (URL lang=es) … /welcome came up in English") — and `p4-p6d` — "Dev-code popup vanishes after switching to ES". RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD on both at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** REQ-414 (a4f497ee, cycle 2) gave /verify an EN | ES toggle that only re-navigates with `?lang=` and writes pm_lang. `front-end/islands/CodeInput.tsx` posted verify-otp with `{ phoneNumber, code }` only and the backend took no language there, so `verify-otp/mod.ts` (master path and normal path) gave a new account the OTP record's language — "en" from the English landing — and /welcome reads `user.language` before the cookie. Separately, `front-end/lib/dev-code.ts` `takeDevCode` removed the stash on CodeInput's mount, so the toggle's full-page navigation mounted CodeInput again with nothing left.
**Requirement:** CodeInput sends the language showing on /verify (`langSignal.value`) with verify-otp; `/auth/verify-otp` and `/auth/verify` accept an optional `language` (en | es only); a NEW account is born in it over the OTP record's on both the master-code and the normal path, and an existing account keeps its saved language (`deriveLanguageOnVerify(existing, otpLanguage, pickedLanguage)`). The dev code is peeked, not taken, on CodeInput's mount, so the toggle keeps the popup; it is cleared on a signed-in verify and when the popup is closed, and a resend re-stashes the new code — a reload after close still shows no stale code (REQ-082).
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/users/domain/business/derive-language/test.ts` ("REQ-590 …" ×3) and `jest/unit/verify-page-lang.test.ts` ("REQ-590 …": peek keeps the code across mounts, other phone's code hidden, clear removes it, resend replaces it; CodeInput sends `language: langSignal.value`, peeks, re-stashes on resend, clears on success/close); `jest/unit/dev-code.test.ts` (REQ-082) now expects `peekDevCode` · integration `backend/src/users/domain/coordinators/verify-otp/int.test.ts` ("REQ-590 …": normal path, master-code path, existing account unchanged) and `backend/src/users/entrypoints/auth-controller/int.test.ts` ("REQ-590 /auth/verify-otp and /auth/verify take the language picked on /verify for a new account": send-otp "en", verify "es" → account "es" on both routes; "fr" refused, no account) · e2e `e2e/verify-page-lang/verify-page-lang.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-590: …": /landing?lang=en → /verify popup → ES on the toggle → the same code still pops up → Use → /welcome "Lo primero — ¿cómo te llamamos?" with ES pressed).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-verify-page-lang off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check` on the three backend files → "FAILED | 25 passed | 4 failed" (the new-account cases: "Values are not equal", account born "en"; the typed run fails TS2554/TS2353 — no `language` parameter); `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Tests: 6 failed" (`devCode.peekDevCode is not a function`, verifyOtp call has no `language: langSignal.value`); `shots run e2e/verify-page-lang` → "✗ … p4-p6d: after ES on /verify the dev-code popup is gone", and with only the dev-code half fixed → "✗ … the page never showed \"Lo primero — ¿cómo te llamamos?\"" (M33). GREEN — backend derive-language, verify-otp, auth-controller, send-otp → "ok | 53 passed | 0 failed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 326 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 3207 passed"; `shots run e2e/verify-page-lang e2e/dev-code` → "✓ REQ-082 … 36s", "✓ REQ-590 … 5s"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on CodeInput.tsx, lib/dev-code.ts, clients/verify.ts, routes/api/auth/verify.ts; `deno fmt --check` clean on CodeInput.tsx, dev-code.ts and the new tests (clients/verify.ts was already not fmt-clean on demo-fixes, untouched lines, left as is). ## REQ-567 — An invoice track opens when it has items, and a phone-only client is billed by text (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m37)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `m37`: "Only invoice in collapsed 04 Upcoming; 'No billing email' with no text option for phone-only client". RCA: analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** (1) `front-end/islands/QuoteTrack.tsx` seeded its open state from localStorage before `defaultOpen`, and an effect wrote that state back on every mount. A visit to /invoices while Upcoming was empty (`defaultOpen={scheduled.length > 0}` = false) stored `invoices:track:upcoming`="0". That "0" then beat `defaultOpen=true`, so pair 3's only invoice was hidden. (2) `missingInfo` (`shared/documents/invoice-form.ts`) pushed `noBillingEmail` whenever the email was empty and ignored the phone, although the form dispatches by text when a phone exists.
**Requirement:** a track remembers only the user's own collapse/expand. ## REQ-580 — The conversation list shows a thread's title and latest answer the moment they land (demo-loop cycle 4, issues p4-p2d + p4-p7b)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issues `p4-p2d` "Conversation preview lags one answer" (pair 2: the sidebar preview showed the previous wizard answer) and `p4-p7b` "Conversation title stays 'New conversation —'" (pair 7: the details-first thread read "New conversation —" all through the options). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD for both at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** (1) `POST /agents/conversations/:id/draft { note }` (P-22, cb090170) appended the details-first note as a user message but set neither title nor preview, so the list fell back to "New conversation" + "—" until the quote bound (REQ-447). (2) The server writes the preview on every wizard answer (`handle-wizard-answer` `convPatch.preview = pickLine`) and chat turn, but AsstThreads re-read the list only on its 8–60 s poll, a status change, or the thread's FIRST chat turn (REQ-442's `THREAD_TURN_EVENT`); `postWizardAnswer`, later chat turns and `ensureConversationForDraft` published nothing.

Every turn the chat lands — the draft note, each wizard answer, each chat turn — publishes `THREAD_TURN_EVENT` carrying the server's new title/preview; the list patches that row in place at once (`applyThreadTurn`) and re-reads soon after.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/thread-list-freshness.test.ts` ("REQ-580 …": `applyThreadTurn` patches only that row, keeps the title on a preview-only turn, never blanks, leaves an unknown thread alone; `publishThreadTurn` carries title/preview; wiring — `ensureConversationForDraft` publishes after the /draft post, `postWizardAnswer` after `answerWizard`, every chat turn publishes with `res.conversation`, AsstThreads' turn handler calls `applyThreadTurn` before `setTimeout(refresh`) · integration/e2e (booted app over HTTP) `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/conversations-controller/thread-title.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-580 e2e (p4-p7b) …": mint + first note → title and preview are the note on the response, the list row, `threadTitle` and the chat header; a second note does not retitle; a quote-bound thread keeps its jobName title) · browser e2e n/a — the sidebar change is the pure `applyThreadTurn` plus event wiring, both pinned by the unit file; the browser lane is not run per cycle-4 fix scope.

## REQ-605 — The worker screen's refresh backs off while idle and polls only the tasks (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m19)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `m19` — "Heavy polling (/api/admin/users, worker page)"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** `front-end/islands/WorkerScreen.tsx` (REQ-143, fd52cfa2) ran a fixed `setInterval(…, REFRESH_MS = 5000)` with no idle back-off, and every tick ran `load()`: `workerClient.me()` then `tasks()` + `taskTypes()` — three requests every 5 s (pair 8: "~8 times in ~30 s"), although me and the task types rarely change. The /admin half of m19 is REQ-424's designed ceiling (5 s base, 60 s idle cap, input resets it), not a defect, and is not changed here.
**Requirement:** /worker polls through REQ-221's scheduler with REQ-424's back-off — 5 s while someone uses the page, doubling to a 60 s cap while idle, back to 5 s on any input (`front-end/lib/worker-refresh.ts` `startWorkerRefresh`). A tick reads `/field/worker/tasks` only. The full read (me + tasks + task types) runs on the first load, on login, on a language pick on the EN/ES switch, on logout, and on the catch-up after the tab was hidden; a tasks read that gets 401 falls back to it so the sign-in form returns. An action's reload reads the tasks only. REQ-508's skip-the-tick-after-an-action gate is kept.

## REQ-576 — A quote whose summary names a saved customer ("— Bob Smith") is bound to that customer; the wizard never asks again who it is for (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m26)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `m26` — "Quote wizard asks again who quote is for; two different flows for same task"; RCA analyst LIKELY, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19` (pair 10 stdout:305-306: card "Electrical outlet installation — Bob Smith", then "Is this for a business or a person?" although Bob Smith was a saved customer).
**Cause (RCA):** the create_quote branch of `HandleChatMessage` (`backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/mod.ts`) bound a customer only through `customerFromTypedFacts` — a "for <Name>" lead-in, a 10-digit phone, an email, or a Capitalized full name in the user's own turns. The model's summary ("… — Bob Smith") was never read, so a lowercase / partial name or a bad phone left `conv.customerId` and `quote.customerId` empty, and lock-quote's CTA (`lock-quote/mod.ts`, known customer only from `conv.customerId ?? quote.customerId`) asked Business or Person again.
**Requirement:** after create_quote, when the typed facts bind nobody, the name after the summary's spaced dash is a hint matched ONLY against the account's own customers (accent- and case-blind, whole name); exactly one match binds `conv.customerId` and the quote's `customerId`, so the lock CTA names them. Zero or several matches bind nothing and no customer is ever created from it. In the chat's customer step, with no typed name the summary's name fills the step's facts, so the step offers that saved customer or, when nobody has that name, opens its create form already filled. The "two flows" half of m26 (typed first message → LLM card vs the "I know my price" chip → price-first wizard) is by design per the RCA and is not changed here.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/c4-summary-customer.test.ts` ("REQ-576 m26 …": `customerNameFromSummary`, `findCustomerNamedInSummary` (one own match / duplicates / unknown / partial), `withSummaryCustomerName`, AsstChat hands `stepFacts` to the CustomerStepPanel); `jest/unit/quote-facts.test.ts` REQ-265 source-shape test amended to accept `stepFacts` · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts` ("REQ-576 m26: create_quote whose summary names one saved customer … binds them", "… the lock CTA names them instead of asking Business or Person", "… two saved customers of that name, or nobody saved, binds nothing and creates no customer") · e2e n/a — the trigger is the model's summary text, which the browser lane cannot script; the integration tests run the real coordinator + lock-quote on in-memory KV with a scripted model, and the island wiring is pinned by the unit source-shape test.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-bind-customer-summary off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts --filter REQ-576` → "FAILED | 1 passed | 2 failed" (customerId `undefined` vs Bob's id; CTA customerName `undefined` vs "Bob Smith"); `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/c4-summary-customer.test.ts` → "Tests: 12 failed" (helpers not defined, AsstChat not wired). ## REQ-578 — No $0.00 line on an assistant draft: unpriced steps fold into the priced line (demo-loop cycle 4, m34)

**User's words:** "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67), issue **m34** "$0.00 line items on assistant draft".

**Demo evidence:** pair 5 typed "Bathroom vanity swap for Derek Chen … $2,400 — actually make it $2,250"; the card read "Remove old vanity $0.00 / Install 36in vanity $2,250.00 / Install faucet $0.00". To a client that reads as free work.

**RCA (analyst + skeptic, UPHELD, at ad104a19):** gpt-4o-mini split the job into steps, put the whole price on one line and 0 on the others. Nothing rejected zero-priced lines. `quotePriceProblem` (shared/quote-flow/quote-price-guard.ts) flags only a negative line or a total <= 0. `settleQuotePrice` keeps lines that match the price, and `scaleLinesToTotal` keeps 0 lines at 0. Confirmed while fixing: `statedTotalCents` reads no stated total from this two-amount message, so the $2,250 came from the model.

**Requirement:** before a chat `create_quote` is saved (`stated-price/settleCreateQuote`), when the contractor gave the whole job's price (a stated total, or an amount typed in this message that the lines add up to) and the lines mix priced and $0 lines, the $0 lines fold into the largest priced line's description: "Install 36in vanity (incl. remove old vanity, install faucet)" / es "(incluye …)" (`chatCoordinator.priceCheck.includes`). The total, the summary and the other lines stay as they were. When the contractor gave no price, a $0 included line stays legal (REQ-267 "Paint supplied by Castro Painting", REQ-302). `prompts.systemQuote` (en + es) gains a NO $0 LINES rule: "Never output a line at 0 … group the unpriced steps into a priced line".

**Decision:** the fold happens at save, not in display ("Included" on card/PDF/q). The stored quote then has no $0 line, so the card, the PDF, /q and the email all agree with no change to their renderers.

**Tests:**
- unit: `backend/src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/test.ts` "REQ-578 m34 …": `foldZeroLines` (en, es, the largest host line, unchanged when all lines or no lines are priced). `settleCreateQuote` folds the demo draft with a stated total, after scaling, and with no stated total when the lines add up to a typed amount. A REQ-267 $0 included line with no price from the contractor stays put. `statedTotalCents` reads nothing from the demo message.
- int: `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/price-target.int.test.ts` "REQ-578 m34 …": the real coordinator, fed the demo model's payload, saves one $2,250 line with no $0.00 line and the card total is $2,250. The prompt the model receives (and both en/es `prompts.systemQuote`) carries the NO $0 LINES rule.
- e2e: n/a: the browser lane can't script gpt-4o-mini into a mixed $0 payload. The integration test drives the real coordinator and checks the persisted quote the card, PDF and /q render.

"es" : "en"`, ignoring `?lang=`, while the islands render from `resolveSsrLang` (state.lang > ?lang= > user.language > pm_lang) — so an es staff account on /admin?lang=en got an English page with a Spanish SiteFooter/DocTitle. Then `front-end/lib/dash-cache.ts` `writeCached` seeded `setLang(profile.user.language, { fromServer: true })` on the mount read and on every PROFILE_UPDATED refresh (StaffNamePrompt save), turning the whole page Spanish over the explicit ?lang=en.
**Requirement:** /admin's own language (footer, document title, greeting date) is `resolveSsrLang(ctx)` — the same language its islands paint. A page opened with an explicit `?lang=` keeps it: the dashboard cache's profile read does not override it (a `?lang=` is the user's choice for that page, as the topbar toggle writes it there). Without `?lang=` the profile still seeds the language (REQ-422 unchanged). The Spanish-first public default for landing / login (REQ-043 amendment, REQ-414) is a product decision and stays as it is.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/dash-cache.test.ts` ("REQ-592 (m5): on /admin?lang=en a profile saying es does not flip the page to Spanish", "REQ-592 (m5): without ?lang= the profile still seeds the language") · integration `front-end/lib/admin-lang-param.int.test.tsx` (the real /admin middleware + ssr-lang middleware + page in a Fresh app, backend in process: an es staff account's /admin?lang=en footer paints "Policies", not "Políticas"; without ?lang= it stays Spanish) · e2e `e2e/admin-lang-param/admin-lang-param.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-592 (m5): an es staff member on /admin?lang=en stays English — the footer at first paint, and after saving a name").

## REQ-534 — A drawn signature shows on the stage while it is drawn, at a visible width (demo-loop cycle 4, issue M8)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `M8` — "Drawn signature not mirrored on stage until after signing (pad empty)"; RCA analyst LIKELY, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** the recorder mirrored canvases only on a 1 s poll (`Date.now() - lastCanvasSweep >= 1_000`, `front-end/lib/demo-mode/mirror-record.ts` flush step 7), so live ink lagged up to a second; and the pad's pen width `Math.max(0.9, Math.min(3.2, 3.4 - speed*1.6))` (`front-end/islands/PublicSignQuote.tsx` drawStroke) put every fast stroke at 0.9 px — below one device pixel once the stage scales the customer's frame down (0.8 on pair 2, a phone fitted to a desktop on pair 3), so the stage's pad read as empty.
**Requirement:** a pointer event (pointerdown/move/up, capture) on a mirrored `<canvas>` schedules a canvas flush right away, throttled to `CANVAS_INK_MS` (100 ms), so the ink streams to the stage while it is drawn and the stroke's last state always goes out; only the canvases drawn on are read between 1 s sweeps; the listeners go with the recorder's pause. The pen width never drops below `MIN_STROKE_PX` = 1.6 px; the live pad and the exported PNG share one `strokeWidth` (`front-end/lib/signature-ink.ts`).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/signature-ink-mirror.test.ts` ("REQ-534 …": a pointermove on the pad sends its bitmap within 100 ms with the sweep pushed out; a 600 ms burst of moves gives ~one cv per 100 ms and the final ink; moves off the canvas send nothing; pointer listeners attach/detach; `strokeWidth` floors at 1.6 and still varies up to 3.2; PublicSignQuote draws with `strokeWidth`, no 0.9 floor) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change (the `cv` op is unchanged; REQ-242/380's fake-DOM wire tests in `jest/unit/demo-mode-mirror-dom.test.ts` still pass) · e2e n/a — the stage's mirror timing and the stroke's on-screen visibility at stage scale are judged by the next demo cycle (the RCA's open question); the browser lane has no stage-scale ink oracle.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-signature-ink-mirror off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first (with `strokeWidth` extracted unchanged at the 0.9 floor) — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/signature-ink-mirror.test.ts` → "Tests: 6 failed" (`CANVAS_INK_MS` undefined; burst "Expected: >= 5 Received: 0" cv ops; `listening("pointermove")` "Expected: 1 Received: 0"; `MIN_STROKE_PX` "Expected: >= 1.5 Received: 0.9"; the island had no `strokeWidth` import). GREEN — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'unit/(signature-ink-mirror|demo-mode|demo-stage|owner-cannot-sign|sign-gate|signer-name)'` → "Test Suites: 28 passed · Tests: 384 passed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` + `deno fmt --check` clean on the three touched front-end files and the new test.
## REQ-613 — A replaced logo reaches every sent quote and invoice at once (demo-loop cycle 4, issue M31)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `M31` — "New logo doesn't reach a sent quote for up to 5 min" (fleet-5: after "Reemplazar logo" the sent quote still showed the orange logo while the later invoice showed the blue one). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** `GET /public-logo/:kind/:id` (`backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/mod.ts`) served the owner's CURRENT logo with `cache-control: public, max-age=300`, and every surface drew it from a URL that never changes with the logo — `front-end/components/quote-doc.tsx` (`/api/public-logo/quote/${quote.id}`), `front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx` (`…/invoice/${invoice.id}`), `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/email-logo/mod.ts`. The browser reused its cached copy for five minutes (deliberate trade-off from 78471312).
**Requirement:** the logo's URL carries its version: the public quote/invoice projections return `contractor.logoVersion` (a short FNV-1a tag of the logo file id — never the id itself) next to `hasLogo`, and the pages and emails draw `/api/public-logo/<kind>/<id>?v=<logoVersion>` through one shared helper (`shared/quote-flow/public-logo-url.ts`). The route serves `?v=<current version>` with `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`; a bare URL or a stale `?v=` gets `no-cache` with the version as its `ETag`, and `If-None-Match` on an unchanged logo answers 304.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/logo-url-version.test.ts` ("REQ-613 …": the version is stable per file, differs per file, hides the id; the URL shape; quote-doc and /i/[id] render through `publicLogoUrl(…, logoVersion)`) and `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/email-logo/test.ts` ("REQ-613 emailLogo …"; REQ-160's expectations now include `?v=`) · integration/e2e `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-613 public e2e …": real server — logoVersion on the public quote and invoice, immutable cache on the versioned URL, no-cache + ETag + 304 on the bare one, a replaced logo changes the version and is served past the old ETag, a stale `?v=` is not cached immutably) · browser e2e n/a — the browser half is the `src` string (pinned by the unit test) plus standard HTTP caching of the headers the HTTP e2e pins; a browser-cache timing story would not add a deterministic check.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-logo-url-version off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/logo-url-version.test.ts` → "Cannot find module '../../shared/quote-flow/public-logo-url'"; `deno test -A src/paperwork/domain/business/email-logo/test.ts` → "TS2307 Cannot find module …/shared/quote-flow/public-logo-url.ts"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/e2e.test.ts --filter REQ-613` → "AssertionError: the public quote carries the logo's version". GREEN — `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 326 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 3204 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/business/email-logo/test.ts src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/` → "ok | 78 passed | 0 failed"; `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on quote-doc.tsx and routes/i/[id].tsx; `deno lint` clean on the backend files; `deno fmt --check` clean on the new/touched front-end and shared files.

## REQ-606 — /admin shows the staff member's own name the moment the name prompt saves it (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m20)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `m20` — "'(no name yet)' in /admin after saving name" (fleet-5, pair 6 employee). RCA analyst LIKELY / medium, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** `front-end/islands/StaffNamePrompt.tsx` saves the name (PUT /me) and calls `announceProfile` (PROFILE_UPDATED); DashTopbar, DashSidebar and SetupChecklist listen, `front-end/islands/AdminPage.tsx` did not. Its `rows` (users table, Accounts tab, Impersonate list) kept the placeholder, rendered as `adminPage.noNameYet`, until the next quiet `search()`; and `search()` returns early on `lockRef`, while a lock (Demo started) stops the REQ-424 poll for good — so the stale row stayed until a reload.

Other rows are untouched; a placeholder or blank name changes nothing. The deliberate "(no name yet)" label for other placeholder accounts (REQ-426) stays.

## REQ-553 — The /payments cash-flow chart is a coral fade, not solid black; no camelCase SVG attributes in islands/components (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m22)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `m22` — "Cash-flow chart filled solid black"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** `PSideFlow` in `front-end/islands/PaymentsPage.tsx` wrote its `#cfArea` gradient stops React-style, `stopColor` / `stopOpacity` (from 69b4ed4f). The JSX runtime is plain Preact (no compat): SSR prints `stop-color`, but the client render sets a literal `stopColor` attribute, which SVG ignores, so both stops fall back to black at opacity 1 and the `url(#cfArea)` area paints solid black. /payments renders after a client fetch, so users always see the client output.
**Requirement:** the cash-flow area's stops compute to coral #FF6B6B at 0.32 (top) and 0 (bottom) opacity in the browser. No `.tsx` under `front-end/islands` or `front-end/components` writes an SVG presentation attribute in camelCase (stopColor, stopOpacity, strokeWidth, strokeLinecap, fillOpacity, clipPath, textAnchor, …); the SVG names are used.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/svg-kebab-attrs.test.ts` ("REQ-553 …": a source sweep that bans camelCase SVG presentation attributes in islands/components; the `#cfArea` stops carry `stop-color` / `stop-opacity`) · integration n/a — front-end markup only, no backend or wire change · e2e `e2e/cashflow-chart-fill/cashflow-chart-fill.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-553 …": one landed Zelle payment, then /payments; `getComputedStyle` on both `#cfArea stop`s gives `rgb(255, 107, 107)` at 0.32 / 0).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-cashflow-svg-attrs off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/svg-kebab-attrs.test.ts` → "Tests: 2 failed" (`islands/PaymentsPage.tsx:1009 stopColor` … `:1010 stopOpacity`; `Received string: "<stop offset=\"0%\" stopColor=\"#FF6B6B\" stopOpacity=\"0.32\" />"`); `shots run e2e/cashflow-chart-fill/cashflow-chart-fill.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check --filter REQ-553` → "✗ … top stop colour ([{"color":"rgb(0, 0, 0)","opacity":"1"},{"color":"rgb(0, 0, 0)","opacity":"1"}])". ## REQ-615 — A first plan pick's note states each charge with its date: today's, the 1st's prorated bill, then monthly (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m4)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `m4` — "Plan step confusing ($99 today · prorated on the 1st); one click jumps to the pay page; test pay page shows no amount" (9 of 9 customers asked "do I pay 99 today or less?"). The real first-pick schedule (REQ-129, `anchoredSchedule` in `shared/quote-flow/plan-switch.ts`) is two charges before the steady one: the full month today (paid through a month later), then on the next 1st a SECOND, prorated bill for the days of that month past the paid-through date, then the full price every 1st. The note named neither the prorated amount nor its date, so "prorated" read as describing today's charge. Introduced e083cfb9 (REQ-129 copy), put on the onboarding card by bf9f9582 (REQ-356).

The prorated amount is to the cent (what the CRM charges); dates are UTC, the calendar the schedule is computed in. No plan note says "prorated on the 1st" without its amount and date. Not changed: one click on a card still goes to the pay page (by design, REQ-059/356); the fake pay page (/pay/fake, test-only, never minted in production) still shows no amount — the RCA rated it a test artifact, and the skeptic noted its "Paid." state already exists.

## REQ-568 — Fixing the phone number resends only the text, never the email again (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m44)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `m44` — "Fixing SMS number re-sends the email too" (pair 10: a quote sent by email + text; the email went out, the text failed; after correcting the number, Save and resend emailed the customer a second time). RCA analyst CONFIRMED (high), skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** the recovery card's Save and resend passed `channel: inferredChannel` to `saveContactAndRetry` (`front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx`), and `inferredChannel = dp.channel ?? <derived from which failure reason is present>`. `dp.channel` is the original send's channel ("both"), so it always won over the failure-derived channel and the retry called `sendQuoteFlow(…, "both")`.
**Requirement:** a recovery resend retries ONLY the channel(s) that failed, read from the send's outcome (`emailedTo`/`textedTo` vs `emailFailureReason`/`smsFailureReason`), never from the original channel: "sms" when only the text failed, "email" when only the email failed, "both" only when both failed. `retryChannel` in `front-end/lib/send-delivery.ts` decides; the island uses it.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/retry-failed-channel.test.ts` ("REQ-568 …": email delivered + text failed → "sms"; text delivered + email failed → "email"; both failed → "both"; single-channel and pre-channel dividers; nothing failed → undefined; the island resends via `retryChannel(dp)`, not `dp.channel ??`) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change; the backend already honours the channel it is given, the bug was which channel the client asked for · e2e `e2e/sms-recovery/sms-recovery.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-568: after a both-channel send whose email delivered, Save and resend retries only the text": a real "both" send to a customer with an email and a fictional 555-01XX phone, then the card's Save and resend POSTs `channel: "sms"`).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c4-retry-failed-channel off demo-fixes ad104a19):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern retry-failed-channel` → 7 failed (`retryChannel is not a function`; the island still matched `inferredChannel … = dp.channel ??`); `SHOTS_DIR=<private> SHOTS_SERVE_TIMEOUT=400000 shots run e2e/sms-recovery/sms-recovery.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check --filter REQ-568` with the old island → "✗ REQ-568 … expectation failed: the resend retries only the text, not the email: channel \"both\"". GREEN — `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 326 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 3208 passed"; the whole sms-recovery file → "5 passed" (REQ-226 en/es, REQ-525 en/es, REQ-568); `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on `lib/send-delivery.ts`, `islands/AsstChat.tsx`; `deno fmt` clean on send-delivery.ts, the new unit test and the e2e file (all were clean before).
## REQ-544 — On /worker the demo pill's End button, its question and the "(you)" chip keep the viewer's language (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m49)

**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 4 (run r857a9d67, demo-report.md), issue `m49`: "Worker sign-in turns the owner's browser and the demo pill Spanish ('… Connected · [Terminar demo]')". The RCA analyst CONFIRMED it and the skeptic UPHELD it at demo-fixes `ad104a19`.
**Cause (RCA):** REQ-494 (cycle 3, M43) sent only the overlay's own strings through `demoChromeLang`, which keeps the viewer's stored language on /worker. The pill's child components still imported the global `t` from `front-end/lib/i18n.ts`, and that `t` reads the live `langSignal`. REQ-285 sets `langSignal` to the signed-in worker's language on /worker. The affected components were `front-end/components/demo-mode/EndDemo.tsx` (`demoMode.end/endAsk/endYes/endNo`) and `PresenterChips.tsx` (`demoMode.you`). DemoModeOverlay rendered both without passing a language, so the pill read "… Connected · [Terminar demo]".
**Requirement:** EndDemo and PresenterChips never read the global `t`. They take a required `t` prop. DemoModeOverlay passes its demo-chrome `t`, now shared as `demoChromeT` in `front-end/lib/demo-chrome-t.ts` (the same REQ-494 logic, moved). DemoStage passes its own `t`. On /worker, with `langSignal` = "es" and the stored language "en", End, "End for everyone?", "Yes, end it", "Keep going" and "(you)" appear in English. The rest of the /worker page still follows the worker's language (REQ-285/416).

## REQ-552 — "Payment received" from an invoice card brings the pay form on screen and focuses it (demo-loop cycle 4, issue m25)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." ## REQ-621 — one rule for what is a real issue, used by the demo testers and the judge (2026-11-12)

Raphael (2026-11-12): "I think we need to figure out a rule. So that it's crystal clear. What is the line between a nitpick? What is pedantic? And what is a real suggestion? Because even feature requests, sometimes are features that are missing from the product." Then: "How about you judge whether it's picky or pedantic? So we add another step that evaluates … Every single one of these issues. How about you also give these rules to the... Testers, so that they know."

Why: the loop's root-cause step marked real defects "NOT_A_BUG" or "FEATURE_GAP" and left them unfixed. Examples: "Settings shows empty Street/State that onboarding saved"; the plan step contradicting the landing page price; no reminder on an unpaid invoice.

Requirement:
- `demo-loop/ISSUE-RULES.md` defines nine categories, checked in order with the first match winning. Each has an action: fix, owner list, log or drop.
- Every polish-visible defect is checked before NITPICK, so nothing a user would notice can be called a nitpick.
- The demo testers (both agents in `demo20b.sh`) read the file and tag every issue they report.
- The demo-loop judge step (`cycle.js`, outside the repo; LOOP-002 in `v2/demo-loop/requirements.md`) applies the same file to every issue.

Tests:
- unit: `demo-loop/demo20b_test.ts` "REQ-621: the rules file names every category, in order, each with an action" (the rules file is executed by agents, so it gets a content test).
- int: `demo-loop/demo20b_test.ts` "REQ-621: both testers are told to read the rules and tag every issue" runs the real harness with a fake fleet-claude.
- e2e: the next demo cycle; its reports carry category tags.

## REQ-698 — Dashboard and Quotes counts agree with the real state (demo-loop cycle 5, issue m14)
**Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 5 (run r37f88707, demo-report.md), issue `m14` "Dashboard and Quotes counts disagree with the real state". RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `2444608a`.
**Cause (RCA):** four mechanisms. (1) Pair 10 saw "QUOTES PENDING 0 … 1 draft is ready to send" while the draft was mid-wizard. `compute-dashboard-stats` counted every real draft, and `dashQuotesEmpty` worded any draft as `quotesAwaiting.emptyDrafts` ("ready to send"). (2) Pair 3 saw the menu badge "Cotizaciones 1" next to "En espera de respuesta 0" after the customer signed in another tab. The badge reads the dash cache (`pickSidebarCounts` → `stats.quotes.sent`), and nothing on /quotes called `refreshDash()`. (3) Pair 1 saw "AVG. PAID JOB $725" for a $1,450 job with only the deposit paid. `pickKpis` divided all YTD revenue by `countPaidJobs`, which counts a job once any installment is paid (REQ-562). (4) Pair 5's CO-002 never appeared in "What we handled today". Only `change_order_approved` / `change_order_declined` events existed, so a sent change order never became a notification.
**Requirement:**
- `GET /analytics/dashboard` returns `quotes.readyToSend`: the drafts whose thread status (the same `threadStatus` rule the chat header and the thread list use, via the shared `threadFlowOf`) is "readyToSend". The dashboard's empty line says "{n} draft(s) ready to send" only for those. Other drafts read `quotesAwaiting.emptyInProgress` — en "No quotes out yet — {n} draft in progress. Finish it to send.", es "Aún no hay cotizaciones enviadas — {n} borrador en curso. Termínalo para enviarlo." (plural forms too).
- The sidebar (`DashSidebar`) re-reads the dash (`refreshDash`) on every quote or invoice change the change feed hears (`followBadgeChanges`). Its badges follow the document on every page, /quotes included.
- "Avg. paid job" averages COMPLETED jobs only (every non-void invoice paid, `isJobComplete`, last payment this year). The numerator is what those jobs were paid (`revenue.paidJobsYtdCents`), the divisor is their count (`revenue.paidJobsYtd`). A paid deposit with the balance still scheduled is not a paid job. This amends REQ-562's "one job has been paid on" assertion.
- `SendChangeOrderAlert`, which every change-order send path goes through (the assistant, a chat edit, the invoice controller), emits `{entityType: "invoice", action: "change_order_sent", data: {number, delta, customerName}}` when the order reached the customer. `notificationL10n` maps it to `notify.invoice.changeOrderSent[Amount]`: en "Change order CO-002 (+$400.00) sent to Linda", es "Orden de cambio CO-002 (+$400.00) enviada a Linda".
**Tests:**
- unit: `backend/src/analytics/domain/business/signed-jobs/test.ts` ("REQ-698 … completedJobsInYear"), `backend/src/communication/domain/coordinators/notify-on-event/test.ts` ("REQ-698 … change_order_sent maps …"), `front-end/lib/dashboard-kpis.test.ts` ("REQ-698 pickKpis …"), `jest/unit/dash-counts-truth.test.ts` (dashQuotesEmpty ready vs in progress; en/es copy; DashboardPage passes `readyToSend`; `followBadgeChanges` re-reads on a quote/invoice change and not on others; DashSidebar is wired to it).
- integration: `backend/src/analytics/domain/coordinators/compute-dashboard-stats/counts-truth.int.test.ts` (mid-wizard draft → readyToSend 0, finished → 1; deposit-only job → paidJobsYtd 0 / cents 0, a fully paid job → 1 / its total), `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-change-order-alert/int.test.ts` ("REQ-698 …": a delivered CO emits `change_order_sent` with number/delta/customer; one that reached nobody emits nothing). REQ-562's case in `receivables.int.test.ts` is amended.
- e2e: `backend/src/analytics/entrypoints/dashboard-controller/e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-698 … analytics e2e") — over HTTP through the real AnalyticsModule wiring. Browser lane n/a here: the islands render these server counts verbatim, and the wiring is pinned by the jest source and behaviour tests above.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c5-dash-counts off demo-fixes 2444608a):**
- RED first:
