## REQ-670 — The assistant's reply streams into its bubble as it is written, and the waiting bubble says in words what the turn is doing (demo-loop cycle 5, issues p7 + c1-nc-6 + c2-nc-stream + c4-nc-no-streaming)

**Requirement (user's words):** "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 5 (run r37f88707, demo-report.md), issue p7 "Assistant replies never stream and show no typing in the text" (pairs 3 and 7, both sides; demo-report.md:52 "No streaming on either side (3, 7)", :84, :788), and the backlog it repeats: c1-nc-6 "Assistant never streams a reply: replies arrive whole after 'Setting up…'", c2-nc-stream "Assistant replies never stream and there is no typing indicator on either side", c4-nc-no-streaming "Assistant replies never stream tokens on either side". Judged BUG_POLISH (REQ-621's rules name it).
**Root cause (RCA, FEATURE_GAP + skeptic UPHELD, at 2444608a):** POST /api/agents/chat ran the whole coordinator (the model call, tool settling, re-asks, price checks) and answered one JSON `{conversation, newMessages}`; nothing in `backend/src/agents` streamed (`rg 'event-stream|ReadableStream|stream: true'` → none). `AsstChat.tsx` awaited the whole turn and appended `res.newMessages`; its typing bubble was three dots with only an aria-label.
**Fix:**
- `LLMRequest.stream` (`LLMStreamSink`, `llm/base`): OpenAILLMClient asks for `stream: true`, hands each prose piece to the sink as it arrives, joins tool-call pieces per index (the sink is only told the first offered tool started, and hears no prose after it) and returns the same whole LLMResponse — same 30 s bound, same empty-answer retry; a JSON-mode call never streams. StubLLMClient streams its text word by word (`STUB_STREAM_PIECE_MS` = 20) then the tool name, so every lane can prove streaming without a key.
- New `backend/src/agents/domain/business/chat-stream/mod.ts`: `turnChannel` (the prose shaped like the stored reply → `delta` while it only grows, `text` when shaping rewrote it; `progress` pricing / drafting / saving, said once in a row; a tool starting is drafting for create_quote, saving otherwise) and `sseTurn` (text/event-stream, `cache-control: no-cache, no-transform`; `done` = the JSON route's turn; `error` {message, name}; the turn still finishes and saves when the client leaves).
- `HandleChatMessage` (`HandleChatInput.onEvent`): the model's first answer and the price explanation stream through `chatProse` (= the stored reply's `toPlainChatText(stripCustomerAsk(…))`); the re-asks never stream; "pricing" while the pricing engine runs (chat question, Pick-a-price re-price), "drafting"/"saving" while a tool turn is applied; the Pick-a-price answer streams too, to a client that asks for the stream (the island's own Pick-a-price turns stay JSON — below). Without `onEvent` nothing changes.
- POST /agents/chat/stream (`ChatController.stream`, sharing a module-level `readTurn` with POST /agents/chat): refuses what the JSON route refuses (401, empty content, missing file) before any stream starts. POST /agents/chat is unchanged and stays the fallback.
- Front-end: `front-end/lib/chat-stream.ts` (`parseSse`, `readChatStream` — a server TimeoutError stays a TimeoutError so the chat shows its message and Retry; a stream without `done` is an error — `pendingReply`, `pendingLabelKey`), `api.postStream`, `assistantClient.chatStream` (404/405 → POST /agents/chat; any other refusal is the turn's error, never a second send). AsstChat's typed and voice turns, and a step turn whose answer lands in the thread (a wizard question, the review), go through it; Pick a price and the Job details picker (`stepOwnsAnswer`, `shared/quote-flow/step-composer.ts`, also what StepComposer uses) cover the thread with their panel and say the turn on the step in words (REQ-442), so nothing streamed would be seen there and their turns stay on POST /agents/chat. The pending bubble — `front-end/components/PendingReplyBubble.tsx`, fed a signal (`useSignal`) that only it reads, so a streamed piece re-renders the bubble and never the 12,800-line island — shows the reply as it streams (`data-cy=msg-streaming`, `white-space: pre-wrap`), else the dots plus a visible label (`data-cy=msg-typing-label`, `asstChat.reply.*`: "Assistant is thinking…" / "Pricing the job…" / "Drafting the quote…" / "Saving…", es "El asistente está pensando…" / "Calculando el precio…" / "Preparando la cotización…" / "Guardando…"). The bubble is ordinary DOM, so the demo stage (mirror-record's MutationObserver, characterData) mirrors it.
**Tests:**
- unit: `backend/src/agents/domain/data/openai/stream.test.ts` ("REQ-670 OpenAILLMClient: …" ×7 — stream:true asked and the first piece reaches the sink before the rest is sent; a tool call held back, told once, parsed whole; two calls; no sink / JSON mode never stream; an empty streamed answer asked again; a throwing sink never breaks the turn), `backend/src/agents/domain/business/llm/implementations/stub/stream.test.ts` (×3), `backend/src/agents/domain/business/chat-stream/test.ts` (×11 — deltas, a rewrite as `text`, blanks, tool stages, stage once in a row, SSE frame, headers before the turn ends, error/TimeoutError frames, the turn finishes after the client leaves), `jest/unit/c5-chat-stream.test.ts` (×15 — parseSse, pendingReply, the en/es labels, readChatStream, chatStream's route/headers/404 fallback/400 not re-sent, AsstChat's typed/voice/thread-step turns stream, a step that owns its answer (price, job_details) asks the JSON way and StepComposer uses the same rule, the bubble component has the streaming text and the label, the live reply is a `useSignal` the island never reads), `front-end/lib/pending-reply-bubble.test.tsx` (×3, deno — the label in words per stage in en/es; the prose replaces the label; in a live Preact tree each streamed piece re-renders the bubble once and the chat around it never).
- int: `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/stream.int.test.ts` (×7 — a plain answer's deltas go out before the reply is saved and join to it; markdown shaped as stored; create_quote → prose then only "drafting"; a pricing question → "pricing" first, no JSON streamed; "lock it in" → "saving"; no onEvent → no request streams; the Pick-a-price answer streams).
- e2e: `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/stream.e2e.test.ts` (×3 over HTTP — ≥5 deltas arriving ≥100 ms before `done`, joining to the saved reply; a continued thread and the JSON route still answering; refusals before any stream) and `e2e/chat-reply-streams/chat-reply-streams.e2e.test.ts` (browser: on /assistant the waiting bubble shows "Assistant is thinking…" and the reply is seen growing in its bubble — two states or more, the first shorter than the last, the last the start of the reply that lands — before it lands as the message; not "each state a prefix of the next", because a real model's "- tip" is reshaped to "• tip" once the bullet is whole).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c5-assistant-streaming off demo-fixes 2444608a):** RED — `deno check` of the new backend tests: TS2307 "Cannot find module …/chat-stream/mod.ts", TS2353 "'stream' does not exist in type 'LLMRequest'" and "'onEvent' does not exist in type 'HandleChatInput'"; run with `--no-check`: OpenAILLMClient 5 failed ("the first piece never reached the sink before the rest"), the stub 2 failed ("streamed in pieces (got 0)"), the coordinator 7 failed, the HTTP route 2 failed (404); jest 13 failed ("Cannot find module '../../front-end/lib/chat-stream'"); the browser story against the base island → "expectation failed: the waiting bubble said it in words (saw labels: [])". GREEN — the five new backend files 31 passed; their neighbours (every handle-chat-message int, every chat-controller e2e, llm base/stub/select, openai unit) 240 passed; jest `c5-chat-stream` 13 passed and the whole jest unit project 393 suites / 3862 tests passed; front-end `deno lint` (431 files) and `deno check` clean; the browser story ✓ on a stub stack (backend `bootstrap/mod.ts` + Vite on random ports, `BASE_URL=… shots run e2e/chat-reply-streams`); through the Vite proxy the deltas arrived ~22 ms apart for ~440 ms before `done`.
**Evidence, follow-up (same branch, 2026-11-12):** two findings from running the neighbouring browser stories, both fixed. (1) The first cut sent every step turn to /agents/chat/stream, so stories that hold or stand in a price / Job-details step turn on `page.route("**/agents/chat")` no longer saw it — RED `e2e/job-picker-keep-selection` (REQ-446) on the first cut: "page.waitForFunction: Timeout 20000ms exceeded" waiting for its stood-in "New drain line"; nothing streamed on those steps was visible anyway (their panel replaces the thread), so they ask the JSON way again (`stepOwnsAnswer`) — GREEN job-picker-keep-selection ✓ (1m30s), step-composer 3/3 ✓ (REQ-442's hold, and REQ-392's review turn, which streams), chat-draft-offer ✓ (10 s); jest RED "TypeError: stepOwnsAnswer is not a function" → GREEN. (2) Every streamed piece re-rendered the whole island — measured in the browser by hooking the page's own Preact `options.diffed` during one turn whose 88 deltas arrived in 16–29 reads: AsstChat rendered 19 and 32 times (a few renders 50–400 ms on the loaded host); with the signal-fed `PendingReplyBubble` AsstChat renders 3 times a turn while the bubble renders once a read (31 and 69 renders for 30 and 68 reads). Deno RED "Module not found …/components/PendingReplyBubble.tsx" → GREEN 3 passed; the live-tree test fails ("the chat never re-rendered for a piece": 5 vs 1) when the chat reads the live reply in its own render, the first cut's shape. The story's question is now long (~1.8 s of stub streaming): on the loaded host the stub's 0.5 s echo once reached the page in a single 2,045-byte read (all 28 deltas) and showed as one state; with the long question it passed twice (24 s, 22 s). Whole jest unit project 393 suites / 3864 passed / 1 skipped; front-end `deno lint` (433 files) and `deno check` clean. Not this change: `e2e/price-step-question` story 2 (REQ-444) gets past the part this touches (its stood-in reply lands, the note and the details show the permit) and then waits for POST /quotes after a tier tap — since REQ-449 (eb0449a3, already in base 2444608a) a tap only selects, so that request never comes.
## REQ-697 — Invoices headlines and owner copy say when money moves; a scheduled invoice is a reminder, and the agreement states the days to pay (demo-loop cycle 5, issues m13 + m22)
**Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 5 (run r37f88707, demo-report.md): m13 "Invoices headlines get the timing of money wrong" (pair 1 19:05:39 "Quiet week — $725 coming next week" over an open $725 deposit due Nov 19; pair 2 19:06:01 "CUENTAS POR COBRAR · ESTA SEMANA — $180 en camino" for a bill due 19 dic; pair 4 19:24:34 "Próxima cuota: 22 nov" beside "VENCE 29 nov") and m22 "Invoices go out on a schedule the contractor didn't expect" (pair 3 19:06:17 "INV-001 Scheduled · Sends Nov 12" — "it's sending Maria the invoice TODAY on its own?"; pair 9 19:03:08 "se envía el 19 nov 2026, Vence 19 dic 2026 — el acuerdo solo decía Pago al finalizar"). RCA analyst + skeptic at demo-fixes `2444608a`: m13 CONFIRMED/UPHELD, m22 CONFIRMED (skeptic CORRECTED: nothing sends a scheduled invoice by itself — ScheduleInvoiceNudges only reminds the owner — so the defect is the wording).
**Cause (RCA):** `invoicesPage.eyebrow` was one constant "Receivables · this week" rendered in every hero mode (InvoicesPage.tsx ~990); `invoicesHeroMode` (front-end/lib/headline-counts.ts) chose "nextWeek" ("Quiet week —") whenever next week's forecast covered everything outstanding, even with a bill open; the scheduled hero showed `scheduledFor` (the reminder/send day) under "Next installment:" with no due date; `quotes.ledger.sends` "Sends {date}", `invoicesPage.subline.scheduled` "Scheduled to send {date}", `quotes.ledger.restScheduled` and `chatCoordinator.billing.next` "goes out {date}" told the owner the bill sends itself; the agreement's "Payment upon completion" never stated the account's days to pay (REQ-411's net days) that set the bill's due date; the owner's signing line for an after-completion job said only "{name} signed {quote}".
**Requirement:**
- The /invoices eyebrow follows the hero mode: "Receivables · this week" only for the this-week headline, "Receivables · next week" for the quiet-week one, plain "Receivables" / "Cuentas por cobrar" otherwise (`invoicesHeroEyebrowKey`).
- "Quiet week —" is never the headline while any bill is open (`outstandingCount > 0` → "outstanding"). This supersedes REQ-566's "next week is all that is out → quiet line" case.
- The scheduled hero reads "{amount} scheduled — not sent yet." / "{amount} programado — aún sin enviar.", and its sub-line names the reminder day and the due day: "Next installment — we'll remind you to send it on Nov 22 · due Nov 29 · 1 scheduled invoice" (es "Próxima cuota — te recordamos enviarla el 22 nov · vence el 29 nov").
- Every owner label for a scheduled invoice's date is a reminder to send, never an automatic send: "We'll remind you on {date} to send it" / "Te recordamos enviarla el {date}" (ledger, invoice card), and likewise the ledger's rest line, the chat's next-bill line and the Drafting KPI sub ("{n} scheduled, not sent").
- The agreement's payment term states the window: "Payment upon completion — due within {n} days of the invoice" / "Pago al finalizar — vence {n} días después de la factura" (0 days → "due when the invoice arrives"), on the /q page (public payload `contractor.invoiceNetDays` = the account's days to pay, default 30) and on the agreement PDF (the long value wraps at its dash inside the cell).
- When a signature schedules the after-completion bill, the owner's signing line names it: "{name} signed {quote} · INV-001 $2,850.00 is scheduled, not sent — we'll remind you on Nov 26, 2026 to send it (due Dec 26, 2026)" (es "… está programada, sin enviar — te recordamos enviarla el … (vence el …)"); the divider payload carries `scheduledInvoiceId`.
- en and es stay in sync.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/invoice-timing-copy-c5.test.ts` ("REQ-697 …" ×21: hero mode, eyebrow key + copy, scheduled hero copy + due date wiring, reminder wording on every owner key, the signing-line key, `paymentTermValue` en/es/0 days/other terms, quote-doc wiring), plus amended REQ-317/REQ-411/REQ-566 cases in `jest/unit/headline-counts.test.ts`, `jest/unit/completion-billing.test.ts`, `jest/unit/dashboard-headlines-c4.test.ts` and `front-end/lib/invoice-card.test.ts` · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/accept-quote/signed-chat.int.test.ts` ("REQ-697 m22 (en|es) …": a real public "Payment upon completion" signature over HTTP → the divider names the scheduled invoice, reminder and due dates; GET /quotes/:id/public carries `contractor.invoiceNetDays` 30) and `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-quote-pdf/payment-window.int.test.ts` ("REQ-697 (demo c5 m22) quote PDF …": the drawn PDF text states the window in en/es; 50/50 carries none) · e2e `e2e/headline-counts/headline-counts.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-317 / REQ-697 …": hero "$1,600 scheduled — not sent yet", eyebrow "Receivables", sub-line "Next installment — we'll remind you to send it on <d+21> · due <d+28>") and `e2e/invoice-card-c2/invoice-card-c2.e2e.test.ts` (card subline "We'll remind you on <date> to send it") — updated, not run here (the browser lane was out of scope for this fix; the unit tests pin the same strings and wiring).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c5-invoice-timing-copy off demo-fixes 2444608a):** RED first. `npx jest --no-watchman --selectProjects unit unit/invoice-timing-copy-c5.test.ts` against an export of origin/demo-fixes gave "Tests: 19 failed, 2 passed, 21 total" (`invoicesHeroMode` returned "nextWeek"; `invoicesHeroEyebrowKey` / `paymentTermValue` were missing; the copy still read "Sends {date}", "{amount} still to bill."). `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv render-quote-pdf/payment-window.int.test.ts accept-quote/signed-chat.int.test.ts --filter REQ-697` gave "FAILED | 1 passed | 3 failed": the divider was "Linda Perez signed Q-001" alone, and the PDF read "PLAZO DE PAGO Pago al finalizar" with no window. GREEN. The full jest unit project gave "Test Suites: 393 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 3870 passed". `deno test -A --unstable-kv` over render-quote-pdf/, accept-quote/, send-signed-confirmation/, public-controller/ and handle-chat-message/billing-actions.int.test.ts gave "ok | 134 passed | 0 failed". The front-end lib tests (invoice-card, invoice-card-nudge, quotes-hero-out-only, overpayment) gave "ok | 30 passed". `deno check` and `deno lint` were clean on every touched module. `deno fmt` was applied only to files that were fmt-clean at baseline, plus the new test. public-controller/mod.ts was already unformatted on demo-fixes and was left as is. ## REQ-709 — An app page's tab title and footer are in the page's language: every app route takes it from resolveSsrLang, and HtmlLang heals the title on mount (demo-loop cycle 5, issue m4)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 5 (run r37f88707, demo-report.md), issue `m4` — "Landing//login in Spanish for an English browser; ?lang=en does not stick; tab title in the other language"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `2444608a` (fleet-6 stdout:257: "/dashboard?lang=en had the title \"Panel · DocuMonster\" (html lang=\"en\")"). Only part (c), the tab title, is a bug; the Spanish landing default (REQ-002, `lib/lang.ts` pickLangFromAcceptLanguage) and `?lang=` as a one-request override are deliberate and unchanged.
**Cause (RCA):** `front-end/routes/dashboard/index.tsx:40` (and quotes:18, invoices:37, assistant/index:60, assistant/[threadId]:59, accounts-manager:20 — plus clients, payments, settings, work-orders, wo/[id], admins and the five field pages) built the DocTitle/SiteFooter `lang` from `user?.language` (the assistant routes from the profile read, "en" when it failed), while the islands and `<html lang>` render from `resolveSsrLang` (state.lang > ?lang= > user.language > pm_lang). REQ-592 fixed /admin only. And `islands/HtmlLang.tsx` skipped the signal's first value, so the title followed only a later switch and a wrong server title never healed.
**Requirement:** every route that renders the dashboard shell (DashTopbar / DashSidebar) takes its own language — DocTitle, footer, greeting date — from `resolveSsrLang(ctx) ?? "es"`, the islands' language; no route builds its DocTitle language from `user?.language` (/welcome keeps its own onboarding chain and is the one listed exception). HtmlLang sets the tab title from the DocTitle in its `initial` language on mount, not only on a later switch; a non-live title (a landing's own) is still left alone.

**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c5-route-doc-title off demo-fixes 2444608a):** RED first — `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/route-doc-title-lang.int.test.tsx` → "FAILED | 6 passed | 6 failed" (/dashboard?lang=en title "Panel · DocuMonster"; /accounts-manager?lang=en "Gestor de cuentas"; /assistant and /assistant/:id without ?lang= "Assistant · DocuMonster" for an es account); `deno test -A lib/html-lang-title.test.tsx` → "FAILED | 1 passed | 1 failed" (title stayed "Panel · DocuMonster" after the mount effect ran); `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern unit/route-doc-title-lang` → "Tests: 35 failed, 16 passed"; `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/route-doc-title/route-doc-title.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → "✗ … /quotes?lang=en: the server's <title> — expected \"Quotes · DocuMonster\", got \"Cotizaciones · DocuMonster\"". ## REQ-645 — The presenter's pointer is found again by WHAT he pointed at, never by where his still mouse is; a fraction the stage cannot name an element for is "pointing…", never an arrow; an element out of view is a chevron where the page can be seen; another tab followed drops his pointer and says so (demo M1, M2, m36, c4-M6 — cycle 5)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 5 (run r37f88707, `demo-loop/runs/r37f88707/demo-report.md`): **M1** — "The presenter's pointer points at the wrong thing after the customer's content moves" (9 pairs: the arrow ends on "Half a day", "TBD", "or a person?", "Back" instead of "Dashboard", "Enviar recordatorio", or jumps to the header search bar, the footer or the empty strip at the bottom with a dashed ring; "Your pointer is sitting on 'Eliminar factura' (delete!)"); **M2** — "The presenter's pointer is missing after a page or tab change, and at the start, until he moves the mouse" (8 pairs; "the arrow stayed frozen on 'Inicio'" after a stage reload); **m36** — "he pointed at 'ES' on /customers; the arrow appeared on Linda's /q tab"; **c4-M6** (still present) — the pointer placed by screen position, so after the content scrolls its target is wrong. RCA at `2444608a` (cluster: pointer anchor identity).
**Cause (re-checked in this worktree at 2444608a):**
- REQ-538's look-up: a dead anchor (its element gone — a card swapped, a button replaced — or another page load) was re-anchored to `anchorOf(lastMove)`, the element under his STILL mouse once the replay settled: whatever the new content had at that spot ("or a person?" where "Lock it in" was; on another tab, "ES" or empty space). `lookAgain` was true for every dead node anchor, `resendPointer` fell back to it for a new page load, and `reanchorDelay` waited at least 1.5 s after every snapshot — a page change was dark that long (M2).
- A provisional fraction (his move before the replay could name an element) went out as a `move` and was drawn as an arrow at that fraction of her screen.
- `placeIn` clamped an element out of view onto the WINDOW's edge with a dashed ring: on a desktop the app's `.content` scroller sits under a 60 px topbar, so a row scrolled away was drawn over the topbar's search bar (or the strip under the footer); on a phone the sticky topbar covers the scrolled page and the arrow rode over it.
- The stage held ONE anchor with no notion of the customer's browser tab: following another tab kept REQ-538's look-up (m36); holding nothing (the start: /admin's hand-off is only a hint, REQ-539) it said nothing.
**Requirement:**
1. Identity: a presenter's element anchor carries the PRINT of the element it names — its tag, data-cy, role, a link's address and its accessible name (aria-label, title, an image's alt, a field's name or placeholder, else its own text, whitespace collapsed, at most 80 characters). When the anchor dies (its element gone, the same tab's next page, a reload), the stage looks for the ONE laid-out element with that print (the same print; else, for a print with a data-cy, the same tag, data-cy, role and address) as soon as the replay shown is STYLED (not settled), again every 150 ms, for at most `REANCHOR_CAP_MS` (1 s) from when it was found dead on that page load. Found: the anchor is on it, at the same spot of its box, sent as a move. None, or more than one alike: no arrow — her page keeps it hidden and the stage keeps saying "Your pointer isn't on {name}'s screen — move to show it". REQ-538's look-up under his still mouse is gone (`lookAgain` false for every element anchor; `reanchorDelay`, `REANCHOR_QUIET_MS`, `reanchorSoon` removed).
2. Never a provisional fraction as an arrow: a move, resend or click the stage cannot name an element for yet goes out as `pending` (a bare fraction with the sender's clock; parsed and relayed like a move, any element it names stripped). Her screen shows "{name} is pointing…" (a pulsing dot, no arrow) near it for at most `PENDING_MS` (2.5 s); the next move, click or leave replaces it.
3. Out of view: an anchor whose element is outside the box it can be seen in — the screen above the pill's band, cut by every ancestor that clips its overflow (`.content` under the topbar) and by every bar pinned over the content beside it (a phone's sticky topbar, a fixed bar at the bottom) (`visibleBox`) — is the small chevron at that box's edge, pointing the way, with "{name} is pointing below — scroll ↓" (above ↑, to the right →, to the left ←; en + es): no arrow, no dashed ring, no name tag. On the stage, the ghost and a colleague's pointer whose element is out of view are the chevron at the edge of where the replay shows it (`clipOf`). His mouse beside the frame (REQ-393's off edge) and a bare fraction are drawn as before.
4. Fade: an arrow whose element has moved more than 40 px from where it was drawn when he pointed (his mouse still; a card grew, the page scrolled) is drawn at 40% (`data-faded`): what he pointed at, no longer where he points.
5. Tabs: the stage hears the followed socket's browser-tab key (REQ-436's). Following ANOTHER browser tab (both keys known and different), it keeps his anchor for its page load (the 8 newest) and drops it — no arrow on the new tab until he moves — and says "Now showing {name}'s other tab ({path}) — move to point there" until he moves (8 s at most). That page load followed again gets the kept anchor back (sent) if he has pointed at nothing since. The same tab's next page is no switch (rule 1 applies). The key is often said only AFTER the stage followed the socket (the hub announces a socket before its page's welcome claim names its tab): the transport tells the stage then (`onPeerTab`), the stage tracks which tab it follows from both (`followTabs`), and until the newly followed socket's tab is known nothing of his goes to it — no resend, no `pending`, no look-up by print; once known, the switch (or the same tab's page) is handled as above, the notice included.
6. Start: holding nothing (the demo's start, his mouse left the window, another tab followed), the stage says "Your pointer isn't on {name}'s screen — move to show it" — chosen over a faint parked arrow, which would bring back m24's arrow over her controls.
7. Supersedes REQ-538's look-up (see its SUPERSEDED note) and REQ-242's resend sentence (see its SUPERSEDED note).
**Tests:**
- unit `jest/unit/demo-pointer-identity.test.ts` (49 cases, each naming REQ-645; `followTabs`, and the transport on a fake socket — a claim naming the followed socket's tab after the follow reaches the stage as `onPeerTab` — came with rule 5's last sentence): `printOf` / `samePrint` / `pickByPrint` (the same print, the data-cy fallback, two alike → none, not laid out → skipped); `anchorDead`, `seekPrint` (styled, capped), `reanchored`; `lookAgain` false for a dead anchor; a stage model (a card swapped for another control never re-anchors; a re-render and a page change re-anchor by print once styled; the cap); `pointerAbsent` with nothing held; `drifted`; `placeView`, `cueKey`, `visibleBox` (the `.content` scroller, a window-scrolled page, a fixed element, an x-only scroller, a phone's sticky topbar and a fixed bottom bar, an element inside the bar); `tabSwitched`, `keepHeld`, `keptFor`; the `pending` parse and relay; the replayer's `printOf` / `findPrint` / `clipOf`; the stage, overlay, PeerPointer, DemoPointer, PointerGhost and transport wiring; the en + es strings.

## REQ-696 — An invoice billed to a typed BILL TO name belongs to that customer; the customers page counts it, shows what is still to bill, and follows changes (demo-loop cycle 5, issues M5 + M22)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 5 (run r37f88707, demo-report.md), issues `M5` "Customers page says nothing signed or owed while money is owed; the list doesn't update until a reload" and `M22` "Invoice made from Nueva factura shows '—' as the customer despite a BILL TO name". RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD for both at demo-fixes `2444608a`.
**Cause (RCA):** REQ-550 (cycle 4) made it legal to issue an invoice with no customer, only a typed bill-to name ("Sin cliente (agregar después)" + BILL TO "Jorge Ruiz"), but every reader keys on `customerId`: `BuildCustomerCards` filters invoices by `customerId === c.id` and `summarize()` adds card balances only ("$0 que te deben" while $200 was owed, Jorge never on the list); `InvoicesPage.tsx` `enrich()` showed "—"; `ComputeInvoiceForecast` fell back to the English literal `"Invoice"` ("jue: Invoice $200" on the Spanish hero). Separately, `buildBalanceSub` ignored `isUpcomingReceivable`, so a card whose only bill was a scheduled $350 completion invoice read "SALDO Saldado", and `ClientsPage.tsx` never followed the REQ-493 change feed, so the roster stayed stale after a signature until a reload.
**Requirement:**
- POST /invoices with no customer and a bill-to name attaches that customer — the existing one by the shared REQ-331 rule (phone, email, then the whole name accent/case-blind), else a new customer with the bill-to's name, business, address and well-formed contact (a malformed contact is left off, never a failed issue).
- The roster's owed total also counts open receivables no card carries (invoices written before this, or whose customer is gone).
- The /invoices list names an invoice's client as the customer on file, else the bill-to name, else its business name, else "—".
- The forecast label is the customer, else the bill-to name/business, else the job (quote's, the invoice's own, or any language's), else the invoice's own number — never an English literal.
- A card with nothing owed but a scheduled installment reads BALANCE "$350 to bill" / "$350 por facturar" and the sub-line "$350 to bill · Nov 20" / "$350 por facturar · 20 nov" (soonest send date, else due date) — never "Settled". en and es in sync.
- The /customers page re-reads its current page on a quote or invoice change (REQ-493 `followChanges(isDocChange, …)`).
- Not changed (owner's call, RCA sub-point 4): a customer with a single completed, paid job still reads "Cliente nuevo" per REQ-562.

## REQ-648 — The stage shows the customer's next page without waiting for her islands, says how far behind it is while it waits, dims the page she left and sends no pointer at it (demo-loop cycle 5, issues M3 + c4-m28)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 5, issue `M3` — "Stage trails a customer page change by seconds ('Loading their next page…') while the debug figure says lag 0.0s" (pair 8: "The customer opened Billing at 19:20:07; at 19:20:13 the stage still showed the root sidebar, so the presenter's arrow aimed at 'Billing' landed on her 'Quotes'"), and backlog `c4-m28` — "Short-lived screens missed on stage; once ~5 s behind". RCA analyst CONFIRMED (high), skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `2444608a`.
**Cause (RCA):** every page change in the app is a full document load. The new page's link (socket, recorder, snapshot) opened only in DemoModeOverlay's effect 2, after ALL the page's island code had loaded and hydrated (Fresh boots every island from one module script), so on a slow dev server the stage held the old page ("Loading their next page…") for seconds while the presenter's arrow went out against it. The stage's lag figure starts at each frame's push, so that boot time read 0.0 s. A held REQ-547 snapshot made the pill say "Live" over the old page (`awaiting` ended at apply), and the customer's second snapshot (stage arrival + sync) restarted the hold with fresh preloads and a fresh deadline.
**Requirement:**
1. Measure. The server stamps a tab's `leaving` with the deploy's clock and its departure carries it (`at`). The stage times each page change of the followed tab, from that stamp to the next page ON SHOW (`createPageClock`). The dev chip reports it as `page last/worst s`. While the stage waits, the pill says "Loading their next page… N s behind" / "Cargando su siguiente página… N s de retraso" once the wait passes LAG_BEHIND_MS.
2. Start early. `_app.tsx` puts a small module script of its own (`lib/demo-mode/demo-early.ts`, no island code) in the head of every signed-in page. When the tab's carry (pill-carry.ts) names a viewer demo from a moment ago, it opens that demo's link at once (`early-link.ts`): socket, recorder and sender. It names the browser tab on the welcome's claim, answers a stage with the page's snapshot once the document is parsed, and keeps the status, presence, last pointer and an end for the overlay. The overlay adopts it (`takeEarlyLink` + `adopt`), so there is still one socket per page. Nobody adopting it within EARLY_ADOPT_MS after load closes it. Its URL comes from `vite-demo-early.ts`: Vite's `/@fs/` source in dev, its own client-build chunk in a build. Because a link now asks the deploy's time while its page is still loading, every link asks again at TIME_AGAIN_MS after its welcome, and the quickest round trip wins.
3. Hold. A snapshot whose sheets the frame has goes on show at once (REQ-547 holds only for sheets not yet loaded). The replay says when a page is on show (`onShown`, `held()`). A later snapshot of a held page keeps the preloads already loading and the first hold's deadline.
4. Guard. While the pill says "Loading their next page…" the frame is dimmed (LOADING_FILTER; the waiting look still wins for a dropped app). No pointer of his is sent against it: no move, no look-up of his still mouse, no click. The awaiting state ends only when the replay says the new page is on show. Re-anchoring is left to pointer-anchor-identity and the hub's claim replay to demo-claim-ranking.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-stage-page-latency.test.ts` ("REQ-648 …" ×35: page clock; pill words en/es; dim look; departure `at` parse; transport `onPageGone` and time re-ask; replay `onShown`/`held()`/kept hold; early link open/defer/adopt/hand-on/pagehide/slot/unadopted close; Vite plugin dev + build; wiring of _app, vite.config, overlay, stage, server) and `backend/src/demo-mode/domain/coordinators/demo-hub/test.ts` ("REQ-648 a tab's departure carries … `at` … across hubs") · integration `backend/src/demo-mode/entrypoints/demo-mode-controller/int.test.ts` ("REQ-648 … over the composed router's socket: a tab's `leaving` is stamped … `at`"; the REQ-391 test there is amended to set `at` aside, its own case) · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-stage-page-latency.e2e.test.ts` (two browsers, the customer's island code held back 6 s: her next page on the stage before she hydrates; the chip's page figure matches the measured leave→on-show gap; frame dimmed and no pointer sent while it says "Loading their next page…"; exactly one demo socket for the new page; a timeline of where the time went kept with the evidence).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c5-stage-page-latency off demo-fixes 2444608a):** RED first. jest: "Cannot find module '../../front-end/lib/demo-mode/early-link'" (Test Suites: 1 failed, 392 passed). Run against the original sources plus the new modules: "Tests: 18 failed, 14 passed" (`createPageClock is not a function`, `rep.held is not a function`, `Received: "Dashboard"` for the kept hold, wiring patterns absent); then `TIME_AGAIN_MS` undefined. ## REQ-653 — the assistant keeps the contractor's corrections, treats a deadline as schedule, and says what it skipped (demo-loop cycle 5, M7 + m50)
**Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none". Demo-loop cycle 5 (run r37f88707), issues M7 "Assistant drops or garbles details" and m50 "Agreement contradicts itself on schedule". RCA verdict LIKELY for both at 2444608a. The skeptic CORRECTED M7's address claim: the gate is `extractServiceAddress`, not `isAddressShaped`. m50 was UPHELD.
**What the demo showed:** "LVP no wait porcelain tile 12x24" became "Install LVP and porcelain tile" in every option (fleet-6 stdout:295). "client wants done before thanksgiving" became the scope bullet "Finish before Thanksgiving", next to start "Right away" + "3 weeks", which ends Dec 3, after Thanksgiving on Nov 26 (fleet-6 stdout:225/298). "its NOT done before thanksgiving if we start now + 3 wks, fix that" got back "I didn't change the start date — ask me again" (`handle-chat-message` termsMissed). The Q-002 card had no job address after "same address" (fleet-4 stdout:216). "email notanemail" was ignored without a word (fleet-9 stdout:37).
**Requirement:**
- **Corrections.** When the contractor corrects themselves, only the correction is kept. A code pre-pass, `dropSelfCorrections` in `shared/quote-flow/self-correction.ts`, runs on the raw text and on the typed yardstick in `GenerateJobOptions`. It handles "no wait", "wait no", "I mean", "make that", "scratch that", "no espera" and "mejor dicho". It drops as many of the clause's last words as the correction itself has. The `prompts.generateJobOptions` rule (en + es) adds "actually", which is left to the model.
- **Deadlines.** A deadline is schedule, not scope. `cleanScopeBullet` and `stripCustomerDetails` drop deadline lines and trailing deadline parts ("Finish before Thanksgiving", "Terminar antes de Acción de Gracias", ", done before Thanksgiving"). They also drop "Job located on …" lines.
- **update_terms.** The tool takes `finishBy`. `readDeadline` reads "done before thanksgiving", "finished by Dec 5" and "listo para el 20 de noviembre" (holidays included). `deadlineCheck` compares the quote's start + time to complete with the deadline, and the reply says whether the job ends in time. A miss also says what to change. This replaces "I didn't change the start date". The check runs in the chat (`applyEditCalls` and the main path), and also when the wizard's start or time-to-complete step is answered and a deadline was typed earlier.
- **"Same address".** The job address is filled from the named customer's latest quote, else from their customer record.
- **Malformed e-mail.** When a `create_quote` turn carries one ("email notanemail"), the reply says it was skipped (`chatCoordinator.emailSkipped`, en + es).

## REQ-642 — The stage's marker for the presenter's own pointer: drawn from the customer's report, always shown, never over the replica (demo-loop cycle 5, issues m10 + setup-14d)
**Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 5 (run r37f88707, demo-report.md), issue `m10` "Stage marker for the presenter's own pointer: wrong place or stale ghost, missing, or its badge and label cover the replica" (pair 1: the ghost was "drawn at the top edge while she saw the arrow at ~1125,485"; pair 7: "Your pointer isn't on Hank Miller's screen covers the frame's header") and `setup-14d` "Pair 6 E took the customer's pointer for his own" (merged into m10). RCA: analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic CORRECTED part (3), at 2444608a.
**Cause (RCA):** (1) `DemoStage.tsx` `showGhost` fed `ghostAt` from `presenterOnStage`, which is the stage's own replay of his anchor, with no report back from the customer's screen, so the ghost could sit where their arrow was not. (2) Nothing of his own was drawn unless the ghost was more than GHOST_GAP_PX from his cursor, so a screenshot or a shared screen showed only the customer's orange arrow. (3) The off and absent badges were at container top `fit.top - bannerH` (= INSET.top, always the frame's top edge) with `translate(-50%,-50%)`, so half the pill always covered the mirrored header. (4) `PointerGhost` called `tagPlacement(…, null)` with a long label, so there was no element box and no covers check.
**Requirement:**
- The customer's overlay reports where it placed each presenter's arrow: `{k:"placed", pid, a, p, o}`, where `a` is the anchor it placed, `p` is the tip as a fraction of their viewport (null when it is not on their screen) and `o` means outside. Reports are rate-limited per presenter (`placedReporter`, PLACED_GAP_MS = 100, leading + trailing, repeats dropped) and go out over the demo link. The server's gate parses the report and relays it to every stage.
- The stage keeps the followed tab's report for its own pid and draws the ghost from it (`reportedGhost`), only for the anchor he holds now, and only when it is more than GHOST_GAP_PX from where he put it. A report from an earlier page or tab is dropped.
- The stage always draws his own small marker (`OwnPointer`, `data-cy="demo-pointer-own"`) where he pointed (`ownAt`), in his presenter colour and tagged "You" / "Tú", never in the customer's colour or with their name. The tag is left off while the ghost carries it.
- The off and absent badges sit in a chrome row above the frame: the stage's top inset is `STAGE_TOP_INSET` (42) and the badge top is `stageBadgeTop(frameTop)`, with a fixed height and no vertical translate.
- The ghost's tag is "You" / "Tú" and is placed outside the anchored element (`rect`), next to the arrow, off other controls (`covers`, by default `coversControl` through the mirror).
- This amends REQ-451's ghost (the stage's replay guess and the "Your pointer on {name}'s screen" label). The REQ-451 wiring test in `jest/unit/demo-presenter-anchor.test.ts` is updated to match.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-stage-own-pointer.test.ts` ("REQ-642 …", 19 cases: wire parse and gate, `placedReport`, `placedReporter` rate and dedupe, `reportedGhost` stale/none/gap/outside, `ownAt`, badge row geometry over three stage/customer sizes, wiring of the overlay, stage, OwnPointer and PointerGhost, en/es "You"/"Tú") and `front-end/lib/demo-pointer-ghost-tag.test.tsx` ("REQ-642 (demo m10) PointerGhost …" ×2: the tag sits outside the anchored element, and a covered side gives way) · integration `backend/src/demo-mode/domain/coordinators/demo-hub/test.ts` ("REQ-642 the customer's placed report passes the server's gate, crosses two isolates and reaches every stage intact") · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-presenter-rest.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-393 (demo M8) + REQ-451 (demo M14) …", with REQ-642 assertions added: the off hint ends above the frame; back on the frame the stage draws `demo-pointer-own` under his mouse tagged "You", with no ghost).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c5-stage-own-pointer off demo-fixes 2444608a):**

## REQ-659 — Private pricing (markup, rates, sub/material costs) never reaches the customer's job details; a finished job's invoice drops the stale relative start (demo-loop cycle 5, issues M14 + m53 + c1-M22)
**Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 5 (run r37f88707, demo-report.md): `M14` "Contractor's private markup written into customer-facing job details" (fleet-6 stdout:295-296, both options carried "Materials at cost +15%"); `m53` "Raw note with prices on the client's quote/invoice; finished job's invoice keeps the start date" (fleet-8 stdout:198, "… media camioneta, $450. Cargo por disposición de basura $75." on quote AND invoice, and "Fecha de inicio: La próxima semana" on a finished job's bill); backlog `c1-M22` "Raw message with private sub cost offered as the job description". RCA analyst + skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `2444608a`.
**Cause (RCA):** REQ-261's filter (`shared/quote-flow/private-cost.ts` `mentionsMoney`) matched only "$N" / "N dollars|usd|pesos|bucks", so a markup ("at cost +15%"), a bare rate ("85/hr") or a sub-cost sentence with its amount stripped ("My sub quoted me for the plumbing") passed; and the filter ran on LLM bullets and polish only — the quote store took any description as written (chat create/update, "use what I wrote", PUT /quotes). The invoice mirrored the quote's wizard terms verbatim, so a start written relative to the quote ("Next week") still printed on a bill issued after that week.
**Requirement:**
- `mentionsMoney` also flags private pricing: a percentage tied to cost/markup/margin/profit/overhead (or a "+N%"), "at cost" / "cost plus" / "al costo", a labor rate ("85/hr", "per hour", "an hour", "por hora"), markup / profit / "my margin" / "overhead and profit" / recargo / ganancia, and what the contractor pays ("my sub quoted me", "charges me", "costs me", "my cost", "me cobra", "me cuesta", "mi costo"). Scope lines ("Install overhead lighting", "Grade the yard to a 2% slope", "Paint 1,500 sqft") stay.
- Every write of a quote's job details (`QuoteStore.create` / `update` / `setPending` / `updateIf` — chat tools, polish, quick quote, PUT /quotes) drops the sentences/lines that name money or private pricing, in `description` and every `descriptionByLang` copy.
- The scope pass (`scopeBulletsFromRaw`, hence the quick quote and "use what I wrote") drops a line that is still private pricing after its price clause is stripped; "use what I wrote"'s as-typed fallback drops priced lines too. The confirm strip echoes the typed message with every money amount redacted (`redactMoney`).
- The job-options prompt (en + es) forbids the contractor's rates, markup, margin, sub/material costs and how they price in a bullet.
- An invoice (public /i payload and the invoice PDF) drops a relative start term ("ASAP", "Next week", "Next month") once the bill is issued on/after the day it pointed to (counted from when the quote went out), and a "To be determined" start once issued after the quote's day; a concrete start date stays (`invoiceTerms`).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/private-pricing-filter.test.ts` ("REQ-659 …": widened `mentionsMoney`, scope lines untouched, `withoutMoneySentences`, `scopeBulletsFromRaw` / `ownWordsOption` drop the sub-cost line, `redactMoney`, the strip renders `redactMoney(pendingJobDetailsRaw)`, the prompt rule in en and es, `invoiceTerms`) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/private-pricing.int.test.ts` ("REQ-659 …": store create/update/setPending scrub the description and its translations; PUT /quotes over HTTP; GET /invoices/:id/public drops "Next week" on a bill issued after it, keeps it on a same-day deposit bill) and `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/generate-job-options/int.test.ts` ("REQ-659 M14 …": a model bullet "Materials at cost +15%" / "Labor 85/hr" is dropped) · e2e n/a — every customer-facing surface reads the stored description and the projected terms that the integration tests pin over HTTP; the strip change is a pure render of `redactMoney`, pinned by the unit test, and the browser lane is out of scope for this fix.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c5-private-cost-filter off demo-fixes 2444608a):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern private-pricing-filter` against the original shared/lang/AsstChat → "Tests: 28 failed, 13 passed" (every widened `mentionsMoney` case, `withoutMoneySentences`, `scopeBulletsFromRaw` / `ownWordsOption`, `redactMoney` not a function, the strip, the prompt rule) and, before `invoice-terms.ts` existed, "Cannot find module '../../shared/quote-flow/invoice-terms'"; `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/private-pricing.int.test.ts src/agents/domain/coordinators/generate-job-options/int.test.ts` → "FAILED | 37 passed | 3 failed" (AssertionError: Values are not equal — the store kept "$450 / $75", PUT /quotes kept it, the public invoice kept `start_date`, the options kept "Materials at cost +15%"). ## REQ-656 — "Job done, invoice X" typed in the chat opens the invoice flow; on a signed job with a scheduled invoice, Send now is the answer (demo-loop cycle 5, M9)
**Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none". Demo-loop cycle 5 (run r37f88707, demo-report.md), issue M9 "Assistant will not invoice a finished job (makes a quote / refuses / schedules)", category BUG_CONTRADICTION. Pair 8 (fleet-8 stdout:184) typed the starter chip's own words in a new chat: "Trabajo terminado, necesito facturar: Jorge Ruiz, jorge.ruiz@example.com, sacamos un refrigerador y una lavadora viejos, $200. Que pague hoy." The chat drafted "Q-002 · Cotización redactada", and "Hazme la factura" then got "Envíala primero…". Pair 1 (fleet-1 stdout:76) typed "Trabajo terminado, factura a María López por la cotización Q-001" on a signed pay-on-completion job. The reply led with "todavía no se ha facturado nada" and the date the invoice was scheduled for.
**Cause (RCA, analyst + skeptic UPHELD at 2444608a):** the "Job done, need to invoice" flow exists only on the client, behind the starter chip (`front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` `startInvoiceFlow`). Typed words went to the chat model, whose only drafting tool is `create_quote`. On a signed job, `billingReply` (`backend/src/agents/domain/business/chat-answers/mod.ts`) reported where the bill stood and never read "the job is done" as "send the completion invoice now".
**Requirement:**
1. A typed message that says the job is finished (done / finished / completed / terminado / terminé / acabé / ya está hecho …) AND asks to bill it (invoice / bill / factura / facturar / cobrar …) is a job-done invoice ask (`parseJobDoneInvoiceAsk`). It never is when the work is not done yet ("when it's done, invoice her", "todavía no termino").
2. In a chat with no job bound, where the message names no customer with a job, the server answers that ask without the chat model. It replies with text plus a payload (`invoiceFlow: { details, amountCents?, customerName?, customerEmail? }`) and drafts no quote. The chat opens the existing invoice flow from that payload, prefilled with the job details, the amount and the customer. The payload is also offered as a "Start the invoice" button on the newest message.
3. On a signed job (bound and asked to bill in REQ-368's words, or found through the customer the message names) with an invoice still scheduled, the reply to a job-done ask leads with sending it now: "Job's done — INV-001 for $180 to María López is ready. Tap Send now to bill it today; otherwise it goes out Nov 19." The card offers Send now, and nothing is sent without that tap (REQ-583's rule). It never opens with "nothing is billed yet".
4. en and es stay in sync.

## REQ-679 — After an approved change order every agreement figure is the agreed total (quote + approved COs): /i, the invoice PDF and email, the /quotes panel header and the dashboard's job row (demo-loop cycle 5, issues M18 + M19)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 5 (run r37f88707, demo-report.md), issues `M18` "After an approved CO the client's invoice shows three balances" (pair 5: /i read "BALANCE DUE $9,750.00", "AGREEMENT VALUE $16,300.00" and a schedule "BALANCE $8,150.00 On completion") and `M19` "Old total stays in the quote panel header and dashboard after a CO" (pair 5: Customers "Q-001 · $17,900.00 · incl. +$1,600.00" vs the /quotes panel header "$16,300"). RCA analyst CONFIRMED (high) for both, skeptic UPHELD at `2444608a`.
**Cause (RCA):** approving a change order revises only its invoice (`public-controller` approveChangeOrder → `invoices.publishRevision({amount: inv.amount + delta})`); the quote's `estimatedTotal` stays. Only `shared/documents/ledger.ts` added approved CO deltas. `getInvoicePublic` (agreementTotal), `render-invoice-pdf` and `send-paperwork-email` (renderInvoiceHtml) read `quote.estimatedTotal`; /i and the PDF split that stale total by the payment terms for the schedule; `QuotesPage.tsx` `qopen__amount` rendered `q.estimatedTotal`; `list-active-jobs` set `totalCents = q.estimatedTotal` (the dashboard row amount and pctPaid).
**Requirement:** one shared rule, `agreedTotalCents(quote, changeOrders)` = quote total + APPROVED change-order deltas (pending/declined ignored, never below 0), used by the ledger, `getInvoicePublic`'s `agreementTotal`, the invoice PDF's agreement-value card and the invoice email's agreement value. The payment schedule on /i and on the invoice PDF is built from the real installments (`installmentSchedule`: each issued installment of the same plan keeps its own amount; slots no installment covers share what is left of the agreed total) — the demo's 16,300 at 50/50 with +1,600 approved on the balance reads deposit $8,150 · balance $9,750 under an agreement of $17,900. The /quotes panel header shows the agreed total (the ledger's `agreementTotalCents`, else quote + the card's approved COs) with "incl. +$X in change orders" / "incl. +$X en órdenes de cambio" when approved COs exist (`panelAgreedTotal`). The dashboard's active-job row total and its % paid use the agreed total.

## REQ-700 — the chat header and the thread list name the bill from the live invoice row (demo-loop cycle 5, issue m20)
**Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none". Demo-loop cycle 5 (run r37f88707), issue m20 "Status names disagree between the chat header, the list and the client card": pair 2 header "Q-001 · Cotización aceptada" vs list "Firmada · Facturada"; pair 9 list still "Firmada · Facturada" after Linda paid.
**RCA (analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD, at 2444608a):** three readers, three snapshots. AsstChat called `deriveChatHeader` without `invoiceStatus`, so the header read the status frozen into the signing divider (AcceptQuote); `threadChip` had no `scheduled` case, so a signature that scheduled the completion bill fell through to "Quote accepted". The list chip read `conversation.invoiceStatus`, written only by assistant coordinators — a send or payment on /invoices never touched it, and ListConversations never re-read the invoice. REQ-563 aligned the keys but kept the two snapshot sources.
**Requirement:** one live source. ListConversations returns each row's `invoiceStatus` from the bound invoice ROW (`conv.invoiceId` → InvoiceStore; a deleted bill has none). LoadConversation returns the same live `invoiceStatus` (null: no bill). The thread route seeds AsstChat with it, the list hands the open thread's live status back on every poll (`THREAD_SERVER_INVOICE_EVENT`), and AsstChat passes it to `deriveChatHeader`; the divider's snapshot is only the fallback until the live value is known (`undefined`), never when the server says there is no bill (`null`). `threadChip` names every live bill status in one vocabulary: `scheduled` on a signed quote → "Signed · Invoice scheduled" / "Firmada · Factura programada" (`asstChat.header.signedScheduled`); `sent`/`viewed`/`claimed`/`overdue` → "Signed · Invoiced"; `paid` → "Paid"; `draft`/`void` leave the quote's status. The client card's quote row ("COTIZACIÓN · ACEPTADA") is the quote document's own state and is left as is (optional in the RCA).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/live-invoice-status.test.ts` ("REQ-700 …" ×8: the scheduled/out/paid/draft chips in en+es, header == list for the divider's 'scheduled' and for a live 'paid' over it, AsstChat / the route / AsstThreads wire the live status) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/list-conversations/live-invoice.int.test.ts` ("REQ-700 m20 …" ×3: signed + scheduled → both "Signed · Invoice scheduled"; the invoice row sent then paid on the paperwork side → both follow it while `conversation.invoiceStatus` stays stale; a deleted bill → no status, header == list) · e2e n/a — the words are a pure function of the server fields the integration test proves over the real stores and coordinators; the island wiring is pinned by the unit test, and the browser lane is not run by fix agents.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c5-live-invoice-status off demo-fixes 2444608a):** RED — `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/coordinators/list-conversations/live-invoice.int.test.ts` → "0 passed | 3 failed" (header and list `asstChat.header.quoteAccepted` for a scheduled bill; snapshot `invoiceStatus: undefined`; list still `scheduled` after the row was sent); `npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/live-invoice-status.test.ts` → 3 failed (no `invoiceStatus: liveInvoiceStatus`, no `initialInvoiceStatus`, no `THREAD_SERVER_INVOICE_EVENT`). GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/{list-conversations,load-conversation,accept-quote}/ src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/chat-header.int.test.ts src/agents/entrypoints/conversations-controller/` → "ok | 50 passed | 0 failed"; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 393 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 3857 passed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` (front-end/) clean on the touched islands, route, lib and shared file. `front-end/clients/assistant.ts` was already not fmt-clean on demo-fixes and is left unformatted; AsstChat.tsx not formatted (known-unformattable).
## REQ-655 — extra work on a fully paid job is billed on a new invoice linked to the job, from the chat and from the quote panel (demo-loop cycle 5, issues M12 + p18-9c)
**Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none". Demo-loop cycle 5 (run r37f88707, demo-report.md), issues `M12` "Assistant refuses a change order and asks for an invoice that already exists" (fleet-1, pair 2: "Q-001 Corte de césped ya está firmada y no se puede editar. Crea primero su factura y vuelve a pedírmelo") and `p18-9c` "Change-order button on a fully paid job leads to a refusal" (pair 9, 19:07:30). RCA analyst CONFIRMED and skeptic UPHELD for both, at demo-fixes `2444608a`.
**Cause (RCA):** `ApplyChatChangeOrder` (apply-chat-change-order/mod.ts:274-277) looked only for an OPEN invoice. `isInvoiceLocked` (shared/documents/versions.ts:153) counts paid as locked, so on a paid-off job it fell through to `isQuoteLocked → needsInvoice` (:329-338) and told the owner to create an invoice that already existed. Nothing could bill the extra work. On /quotes, `SignedChangeOrder` (QuotesPage.tsx:241-300) showed "New change order" unconditionally. Only after the click did it consult `newChangeOrderTarget`, and in the all-paid case it refused with a bare `/invoices?new=1` link that carried no quoteId and no customer.
**Requirement:**
- (a) **Chat.** A change order for a signed job whose invoices are all paid bills a positive delta on a NEW draft invoice for that amount: one line, the job's customer, linked to the quote. The draft is not sent. The reply names the paid invoice(s) and the new one, and the outcome is `new_invoice`. A credit (delta ≤ 0) writes nothing; the reply says the invoices are paid and suggests a refund (`all_paid`). `needs_invoice` ("create its invoice first") is kept only for a signed job with no invoice at all. Both new outcomes link back to the quote in the chat.
- (b) **Quote panel.** The button is decided before it renders (`newChangeOrderButton`). On a fully paid job it reads "Bill extra work" / "Cobrar trabajo extra" and goes straight to `/invoices?new=1&quoteId=<id>&extra=1`. The refusal box is gone.
- (c) **Invoices page.** The New invoice form honours that link. It is prefilled from the quote (customer, job), the amount is left for the contractor to type, and the intro reads "Bill extra work on Q-001…". It bills its own one line and sends REQ-233's `override`, so the agreement cap does not refuse deliberate extra work. An ordinary quote-drawn invoice is unchanged.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/co-on-paid-job.test.ts` ("REQ-655 …" ×10: button decision, link round-trip, en/es labels, QuotesPage source, `buildInvoiceBody` extraWork/override plus the unchanged ordinary case, InvoicesPage wiring, chat link kinds, en/es reply placeholders). `jest/unit/quote-change-order-actions.test.ts` REQ-462 is amended: it now expects `newChangeOrderButton(` instead of the `coNewInvoice` box.
- integration: `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/apply-chat-change-order/paid-job.int.test.ts` ("REQ-655 M12 …" ×3: new draft INV-002 linked to Q-001 for $45.00, with no "Crea primero su factura"; a credit writes nothing; no invoice still → needs_invoice).
- e2e: `e2e/co-on-paid-job/co-on-paid-job.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-655 p18-9c …": the paid-off Q-001 panel shows "Bill extra work" and no change-order button, and the click opens the New invoice form with Ana prefilled. Saving $45 creates a second invoice on the job, and the cap does not refuse it).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c5-co-on-paid-job off demo-fixes 2444608a):**
- RED, integration: `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/coordinators/apply-chat-change-order/paid-job.int.test.ts` gave "1 passed | 2 failed". The failures were "the demo's dead end came back: Q-001 Corte de césped ya está firmada y no se puede editar. Crea primero su factura y vuelve a pedírmelo…" and the en twin. With type checking on, the run also failed earlier because `new_invoice` / `all_paid` were not outcome kinds.

## REQ-665 — a custom payment split reads as worded percentages, never "100 / 0" (demo-loop cycle 5, issue m47)
**Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none". Demo-loop cycle 5 (run r37f88707), issue m47 "'Payment: 100 / 0' with no units on the agreement" (fleet-9 stdout:262-263 "AGREEMENT READS: 100 / 0").
**RCA (analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD, at 2444608a):** the custom payment picker (`front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` CustomPaymentPickerForm, preview → submitted value) builds its value with `termLabel`, and `termLabel` joined splits as bare numbers (`return v.splits.join(" / ")`, `shared/quote-flow/terms-i18n.ts:66`). That string was stored as the payment term and printed raw by `expandTermValue` → `localizeTermValue` on the checklist, the sidebar and the signed agreement, readable as $100 / $0. The typed "Did I hear that right" path and the wizard's prefill (`quote-facts.ts` `wizardPrefillFor`) go through the same `termLabel`.
**Requirement:** a split is stored and shown with its units. 100/0 is the "paid in full upfront" preset — "Due Now" / "Pago inmediato"; 0/100 is "Payment upon completion" / "Pago al finalizar"; any other two-payment split is "30% upfront, 70% on completion" / "30% por adelantado, 70% al terminar"; three or more read "30% / 40% / 30%". The bill matches the words: `computePaymentSplit` reads every label to the same shares, "Pago inmediato" counts as due now everywhere "Due Now" does (shared `isDueNowTermValue`: invoice due date at signing, the "on signing" milestone in the agreement and both PDFs, the New-invoice days), and the Spanish 0/100 bills after completion. A Spanish reader of an English-stored two-payment split gets it in Spanish (front-end and PDF `localizeTermValue`).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/split-term-label.test.ts` ("REQ-665 …" ×10: the labels in en/es, no bare number list, the money each label bills, `isDueNowTermValue`, the Spanish localization); `jest/unit/payment-terms-custom.test.ts` REQ-387 prefill expectation updated to "30% / 40% / 30%"; `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-quote-pdf/term-i18n.test.ts` ("REQ-665 quote/invoice PDF: a worded split localizes to Spanish") · integration `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/milestone.test.ts` ("REQ-665 send-signed-confirmation run: the picker's 100/0 (en|es) bills ONE invoice due the day of signing" against the real KV stores, plus the worded-split milestone amounts and the 0/100 completion terms) · e2e n/a — the picker submits `termLabel`'s string verbatim and every surface prints the stored value; the unit and integration tests pin both ends, and the browser lane is not run in fix branches.

## REQ-637 — The folded customer demo pill is a labelled mini-pill with End; public documents keep the whole pill (demo-loop cycle 5, issue m5)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." **Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle 5, issues M25 ("Negative price silently turned positive; quote sent at $1,850": typed "-1850" → the pad showed 1,850; "price -500 dollars" in the chat sentence seeded the pad at $500) and m62 ("'abc' in Amount field gives no message"). The shared money reader flags a negative amount (`negative`: "-500 dollars", "-$500", "$-500", "minus / negative / negativo $500"; never a range's dash "$3,000 - $4,000" / "$3,000-$4,000" or a hyphenated word "all-in $18,500"); `extractPriceCents` returns null and `extractPriceLines` [] when the sentence has one, and the quick-quote price step opens empty with `asstChat.price.negativeNote` (`data-cy="price-negative-note"`, "Your message says -$500 — a price can't be negative, so the amount is left empty. Type the price; for a credit, add a discount or a change order.") until a price is typed. en + es keys in sync.

## REQ-695 — an invoice is sent only on the channels the client has, a missing contact is never a raw developer reason, and "Finish + send" with no contact offers to add one (demo-loop cycle 5, issues M23 + m55)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 5 (run r37f88707), issues `M23` "Raw English developer error after issuing an invoice" and `m55` "'Finish + send' with no contact is a dead end". RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD for both at demo-fixes `2444608a`.
**Cause (RCA):** `dispatchInvoice` (front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx) always POSTed to both `/email` and `/text`. For a client with an email and no phone, the SMS dispatcher answered "no recipient: pass `to` or attach a customer with a phone number" (customer-sms/mod.ts), the send counted as half-delivered, and `partialDispatchCopy` / `partialParts` passed that `rawReason` straight into "Factura enviada por correo — el texto no salió: {reason}". Only the not-delivered path (REQ-480 `missingRecipient`) mapped it. When both channels lacked an address, `CardSendNotes` rendered text only: no field, no link.
**Requirement:**
- New invoice dispatches only the channels its known contact can use (`sendChannel`), so a phone-less bill is just sent by email.
- Every invoice dispatch is summarized by `summarizeInvoiceDispatch` (shared/quote-flow/send-result.ts): a channel with no address (backend `failureCode: "missing"`, a "no recipient" reason, or never fired) is not a failure when the other one delivered.
- A failed channel's reason goes through `channelFailReason`: a missing recipient reads "no phone on file" / "no email on file" and the raw reason is never shown. The email dispatcher now returns `failureCode: "missing"`, the same code the SMS dispatcher already returned (REQ-226).
- When neither channel has an address (`noRecipient`), the card shows an inline "Add email or phone" form. It saves the contact on the customer (PUT /api/customers/:id), or on the invoice's bill-to when there is no customer (PUT /api/invoices/:id), then sends again in place. It also links to the client's own card (`/customers?open=<id>`, REQ-600).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/c5-invoice-dispatch-contact.test.ts` ("REQ-695 …" ×14: an es partial never contains "recipient"; failureCode-only missing; missing-plus-delivered is not partial; noRecipient; the island wiring; en/es keys) and `front-end/lib/invoice-card.test.ts` ("REQ-695 m55 …" ×4, `contactFixRequest`) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/int.test.ts` ("REQ-695 (cycle 5, M23) … failureCode 'missing'") · e2e `e2e/c5-invoice-dispatch-contact/c5-invoice-dispatch-contact.e2e.test.ts` (M23: a Spanish issue to an email-only client fires no text and shows no "recipient"; m55: Finish + send → inline add email → saved on the customer, invoice sent). `e2e/invoice-card-refresh` REQ-554's half-delivered story now gives its client a fictional 555 phone, because a client with no phone is no longer half-delivered.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c5-invoice-dispatch-contact off demo-fixes 2444608a):**
- RED:
  - unit (`cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit`): "Tests: 14 failed, 1 skipped, 3849 passed", with every failure in the new file (`channelFailReason` / `summarizeInvoiceDispatch` / `invoicePartialCopy` is not a function).
  - integration: `failureCode` Actual `undefined` / Expected `"missing"`.
  - front-end lib: `contactFixRequest` not exported.
  - e2e on the original code: M23 "expectation failed: no developer 'recipient' text anywhere"; m55 timed out waiting for `[data-cy='invoice-add-contact']`.
- GREEN:

## REQ-647 — The end of a demo is said on every path, survives a page load, and a restart after it is said long enough to read (demo-loop cycle 5, issues m29 + m23 + c2-p13-r)
**Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 5 (run r37f88707, demo-report.md), issues `m29` "Customer gets no live 'demo ended' notice" (REGRESSION), `m23` "Restart gives the customer no notice", and backlog `c2-p13-r` "No 'demo ended' message on the staff side" (pairs 1 and 2 landed on `/admin?demo=ended&by=you` with no notice). RCA analyst + skeptic at demo-fixes `2444608a`: m29 CORRECTED, m23 UPHELD (the auto-join half stays by REQ-153's amendment), c2-p13-r judged BUG_POLISH.
**Cause (RCA):** the only live `setNotice` for a remote end was the socket's `ended` frame (`DemoModeOverlay.tsx` onEnded). Every other way the customer's app learned the demo was gone — the /active poll answering null, a refused/closed socket, a carried demo /active denies, a page load (the notice was page-local; REQ-535's carry held only the demo) — was a bare `setDemo(null)`: the pill vanished with no word, and since REQ-298's restart window opened only `if (notice)`, the next demo arrived unannounced. "{name} started a new demo" lasted 4 s (`RESTART_SAY_MS`), shorter than a person's glance. On /admin the handover notice was set only in an effect after hydration, so a page whose islands did not hydrate still showed `?demo=ended&by=you` in the address and no notice (what pairs 1 and 2 reported).
**Requirement:**
- Every "demo gone" path of the overlay (poll null, socket closed/refused, /active failing after a close) goes through one `demoGone()`: the ended notice is set (`goneNotice` — a notice already up is kept, else `{by:"unknown"}` → "The demo ended" / "La demo terminó"), REQ-298's restart window opens, and the pill is replaced by the notice — never a silent vanish.
- The tab carries the notice across a page load in REQ-535's sessionStorage slot (`keepEnded` / `carriedEnded`, fresh for `PILL_ENDED_FRESH_MS` = 2 min); a carried end replaces the carried demo, so no load after a known end seeds a Connected pill. Dismissing the notice forgets it.
- `showsConnected` never claims the carried Connected grace once /active denied the demo.
- "{name} started a new demo" stays `RESTART_SAY_MS` = 10 s, or until the customer presses or types (not in its first `RESTART_MIN_MS` = 2 s). REVISION of REQ-298's "for a few seconds" (was 4 s).
- The customer's app logs `ended` receipt (`console.info("[demo] ended", …)`), so a live tab that misses the frame (m29 pair 8, cause unproven) can be traced on the next run.
- /admin's handover (`?demo=ended&by=…`) is read on the server by `_app.tsx` (`adminEndedNotice`) and handed to the island as `endedNotice`, which paints it from its first render: the notice is in the server's HTML, on first paint, hydrated or not. The address is still made bare once hydrated.
- Auto-join is unchanged (REQ-153 AMENDMENT: the customer is never asked).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-ended-sticky.test.ts` ("REQ-647 …": goneNotice; keepEnded/carriedEnded round trip, TTL, malformed, refused storage; showsConnected with /active denied; RESTART_SAY_MS ~10 s and the input rule; the overlay's poll/closed paths go through demoGone, keepEnded/carriedEnded wired, `ended` logged; `_app` passes `endedNotice`), plus REQ-298's bound in `jest/unit/demo-mode-restart.test.ts` revised to REQ-647's, and the source-shape checks in `jest/unit/demo-mode-protocol.test.ts` (REQ-153: the shell mounts the island with `endedNotice`) and `jest/unit/demo-pill-carry.test.ts` (REQ-535: `showsConnected(status, carrying, activeOk)`) amended · integration `front-end/lib/demo-ended-sticky-ssr.test.tsx` ("REQ-647 c2-p13-r …": the real overlay island server-rendered with `endedNotice` paints `[data-cy=demo-ended]` "You ended the demo"; empty without; `adminEndedNotice` reads only /admin's handover) · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-ended-silent.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-647 (cycle 5, m29 + m23) …": the customer's socket blocked, a staff End still turns her pill into "The demo ended", a reload keeps it, the next demo says "Hans started a new demo" and still does 6 s later; "REQ-647 (cycle 5, c2-p13-r) …": /admin?demo=ended&by=you shows "You ended the demo" with JavaScript off, and hydrated it stays with a bare address).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c5-demo-ended-notice off demo-fixes 2444608a):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --no-watchman --selectProjects unit unit/demo-ended-sticky.test.ts` → "Tests: 9 failed" (`goneNotice is not a function`, `keepEnded is not a function`, `Received: 4000` for RESTART_SAY_MS, `h.r.touched is not a function`, the overlay/_app wiring absent); `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/demo-ended-sticky-ssr.test.tsx` → TS2305 "no exported member 'adminEndedNotice'" / TS2322 "Property 'endedNotice' does not exist"; `shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-ended-silent.e2e.test.ts` (fake-mode stack on random ports) → "✗ … m29 + m23 … locator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded" (line 118: no `[data-cy=demo-ended]` after the end — the pill just vanished) and "✗ … c2-p13-r … Timeout 5000ms exceeded" (no notice in the server HTML). GREEN — the same shots run → "✓ REQ-647 (cycle 5, c2-p13-r) … 29.9s", "✓ REQ-647 (cycle 5, m29 + m23) … 40.3s"; `deno test -A lib/demo-ended-sticky-ssr.test.tsx lib/demo-chrome-children-lang.test.tsx lib/outside-click-chrome.test.ts` → "ok | 10 passed | 0 failed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → 391 of 393 suites passed, the 2 others being the amended source-shape checks, which then passed ("Test Suites: 11 passed · Tests: 121 passed" on every demo-* suite); `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on the touched front-end files; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file except `islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx`, which was already unformatted on demo-fixes and was left so. Neighbours: `demo-restart.e2e.test.ts` passes on this branch and on 2444608a side by side (46.1 s / 46.7 s). They are not caused by this change.
## REQ-652 — The assistant makes a change order when asked to make one; it reaches the customer only on an explicit send (demo-loop cycle 5, issue M8)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 5 (run r37f88707, demo-report.md), issue `M8`: "Assistant emails a change order to the client when asked only to make one". fleet-4 stdout:222 shows "Sent CO-002 to Dana Whitfield by email" after "Make a change order on Q-001: credit $500…", and fleet-0 stdout:254 shows the same after "add $400 change order". RCA analyst CONFIRMED and skeptic UPHELD at demo-fixes `2444608a`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** on a job with an open invoice, `ApplyChatChangeOrder.run` (`backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/apply-chat-change-order/mod.ts`:274-317) called `changeOrders.create`, then `await this.alert.run(co.id)`. That is `SendChangeOrderAlert`, which emails and texts the CUSTOMER the /co link. No make-vs-send intent was ever checked. The alert was wired in f4a3f731 (REQ-238), and REQ-456 made the chat wait for it. Note: the invoice page's own `POST /invoices/:id/change-orders` also fires the alert on create (invoice-controller/mod.ts:221-226). The RCA's claim that the hand-made path "waits for Send" does not hold, and that path is unchanged here because it is out of this issue's scope.
**Requirement:**
- A chat change order is created **unsent**. Its outcome carries `sent: false`, and the reply (`chatCoordinator.changeOrder.createdNotSent`, en + es) says it has not been sent to the customer yet.
- The newest reply offers three actions: **Send CO-00N** (the one solid primary), **Open CO-00N as customer** (the preview) and **Copy CO-00N link** (both outlined).
- The customer is emailed and texted only when the contractor says so:
  - in the same message ("… and send it to her", "email it to Dana", "mándasela"), read by `asksToSendChangeOrder` using parseSendInvoiceAsk's cues per clause, so "not yet" and "later" are not a send;
  - or afterwards, with the Send button's words "Send CO-001" / "Enviar CO-001", or "send it to her" right after the unsent reply (`parseSendChangeOrderAsk` + `liveUnsentChangeOrder`, then `ApplyChatChangeOrder.send`).
- A send reports delivery in REQ-456's wording, with `sent: true`.
- Only a pending change order of the contractor's own is sent.
**Tests:**

  - `jest/unit/chat-change-order-link.test.ts` ("REQ-652 M8 …"): `unsent` flag, `liveChangeOrderSendId`, AsstChat `msg-co-send` → `sendText`, en/es keys.

  - amended: REQ-238 M27 now expects no alert and `sent: false`; both REQ-456 tests now say "Send it to her." and expect `sent: true`.
- e2e: `e2e/chat-change-order-no-autosend/chat-change-order-no-autosend.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-652 M8 (cycle 5): 'Make a change order' in chat makes it unsent with Send / Preview / Copy link; tapping Send CO-00N sends it to the customer").

**Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none". **Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Pair 7 (fleet-6 stdout:219/310): "please put the job details in spanish on the agreement too" got "The job details already say that — nothing changed." `jobDetailsChangeLine` found no language that changed (the Spanish copy already existed behind Preview's Español toggle) and did not say where it was.

A bound quote that belongs to, or names, someone else is never the fallback for another name. When an update to the job details changes nothing but carries another language the quote already has, the reply says where it is: en "The Spanish job details are already on the agreement — switch Preview to Español to see them.", es "Los detalles del trabajo en inglés ya están en el acuerdo: cambia la vista previa a English para verlos."
